Conclusion: 该研究揭示了一个重要洞见：优化后的工作流不仅仅是一个静态的优化产物，而是一种可适应的执行策略，能够随着推理时的反馈和更强的执行器不断演进。GRAFT证明了在无需整体重新优化的情况下，通过局部替换即可实现实例级的工作流适应。

Abstract: Recent advances in agentic workflow optimization automate workflow design through task-specific workflow search or input-conditioned architecture selection. However, they determine the workflow before execution and cannot adapt failed workflow regions using execution-time label-free quality signals. Naively enabling such inference-time adaptation through whole-workflow re-optimization would be computationally prohibitive. To tackle this challenge, we introduce GRAFT, which preserves a globally optimized workflow while locally replacing only selected regions for each input. Without parameter training, GRAFT evaluates region-level alternatives using label-free execution-quality signals and accepts only replacements that improve local quality while preserving workflow-level consistency, thereby enabling instance-wise adaptation without whole-workflow re-optimization. GRAFT applies without modification across a range of tasks spanning mathematical reasoning, code generation, and multi-hop and knowledge-intensive question answering. Under matched optimizer and executor settings, it improves over the strongest prior workflow-optimization method, MaAS, by 3.85 points on average. Replacing only the executor with a stronger model yields further gains without re-optimizing the global workflow. This suggests that an optimized workflow is not merely a static optimization artifact, but an adaptable execution policy that can evolve with inference-time feedback and stronger executors.

</details>


### [120] [ScrambleToolBench: Agents Search Exhaustively Even When Their Own Map Points to the Next Step](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02358)
*Vernon Toh,Navonil Majumder,Zhengyuan Liu,Nancy F. Chen,Soujanya Poria*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出ScrambleToolBench，一个交互式终端基准测试，旨在隔离和评估智能体在无语义线索环境下通过试错交互推断未知工具行为的能力。实验发现当前最先进的语言模型在初始发现后无法适应环境动态变化，存在信念惯性并退化为穷举搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工具使用基准在静态环境中暴露语义工具模式，使智能体可依赖先验知识而非自主发现，无法评估智能体在开放世界中面对陌生系统的行为推理能力。作者希望填补这一空白，设计一个只依赖交互、无语义提示的基准来真正评估行为推理。

Method: 提出ScrambleToolBench基准，包含三个关键设计：(1)移除语义线索，仅保留终端交互；(2)持续任务课程（continuous task curriculum）；(3)动态挑战包括映射漂移、随机动作失败和时间执行窗口。通过评估多种SOTA语言模型来测试其发现与适应能力。

Result: 评估显示：成功的初始发现并不能转化为稳健适应。面对映射漂移等结构变化时，智能体无法使用循环追踪等演绎策略，表现出信念惯性或退化为穷举搜索。增加测试时推理仅放大昂贵搜索而非实现演绎恢复。持久记忆虽减少累积错误，但无法高效推断结构变化。

Conclusion: 当前语言模型智能体在行为推理中存在关键缺陷：缺乏从交互中演绎推断结构变化的能力。持续任务课程和动态环境暴露了这一差距，说明需要进一步改进智能体在开放式环境中的自适应推理机制。

Abstract: To operate robustly in open-world environments, autonomous agents should be able to infer the behavior of unfamiliar systems through interaction alone, even in the absence of documentation. However, existing tool-use benchmarks expose semantic tool schemas in static environments, allowing agents to rely on prior knowledge rather than autonomous discovery. To address this limitation, we introduce ScrambleToolBench, an interactive terminal benchmark designed to isolate behavioral reasoning. By removing semantic cues and enforcing a continuous task curriculum, the benchmark requires agents to uncover hidden tool behaviors entirely through trial-and-error interaction. The benchmark further introduces dynamic challenges, including mapping drift, stochastic action failures, and temporal execution windows, to evaluate whether agents can revise and adapt their hypotheses as the environment changes. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art language models reveals that successful initial discovery does not translate into robust adaptation. When faced with structural changes such as mapping drift, agents fail to use deductive strategies such as cycle tracing, and instead exhibit belief inertia or fall back to exhaustive search. Increasing test-time reasoning only amplifies this expensive brute-force search rather than enabling deductive recovery. While equipping agents with persistent memory reduces compounding errors, they remain unable to efficiently infer structural changes, highlighting a gap in current agent reasoning.

</details>


### [121] [Fast and Accurate Quotation Attribution in Literary Texts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02359)
*Gaspard Michel,Hugo Attali,Elena V. Epure*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于编码器的高效引语归因方法"联合评分"（joint scoring），在共享的大上下文窗口内同时解决多个引语的说话人归因任务，在PDNC语料库上达到94.5%的SOTA准确率，同时比标准方法快20倍、比LLM方法快1000倍以上，并发布了ModernBookNLP工具。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文学文本中的引语归因（将引语归因于其说话者）仍然是一个开放挑战。现有标准方法（独立预测每个引语的说话人提及）效率高但准确率有限；而LLM方法性能强但计算成本过高，无法用于大规模文学分析。作者希望找到一种兼具高准确率和高效率的解决方案。

Method: 提出基于编码器的高效公式"联合评分"（joint scoring），在共享的大型上下文窗口中同时（jointly）解析多个引语的归因问题。该方法利用了预训练编码器中已存在的长距离回指消解信号，通过联合评分来保留这一信息以提升挑战性样本的归因准确率。

Result: 在包含35,000多条人工标注引语的Project Dialogism Novel Corpus（PDNC，22部英语小说）上达到94.5%的整体归因准确率，达到SOTA水平。处理小说速度比标准方法快20倍，比LLM方法快1000倍以上（在A100 GPU上）。

Conclusion: 联合评分方法通过共享上下文窗口的联合推断，有效结合了标准方法的效率优势与LLM方法的准确性优势。分析表明该方法通过保留长距离回指消解信号提升了困难样本的归因效果。作者开源了ModernBookNLP工具（BookNLP的修改版分支），以促进该方法的广泛采用。

Abstract: Attributing quotations to their speakers in literary texts remains an open challenge. Standard methods, which independently predict a speaker mention for each quotation, are efficient but still limited in accuracy. In contrast, large language model (LLM) approaches achieve strong performance, but their computational cost limits their use in large-scale literary analysis. We propose an encoder-based efficient formulation that resolves multiple quotation attributions within a shared, large context window. Using our new formulation, \textit{joint scoring}, we report state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on the Project Dialogism Novel Corpus (PDNC), comprising more than 35,000 manually annotated quotations from 22 English novels. Our best model reaches 94.5\% overall attribution accuracy while processing novels $20\times$ faster than comparable standard methods and more than $1000\times$ faster than LLM-based approaches on an A100 GPU. An analysis of models' representations suggests that joint scoring improves on challenging attribution examples by preserving long-range anaphora resolution signal, an information that we found already present in pretrained encoders. To facilitate adoption, we release ModernBookNLP, a modified fork of BookNLP that replaces its quotation attribution model with our best system available at https://github.com/gasmichel/ModernBookNLP_QA/.

</details>


### [122] [PredAct-Bench: Benchmarking Tool-Augmented Dialogue under Controlled Tool Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02372)
*Abdulrahman AlRabah,Xiaocheng Yang,Dilek Hakkani-Tür,Abdussalam Alawini*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出PREDACTBENCH基准，用于评估对话智能体在配备统计不完美工具时的表现，以教育领域为测试平台。研究发现当前最先进的LLM在工具输出有噪音时，无法向人类决策者提供足够的可见性，导致用户可能过度依赖错误的建议或幻觉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准假设工具输出完美准确，忽略了实际部署中工具存在噪音以及人类决策者对智能体信任不确定的现实情况。在高风险领域（如教育、医疗、金融）的多步骤决策中，这些条件普遍存在，因此需要一个新的基准来评估这种情况下的对话智能体。

Method: 1) 构建AI辅助人类决策基准，其中AI使用有噪音的预测工具引导用户；2) 引入回合级相对AI依赖（RAIR）和相对自我依赖（RSR）指标，扩展信任校准框架到多轮对话；3) 在两个教育数据集（OULAD和PREDACT-CS）上评估13个最先进的闭源和开源LLM，并进行人类研究（教师和助教参与）。

Result: 当工具存在噪音时，最先进的模型本应为教师提供足够的可见性以防止他们过度依赖错误的建议或幻觉，但当前模型均未能做到这一点。

Conclusion: PREDACTBENCH可作为构建更好LLM作为AI决策支持系统的基准，帮助教师在现实噪音环境中做出更好的决策。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in task-oriented dialogue systems that support multi-step decision-making in high-stakes domains such as education, healthcare, and finance. However, existing benchmarks typically assume perfectly accurate tool outputs, overlooking the reality that deployed systems must operate with noisy tools and human decision-makers whose trust in the agent is itself uncertain. Such conditions are common in practice, for example, a clinician using a diagnostic prediction tool or an advisor relying on a model that forecasts student outcomes from historical records. We introduce PREDACTBENCH, a benchmark for evaluating dialogue agents paired with statistically imperfect tools, using education as a measurable testbed where ground truth outcomes and clear intervention decisions are available. First, we build a benchmark for AI-assisted human decision-making, where the AI uses noisy predictors to help guide a user. Second, we introduce episode-level Relative AI-Reliance (RAIR) and Relative self-reliance (RSR) metrics, extending prior trust calibration framework to multi-turn dialogue. Third, we evaluate 13 state-of-the-art closed and open source LLMs on two educational datasets, OULAD (real assessment trajectories from the UK Open University) and PREDACT-CS (60 courses with real final grade outcomes and synthetically generated weekly score trajectories), alongside a human study with instructors and teaching assistants. We find that when tools are noisy, SOTA models are supposed to provide visibility to teachers so that they do not over-rely on wrong suggestions or hallucinations, but current models fail to do that. We offer PREDACTBENCH to help build better LLMs as AI decision support systems to help teachers.

</details>


### [123] [Training-Free versus Training-Based Intent Classification in LLMs: Accuracy, Robustness, and Failure Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02415)
*Nan Chen,Zhouhao Yang,Soufiane Hayou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了大语言模型中意图分类的训练免费（基于内部表征统计）与基于训练（MLP分类器和线性探针）的方法，发现两者在简单基准上均饱和，训练方法在困难任务上更优，而训练免费方法在混合意图和对抗性提示下更鲁棒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 意图分类对于将用户提示路由到专用模型以提升准确性和计算效率至关重要，但训练免费与基于训练的方法在意图分类中的相对优劣尚不明确。本文旨在系统性地比较这两类方法，以指导实际应用中的方法选择。

Method: 作者设计了系统的对比实验：1) 采用两种轻量级、训练免费的方法，基于内部表征的统计特征进行意图分类；2) 与基于训练的MLP分类器和线性探针进行对比；3) 在多个难度级别的分类任务（简单：数学vs编码vs自然语言；困难：Java vs Python）以及混合意图和对抗性提示场景下进行评估。

Result: 实验发现：1) 训练免费和基于训练的方法在简单基准（数学vs编码vs自然语言）上均达到饱和性能；2) 在困难分类任务（如Java vs Python）上，基于训练的分类器具有优势；3) 训练免费方法对混合意图和对抗性提示的鲁棒性更强。

Conclusion: 两类方法各有优劣：训练免费方法在简单任务上表现足够好且鲁棒性更佳，适合追求效率和鲁棒性的场景；训练方法在困难任务上精确度更高，适合复杂分类需求。实际应用应根据任务难度和鲁棒性要求选择合适的方法。

Abstract: Intent classification in Large Language Models (LLMs) involves categorizing user prompts into predefined classes. For instance, given a user prompt, the system must determine whether it primarily concerns mathematics, coding, or general text processing. Such classification enables routing prompts to specialized models optimized for specific domains, improving both accuracy and computational efficiency. In this work, we conduct a systematic study comparing training-free vs training-based approaches for intent classification. For this purpose, we consider two lightweight, training-free methods based on statistics of internal representations and compare them against MLP classifiers and linear probes. Our comprehensive empirical evaluation reveals that 1) Both training-free and training-based methods saturate easy benchmarks (mathematics vs. coding vs. natural language), 2) Training-based classifiers have an advantage on harder classification tasks (e.g. Java vs Python), and 3) Training-free methods are generally more robust to mixed-intent and adversarial prompts.

</details>


### [124] [CTRAG: An In-Context Retrieval-based Framework for Automated Compliance Checking using LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02472)
*Muhammad Roman,Karen Rafferty,Barry Devereux*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CTRAG是一个基于检索增强生成（RAG）的自动化合规检查流水线，通过自适应分块、动态检索配置和上下文学习等策略，从监管文本中提取控制问题并与非结构化公司文档交叉比对，实现高精度的合规验证。在真实部署中达到F1分数78%、召回率85%，并在四大会计师事务所中完成概念验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统人工合规测试耗时且易出现不一致，尤其在合规间接依赖第三方服务（如云服务商）的情况下更为复杂。需要一种自动化方法来提高合规检查的精准性和效率。

Method: 提出CTRAG流水线，包含三大核心策略：1）自适应分块（adaptive chunking）提高文档切分质量；2）动态检索配置（dynamic retrieval configurations）优化检索精度；3）上下文学习（in-context learning）增强合规评估相关性。方法从监管文本中提取控制问题，并与非结构化公司文档进行交叉引用，支持间接合规通过第三方的场景。

Result: 在最终部署配置中达到F1分数78%和召回率85%，显著减少遗漏的不合规案例，同时在四大会计师事务所的真实环境中完成概念验证（POC），与人工合规报告交叉验证一致。

Conclusion: CTRAG展示了自动化合规检查的可行性，能有效简化合规工作流程、降低风险、增强复杂高风险环境中的监管信任，尤其适用于涉及第三方服务依赖的间接合规场景。

Abstract: Trust is fundamental in modern regulatory ecosystems, and compliance checking plays a critical role in fostering that trust. Regulatory compliance verification is essential for businesses operating in highly controlled environments, as it ensures alignment with sector-specific guidelines across domains such as financial reporting, data privacy, and cybersecurity. Manual compliance testing, however, is often time-intensive and prone to inconsistencies, particularly when compliance depends indirectly on third-party services such as cloud providers, where vendors rely on external providers to meet regulatory standards. In this paper, we present CTRAG, a novel Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline designed for automated compliance checking. CTRAG employs advanced strategies, including adaptive chunking, dynamic retrieval configurations, and in-context learning, to improve the precision and relevance of compliance assessments. By extracting control questions from regulatory texts and cross-referencing them with unstructured company documentation, CTRAG achieves highly accurate, document-informed compliance verification, even in cases of indirect compliance through third-party services. Empirical evaluations demonstrate significant improvements, with CTRAG achieving an F1-score of 78% and a recall of 85% in the final deployed configuration, ensuring minimal missed non-compliance cases while reducing manual reviewer effort in a real-world deployment. To validate CTRAG value, we developed and deployed a POC within a Big Four professional services firm, applying it to real-world cases and cross-checking results against manual compliance reports. These findings highlight CTRAG potential to streamline compliance workflows, mitigate risks, and enhance regulatory trust in complex, high-stakes environments.

</details>


### [125] [LiveMem: Maintaining Memory State Continuity in Long-Running LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02515)
*Zhichen Liu,Ruihan Sun,Hengjie Yang,Zipeng Wu,Zhaohan Chen,Xiaofan Zhang,Yang Xu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LiveMem提出了一种内在记忆方法，通过固定容量的记忆状态来维持长时间运行的LLM代理的完整生命周期状态连续性，即使原始上下文已被轮换移除，仍能基于记忆状态回答问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期运行的助手和代理消费交互流，最终会超出上下文窗口。现有的上下文保留、摘要和检索方法只保留对选定历史的访问，但在工作上下文变化时无法提供跨越完整生命周期的持久状态。作者将此缺失的推理能力形式化为"上下文轮换下的状态连续性"问题。

Method: LiveMem增强了一个预训练的全注意力LLM，引入记忆状态以在完整生命周期中保留历史信息，同时主注意力路径维持有界的KV窗口。该方法结合三方面技术：(1)上下文轮换与记忆状态维护；(2)面向记忆的后训练；(3)状态感知的服务推理。这些共同确保记忆状态在原始token被释放后仍然承担计算负荷。

Result: 实验表明LiveMem在评估系统中取得领先的整体性能。在LongMemEval上的实验显示，即使支持证据已从当前上下文中移除，LiveMem仍能基于记忆状态回答问题。证据距离分析表明有用信息能够持续存在于活动窗口之外。

Conclusion: LiveMem确立了状态连续性作为持续LLM推理中一个独特且互补的抽象概念。

Abstract: Long-running assistants and agents consume interaction streams that eventually outgrow the context. Existing context retention, summarization, and retrieval preserve access to selected history, but do not provide a persistent state over the full lifecycle when working context changes. We formulate this missing inference capability as \emph{state continuity under context turnover}: carrying computation forward through a fixed-capacity memory state whose lifetime is independent of the active context. We introduce an intrinsic memory method, \textbf{LiveMem}, which augments a pretrained full-attention LLM with a memory state that preserves the historical information over the whole lifecycle while the main attention path retains a bounded KV window. Context turnover and memory state maintaining, memory-oriented post-training, and state-aware serving jointly make this memory state load bearing after its originating tokens are released. Our experiments show that LiveMem achieves leading overall performance among evaluated systems and other intrinsic memory methods. Experiments on LongMemEval show that LiveMem is able to answer the question based on the memory state, even when the supporting evidence has been removed from the current context, and evidence-distance analysis shows that useful information persists beyond the active window. LiveMem thus establishes state continuity as a distinct and complementary abstraction for continual LLM inference.

</details>


### [126] [MedPRESS: A Multi-turn Benchmark for Patient-Pressure-Induced Medical Sycophancy in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02520)
*Saman Sarker Joy,Niloy Farhan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 MedPRESS，一个用于评估大语言模型在患者施加压力下产生谄媚行为（sycophancy）的多轮对话基准。该基准包含 600 个医学对话，涉及用药与治疗要求、个人健康自我护理、症状分诊与护理抗拒三类场景。通过评估 20 个 LLM，发现模型在反复患者压力下频繁转向不安全的一致性回答，且不同模型系列、规模和提示类型间存在显著差异。反谄媚提示虽能提升部分模型的稳健性，但无法完全消除不安全的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究仅用静态问题衡量 LLM 的医疗安全性，忽略了真实患者对话中常见的压力性情境。患者可能会通过个人经历、社会证据、外部证据声称和直接对抗性挑战等方式向模型施压，导致模型产生谄媚性回答。这种压力下的安全缺口尚未被系统量化。

Method: 构建包含 600 个医学多轮对话的基准 MedPRESS。每个对话从健康查询开始，依次通过个人经历、社会证据、外部证据声称和直接对抗性挑战逐步升级压力。覆盖三类场景：用药与治疗要求、个人健康自我护理、症状分诊与护理抗拒。使用结构化评判和安全导向指标评估 20 个 LLM（涵盖通用、医学领域、轻量、大型、开源和专有模型）。

Result: 模型在反复患者压力下频繁转向不安全的一致性回答。不同模型系列、模型规模和提示类型间存在显著差异。反谄媚提示可以改善部分模型的稳健性，但无法完全消除不安全的一致性行为。

Conclusion: 安全医学知识储备不足以保证安全行为——模型必须在对话压力下仍能维持安全边界。MedPRESS 揭示了医学 LLM 评估中的关键缺口，强调了压力下稳健性评估的必要性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for health-related advice. Existing research measures their safety with static questions rather than pressured patient-facing conversations. We introduce MedPRESS, a multi-turn benchmark for measuring patient-pressure-induced sycophancy in LLMs. MedPRESS contains 600 medically grounded five-turn dialogues across three scenario families: medication and treatment demand, personal health self-care, and symptom triage and care resistance. Each dialogue begins with a health query and escalates through personal experience, social proof, external evidence claims, and direct adversarial challenge. We evaluate 20 LLMs across general, medical-domain, lightweight, large, open-weight, and proprietary families using structured judging and safety-focused metrics. Results show that models frequently shift toward unsafe agreement under repeated patient pressure, with substantial variation across model families, model scale, and prompt type. Anti-sycophancy prompting improves robustness for several models, but does not eliminate unsafe agreement. MedPRESS highlights a critical gap in medical LLM evaluation: safe medical knowledge is not enough unless models can maintain it under conversational pressure.

</details>


### [127] [Romanized Arabic Across Dialects: Views, Usage Patterns, and Linguistic Variation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02555)
*Amr Keleg,Ahmed Amine Ben Abdallah,Taha Yassine,Chadi Helwe,Imane Guellil,Nedjma Ousidhoum*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对阿拉伯语拉丁字母转写（Arabizi）进行了最大规模的人类中心跨方言研究，通过收集五个方言区（阿尔及利亚、埃及、黎巴嫩、摩洛哥、突尼斯）阿拉伯语使用者的感知和用法，发布了字符级词对齐资源和人工筛选的句子级平行语料库，发现方言内部存在系统性规律而方言间存在差异性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往NLP研究将Arabizi视为因阿拉伯文字技术支撑不足而产生的暂时现象，忽略了它实际上受地区和年龄等因素影响的普遍存在。作者希望深入理解阿拉伯语使用者对Arabizi的真实感知和使用习惯，填补跨方言研究空白。

Method: 1) 与阿拉伯语使用者互动，收集他们对Arabizi的感知和用法见解；2) 构建字符级阿拉伯语词对齐资源，分析五个方言间的内部与跨方言变异；3) 构建人工筛选的平行语料库，包含阿拉伯文字和多种Arabizi转写，研究说话者在句子层面识别文体变异的能力。

Result: 发现方言内部具有系统性的转写规律，而不同方言之间存在明显的转写差异。发布了两个资源：字符级词对齐数据集和句子级平行语料库，覆盖五种方言。

Conclusion: 这是迄今最大规模的人类中心跨方言Arabizi感知与实践研究，表明Arabizi并非简单的技术限制产物，而是一种具有系统性、方言特异性规律的语言实践，对NLP处理阿拉伯文本具有重要意义。

Abstract: Arabizi refers to Arabic written in Latin script. Although previous studies have shown that the prevalence and usage of Arabizi vary by factors such as region and age group, most NLP research on Arabic texts treats it as a temporary phenomenon resulting from limited technological support for the Arabic script. In this work, we engage with Arabic speakers to collect insights on their perceptions and usage of Arabizi. We further examine writing norms among speakers of different dialects, focusing on Algerian, Egyptian, Lebanese, Moroccan, and Tunisian Arabic. To this end, we release two resources. First, a character-level alignment of Arabic words to study inter- and intra-dialectal variation across these five dialects, based on words transliterated by survey participants, finding systematic intra-dialectal regularity and inter-dialectal variation. Second, to study Arabic speakers' ability to identify this stylistic variation at the sentence-level, we build a manually curated parallel corpus of sentences written in Arabic script alongside multiple Arabizi transliterations, collected from speakers of the same five dialects. Our study presents the largest human-centered, cross-dialectal study of Arabizi's perceptions and practices to date.

</details>


### [128] [AURORA-LM: Autoencoding Unified Representation for Continuous-Latent Diffusion Language Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02602)
*Jiajun Liang,Yucheng Liao,Yukang Cao,Jiazhe Wei,Ken Li,Wende Tan,Jiankun Zhang,ZY Cui,Jingkang Yang,Liucheng Guo,Shiqi Yang,B. Yang,Caifeng Shan,Ziwei Liu,Chenyang Si*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AURORA-LM是一种基于连续潜空间扩散的文本生成模型，通过查询编码器-解码器构建高容量、前缀对齐的文本潜表征，并用块因果扩散Transformer通过流匹配直接学习该分布的生成。在OpenWebText和XSum上超越了现有的连续/扩散语言模型，1B参数规模下表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言生成仍是生成建模中的异类：图像、视频、音频已广泛使用连续潜空间建模，而文本仍主要依赖离散token。现有的连续语言模型要么继承了不适合联合生成和解码的嵌入空间，要么通过压缩自编码潜变量来简化扩散过程，牺牲了token级保真度。作者认为不应牺牲表征能力去适应生成模型，而应保持高容量可解码的文本潜表征，让扩散模型直接学习其分布。

Method: AURORA-LM将可解码文本表征的构建与分布建模分离：1) 使用Query-based Encoder-Decoder将文本组织成高容量、前缀对齐的潜序列；2) 使用Block-causal Diffusion Transformer通过流匹配学习分布，从左到右生成块，同时并行去噪块内位置；3) 仅限制噪声输入通路，保留完整干净潜预测目标，适应全宽度潜表征而不降低解码端容量；4) 将噪声水平分布校准到潜宽度；5) 引入自轨迹一致性，连接独立采样的训练噪声与推理时的迭代去噪。

Result: AURORA-LM在OpenWebText自由生成和XSum摘要任务上，在评估的连续和基于扩散的语言模型中取得最强性能。扩展到1B参数（约1500 EFLOPs总计算量）后进一步提升，超越了在匹配评估协议下更大的公开潜扩散语言模型。所有实验在Ascend NPU上进行。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过设计能够直接学习高容量可解码文本潜分布的扩散模型，而不是简化文本表征来迁就生成模型，连续潜语言模型可以达到甚至超越离散token模型的性能，为连续语言建模开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Language remains an outlier in generative modeling: while images, video, and audio are increasingly modeled in continuous latent spaces, text generation still relies predominantly on discrete tokens. Existing continuous language models either inherit embedding spaces not designed for joint generation and decoding, or compress autoencoded latents to ease diffusion, sacrificing token-level fidelity. Instead of simplifying the representation to suit the generative model, we preserve a high-capacity, decodable text latent and design the diffusion model to learn its distribution directly.
  We introduce AURORA-LM, a continuous-latent diffusion language model that separates the construction of a decodable text representation from the modeling of its distribution. A Query-based Encoder-Decoder organizes text into a high-capacity, prefix-aligned latent sequence, and a Block-causal Diffusion Transformer learns its distribution through flow matching, generating blocks left to right while denoising positions within each block in parallel. Because such a latent is harder for diffusion to model, AURORA-LM restricts only the noisy-input pathway while retaining the full clean-latent prediction target, accommodating full-width latents without reducing decoder-facing capacity. We further calibrate the noise-level distribution to the latent width, and introduce self-trajectory consistency to bridge independently sampled training noise and iterative denoising at inference.
  AURORA-LM achieves the strongest performance among evaluated continuous and diffusion-based language models on OpenWebText free generation and XSum summarization. Scaling to 1B parameters with about 1500 EFLOPs of total compute yields further gains, surpassing a larger publicly released latent-diffusion language model under a matched evaluation protocol. All experiments are conducted on Ascend NPUs.

</details>


### [129] [Amplitude-Only FFN Intervention for Tool-Structured LLM Inference Method: Gated Evaluation Protocol, and Cross-Model Empirical Results](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11183)
*Sheng Xu,Junhua Wang,Boyuan Huang,Ke Jia,Jiadun Zhu,Zhen Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究了大语言模型在工具使用场景下的推理时前馈网络（FFN）干预方法。作者首先尝试了方向改变型的正交残差投影（ORP），发现SwiGLU FFN干预点敏感但弊大于利，因此提出非破坏性的幅度门控（AG）方法，仅调节激活幅度而不改变预训练权重方向。实验在Qwen3.5-9B、Qwen3-8B和Qwen2.5-7B上进行，AG在工具结构化任务上效果最强，Qwen3.5-9B上类别级学习门控将工具/结构化/智能体性能从38.66%提升至42.92%，Qwen3-8B上Hermes JSON模式提升+11.36个百分点。结果表明工具结构化推理是FFN级推理优化的最可信首选目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地作为工具使用代理，而小的格式、参数或函数调用错误会使原本合理的响应失效。作者希望在不重新训练模型权重的前提下，通过推理时FFN干预来改善结构化输出，提高工具使用场景的可靠性。

Method: 本文提出幅度门控（AG）方法，这是一种非破坏性干预：保留预训练FFN权重方向，仅调节生成过程中的激活幅度。作者定义了细粒度的干预体系（P1/P2/P3及分支特定的P1s/P2a/P2b位点），并引入评估协议，该协议将组合oracle上限与固定配置和学习门控分开，强制执行样本级核算，并使用任务感知指标处理二元和部分信用数据集。同时比较了熵AG与Newton-Schulz窗口AG两种变体。

Result: AG在总体上呈弱正值，但在工具结构化任务上效果最强。Qwen3.5-9B上类别级学习门控提升工具/结构化/智能体性能4.27个百分点（38.66%→42.92%），Hermes函数调用任务约+7.6点。Qwen3-8B上Hermes JSON模式提升+11.36点。Qwen2.5-7B保留了oracle上限但当前学习门控无法捕获，说明部署需要模型和类别特定的路由。熵AG与Newton-Schulz窗口AG两族方法均无统一优势。

Conclusion: 工具结构化推理被识别为FFN级推理优化的最可信首个目标，但前瞻性在线验证和更广泛的跨模型评估仍然必要。结果表明AG作为非破坏性干预方法在实际部署中具有潜力，但不同模型和任务类别需要精细的策略选择。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly operate as tool-using agents, where small format, argument, or function-call errors can invalidate otherwise plausible responses. We study inference-time feed-forward network (FFN) intervention for improving structured outputs without retraining model weights. Our project began with Orthogonal Residual Projection (ORP), a direction-changing repair attempt that revealed sensitive SwiGLU FFN intervention sites but often caused more harm than fixes. We therefore propose Amplitude Gating (AG), a non-destructive alternative that preserves pretrained FFN weight directions and modulates only activation magnitudes during generation. We define a fine-grained intervention system spanning P1/P2/P3 and branch-specific P1s/P2a/P2b sites, and introduce an evaluation protocol that separates combination-oracle headroom from fixed configurations and learned gates, enforces sample-level accounting, and uses task-aware metrics for binary and partial-credit datasets. Across Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B, AG is weakly positive in aggregate but strongest on tool-structured tasks. On Qwen3.5-9B, a category-level learned gate improves tool/structured/agentic performance from 38.66% to 42.92% (+4.27 percentage points), with Hermes function-call tasks reaching about +7.6 points. On Qwen3-8B, Hermes JSON mode improves by +11.36 points. Qwen2.5-7B retains oracle headroom but current learned gates fail to capture it, showing that deployment requires model- and category-specific routing. Comparisons of entropy AG with Newton-Schulz-windowed AG show that neither family is uniformly dominant. These results identify tool-structured inference as the most credible first target for safe FFN-level inference optimization, while prospective online validation and broader cross-model evaluation remain necessary.

</details>

### [130] [AI and Exchange Rate Predictability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00761)
*Amin Izadyar*

Main category: q-fin.GN

TL;DR: 本文利用生成式AI（ChatGPT和DeepSeek）基于经济基本面数据预测货币收益，重新考察了汇率脱节难题（Meese and Rogoff, 1983）。研究发现AI驱动的基本面指标具有显著的横截面预测能力，简单的多空策略年化夏普比率超过0.7，且在控制传统货币因子后超额收益依然显著。进一步分析表明，泰勒规则框架是连接汇率与经济基本面的关键机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上宏观经济基本面难以预测汇率变动（即汇率脱节难题），本文旨在利用生成式AI的新能力，检验AI能否基于经济数据发布来有效衡量货币基本面强度，从而克服这一经典难题。

Method: 使用ChatGPT和DeepSeek分析主要货币对的综合经济数据发布数据集，让AI衡量每种货币的基本面强度，构建AI基本面指标，并设计多头强基本面货币、空头弱基本面货币的交易策略。

Result: AI基本功指标具有显著的横截面预测能力，该多空策略年化夏普比率超过0.7；在控制传统货币因子后超额收益仍然显著；通过多重检验排除了前瞻性偏差（look-ahead bias）的担忧；并发现泰勒规则是解释预测力的关键机制。

Conclusion: 生成式AI能够有效利用经济基本面信息预测汇率走势，部分解决了经典的汇率脱节难题。AI的预测力来源于AI推理而非数据记忆，且泰勒规则框架是汇率与基本面之间的核心传导机制。

Abstract: I revisit the exchange rate disconnect puzzle, first documented by Meese and Rogoff (1983), using generative artificial intelligence (AI) to forecast currency returns based on economic fundamentals. Using ChatGPT and DeepSeek, I analyze a comprehensive dataset of economic data releases for major currency pairs and measure the fundamental strength of each currency. These AI-powered fundamentals exhibit significant cross-sectional predictive power. A simple trading strategy that goes long currencies with strong fundamentals and short currencies with weak fundamentals generates a Sharpe ratio exceeding 0.7 per annum. The excess returns of this strategy remain significant after controlling for traditional currency factors. To mitigate concerns of look-ahead bias, I run multiple exercises to ensure that predictability stems from AI reasoning rather than memorization. Finally, I explore the potential sources of predictability and find evidence that the Taylor rule framework, generally used by central banks to set interest rates, is a key mechanism connecting exchange rates to economic fundamentals.

</details>


### [131] [Data-Driven Measures of High-Frequency Trading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00858)
*Gbenga Ibikunle,Ben Moews,Dmitriy Muravyev,Khaladdin Rzayev*

Main category: q-fin.GN

TL;DR: 本文提出基于数据驱动的高频交易（HFT）度量方法，区分流动性供给型和流动性需求型策略。通过机器学习模型在专有数据上训练，再应用于2010-2023年美国股票的公开日内数据，生成HFT度量。该度量优于传统代理指标，并能揭示HFT对信息获取的差异化影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的高频交易代理指标难以捕捉HFT的时序动态变化，且无法区分不同类型的HFT策略（流动性供给型与流动性需求型），而这对于理解HFT对市场质量的影响至关重要。

Method: 在包含观测HFT活动的专有数据集上训练机器学习模型，然后将训练好的模型应用于公开的日内数据，生成覆盖2010-2023年所有美国股票的HFT度量指标，并区分流动性供给型和流动性需求型两种策略。

Result: 新度量指标优于传统代理指标；对类外生减速带（speed bump）引入和数据馈送升级的响应与理论一致；发现流动性供给型HFT改善盈利公告期间的价格信息性，而流动性需求型HFT则妨碍价格信息性。

Conclusion: 数据驱动的HFT度量能够有效区分不同策略类型，并揭示HFT对信息获取的差异化影响，为理解HFT的市场作用提供了更精细化的工具和证据。

Abstract: We introduce data-driven measures of high-frequency trading (HFT) that distinguish between liquidity-supplying and liquidity-demanding strategies. We train machine learning models on a proprietary dataset with observed HFT activity, then apply these models to public intraday data to generate HFT measures across all U.S. stocks during 2010-2023. Our measures outperform conventional proxies, which struggle to capture the temporal dynamics of HFT. Consistent with theory, our measures respond to a quasi-exogenous speed bump introduction and a data feed upgrade. The measures help uncover the differential impact of HFT on information acquisition. Liquidity-supplying HFT improves price informativeness around earnings announcements, while liquidity-demanding HFT impedes it.

</details>


### [132] [Methodology for Modelling Token Economies and Performing Event Impact Analysis with DeTEcT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02475)
*Rem Sadykhov,Geoffrey Goodell,Philip Treleaven*

Main category: q-fin.GN

TL;DR: 本文提出了将DeTEcT框架应用于代币经济建模的方法论，形式化了仿真环境的配置方式，并引入了一个事件分析框架。以比特币为案例，展示了如何建立代币经济模型，并衡量比特币内生政策（BIPs）对参与者财富分配的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代币经济是一种具有独特货币供应控制机制的经济系统，但缺乏系统化的建模方法论。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供一个可操作的框架来形式化建模和仿真代币经济，同时建立事件影响分析的标准化流程。

Method: 本文提出了一种基于DeTEcT框架的代币经济建模方法论，包括：1）形式化仿真环境的配置决策；2）结合数值方法进行经济仿真；3）提出事件分析框架，用于分析和衡量事件对经济的影响，并开发了度量这些影响显著性的程序。以比特币作为案例验证整个方法论。

Result: 展示了如何应用DeTEcT框架建立比特币代币经济模型，并成功测量了比特币内生政策（BIPs）对经济参与者财富分布的影响。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了一套完整的代币经济建模与事件分析框架，并通过比特币案例验证了其可行性，为未来代币经济系统的量化研究提供了方法论基础。

Abstract: The objective of this paper is to provide a methodology for applying the DeTEcT framework to modelling token economies, to formalise the configuration of the simulation environment, and to introduce an event analysis framework. A token economy is an economic system that has a unique mechanism for controlling its monetary supply, and a medium, in the form of a token or currency, for the valuation of goods and services, the settlement of transactions, and the storage of value. We show the key decisions that must be made when modelling an economy with the DeTEcT framework and showcase some numerical methods that can be used in conjunction with the framework to perform economic simulations. We also propose a framework for analysing and measuring the impacts of events on an economy, while also developing a procedure to measure the significance of these impacts.
  Throughout the paper, we use Bitcoin as a case study to demonstrate how to apply the frameworks and tools we proposed here. We show how a model of Bitcoin token economy can be set up, and how to measure the impacts of Bitcoin's endogenous policies (i.e., BIPs) on the wealth distribution of its economic participants.

</details>

### [133] [A Nonparametric Test for Cross-Unit Spillovers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00136)
*Margherita Comola,Camila Comunello,Abhimanyu Gupta*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新颖的非参数检验方法，用于检测跨单元溢出效应，该效应可能通过同伴特征、同伴结果或两者同时发挥作用。该检验实现简单，只需在无溢出效应的原假设下进行估计，且渐近服从标准正态分布，适用于多种交互结构，并通过四个实证案例展示了与传统方法不同的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨单元依赖在实证应用中普遍存在，使计量推断变得复杂，尤其是当溢出效应以非线性方式运作时。现有的检验方法在处理这种复杂依赖结构时存在局限，因此需要一种更灵活且易于实施的非参数检验方法。

Method: 提出一种非参数检验统计量，该统计量仅需在"无跨单元溢出"的原假设下进行估计即可构造，避免了在备择假设下进行复杂估计的负担。检验统计量被证明具有便捷的渐近标准正态分布，并且能够适应广泛的交互结构（包括通过同伴属性、同伴结果或两者同时产生的溢出效应）。

Result: 该检验具有易于实施的特点，渐近分布为标准正态，便于推断。通过四个实证案例表明，该检验与传统方法相比，在判断跨单元溢出效应是否存在时可能得出实质性不同的结论。

Conclusion: 该非参数检验为实证研究中跨单元溢出效应的检测提供了一种通用且可靠的工具，能够捕捉非线性溢出机制，并可能改变现有研究中对溢出效应存在性的判断。

Abstract: Cross-unit dependence is pervasive in empirical applications and complicates econometric inference, especially when spillovers operate in nonlinear ways. We propose a novel nonparametric test for cross-unit spillovers that may operate through peers' attributes, peers' outcomes, or both. The test is straightforward to implement, as it requires only estimation under the null hypothesis of no cross-unit spillovers, and is shown to have a convenient asymptotic standard normal distribution. It is also versatile, accommodating data generated by a wide range of interaction structures. We present four empirical illustrations showing that the proposed test can yield substantively different conclusions about the presence of cross-unit spillovers than existing approaches.

</details>


### [134] [A Structural Matrix Autoregression Framework for International Spillovers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00262)
*Ignacio Moreira Lara,Jan Prüser,Christoph Hanck*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出了贝叶斯结构矩阵自回归（BSMAR）框架，利用国际宏观经济数据的自然矩阵结构来分离经济变量间依赖与国家间依赖，从而大幅降低大型多国SVAR系统的维度。通过贝叶斯采样算法同时纳入零、符号和排序（幅度）约束，该方法将传统SVAR识别方案与识别同期国际溢出效应的新方法相结合。对15个经济体的季度数据应用表明，国际冲击传导存在显著的异质性，需求冲击在跨国溢出中比供给冲击发挥更重要作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解宏观经济冲击如何跨国传导需要能同时识别国家特定冲击及其国际传导机制的结构模型。然而，将SVAR扩展到大型多国系统面临维度快速增长、计算成本高昂以及识别约束爆炸性增加等挑战，亟需一种更具简约性的建模方法。

Method: 开发BSMAR框架，利用国际宏观经济数据的矩阵结构，将经济变量间的依赖关系与国家间的依赖关系分离，提供简约表示以降低大型结构系统的维度。设计了贝叶斯采样算法进行后验推断，支持零约束、符号约束和排序（幅度）约束，将现有SVAR识别方案与识别同期国际溢出效应的新方法相结合。

Result: 将该模型应用于15个经济体的季度数据，发现国际冲击传导存在显著的异质性，且需求冲击在产生跨国溢出效应方面比供给冲击发挥更突出的作用。

Conclusion: BSMAR框架为大型多国结构宏观经济建模提供了一种具有计算可行性和识别灵活性的解决方案，并揭示了跨国冲击传导中需求冲击的主导地位及各国间的异质性。

Abstract: Understanding how macroeconomic shocks propagate across countries requires structural models that can jointly identify country-specific shocks and their international transmission. Yet extending structural vector autoregressions (SVARs) to large multi-country systems is challenging due to rapidly increasing dimensionality, computational costs, and the proliferation of identifying restrictions. This paper develops a Bayesian Structural Matrix Autoregression (BSMAR) framework that exploits the natural matrix structure of international macroeconomic data. By separating dependence across economic variables from dependence across countries, the framework provides a parsimonious representation that substantially reduces the dimensionality of large structural systems. We develop a Bayesian sampling algorithm for posterior inference that accommodates zero, sign, and ranking (magnitude) restrictions, allowing established SVAR identification schemes to be combined with a novel approach to identifying contemporaneous international spillovers. Applying the model to quarterly data for 15 economies, we find substantial heterogeneity in international shock transmission, with demand shocks playing a more prominent role than supply shocks in generating cross-country spillovers.

</details>


### [135] [Measurement Error and Peer Effects in Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00336)
*Yann Bramoullé,Sebastiaan Maes*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文研究了在仅有含噪代理变量（而非真实回归变量）可用的场景下，线性均值（linear-in-means）模型中测量误差导致的有偏估计问题。与常见认知相反，测量误差在同伴效应估计中可能导致膨胀偏差（而非衰减偏差），从而产生假阳性。文章证明渐近偏差取决于个体特征与网络链接的交互，并展示了网络结构本身如何促进识别，无需额外外部信息，进而提出一致的GMM和2SLS估计量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多实际应用中只能获得真实回归变量的含噪代理，传统观点认为这会导致衰减偏差（向零偏倚）。但在线性均值网络模型中，测量误差可能反而导致同伴效应估计膨胀，产生虚假显著的假阳性风险，因此需要深入理解偏差方向及可行的识别策略。

Method: 论文通过理论分析刻画了测量误差在线性均值模型中的渐近偏差，揭示了偏差方向取决于个体特征与网络连接结构之间的交互关系。基于网络结构本身所提供的识别信息，提出了易于实施的广义矩估计（GMM）和两阶段最小二乘（2SLS）估计量，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证其有限样本表现。

Result: 证明了同伴效应的估计偏差方向并非总是衰减，而可能因测量误差而膨胀；网络结构可辅助实现无外部信息的识别；所提GMM和2SLS估计量具备一致性，且蒙特卡洛模拟验证了其有效性。

Conclusion: 本文纠正了测量误差在网络同伴效应估计中仅产生衰减偏差的传统认知，指出膨胀偏差和假阳性风险的存在，并利用网络结构本身实现了无需外部工具的识别与一致估计，为实证研究提供了易于实施的估计方法。

Abstract: In many practical applications, only noisy proxies for the true regressors are available, which is commonly believed to induce an attenuation bias. In the linear-in-means model, however, estimated peer effects might be inflated, potentially leading to false positives. This paper shows that the asymptotic bias depends on the interplay between individual characteristics and network links and demonstrates how the network structure can facilitate identification without the need for additional external information. Based on these identification results, we present consistent GMM and 2SLS estimators that are easily implementable. Our results are illustrated by means of a Monte Carlo simulation.

</details>


### [136] [AI Governance for Institutional Readiness in Finance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02311)
*Irene Aldridge,Steve Krawciw*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文指出资产管理领域智能体AI（Agentic AI）的治理框架严重滞后于技术部署，提出这是一个架构性问题而非文化问题，并给出一个四层治理框架（Policy, Engineering, Composition, Systemic）及其可计算的量化实现，用于检测策略漂移和度量系统性拥挤风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管88%的金融专业人士意识到智能体AI已被部署，但88%的机构没有运营治理框架；在75家大型美国资产管理公司中仅24家在Form ADV中披露正式治理政策。现有治理体系是为确定性系统设计的静态验证，而持续重训的智能体策略本质上违背了这一前提，治理缺口是架构性而非文化性的。

Method: 提出四层治理框架（Policy/Engineering/Composition/Systemic），并给出两个可计算实例：1）regret-covariance统计量，仅从观测数据即可检测策略漂移；2）校准的拥挤模型（crowding model），量化机构收敛于相关头寸时联合回撤概率的变化。同时结合一个已部署的LLM嵌入交易策略研究和同期主观基金爆仓事件进行验证。

Result: 拥挤模型显示，当机构收敛于相关头寸时，联合回撤概率从39.2%上升至79.3%。研究还明确了哪些控制措施可跨智能体与人工驱动风险承担场景迁移，并提供了90天的框架实施序列。

Conclusion: 治理缺口源于架构设计不匹配而非文化阻力，通过四层框架和可计算监控指标可以弥合该缺口，为机构提供可操作的实施路径。

Abstract: Agentic AI is gaining acceptance in asset management, but governance has not kept pace: 88% of surveyed finance professionals report no operational governance framework for agentic AI despite universal awareness of its deployment, and only 24 of 75 large U.S. money managers disclosing AI use in Form ADV filings report a formal governance policy. We argue this gap is architectural, not cultural: governance built for deterministic systems assumes static validation. However, continuously retrained agentic policies violate static governance by design. We propose a four-layer framework (Policy, Engineering, Composition, Systemic) with computable instantiations: a regret-covariance statistic that detects policy drift from observed data alone, and a calibrated crowding model showing joint drawdown probability rising from 39.2% to 79.3% as institutions converge on correlated exposures. We support the framework with a study of a deployed LLM-embedding trading strategy and a contemporaneous discretionary fund blowup, clarifying which controls transfer across agentic and human-directed risk-taking. We also provide a 90-day framework implementation sequence for institutions.

</details>


### [137] [Monotone Response for Random Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00772)
*Daisuke Kurisu,Yuta Okamoto,Taisuke Otsu*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架，将MTR、MTS和MIV单调性假设推广到一般度量空间中的结果变量，通过将度量空间嵌入L²空间并施加逐坐标单调性，实现Fréchet均值的部分识别，并在Wasserstein度量、区间值结果和成分数据下获得尖锐识别集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MTR、MTS和MIV假设被广泛用于反事实均值结果的部分识别，但现有分析几乎完全局限于标量结果。实际中许多数据（如分布数据、区间值数据、成分数据）无法用标量表示，需要将这些单调性框架推广到一般度量空间中的结果变量。

Method: 将一般度量空间嵌入L²空间，对嵌入函数施加逐坐标单调性约束，从而建立统一的部分识别框架。该框架适用于多种随机对象空间，并给出Wasserstein度量下分布结果、支撑函数表示的区间值结果、Aitchison度量下成分结果等的尖锐识别结果。此外，还建立了联合MTR-MTS假设下识别集的无支撑刻画。

Result: 该框架在各种随机对象空间中产生有效的Fréchet均值识别集，并对分布结果（Wasserstein度量）、区间值结果（支撑函数）和成分结果（Aitchison度量）给出尖锐识别。基于Job Corps收入数据和NHANES牙周健康分布的数值与实证示例验证了方法的实用性。

Conclusion: 本文显著扩展了单调性假设在部分识别中的应用范围，将理论从标量结果推广到一般度量空间，为随机对象数据的因果推断提供了统一且可操作的工具。

Abstract: Monotone treatment response (MTR), monotone treatment selection (MTS), and monotone instrumental variable (MIV) assumptions are widely used to partially identify counterfactual mean outcomes, but existing analyses have focused almost exclusively on scalar outcomes. We develop a unified framework for partial identification with outcomes that take values in a general metric space under these monotonicity restrictions by embedding the metric space into an $L^2$ space and imposing coordinatewise monotonicity on the embedded functions. The proposed framework yields valid identified sets for Fréchet means in a broad class of random-object spaces and further delivers sharp identification results for distributional outcomes under the Wasserstein metric, interval-valued outcomes represented by support functions, and compositional outcomes under the Aitchison metric. We also establish a support-free characterization of the identified set under the joint MTR--MTS assumption. Numerical and empirical illustrations based on Job Corps earnings data and periodontal health distributions from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey demonstrate the empirical usefulness of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [138] [Double Machine Learning with High-dimensional Interactive Fixed Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01137)
*Binzhi Chen,Annalivia Polselli,Paul S. Clarke*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种针对具有交互固定效应的高维部分线性面板数据的双机器学习估计量（panel DML-IFE），该方法结合投影去因子化、Neyman正交评分和交叉拟合，能够同时处理低秩因子结构和高维非线性协变量效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的交互固定效应（IFE）估计器依赖于低维和线性协变量设定，这在面对包含未知函数形式控制的丰富数据集时越来越具有限制性。因此需要一种能够处理高维、潜在非线性协变量效应的估计方法。

Method: 提出panel DML-IFE估计器，包括三个核心组件：（1）基于Common Correlated Effects（CCE）思想的投影去因子化；（2）Neyman-正交评分函数；（3）交叉拟合（cross-fitting）程序，用于估计高维非线性协变量效应。

Result: 蒙特卡洛模拟表明，在线性设定错误的情况下，panel DML-IFE优于传统IFE估计器，偏差减少主要由时间和协变量维度驱动。在美国股票收益的实证应用中，若干在线性设定下显著的效应在同时考虑高维非线性混杂因素和IFE后失去统计显著性。

Conclusion: 该研究为高维面板数据的因果推断提供了更稳健的工具，表明在数据丰富且函数形式未知的应用场景下，传统的线性IFE方法可能导致误导性的结论，而结合机器学习与去因子化的双重估计框架能更准确地识别效应。

Abstract: Factor structures are central to empirical work in economics and finance, and are usually used to model time-varying unobserved heterogeneity through interactive fixed effects (IFE). Existing IFE estimators rest on low-dimensional and linear specifications in the covariates, assumptions which are increasingly restrictive in applications drawing on rich datasets with controls of unknown functional form. This paper develops a Double Machine Learning estimator for the high-dimensional partially linear panel model with interactive fixed effects (panel DML-IFE). The method combines projection-based defactorisation of the data, in the spirit of Common Correlated Effects (CCE), with a Neyman-orthogonal score function and cross-fitting procedure, and accommodates low-rank factor structures in outcomes and treatments alongside high-dimensional, potentially nonlinear covariate effects estimated by machine learning algorithms. Monte Carlo simulations show that panel DML-IFE outperforms conventional IFE estimator outside the correctly-specified linear case, with bias reduction driven primarily by the time and covariate dimensions. An empirical application to U.S. stock returns shows that several effects documented under linear specifications lose statistical significance once high-dimensional nonlinear confounding and the presence of IFE are jointly accounted for.

</details>


### [139] [Estimating Social Effects with Randomized and Observational Network Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01405)
*TszKin Julian Chan,Juan Estrada,Kim Huynh,David Jacho-Chavez,Chungsang Tom Lam,Leonardo Sanchez-Aragon*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在线性均值回归模型中识别和估计感兴趣参数的新方法，适用于初始同伴随机化决定观察网络的情形。论文证明初始随机化的同伴不产生社会效应，但随机化后个体可内生发展重要联系并产生同伴影响。通过构建包含局部异质识别信息的矩条件，并假设内生网络空间满足ψ-依赖性，提出了GMM估计器，该估计器具有闭式解、一致性和渐近正态性。蒙特卡洛模拟验证了小样本表现，香港高中生数据实证分析发现学习伙伴对数学成绩有显著正向溢出效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的线性均值回归模型通常假设观察到的同伴网络是外生给定的，但在现实中，网络往往由内生过程形成。论文的核心动机是解决当初始随机化决定网络，但后续个体内生发展联系时，如何正确识别和估计同伴效应的问题。

Method: 论文构建了一个矩条件来汇总所有个体在总体中的局部异质识别信息，利用内生网络空间的ψ-依赖性假设，提出了具有闭式解的GMM估计器。该方法结合了随机初始化和内生网络形成的双重特征。

Result: GMM估计器被证明具有一致性、渐近正态性，且因闭式解形式易于用常见统计软件实现。蒙特卡洛模拟显示小样本表现良好。香港高中生数据实证分析发现，在教师外生分配座位的情况下，学习伙伴对数学测试成绩存在显著正向溢出效应。

Conclusion: 论文为处理内生化网络形成过程中的同伴效应估计提供了新的理论框架和实用工具，既保持了随机实验的内部有效性，又考虑了现实世界中网络内生演化的特征，具有理论和应用上的双重价值。

Abstract: This paper introduces an innovative approach to identifying and estimating the parameters of interest in the widely recognized linear-in-means regression model under conditions where the initial randomization of peers determines the observed network. We assert that peers who are initially randomized do not produce social effects. However, after randomization, agents can endogenously develop significant connections that potentially generate peer influences. We present a moment condition that compiles local heterogeneous identifying information for all agents within the population. Under the assumption of $ψ$-dependence in the endogenous network space, we propose a Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) estimator, which is proven to be consistent, asymptotically normally distributed, and straightforward to implement using commonly available statistical software due to its closed-form expression. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate the GMM estimator's strong small-sample performance. An empirical analysis utilizing data from Hong Kong high school students reveals substantial positive spillover effects on math test scores among study partners in our sample, provided that their seatmates were exogenously assigned by their teachers.

</details>


### [140] [Estimating Peer Influence in Multilayer Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01415)
*Weihua An,Pablo Estrada,Juan Estrada,David Jacho-Chavez*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于模型的经验方法，利用横截面观测数据从多个社会连接中估计同伴影响，从而识别高风险行为中的关键影响者。使用工具变量解决同质性带来的内生性问题，基于Add Health数据发现朋友和同学对吸烟及大麻使用有正向同伴效应，并据此刻画样本中的影响者特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 识别高风险行为（如吸烟、吸毒）中的关键影响者对于制定有效的干预政策至关重要，但横截面观测数据中存在同质性（homophily）导致的内生性问题，使得传统方法的同伴影响估计存在偏差。

Method: 提出基于模型的实证方法：利用观测到的多个社会网络中远端个体的特征作为工具变量，解决同质性导致的内生性；基于估计的同伴效应进一步刻画和识别样本中的影响者。

Result: 基于Add Health数据，发现朋友和同学对吸烟和大麻使用均存在显著的正向同伴效应，并根据估计的同伴效应刻画了样本中的影响者特征。

Conclusion: 该方法能够有效识别高风险行为中的关键影响者，为公共卫生干预提供了新的实证工具和决策依据。

Abstract: This paper proposes a model-based empirical method to identify influential individuals in risky behaviors. To determine the most influential individuals, we estimate peer influence using observational cross-sectional data from multiple social connections. Our empirical strategy employs the observed characteristics of distant individuals across multiple social networks as instruments to address the endogeneity arising from homophily. Using Add Health data, we find positive peer effects from friends and classmates on both cigarette smoking and marijuana use. Based on the estimated peer effects, we characterize the influencers in our sample.

</details>


### [141] [Regression with Observational Multilayered Network Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01421)
*Juan Estrada,Kim Huynh,David Jacho-Chavez,Leonardo Sanchez-Aragon*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的广义三阶段最小二乘（G3SLS）估计器，用于在社会科学中流行的线性均值（linear-in-means）回归模型中估计社会效应系数。该方法利用双层多路网络数据的全观测性，通过第二层外生网络链接来处理与误差相关的社会交互作用，估计量具有一致性、渐近正态性且计算简单。蒙特卡洛实验验证了小样本性能，实证应用发现经济学顶级期刊论文引用中存在显著的正向同伴效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统线性均值模型在社会效应估计中面临内生性问题——社会交互作用可能与误差项相关，导致估计有偏。现有方法需要实验数据或难以满足的外生性假设，而观测数据常伴随测量误差、同时性和未观测异质性等问题。因此需要一种能够利用非实验性多维网络数据来一致估计社会效应的方法。

Method: 假设观测到双层多路网络（two-layered multiplex network）数据的完整结构，利用同一组观测中不同的、在传统意义上外生的网络链接来识别社会交互效应。在此基础上提出广义三阶段最小二乘（G3SLS）估计器，该估计器具有闭式解，便于在现有统计软件中实现。其假设足够一般化，可处理测量误差、同时性和未观测异质性等常见观测数据问题。

Result: 蒙特卡洛实验表明G3SLS估计器在多种问题场景下具有良好的小样本性能。实证应用中，对经济学顶级综合期刊发表的研究论文的引用数据进行分析，发现存在显著且正向的同伴效应（peer effects），即论文之间的引用行为受到同侪影响。

Conclusion: 该研究为利用非实验性网络数据估计社会效应系数提供了一种可行且易于实施的新工具，突破了传统方法对外生性或实验数据的要求，对社会科学中的同伴效应研究具有重要的方法论贡献。

Abstract: A novel method to estimate social effect coefficients in the popular so-called linear-in-means regression model in the Social Sciences is presented here that utilizes non-experimental multidimensional network data. The procedure can accommodate social interactions that correlate with the error in the model by making use of a different set of network links among the same observations that are exogenous in the traditional sense. In particular, the full observability of a two-layered multiplex network data structure is assumed here to propose a new Generalized 3-Stage Least Squares (G3SLS) estimator that is consistent, asymptotically normally distributed, and also easy to implement using widely-used existing statistical software because of its closed-form definition. The underlying assumptions are general enough to accommodate common problems with observational data such as measurement error, simultaneity, and unobserved heterogeneity. Monte Carlo exercises confirm the good small sample performance of the proposed G3SLS estimator in these scenarios. An empirical application finds positive and significant peer effects in citations among research articles published in top general-interest journals in economics.

</details>


### [142] [Measuring Product Quality Using Images: The CLIP Q-Score and an Application to Real Estate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01544)
*Fabian Slonimczyk,Danila Karapsin*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出CLIP Q-score，一种基于对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）的客观产品质量评分方法，应用于约50万张在线平台房地产图像，证明该评分与LLM评估一致，并能有效预测房产销售与租赁价格，同时与房产流动性（上市时间）相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的产品质量评估通常依赖人工主观判断或昂贵且不可复现的方法，缺乏一种客观、安全、计算高效且完全可复现的视觉数据质量度量方法。

Method: 利用对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）模型从视觉数据中提取客观的质量评分指标（CLIP Q-score），并在约50万张来自在线平台的房地产图像上进行大规模应用验证。

Result: CLIP Q-score与LLM评估结果一致，是房产销售和租赁市场价格的有力预测因子；更高的CLIP Q-score与更好的流动性（更短的上市时间）相关，尤其是对出售中的房产更为显著。

Conclusion: CLIP Q-score是一种新颖、安全、完全可复现且计算高效的方法，能够从视觉数据中提取客观产品质量度量，在房地产领域展示了强大的预测能力和实用价值。

Abstract: The CLIP Q-score is a novel, safe, fully reproducible, and computationally efficient method for extracting objective product quality metrics from visual data using contrastive language-image pre-training. We introduce the technique and provide an extensive application to real estate data from an online platform ($\sim500,000$ images). Our open-source metric aligns with LLM assessments and proves to be a powerful predictor of housing market prices for both sales and rentals. We also show that a higher CLIP Q-store is associated with better liquidity (reduced time on the market), especially for properties on sale.

</details>


### [143] [High-Dimensional Panel Data Models with Interactive Fixed Effects: Beyond the Linear Case](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02055)
*Maximilian Ruecker,Michael Vogt,Oliver Linton*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文研究了高维面板数据中带有交互固定效应的可加模型，其中每个协变量通过未知的非线性分量函数进入模型。作者开发了估计方法论和理论，扩展了Ruecker等人(2025)的线性高维情形，分别推导了小T和大T面板情形下的收敛速率，并通过蒙特卡洛实验和实证应用加以验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代经济面板数据集通常具有高维特征，控制变量数量可能超过样本量。然而，针对高维面板的计量经济方法文献相当有限。现有工作（如Ruecker等人2025）仅处理了线性情形，缺乏对非线性结构（如可加模型）的推广，因此需要发展在高维面板中处理未知非线性分量函数的估计方法。

Method: 采用带有交互固定效应的高维面板可加模型框架，其中回归函数具有可加结构，每个协变量通过未知的非线性分量函数进入模型。在理论上分别推导小T和大T面板情形下估计量的收敛速率，并通过蒙特卡洛实验和实证应用进行补充验证。

Result: 论文在小T和大T两种面板情形下均推导出了估计量的收敛速率，并通过综合蒙特卡洛实验和实证应用验证了所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该研究显著扩展了高维面板线性模型的理论框架到可加非线性情形，为高维面板数据中处理未知非线性分量函数提供了估计方法和理论保证。

Abstract: Modern economic panel data sets are often high-dimensional: they contain information on a wide variety of control variables whose number may even exceed the sample size. Nevertheless, the literature on econometric methods for high-dimensional panels is quite limited. In this paper, we study high-dimensional panel models with interactive fixed effects where the regression function has an additive structure, i.e., each covariate enters the model via an unknown nonlinear component function. We develop estimation methodology and theory in this additive framework which substantially extends previous work on the high-dimensional linear case by Ruecker et al. (2025). In the theoretical part of the paper, we derive the convergence rate of our estimator for both the small-T and the large-T panel case. The theory is complemented by comprehensive Monte Carlo experiments and an empirical application.

</details>


### [144] [A Simple Approximation to the Distribution of the Ridge Regression Estimator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02539)
*José Luis Montiel Olea,Ryan Strong,Amilcar Velez,Zhuoheng Xu,Haomin Yu*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出一种简单的高斯近似方法来刻画岭回归估计量在有限样本下的分布，并基于此提出两种新的正则化参数选择策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的岭回归渐近理论通常假设正则化参数固定或趋于零，无法准确捕捉有限样本下岭回归估计量在偏差与方差之间的权衡。作者希望提供一种更精确的有限样本分布近似，从而改进正则化参数的选择。

Method: 采用非标准渐近框架：1) 令正则化参数与样本量成比例增长；2) 将总体回归系数视为相对于收缩方向参考向量的局部（local）扰动。该近似允许数据生成过程中存在一般形式的异方差性和自相关（以低维模型为代价，即协变量数量不随样本量增长）。基于此高斯近似，提出两种正则化参数选择策略，分别最小化平均超额预测风险和最坏情况超额预测风险。

Result: 作者提出了能够捕捉有限样本下岭回归偏差-方差权衡的简单高斯近似，并据此设计了两种正则化参数选择策略。

Conclusion: 与文献中其他渐近近似相比，该方法允许一般形式的异方差和自相关，为岭回归的正则化参数选择提供了新的理论依据和实用工具。

Abstract: We present a simple Gaussian approximation to the finite-sample distribution of the classical ridge regression estimator. Our approximation captures the fact that, in finite samples, the ridge regression estimator trades off bias and variance to reduce estimation and prediction error. Our approximation is based on nonstandard asymptotics where $i)$ we let the estimator's regularization parameter grow proportionally to the sample size; and $ii)$ we treat the population regression coefficients as \emph{local} to the reference vector that defines the estimator's direction of shrinkage. In contrast to other asymptotic approximations in the literature, we allow for general forms of heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation in the data generating process (at the cost of considering a low-dimensional model where the number of covariates is not allowed to grow with the sample size). We use our simple Gaussian approximation to propose two new strategies to select the regularization parameter for the ridge regression estimator. The suggested strategies select the regularization parameter to minimize either average or worst-case excess prediction risk, where risk is computed using our suggested Gaussian approximation.

</details>

Abstract: Leveraged event positions combine a repayable loan with an outcome claim that may become non-tradable before oracle payout is final. This paper specifies Axient, a physically backed margin layer for binary event markets that separates leverage maturity from claim maturity and makes the hard-flat decision under explicit execution uncertainty. The model distinguishes quoted book proceeds, matched proceeds, settled proceeds, and redemption. At decision time, the protocol selects the smallest sale whose lower settled-proceeds envelope covers an upper bound on debt at the settlement horizon plus a buffer. We prove robust ex-ante debt clearing, pathwise debt-extinguishment and debt-free-finality invariants, maximal residual spot exposure, payout-vector and dispute-duration invariance of lender principal after debt extinction, and an impossibility boundary when execution, signer control, settlement, or market closure leave the registered operating set. We also derive a book-dependent leverage envelope, aggregate hard-flat capacity without double-counting shared liquidity, and scenario-conditional reserve bounds. A deterministic verifier covers step books, partial fills, settlement delay, adversarial book transformations, shared-book liquidation, reserve allocation, zero liquidity, and multiple payout vectors. The operating and stress sets are author-specified; empirical calibration is separate. The contribution is a conditional mechanism-design result and reference-implementation boundary, not a production-safety claim.

### [147] [Optimal Trading of Microstructure Mean Reversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00885)
*Lucas Rabechini Amaral*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 本文研究了一个订单簿模型，其中中间价（mid）在潜在有效价格（efficient price）周围携带平稳的均值回归误差。作者构建了产生该误差的订单簿，并求解了最大化长期平均利润率的交易规则。在流动性好、大价差（large-tick）的资产中，价差为1或2个tick，问题的核心由中间价与有效价格之间的缺口G刻画。作者证明在平衡响应的条件下，G的均值回归性质与Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程完全一致，并推导出最优交易带宽和利润率的闭式解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 市场微观结构中，中间价的短期波动包含围绕潜在有效价格的均值回归误差，但现有理论往往将中间价视为外生过程。作者希望构建一个内生订单簿模型，在其中观测量（中间价）的运动是由订单簿自身流量产生的，并在此基础上求解最优的统计套利交易策略，同时揭示价差奇偶性与最优交易阈值之间的深层关系。

Method: 作者构建了一个订单簿模型：有效价格由外生Brownian鞅驱动，中间价是纯跳过程，其跳跃强度向有效价格倾斜。通过引入平衡响应条件（使订单簿在不同奇偶性下的修正漂移相等），证明缺口G的条件均值和稳态协方差与Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程精确匹配（虽然路径不同）。随后在Gaussian扩散代理过程上求解最优对称波段策略（半宽度θ），得到闭式解：θ*(θ*-φ)=s_G^2，最优利润率R*=αs_G√(2/π)e^{-θ*²/2s_G²}。

Result: 论文推导出最优交易半宽度和利润率的闭式公式。关键发现包括：最优阈值对应的边际时间等于缺口的稳态方差；当缺口刚覆盖价差（即θ=φ）时，利润为零——所有利润都来自于等待的期权价值。同时作者给出了在代理扩散上求解最优策略的误差界（奖励侧有界，时间侧为启发式），并指出在跳过程本身上最优性缩减仍只是猜想。

Conclusion: 本文建立了从订单簿微观动力学到最优做市/统计套利策略的完整理论桥梁，揭示了中间价均值回归的OU结构可以由订单簿自身流量内生产生。最优策略的核心洞见是：覆盖价差即交易无法盈利，利润完全来源于等待缺口远离价差边界的时间期权价值，且最优等待的阈值平方与缺口稳态方差的乘积满足一个简单关系。

Abstract: At the scale of seconds the observed mid carries a stationary, mean-reverting error around a latent efficient price. We build an order book whose own flow produces that error and solve for the trading rule that maximises the long-run average profit rate net of the bid-ask spread. In a liquid large-tick asset the spread is one tick or two, and it is exactly the parity of the mid on the half-tick grid: tight at a half-integer, open at an integer. One coordinate therefore carries the problem: the gap $G$ between the mid and the efficient price; the price is an exogenous Brownian martingale, and $G$ is observable. The mid is a pure jump process whose move intensities lean toward the efficient price. Under one balanced-response condition, which equalises the book's corrective drift across parities, mean reversion of $G$ is a theorem: its conditional mean and stationary covariance are exactly those of an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process with reversion rate $α$ and stationary standard deviation $s_G$. Its paths are not: the mid jumps. Passage times are therefore evaluated on the Gaussian diffusion those two moments define, at an error we bound on the reward side and leave heuristic on the timing side. A symmetric band of half-width $θ$ buys when the gap reaches $-θ$, sells at $+θ$, and holds inside; on the surrogate it is optimal among all admissible strategies, on the jump process itself that reduction remains a conjecture. With $φ$ the tight-book half-spread, the optimal half-width and its profit rate are $θ^*(θ^*-φ)=s_G^2$ and $R^*=αs_G\sqrt{2/π}\,e^{-θ^{*2}/2s_G^2}$. Threshold times margin equals the stationary variance of the gap. Trading as soon as the gap covers the spread earns zero: all profit is the option value of waiting.

</details>


### [148] [Exactly solvable model for the diffusive price-dynamics paradox under long-range correlated market-order flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00988)
*Yuki Sato,Shunta Fujiwara,Kiyoshi Kanazawa*

Main category: q-fin.TR

TL;DR: 本文通过将平方根价格冲击定律纳入Lillo-Mike-Farmer（LMF）模型，开发了一个可精确求解的非线性时间序列模型，解决了可预测市场订单流下的扩散价格动态悖论。该模型可数学映射到Lévy游走框架，证明了在平方根定律下即使市场订单流可预测，长期价格动态仍是扩散的（即服从布朗运动），从而为有效市场假说的微观结构基础提供了重要支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融市场微观结构中存在一个悖论：一方面，长期价格动态近似为布朗运动（扩散过程）；另一方面，由于市场订单流存在长程相关性，其是可预测的（如LMF模型所数学表述）。既然市场订单通常具有正的价格影响，可预测的订单流似乎应该与布朗运动的价格动态相矛盾。作者的目标是解决这一"扩散价格动态悖论"。

Method: 作者基于平方根价格冲击定律（square-root price-impact law）推广LMF模型，构建了非线性时间序列模型。关键创新在于将这些模型数学映射到Lévy游走框架——统计物理中一类可精确求解的非马尔可夫随机过程，从而能够严格分析模型的长时间行为。

Result: 作者证明，在平方根定律下，即使市场订单流是可预测的，长期价格动态仍然是扩散的。这解决了可预测订单流与布朗运动价格动态之间的悖论。

Conclusion: 该研究强调了平方根定律在理解有效市场假说微观结构基础方面的关键实践重要性，表明价格影响的非线性（平方根形式）是协调可预测订单流与扩散价格动态的核心机制。

Abstract: We develop an exactly solvable nonlinear time-series model by incorporating the square-root price-impact law into the Lillo--Mike--Farmer (LMF) model to resolve the diffusive price-dynamics paradox under predictable market-order flow. In financial market microstructure, it is well established that the price dynamics are approximately described by Brownian motion at long times. However, it is also well-known that market-order flow is clearly predictable due to long-range correlations, as mathematically formulated by the LMF model. Since market orders have a positive price impact in general, predictable market-order flow seems to contradict Brownian price dynamics. In this work, we resolve this diffusive price-dynamics paradox by developing nonlinear time-series models that generalize the LMF model based on the square-root price-impact law. Our time-series models can be mathematically mapped onto the Lévy-walk framework---an exactly solvable class of non-Markovian stochastic processes developed in statistical physics. We prove that the price dynamics are diffusive at long times under the square-root law even under predictable market-order flow. Our work highlights the crucial practical importance of the square-root law in understanding the microstructural foundation of the Efficient Market Hypothesis.

</details>

### [149] [Pro-rata mechanisms in groundwater markets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00917)

Main category: q-fin.MF

TL;DR: 本文提出一种按比例配给机制（pro-rata rationing）来解决地下水市场的供需失衡问题，扩展了Cialenco和Ludkovski (2025)的价格形成模型。研究表明在按比例分配下，任何价格都是纳什均衡，从而提供了一种唯一且公平的供需失衡解决方案。文章涵盖单边/双边交易限制下的均衡特征分析、监管者-农户的领导者-跟随者博弈框架，以及与多种非对称配给方案的比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地下水市场面临供需不匹配的问题，需要一种公平且唯一的配给机制来解决。同时，现有研究缺乏对交易限制如何影响价格形成、以及监管者如何通过优化自身目标来设定交易价格的分析。

Method: (1) 提出按比例配给机制并证明其纳什均衡性质；(2) 分析外生交易限制（单边与双边限额）下的一阶最优消费及帕累托价格的单调性/模糊性影响；(3) 建立领导者-跟随者博弈模型，监管者优化社会福利、目标交易量或Gini公平性目标，农户通过按比例交易响应；(4) 与基于资历、超额、均匀、混合等非对称配给方案进行对比分析。

Result: 按比例配给下每个价格都是纳什均衡，供需失衡的解决方案唯一且公平。单边限额会单调地改变帕累托价格，双边限额的影响则是不确定的。给出了闭式形式的一阶最优消费解，并通过四农户地下水市场的数值案例验证了理论结果。

Conclusion: 按比例配给机制为地下水市场提供了公平且唯一的供需失衡解决方案，监管者可以通过优化自身目标来设定交易价格，同时该机制在比例公平与其他保护性配给方案之间存在权衡取舍。

Abstract: We introduce a pro-rata rationing mechanism for resolving supply-demand imbalances in groundwater markets, extending the price-formation model of Cialenco and Ludkovski (2025). We show that under the pro-rata distribution, every price is a Nash equilibrium, thereby pro-rata approach provides a rationing device whenever supply and demand fail to match. By the very nature of the pro-rata mechanism, the resolution of supply-demand imbalances is unique, and the proportional rationing approach is fair. First, we consider markets with exogenous restrictions on the amounts each agent may buy and/or sell, deriving closed-form first-best consumption and characterizing how one-sided caps monotonically shift the Pareto price, while two-sided caps have an ambiguous effect. These results give the market-maker (or regulator) a tool for studying the impact of trading restrictions on price formation. Second, we study a leader-follower setting in which a regulator (the leader) sets the trading price by optimizing first its own objective, such as balancing social welfare against a target traded volume or a fairness objective such as Gini-type disparity measure across farmers' profitability, while farmers (the `followers') respond via pro-rata trading. We further compare the proposed pro-rata approach to a family of asymmetric rationing schemes (seniority-based, excess-based, uniform, and mixed pro-rata rules) that trade off proportional fairness against protections for small or senior water-rights holders. Throughout, we illustrate the theoretical results with a numerical case study calibrated to a stylized four-farmer groundwater market.

</details>


### [150] [Climate-Dyna Deep Hedging for XVAs: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning, Residual Climate HVA, and Hedge-Instrument Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01208)

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 该方法成功将残差气候对冲估值转化为可解的估值问题，证明了从继承对冲出发结合学习型叠加对冲能有效降低气候成本，且数据效率显著优于传统回放方法。

Abstract: For a trading desk, residual climate hedging valuation adjustment (HVA) is the climate cost left after its inherited hedge and any admissible overlay have been taken into account; it therefore cannot be inferred from a stand-alone stress loss. We obtain this residual by comparing paired climate-on and baseline worlds and reoptimizing the overlay for each hedge universe, which also turns hedge-instrument discovery into a valuation problem: an instrument is useful to the extent that it lowers the optimized residual cost. The linear-Gaussian case has an exact finite-horizon Riccati solution; Climate-Dyna starts from that hedge and learns the remaining nonlinear correction from paired world-model rollouts, with an independent gate deciding whether to deploy the update. In a public-data-calibrated semi-synthetic EU ETS study, crediting the inherited hedge lowers the mean climate charge from 1.517 to 0.906, and the learned overlay lowers it to 0.831 against a 0.821 exact floor; residual Dyna cuts regret by 93% relative to replay with one quarter as many trajectories, while adaptation from only 25 target transitions retains 60.7% of the exact-assisted gain.

</details>


### [151] [Amortizing the Calibration Triple: A Projection-Consistent Neural Operator for Local-Stochastic Volatility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01217)
*Xiaozhen Wang,Anaïs Després,Martin Dureau,Francois Buet-Golfouse*

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于算子学习（DeepONet和FNO）的局部随机波动率（LSV）模型快速校准方法，将原本缓慢、嘈杂的McKean-Vlasov不动点迭代替换为一次投影一致的算子评估，将校准延迟从98.5毫秒降至0.6毫秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LSV模型结合了普通期权边际与更丰富的微笑动态，但其校准需要求解缓慢、嘈杂且顺序执行的McKean-Vlasov不动点问题，这严重限制了其实际应用效率。

Method: 学习一个投影一致的算子来处理校准三元组：给定有限报价和随机波动率（SV）骨干，联合返回满足静态套利约束的隐含波动率曲面、Dupire局部波动率、LSV杠杆以及投影恒等式所需的条件矩。从期权价格边际出发，推导出对数隐含方差坐标下的无除法Dupire残差和Gyöngy投影后的商Fokker-Planck方程。采用DeepONet和FNO实现，强制执行报价拟合、静态套利、Dupire和投影约束。对于见证增强残差系统，证明了条件识别性和经验一致性。

Result: 在受控合成测试中，远期起始和障碍期权（cliquet）误差与粒子方法相比仅差0.1和0.2个百分点，校准延迟从98.5毫秒降至0.6毫秒。与测试基线相比，局部波动率RMSE降低36%，杠杆RMSE降低7-16%。

Conclusion: 这些结果支持将LSV不动点摊销化：昂贵的求解移至离线阶段，在线校准简化为一次投影一致的算子评估。

Abstract: Local-stochastic volatility (LSV) combines vanilla marginals with richer smile dynamics, but calibration requires a slow, noisy and sequential McKean--Vlasov fixed point. We learn a projection-consistent operator for the calibration triple. Given finite quotes and a stochastic-volatility (SV) backbone, it jointly returns an implied-volatility surface subject to static-arbitrage constraints, its Dupire local volatility, LSV leverage and the conditional moment required by the projection identity. Starting from option-price marginals, we derive a division-free Dupire residual in log-implied-variance coordinates and a quotient Fokker--Planck equation after Gyöngy projection. Deep Operator Network (DeepONet) and Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) implementations enforce quote fit, static-arbitrage, Dupire and projection constraints. For the witness-augmented residual system, we prove conditional identification and empirical consistency under LSV existence and inverse residual stability. In controlled synthetic tests, forward-start and cliquet errors differ from a particle method by 0.1 and 0.2 percentage points, while calibration latency falls from 98.5 to 0.6 ms. Compared with the tested baselines, local-volatility root-mean-square error (RMSE) falls by 36% and leverage RMSE by 7-16%. These results support amortizing the LSV fixed point: the expensive solve moves offline, while online calibration reduces to a single projection-consistent operator evaluation.

</details>


### [152] [The VIX-Derived Volatility Model: A VIX-first Joint SPX-VIX Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01479)
*Nicola F. Zaugg,Lech A. Grzelak*

Main category: q-fin.MF

TL;DR: 本文提出VIX优先的VDV模型，用于联合建模SPX和VIX市场。该模型先独立标定VIX动态（定价VIX期货和期权），再利用VIX的滚动窗口定义推导耦合函数，得到与VIX动态一致的SPX隐含波动率过程，最后在不改变VIX标定的前提下进一步标定SPX期权。数值实验表明该模型能同时拟合VIX期货、VIX期权和SPX期权市场。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的SPX-VIX联合标定方法依赖全局优化或高度灵活的黑箱动态，缺乏可解释性和可操作性，且难以在保持两个市场一致性的同时实现高效标定。作者希望提出一种可解释、可分解的联合建模框架。

Method: 1) 首先为VIX过程定义显式动态，独立标定VIX期货和期权；2) 利用VIX的滚动窗口定义，推导耦合函数以得到SPX的波动率过程（作为潜在过程）；3) 由此获得SPX的随机波动率表示，可进一步标定SPX期权而不改变VIX动态；4) 使用局部波动率和均值回归VIX动态构建VDV模型进行数值验证。

Result: 数值实验表明，VDV模型（含局部波动率和均值回归VIX动态）能同时紧密拟合VIX期货市场、VIX期权市场和SPX期权市场，提供了一个一致的联合框架。

Conclusion: VDV模型通过将联合问题分解为VIX标定与SPX标定两个独立步骤，比现有全局优化方法更具可解释性和可处理性，并且数值上验证了其联合拟合能力，为SPX-VIX联合建模提供了一种实用的替代方案。

Abstract: We propose the VIX-derived volatility (VDV) model, a VIX-first framework for joint SPXVIX modeling. In the model, we define explicit dynamics for the VIX process to price VIX futures and options, yielding a VIX-side calibration that is independent of the SPX dynamics. Using the rolling-window definition of the VIX, we then derive a coupling function to obtain the SPX volatility process as a latent process consistent with the calibrated VIX dynamics. This produces a stochastic-volatility representation for SPX that can be further calibrated to SPX options without altering the VIX dynamics. Relative to existing joint-calibration approaches based on global optimization or highly flexible black-box dynamics, the method offers an interpretable and tractable decomposition of the joint problem by separating the calibration of the VIX from the calibration of the SPX. In a numerical experiment, we show that a VDV model with local volatility and mean-reverting dynamics for the VIX achieves a close model fit to the VIX futures market, VIX option market, and the SPX option market at the same time, providing a consistent joint framework.

</details>


### [153] [P-Bubbles, Q-Bubbles, and Risk Premia](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01554)
*Robert A. Jarrow,Simon S. Kwok*

Main category: q-fin.MF

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个统一建模框架，将文献中定义的两类泡沫——理性泡沫（P-泡沫）和局部鞅泡沫（Q-泡沫）——联系起来，并证明局部鞅泡沫模型包含经典理性泡沫作为特例。文中还通过一种新颖的分解将两类泡沫与股票的风险溢价关联起来。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文献中存在的两类泡沫（理性泡沫和局部鞅泡沫）虽然分别被广泛研究，但缺乏统一的建模视角来揭示它们之间的内在联系。作者希望弥合这两类理论之间的鸿沟，并进一步理解泡沫与资产风险溢价之间的关系。

Method: 构建一个统一的建模框架，将P-泡沫和Q-泡沫置于同一个理论体系下；通过数学证明展示局部鞅泡沫模型包含理性泡沫作为特例；提出一种新的分解方法，将两类泡沫分别与股票的风险溢价建立联系。

Result: 成功地建立了统一框架，证明了理性泡沫是局部鞅泡沫的特殊情形，并通过新颖的分解将两类泡沫与股票风险溢价关联起来。

Conclusion: 两类泡沫理论并非相互独立，而是存在层级包含关系；该框架为后续研究泡沫定价和风险溢价提供了统一的理论基础。

Abstract: We develop a unified modeling framework that connects two distinct types of bubbles defined in the literature: the rational bubbles (aka P-bubbles), and the local martingale bubbles (aka Q-bubbles). We show that the local martingale bubble model includes the classical rational bubble as a special case. We relate both types of bubbles to an equity's risk premium via a novel decomposition.

</details>

### [154] [Drawdown Risk Beyond Brownian Motion: A Monte-Carlo Framework, Non-Gaussian Extensions, and Long Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00127)
*Francesco Landolfi*

Main category: q-fin.RM

TL;DR: 本文在Rej, Seager和Bouchaud（2017）回撤框架基础上，系统研究了系统化交易策略的回撤深度和持续时间如何取决于其夏普比率和收益统计结构。作者将解析结果重构为蒙特卡洛实验，并扩展了四个决策相关指标（最大回撤、最大亏损、最终负时间、最长恢复时间），同时放宽高斯假设考察偏度、肥尾、波动率聚集和夏普估计不确定性对结果的影响，最后用分数布朗运动替代短记忆持续性，揭示最大回撤风险在持续性下的放大主要是自相似分散标度（T^(H-1/2)）而非路径几何效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交易策略的回撤是投资者最关心的风险指标，但现有回撤理论（如Rej等2017）基于高斯和短记忆假设，无法全面刻画真实市场中策略收益的复杂统计特征（偏度、肥尾、波动率聚类等），也缺少对持续性影响回撤风险的深入理解，导致实践中可能产生误导性风险预警。

Method: 论文采用三步法：(1) 将Rej等（2017）的闭式回撤结果重构为透明蒙特卡洛实验，验证其解析基准，并将回撤映射扩展到四个决策相关指标；(2) 在固定真实夏普比率和波动率的前提下，放宽高斯假设，系统变化偏度、肥尾、波动率聚集和夏普估计不确定性，对比四指标在不同策略原型下的表现；(3) 用分数布朗运动替代短记忆持续性，分析持续性对最大回撤深度的影响并揭示其自相似标度本质。

Result: 研究发现：(1) 蒙特卡洛方法能够准确复现解析基准；(2) 四个回撤相关指标在不同非高斯收益分布下表现出不同方向的变化，单一高斯查表会导致误导性预警；(3) 持续性下的最大回撤风险放大几乎完全源于自相似分散标度T^(H-1/2)，而非路径几何效应，这实为平方根时间标度的失效而非内在危险性增加。论文提供了可复现的查表和实际校准方法。

Conclusion: 论文为系统化交易策略的回撤风险评估提供了更全面的分析框架，超越简单高斯假设，覆盖了真实市场中的多种收益统计特征，并厘清了持续性对回撤影响的本质（标度效应而非路径几何）。通过可复现的查找表和校准方案，为实践者提供了实用的风险评估工具。

Abstract: How deep and how long should the drawdowns of a systematic trading strategy run, given its Sharpe ratio and the statistical structure of its returns? Building on the drawdown framework of Rej, Seager and Bouchaud (2017), we develop the answer in three steps. We first reframe their closed-form results as a transparent Monte-Carlo experiment, validate it against their analytic benchmarks, and extend the mapping from drawdowns to four decision-relevant measures: maximum drawdown, maximum loss, final negative time and longest recovery time. We then relax the Gaussian assumption, holding the true Sharpe and volatility fixed while varying skewness, fat tails, volatility clustering and Sharpe-estimation uncertainty across strategy archetypes; the four measures move differently, so a single Gaussian table mis-warns. We finally replace short-memory persistence with fractional Brownian motion and show that the apparent amplification of drawdown risk under persistence is, for maximum-drawdown depth, almost entirely self-similar dispersion scaling (T^(H-1/2)) rather than path geometry: a failure of square-root-of-time calibration, not intrinsic danger. We provide reproducible lookup tables and a practical calibration recipe.

</details>


### [155] [An Information-Geometric Framework for Bayesian Credit Risk Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01294)
*Lorenzo Quirini*

Main category: q-fin.RM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个信息几何框架用于信用风险监测，将银行对借款人的认知表示为潜在信用维度和财务脆弱性上的后验分布，在线性高斯设定下通过贝叶斯更新将行为评分映射为高斯后验信念，形成带有Fisher信息度量的统计流形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的信用风险监测方法通常只关注点估计或单一风险指标，缺乏对借款人评估不确定性的系统刻画。作者希望通过信息几何视角，将信用监测重新概念化为后验信念的演变过程，从而同时捕捉预期风险和评估不确定性。

Method: 采用信息几何框架：在后验高斯分布构成的统计流形上赋予Fisher信息度量；在共同协方差情形下几何退化为后验均值上的Mahalanobis度量；在借款人特定协方差情形下，信息距离可同时反映预期风险和评估不确定性；通过Kullback-Leibler和Jeffreys散度比较不同投资组合段。

Result: 模拟实验展示了Kullback-Leibler和Jeffreys散度在投资组合段比较中的应用效果，验证了该框架能够借助几何距离区分不同的风险状态和不确定性水平。

Conclusion: 该框架为信用监测提供了几何解释：信用监控本质上是借款者风险后验信念在统计流形上的演化过程，信息几何工具为风险比较和监测提供了新的理论视角。

Abstract: We propose an information-geometric framework for credit risk monitoring in which a bank's knowledge of a borrower is represented by a posterior distribution over latent dimensions of creditworthiness and financial fragility.
  Under a linear-Gaussian specification, Bayesian updating maps observed behavioural scores into Gaussian posterior beliefs, which form a statistical manifold endowed with the Fisher information metric.
  In the common-covariance case, the induced geometry reduces to the Mahalanobis metric on posterior means, while borrower-specific covariance matrices allow informational distances to account for both expected risk and assessment uncertainty.
  Simulation exercises illustrate how Kullback-Leibler and Jeffreys divergences can be used to compare portfolio segments.
  The framework provides a geometric interpretation of credit monitoring as the evolution of posterior beliefs over borrower risk.

</details>


### [156] [Hawkes-Driven OTC Market Making: Volterra-Riccati Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02002)
*Alexander Barzykin*

Main category: q-fin.RM

TL;DR: 本文研究OTC做市问题，其中RFQ到达由一般Hawkes核建模，成交是外生请求流的受控细化。作者基于现货外汇RFQ数据（高分支比、多尺度持续性），发展了一套Volterra-Riccati近似层级来求解该路径依赖控制问题，并在指数Hawkes基准下验证了近似策略接近精确解，同时展示了该方法在长记忆核下的内外生报价冲击与库存风险控制优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OTC做市中的RFQ到达具有复杂的自激（Hawkes）结构和高分支比，但一般Hawkes核下的控制问题是路径依赖的，精确马尔可夫提升仅对指数核可行且维度过高，对长记忆核不切实际。需要一种可计算的近似方案来处理现实数据中的多尺度持续性。

Method: 论文提出三层Volterra-Riccati近似：(1) 第一层用条件Volterra预测替换随机未来请求流；(2) 第二层加入强度不确定性的协方差校正；(3) 第三层用已实现的Hawkes记忆更新报价规则。该近似在指数Hawkes基准下与精确提升HJB数值解对比验证。

Result: 在指数Hawkes基准中，状态反馈Volterra-Riccati策略紧密跟踪精确基准（尤其在方向性区间），而无记忆Poisson策略产生显著遗憾。在幂律长记忆模型下，方向性RFQ突发会形成持续报价偏移，内生OTC报价冲击继承长记忆衰减，并相对无条件Poisson基准改善库存和P&L风险控制。

Conclusion: Volterra-Riccati近似层级为一般Hawkes核下的OTC做市问题提供了实用且准确的求解框架，能够捕捉长记忆RFQ流的方向性影响，改善做市商的库存与损益风险管理。

Abstract: We formulate an over-the-counter (OTC) market-making problem in which request-for-quote (RFQ) arrivals are modelled by general Hawkes kernels and fills are controlled thinnings of the exogenous request flow. The modelling choice is motivated by spot-FX RFQ data: after filtering and transforming to seasonality-adjusted RFQ activity time, two-way activity in major currency pairs exhibits large fitted branching ratios and multi-scale persistence. For general Hawkes kernels the control problem is path-dependent: the relevant state contains the order-flow history, or equivalently the forward curve of conditional future RFQ intensities. Exact Markovian lifting is available for exponential kernels, but it becomes high-dimensional for mixtures of exponentials and impractical for long-memory kernels. We therefore develop a hierarchy of Volterra-Riccati approximations. The first level replaces random future request flow by its conditional Volterra forecast; the second adds a covariance correction for intensity uncertainty; the third updates the quote rule with the realized Hawkes memory, or equivalently with the post-request conditional forecast curve. The approximation hierarchy is validated in an exponential Hawkes benchmark, where the exact lifted HJB can be solved numerically. The state-feedback Volterra-Riccati policy closely tracks the exact benchmark, especially in directional regimes, while a memory-free Poisson policy suffers substantial regret. We then apply the same state-feedback rule to a power-law-like RFQ memory model. A directional RFQ burst changes the conditional forecast of future flow and is converted by the continuation-value shadow price into a persistent quote skew. The resulting endogenous OTC quote impact inherits the long-memory decay of the RFQ forecast response and improves inventory and P&L risk control relative to a no-conditioning Poisson benchmark.

</details>
