### [157] [Conformal Kelly: Conformal Prediction Intervals as the Scale in Fractional Kelly Position Sizing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01494)
*Robert Jacob Ryan*

Main category: q-fin.PM

TL;DR: 本文提出将75%共形预测区间与分数Kelly准则结合用于投资组合仓位管理，在2016-2021开发窗口上实现28.5%年化净对数增长、夏普比率1.34。但预注册的样本外测试显示增长未能持续（8.5%和7.0%年化），低于被动基准，揭示了策略过拟合的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统共形预测仅用于量化预测不确定性，本文探索将其不确定性进一步用于投资组合构建，即利用区间宽度动态调整仓位大小。同时，现有文献对时间序列共形预测的建议在真实的投资场景中是否最优值得检验。

Method: 将75%共形预测区间与分数Kelly准则结合：区间变宽则缩小仓位，变窄则扩大仓位。使用简单的慢速、未加权、逐资产滚动分位数作为最优方法。另设计风险控制机制：当区间下行脱靶率超过历史水平时削减杠杆。整个流程由自主LLM智能体在200个配置中搜索，并在2022年后的样本外数据上预注册验证。

Result: 开发窗口（2016-2021）上实现28.5%年化净对数增长、夏普比率1.34、最大回撤27.7%；风险控制将回撤降至20.3%并提升夏普比率（p=1/41）。但样本外（2022年后）增长仅为8.5%和7.0%，低于被动基准，且预注册的事后基准在原始增长上更优但回撤达46%。校准保持良好（覆盖率0.745对0.750）。

Conclusion: 宽度稳定性优于局部锐度——慢速简单的共形区间比快速自适应的更有利于仓位管理。但开发窗口的优异表现具有显著的过拟合成分，经预注册的样本外测试证实质朴的共形预测策略无法超越被动基准。该研究强调了在量化策略中预注册与诚实报告全部结果的重要性。

Abstract: Conformal prediction has traditionally been used to quantify prediction uncertainty. We put that uncertainty to a second use, combining a 75% conformal interval with fractional Kelly to size portfolio positions: as the range widens we shrink the position, and as it narrows we grow it. On a six-year development window (2016-2021), with trading costs and strict leverage caps, this compounds at 28.5% annualised net log growth with a Sharpe ratio of 1.34 and a 27.7% maximum drawdown, versus 15.9% for holding the S&P 500 and 21-22% for passive portfolios at the same leverage.
  Our main development-window finding runs against the literature's advice for conformal prediction on time series. Every tweak that adapts the interval faster to market conditions costs 0.7 to 5.3 points of annual growth; the winner is the simplest method: slow, unweighted, per-asset rolling quantiles. When an interval sizes a position rather than describing one forecast, width stability beats local sharpness. It also beats the textbook standard deviation by 2.1 points at matched leverage. We also implement a risk control: when the intervals miss on the downside far more than their historical rate, we cut leverage. On the development window this cut maximum drawdown from 27.7% to 20.3% while raising the Sharpe ratio, beating all 40 placebo timings (rank-based p = 1/41).
  These numbers came from an autonomous LLM-agent search over 200 configurations, so we sealed all data from 2022 onward and pre-registered configurations, benchmarks, and interpretation rules before one evaluation. Calibration held (0.745 coverage against 0.750, weakest through 2022); growth did not: the two configurations earned 8.5% and 7.0% per year, below the passive benchmarks, and a pre-registered hindsight benchmark beat them on raw growth while taking a 46% drawdown. All outcomes are reported as pre-registered.

</details>


### [158] [Path Portfolio Optimization: Defect, Lift, and the Price of Path Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02355)
*Miquel Noguer i Alonso*

Main category: q-fin.PM

TL;DR: 本文构建了路径组合优化（Path Portfolio Optimization）框架，利用签名（signature）作为价格路径的通用坐标，将组合问题转化为截断张量代数中的线性系统。研究发现该框架面临维度权衡：已知期望签名时收益显著，但估计时会遭遇严重过拟合，需要结构化估计器来缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统组合理论基于特征统计量（如均值、协方差），忽略了路径本身的信息。作者希望将路径视为基本分析单元，利用签名作为路径的通用坐标来构建均值-方差组合优化框架，并检验其在实际估计中的可行性与局限。

Method: 1. 将组合定义为签名的线性泛函，控制变量生活在截断张量代数中；2. 签名坐标的协方差构成期望签名的非群元部分（缺陷形式），使整个均值-方差问题化为单一张量中的线性系统；3. 区分Marcus升和Forward升两种执行约定，推导Fernholz超额增长率与几何性缺陷的联系；4. 通过数值实验比较期望签名已知与估计两种情形下的策略表现，并引入基于生成器的结构化估计器。

Result: 已知期望签名时，二次路径泛函可将双资产的确定性等价收益提升11倍，20资产横截面提升60倍；估计情形下，非正则策略在样本量少于每参数6个观测时严重为负，收缩在双资产中有害但在横截面中不可或缺；收益全部来自对称块；结构性估计器在每参数仅1个观测时即可恢复大部分可达价值。

Conclusion: 路径签名框架在理论上优雅且与超额增长率等经典概念自然联系，但实际应用的瓶颈在于非结构化估计的高样本需求。解决之道在于利用驱动过程的生成器结构来重构期望签名，而非直接估计全部签名坐标。

Abstract: This paper builds Path Portfolio Optimization: portfolio theory on a path-first framework in which the signature is the universal coordinate of the price path, and asks whether it survives estimation. A portfolio is a linear functional of the signature, so the control lives in a truncated tensor algebra, the covariance of signature coordinates is the non-group-like part of the expected signature --- a defect form --- and the whole mean--variance problem becomes a linear system in one tensor. Two structural results follow. The lift is the execution convention: the gap between the Marcus and forward lifts, contracted with portfolio weights, is Fernholz's excess growth rate exactly, so excess growth is the geometricity defect of the portfolio map. And the antisymmetric block at level two is lift-invariant pathwise, so directional signals are convention-free while variance signals and ruin are not. The empirical finding is a dimensional trade-off. With the expected signature known, quadratic path functionals raise the certainty equivalent elevenfold for a pair of assets and sixtyfold for a cross section of twenty; with it estimated, the unregularized policy is severely negative until the sample exceeds roughly six observations per parameter, and shrinkage flips from harmful in the pair to indispensable in the cross section. The entire gain sits in the symmetric block, which is convexity in the terminal increment rather than path-dependence; the path-dependent antisymmetric block earns nothing when the driver has no expected area. And the sample-size floor belongs to unstructured estimation rather than to path complexity: an estimator that fits only the generator of the driver and rebuilds the expected signature recovers almost all of the attainable value at barely one observation per parameter

</details>

### [159] [Truncated Differentiation for Inverse Potential MFGs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00217)
*Siting Liu,Yat Tin Chow,Samy Wu Fung*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究逆势均场博弈（MFG）问题，通过观测人口密度推断未知的空间逆成本（移动性）映射。提出无雅可比反向传播方法（JFB-r），仅记录最终r轮迭代即可实现与完整展开相当的反演精度，同时显著降低内存和运行时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在逆MFG问题中，需要在正向求解器上进行反向传播以推断未知参数。完整展开（full unrolling）所有迭代虽然精度高，但内存和计算开销巨大。如何在不牺牲精度的情况下降低反演成本是核心动机。

Method: 1) 使用带预条件子的原始-对偶混合梯度（PDHG）方法求解正向MFG；2) 提出JFB-r方法，从分离的热启动点出发仅记录最后r次迭代进行反向传播，保留完整正向求解；3) 理论上证明精确近端对偶外推PDHG映射是最大单调KKT算子的度量预解，从而证明JFB-r精确微分了一个有限轨迹替代模型，且在精确均衡分离点处局部固定活动集条件下，随跟踪深度增加收敛到隐式梯度。

Result: 在多个逆MFG设置下，数值实验表明JFB-r在适度的跟踪深度下即可实现与完整展开相当的恢复精度，同时减少内存和运行时间。

Conclusion: JFB-r通过截断的反向传播在逆MFG问题中实现了精度与效率的良好权衡，为大规模逆MFG参数推断提供了实用的计算方案。

Abstract: We study inverse potential mean-field games (MFGs), in which an unknown spatial inverse-cost (mobility) map is inferred from observed population densities. We solve the forward MFG with a preconditioned primal-dual hybrid gradient (PDHG) method and develop Jacobian-free backpropagation (JFB-$r$), which records only the final $r$ iterations from a detached warm start while retaining the full forward solve. To analyze this truncated differentiation method, we show that the exact-proximal dual-extrapolated PDHG map is a metric resolvent of the maximal monotone KKT operator. This resolvent view shows that JFB-$r$ exactly differentiates a finite-trajectory surrogate and, under a locally fixed active set at an exact equilibrium detach point, converges to the implicit gradient as the tracked depth increases. Across several inverse-MFG settings, numerical experiments show that JFB-r at moderate tracked depths can achieve recovery accuracy comparable to full unrolling while reducing memory and runtime.

</details>


### [160] [Residual Centering and Error Bounds for Convex Approximation of Mixed-Integer Recourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00245)
*Alban Kryeziu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究两阶段随机规划中混合整数回补函数的凸逼近问题。通过坐标切片居中条件，利用分部积分推导出各向异性全变差界和混合导数界（全坐标情形用Vitali变差表达），并引入交换坐标投影算子将任意残差分解为居中分量和显式切片均值缺陷，从而得到可选择的误差证书和均匀的一阶段决策质量保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在两阶段随机规划中，用凸逼近替代整数回补值函数会产生期望残差误差。需要在有界不确定性箱体上获得该期望误差的确定性界，以评估一阶段决策的质量。然而精确居中条件可能与凸性不相容（即使对完全幺模天花板回补也如此），因此需要新的分解方法。

Method: 1) 识别出坐标切片居中作为核心条件，通过分部积分推导各向异性全变差界和混合导数界；2) 引入交换坐标投影算子，将任意残差分解为居中分量和显式切片均值缺陷；3) 提出缺陷调整界，提供可选择的误差证书；4) 扩展混合导数估计到非光滑密度；5) 发展张量积和几何扩展框架，以及最大仿射凸拟合和审计方法。

Result: 建立了确定性期望误差界，包含了全变差界和混合导数界（后者在全坐标情形下通过Vitali变差刻画），给出了锐利常数，扩展到非光滑密度情形，并提供了均匀的一阶段决策质量保证。

Conclusion: 通过缺陷调整界框架，在居中与凸性不兼容的情况下仍能获得有效的误差界和决策质量保证，同时建立了锐利常数并扩展了方法的适用范围。

Abstract: We study convex approximations of mixed-integer recourse functions in two-stage stochastic programming. For first-stage decisions, the relevant approximation error is the signed expected residual between the convex approximation and the integer-recourse value function. On bounded uncertainty boxes, we identify residual conditions that yield deterministic bounds for this expectation error. The central condition is coordinate slice-centering, under which integration by parts gives an anisotropic total-variation bound and a mixed-derivative bound whose all-coordinate case is expressed through Vitali variation of the density. Exact centering, however, may be incompatible with convexity, even for totally unimodular ceiling recourse. We therefore use commuting coordinate projectors to decompose an arbitrary residual into a centered component and an explicit slice-mean defect. The resulting defect-adjusted bounds provide selectable error certificates and uniform first-stage decision-quality guarantees. We further establish sharp constants, extend the mixed-derivative estimate to nonsmooth densities, and develop tensor-product and geometric extensions of the framework, alongside a max-affine convex fitting and audit methodology.

</details>


### [161] [Persistent Mean Tracking in Client--Server Open Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00327)
*Amit Dutta,Fat-Hy Omar Rajab,Marcos M. Vasconcelos,Olugbenga M. Anubi*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究开放客户端-服务器网络中持久代理识别与均值跟踪问题。网络包含高频率出现的持久代理和零星出现的瞬时代理。由于服务器只能观测到二值活动指标和标量更新，简单平均无法恢复活跃持久均值。作者提出两阶段估计框架：第一阶段通过双层窗口识别程序以高概率分离持久与瞬时代理；第二阶段利用结构估计通过平滑滤波器跟踪活跃持久均值，并证明跟踪误差几何收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在开放客户端-服务器网络中，代理间歇性参与且存在非持久代理，导致朴素平均法因瞬时代理更新污染和异构参与偏差而失效。需要在仅有二元活动指标和标量更新的条件下可靠识别持久代理并跟踪其均值。

Method: 两阶段估计框架：(1) 第一阶段提出两层窗口识别程序——第一层形成单窗口活动决策，第二层跨窗口聚合决策，在异构Bernoulli参与模型下推导出有限窗口界，给出高概率分离所需等待的窗口数；(2) 第二阶段利用结构估计结果，通过平滑滤波器跟踪活跃持久均值，并分析跟踪误差的几何收缩特性。

Result: 推导了持久与瞬时代理高概率分离所需的显式有限窗口界限；证明平滑滤波器的跟踪误差几何收缩到由目标漂移和滤波器增益决定的邻域；数值仿真验证了理论结果的有效性。

Conclusion: 该两阶段框架能够有效解决开放网络中存在瞬时代理污染时的持久代理识别与均值跟踪问题，为实际系统提供了具有理论保证的估计方法。

Abstract: We study persistent-agent identification and mean tracking in an open client-server network where agents participate intermittently. The network consists of a core of highly regular persistent agents and a subset of transient/non-persistent agents that appear only sporadically. Since the server observes only binary activity indicators and scalar updates from active agents, naive averaging cannot recover the active persistent mean because transient-agent updates contaminate the aggregate, and heterogeneous participation introduces bias. To address this, we propose a two-phase estimation framework. In Phase I, we develop a two-layer window-based identification procedure: the first layer forms single-window activity decisions, while the second aggregates these decisions across windows to create a high-probability separation between persistent and transient agents. Under heterogeneous Bernoulli participation, we derive explicit finite-window bounds that specify how many windows the server must wait for this separation to occur with high probability. In Phase II, we use the resulting structural estimate to track the active persistent mean via a smoothing filter, and show that the tracking error contracts geometrically to a neighborhood determined by the target drift and the filter gain. We provide numerical simulations to illustrate the effectiveness of our theoretical results.

</details>


### [162] [Source Reliability Weighted Observer Design for Open Client Server Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00342)
*Amit Dutta,Marcos M. Vasconcelos,Olugbenga M. Anubi*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究开放客户端-服务器网络中的状态估计问题。由于活跃观测源随时间变化且可能包含无效传感器（干扰源），作者提出了一种基于源可靠性加权（source-reliability-weighted）的观测器，通过反复的创新一致性（innovation consistency）学习每个源的可靠性得分，并在有限学习期后有效跟踪潜在状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在开放客户端-服务器网络中，活跃观测源集合随时间动态变化，且并非所有活跃源都是潜在状态的有效传感器（可能存在干扰源/噪声源）。服务器无法事先知道哪些代理提供有效的状态测量，这给传统的状态估计方法带来了挑战。

Method: 提出一种源可靠性加权观测器：状态估计采用标准的固定先验加权最小二乘更新，但每个活跃观测被分配的信息权重由一个源级可靠性评分决定，该评分通过反复的创新一致性（innovation consistency）学习获得。

Result: 数值结果表明：当考虑所有活跃源时，标准观测器存在有限偏差；而所提出的观测器能够先学习源可靠性，在有限学习期之后准确跟踪期望的潜在状态。

Conclusion: 通过源级可靠性学习与加权机制，该观测器能够在存在干扰源和动态活跃源集合的开放网络中实现有效的状态估计，克服了传统方法在类似场景下的偏差问题。

Abstract: State estimation in open client server networks is challenging because the set of active observation sources changes over time, and active sources need not be valid sensors of the latent state. We study a client-server estimation problem in which a fixed but unknown state-consistent sensing class measures the latent state when active, while nuisance sources may arrive in the active set and generate observations from a different signal class. The server observes active sources, but it does not know which agents observe valid state measurements. We propose a source-reliability-weighted observer. The state estimate is a standard fixed-prior weighted least-squares update, but the information assigned to each active observation is determined by a source-level reliability score learned from repeated innovation consistency. Numerical results show that the observer, when all active sources are considered, has a finite bias, while the proposed observer initially learns source reliability and then tracks the desired latent state after a finite learning period.

</details>


### [163] [On the Iterate Convergence of AdaGrad for Generalized Smooth Convex Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00482)
*Mathieu Besançon,Tung Quoc Le*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文证明了AdaGrad算法族在凸可微目标函数上的序列收敛性结果，为三种主要变体（AdaNorm、AdaDiag、AdaFull）在凸且局部Lipschitz光滑条件下的迭代收敛提供了充要条件。进一步在广义$(L_0,L_1)$-光滑条件和多项式可修正光滑假设下证明了序列收敛性，并通过数值实验表明仅靠光滑性不足以保证AdaGrad型算法的序列收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AdaGrad算法族是自适应优化方法的重要代表，但其序列收敛性（即迭代点自身收敛，而非仅函数值或梯度收敛）的问题在文献中一直悬而未决。作者旨在填补这一理论空白，探究在何种函数条件下AdaGrad的迭代点能够保证收敛，以及AdaGrad是否具备自适应性质（不需要根据实例调整参数）。

Method: 本文采用理论分析方法：1）在凸且局部Lipschitz-smooth条件下，为三种AdaGrad变体的迭代序列收敛建立充要条件；2）将结果推广到广义$(L_0,L_1)$-光滑条件下，证明足够小常数步长下的序列收敛；3）引入$(L_0,L_1)$-多项式可修正光滑假设（放宽广义光滑性），证明任意学习率下的序列收敛；4）通过数值实验构造反例，验证理论结论并探究光滑性之外的充分条件。

Result: 1）完整刻画了凸情况下AdaGrad三种变体的序列收敛充要条件，解决了文献中遗留的开放问题；2）在$(L_0,L_1)$-广义光滑条件下，证明了小步长时的序列收敛；3）在多项式可修正光滑假设下，证明了对任意学习率AdaGrad均序列收敛，体现了其自适应性；4）数值反例表明仅光滑性不足以保证收敛，凸性或KL不等式等几何条件不可或缺。

Conclusion: 本文系统性地解决了AdaGrad算法族在凸优化中的序列收敛理论问题，揭示了收敛所需的精确条件，并厘清了光滑性、凸性等假设在AdaGrad收敛性分析中的角色。该工作不仅弥补了理论空白，也为理解和改进自适应优化算法提供了重要理论支撑。

Abstract: We prove sequential convergence results for the AdaGrad algorithm family optimizing convex differentiable objectives. Specifically, we provide necessary and sufficient conditions for the convergence of iterates for the three main AdaGrad variants (AdaNorm, AdaDiag, AdaFull) when the objective is convex and locally Lipschitz-smooth, closing the question left open from the literature. We harness this general result to study the three variants under the generalized $(L_0,L_1)$-smoothness condition and show sequential convergence for sufficiently small constant step size. Moreover, under the so-called $(L_0,L_1)$-polynomially modifiable smoothness assumption, which is a relaxation of the $(L_0,L_1)$ generalized smoothness property and is satisfied by many function classes such as $L$-smooth functions or univariate polynomials, sequential convergence for these AdaGrad variants is proved for arbitrary learning rates. This result provides conditions under which AdaGrad presents adaptivity, i.e., does not require tuning the parameters based on the instance. Finally, we provide numerical illustrations of the behavior of AdaGrad on convex and nonconvex functions. In particular, we construct a counterexample empirically showing that smoothness alone is not sufficient for the sequential convergence of AdaGrad-type algorithms, and suggesting that additional geometric hypotheses (e.g., convexity as in this paper, or the Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz inequality) are indispensable for sequential convergence results.

</details>


### [164] [Quantitative Particle Approximation for Controlled Nonlinear Filtering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00686)
*Erhan Bayraktar,Ibrahim Ekren,Xihao He,Xin Zhang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究受控非线性滤波问题中粒子近似值函数的收敛速率。状态为平坦环面上的McKean–Vlasov扩散，滤波器（条件分布）作为控制问题的状态变量，其值函数满足Wasserstein空间上的二阶Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman方程。作者通过N粒子集中控制问题逼近原问题，建立了值函数误差界：d=1时为N^{-1/6}，d=2时为N^{-1/6}(log N)^{1/3}，d>2时为N^{-1/(3d)}。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受控非线性滤波问题在工程和控制领域具有重要应用，但滤波器作为无穷维状态变量使得问题难以直接求解。粒子近似是常用的数值方法，然而其值函数的收敛速率此前缺乏严格的量化分析，特别是在非可分离报酬、受控漂移以及均匀椭圆性的广义设定下。

Method: 采用集中式N粒子控制问题近似原无穷维控制问题，其中每个粒子具有独立特质噪声和共同观测噪声。证明的关键技术包括：共同噪声方向的平移提升、Fourier–Wasserstein上下卷积、粘性比较原理，以及关于N一致成立的粒子导数估计。哈密顿量通过对总体积分后再优化来定义，以处理单一控制作用于整个群体的设定。

Result: 在数据光滑性、均匀椭圆性和哈密顿量正则性假设下，建立了统一的值函数误差界：d=1时为N^{-1/6}，d=2时为N^{-1/6}(log N)^{1/3}，d>2时为N^{-1/(3d)}。

Conclusion: 论文为受控非线性滤波问题的粒子近似提供了严格的值函数收敛速率，涵盖了非可分离报酬和受控漂移等一般性设定，对维度依赖的收敛速率给出了完整的刻画。

Abstract: We estimate convergence rates of value functions for particle approximations of a controlled nonlinear filtering problem. The state is a McKean--Vlasov diffusion on the flat torus, driven by hidden idiosyncratic noise and observed common noise. The filter---the conditional law of the state given the observations---serves as the state variable of the control problem, and the associated value function solves a second-order Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation on the Wasserstein space. We approximate this problem by a centralized \(N\)-particle control problem with independent idiosyncratic noises and a common observation noise. The framework accommodates nonseparable rewards and controlled drifts. Since a single control is applied to the entire population, the Hamiltonian is defined by an optimization performed after integration over the population. Under smoothness of the data, uniform ellipticity, and regularity of this Hamiltonian, we establish uniform value-function error bounds of order \(N^{-1/6}\) for \(d=1\), \(N^{-1/6}(\log N)^{1/3}\) for \(d=2\), and \(N^{-1/(3d)}\) for \(d>2\). The proof combines a translation lift in the common-noise direction, Fourier--Wasserstein inf- and sup-convolutions, viscosity comparison, and particle derivative estimates uniform in \(N\).

</details>


### [165] [Dynamic-Threshold Algorithms for the Continuous Quadratic Knapsack Problem: Reset Mechanisms and Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00740)
*Yong-Jin Liu,Peicheng Xie,Chuan Yang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对带有加权等式约束的连续二次背包问题，提出了动态阈值算法（DTA）及其无重置变体（NDTA）。DTA通过加法、重置和移除三种操作维持阈值不变量，证明了有限终止性和正确性。实验表明在高达10^7变量规模下，DTA和NDTA表现出近似线性的经验复杂度，在运行时间上优于Secant、WMVA、Variable Fixing、Newton、Median Search、Heap和Sort等多种方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Condat算法是求解单纯形投影的高效动态阈值方法，但其向加权等式约束的扩展以及重置和移除操作的算法作用尚未得到充分分析。本文旨在填补这一理论空白，深入理解动态阈值方法的机制。

Method: 提出动态阈值算法（DTA），通过加法（addition）、重置（reset）和移除（removal）三种操作维持阈值不变量。基于重置不会发生的充分条件，进一步提出简化的无重置变体NDTA，并建立了两个算法的有限终止性和正确性。

Result: 构造了DTA在Θ(n)时间运行而NDTA需要Θ(n²)时间的实例（尽管两者最坏复杂度均为二次）。证明在权重比和每次移除遍的删除次数有界时，线性次正阈值增量遍数要求输入值之间的最小非零间隔（按数据范围归一化）至多为exp[-Θ(n log n)]。数值实验（最多10^7变量）显示DTA和NDTA具有近似线性的经验缩放，且在运行时间上优于七种对比方法。

Conclusion: DTA和NDTA是求解加权等式约束连续二次背包问题的高效算法，在理论和实践上均表现出优越性。重置操作在特定条件下可以省略，但它在某些实例中能带来显著的复杂度优势。算法在最坏情况下的复杂度边界与数据分布特征密切相关。

Abstract: Condat's algorithm is an efficient dynamic-threshold method for projection onto the simplex, but its extension to weighted equality constraints and the algorithmic roles of resetting and removal have received limited analysis. We develop a dynamic-threshold algorithm (DTA) for a continuous quadratic knapsack problem with a weighted equality constraint. DTA maintains a threshold invariant through three operations--addition, reset, and removal--and we establish its finite termination and correctness. A sufficient condition under which reset cannot occur motivates a simpler no-reset variant, NDTA. We construct instances for which DTA runs in $Θ (n)$ time whereas NDTA requires $Θ(n^2)$ time, although both algorithms have quadratic worst-case complexity. We further show that, when the weight ratio and the number of deletions per removal pass are bounded, a linear number of passes with positive threshold increments requires the minimum nonzero gap between input values, normalized by the data range, to be at most $\exp [- Θ(n \log n)]$. Numerical experiments with up to 10^7 variables demonstrate that DTA and NDTA achieve approximately linear empirical scaling, and outperform Secant, WMVA, Variable Fixing, Newton, Median Search, Heap, and Sort in running time.

</details>


### [166] [Learning-Based Stochastic Optimal Control with Infinite-Horizon Probabilistic Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01151)
*Francesco Cordiano,Kanghui He,Bart De Schutter*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了带有无限时域联合机会约束的随机最优控制问题。通过状态增广将原问题重构为约束马尔可夫决策过程，证明其具有强对偶性，从而可以在拉格朗日对偶框架下转化为等价的无约束问题。提出了一种对偶上升算法，可收敛到最优且可行的确定性马尔可夫策略。针对连续状态-输入空间，提出了一种离线训练的专用学习算法来近似价值函数，显著降低了在线控制阶段的计算复杂度。数值实验验证了该方法在性能和计算复杂度方面优于在线预测控制方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机最优控制问题中的无限时域联合机会约束（joint chance constraints）是一个具有挑战性的问题。联合机会约束要求在无限时域上同时满足多个约束的概率不低于某个阈值，这使得问题的求解变得困难。因此，需要一种方法来有效地处理这类问题。

Method: 1) 通过状态增广将原有问题重构为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），使成本和约束函数具有可加结构；2) 证明该公式满足强对偶性，从而在对偶框架下转化为等价的无约束问题；3) 提出对偶上升算法求解，并证明其收敛到增广状态空间上的最优且可行的确定性马尔可夫策略；4) 针对连续状态-输入空间，设计离线训练的学习算法来近似价值函数，降低在线计算复杂度。

Result: 数值实验表明，所提出的方法在性能和计算复杂度两个方面均优于在线预测控制方法。

Conclusion: 本文通过状态增广、强对偶性证明和对偶上升算法，为无限时域联合机会约束的随机最优控制问题提供了一种有效且可计算的求解框架，并结合离线学习大幅降低了在线计算负担。

Abstract: In this paper, we consider stochastic optimal control problems with infinite-horizon joint chance constraints. By means of an appropriate state augmentation, we reformulate the original problem as a constrained Markov decision process, in which both the cost and the constraint function exhibit an additive structure. We then prove that this formulation enjoys strong duality, thereby enabling us to reformulate the problem as an equivalent unconstrained one in the Lagrange dual framework. We propose a dual-ascent algorithm to solve the resulting problem and show that it converges to a deterministic Markov policy defined over the augmented state space that is both optimal and feasible. To accommodate continuous state-input spaces, we propose a dedicated learning algorithm to approximate the value function in an offline training setting, thereby significantly reducing the computational complexity of the online control phase. We then test our approach on a numerical example and demonstrate its effectiveness compared to online predictive control methods in terms of performance and computational complexity.

</details>


### [167] [Revisiting Decomposition-Invariant Conditional Gradient Methods for Polytopes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01243)
*Dan Garber*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文重新审视了分解不变的条件梯度方法（Decomposition-Invariant Conditional Gradient methods），针对在凸多边形上最小化凸且β-光滑函数的问题，在α-二次增长条件下提出了新的参数无关的dyadic步长规则，实现了线性收敛速率，且收敛速率依赖于最优面的维度而非环境维度，显著优于传统的条件梯度方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的基于away-step的条件梯度方法在多面体上的收敛速度受限于环境维度n，而实际问题的复杂度往往取决于最优面的维度d*而非环境维度。作者希望设计参数无关的方法，使得收敛速率能够利用问题本身的结构特性（最优面的维度、分离参数等），从而在d*远小于n时获得显著改进。

Method: 1. 对于2级多面体（2-level polytopes），设计了一个简单且参数无关的dyadic步长规则，实现线性收敛，收敛速率与最优面维度相关。2. 对于一般多面体，在更强的α_F-面二次增长条件下，提出了一种方法，迭代复杂度为n + βD²/(αr*²) + (d*+1)βD²/(α_F)log(1/ε)，其中d*为最优面维度，r*为最优集与不含最优解的面之间的分离参数，D为多面体直径。该方法同样参数无关，仅依赖标准线搜索计算。

Result: 该方法在最大{α/α_F(d*+1), 1/r*²}远小于n的有意义场景下，将迭代复杂度从传统的βD²n/α log(1/ε)改进为n + βD²/(αr*²) + (d*+1)βD²/(α_F)log(1/ε)，即收敛复杂度从依赖环境维度n转向依赖最优面维度d*。

Conclusion: 本文通过重新设计步长规则和引入更细化的面二次增长条件，成功将条件梯度方法的收敛保证从环境维度改进为最优面维度，在低维最优面但高维环境空间的问题中具有显著的实践意义。

Abstract: We revisit Decomposition-Invariant Conditional Gradient methods, originally introduced by Garber and Meshi in 2016, for minimizing a convex and $β$-smooth function over a polytope in $\reals^n$, under an $α$-quadratic growth condition. For 2-level polytopes we design a simple and parameter-free dyadic step-size rule that yields a linear convergence rate which scales with the dimension of the optimal face and not with the ambient dimension as in standard away-step-based conditional gradient methods for polytopes. For general polytopes, under a slightly stronger condition of $α_{\mathrm{F}}$-\textit{facial quadratic growth}, we introduce a method whose number of iterations to reach an $ε$-approximate solution is of the order $n+\frac{βD^2}{αr^{*2}} + \frac{(d^*+1)βD^2}{α_{\mathrm{F}}}\log(1/ε)$, where $d^*$ is the dimension of the optimal face, $r^*$ is a separation parameter between the optimal set and faces that do not contain an optimal solution, and $D$ is the diameter of the polytope. This method is also parameter-free and only relies on standard line-search computations. The second result improves upon previous conditional gradient methods, whose number of iterations to $ε$-approximation scales with $\frac{βD^2n}α\log(1/ε)$, in a meaningful regime $\max\{\fracα{α_{\rm F}}(d^*+1), \frac{1}{r^{*2}}\} \ll n$

</details>


### [168] [Rake-Compress Riccati Recursions for Parallel Scenario-Tree Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01332)
*João Sousa-Pinto*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于rake-compress树收缩的代数精确并行求解器，用于求解场景树模型预测控制（MPC）中的非线性规划问题。该方法将任意有根树收缩到根节点，实现了O(N)算术工作量和O(log N)跨度，与树高、平衡性和最大出度无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准树Riccati递归虽然具有线性计算复杂度，但其依赖链与树高成正比，限制了并行化能力。对于大型场景树MPC问题，需要一种与树结构无关的对数级跨度并行求解方法。

Method: 基于rake-compress树收缩的并行求解器：1) rake操作消除叶节点及其父边，将约简贡献添加到父节点数据中；2) compress操作消除单子节点，用条件值组合替换其两条相邻边。通过这两种操作将任意有根树收缩至根，反向操作恢复所有Riccati系数、状态、控制和对偶变量。支持半正定对偶正则化（含非正则化情形），并通过精确线性大小提升覆盖标准场景MPC约定（每个信息节点一个控制）。

Result: 对于N个节点、固定状态和控制维度的系统，实现O(N)算术工作量和存储量，O(log N)跨度，与树高、平衡性及最大出度无关。证明了收缩恒等式与KKT系统的等价性，并提供了三个MIT许可的JAX实现包。

Conclusion: 该工作为场景树MPC提供了一种理论上最优跨度的精确并行求解方法，通过树收缩技术打破了标准Riccati递归中依赖链随树高增长的限制，同时保证了代数精确性和对多种正则化情形的支持。

Abstract: Scenario-tree model predictive control (MPC) represents future information by a rooted tree and optimizes a nonanticipative policy over that tree. Numerical methods for solving the resulting nonlinear program typically compute their search directions through a sequence of branched linear-quadratic regulator (LQR) subproblems. The standard tree Riccati recursion requires linear work but has a dependency chain proportional to tree height.
  We present an algebraically exact parallel solver based on rake-compress tree contraction. After independent local control condensation, its two operations act on node and edge data that represent conditional quadratic functions. A rake eliminates a leaf and its parent edge, adding their reduced contribution to the parent-node data. A compress eliminates a unary node and replaces its two adjacent edges by one edge, using the same conditional-value composition as parallel Riccati methods on a chain. Together they contract an arbitrary rooted tree to its root; reversing the contraction recovers every Riccati coefficient, state, control, and multiplier. Given a reusable topology plan, a solve with $N$ nodes and fixed state and control dimensions has $O(N)$ arithmetic work and storage and $O(\log N)$ span, independently of tree height, balance, and maximum out-degree.
  The formulation allows positive-semidefinite dual regularization, including the unregularized case, and an exact linear-size lifting covers the standard scenario-MPC convention of one control per information node. We prove the contraction identities and equivalence to the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) system. Three MIT-licensed JAX packages implement the bidirectional contraction, the dual-regularized LQR solver, and a user-facing primal-dual interior-point solver for tree-structured optimal control.

</details>


### [169] [A Geometric Inverse Source Problem for Stochastic Parabolic Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01351)
*Yunzhang Li,Qi Lü,Meizhi Qian,Yu Wang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了随机抛物方程中同时反演漂移项和扩散项两个未知确定性源支撑的几何反问题，证明了仅通过部分边界通量测量即可唯一确定两个源支撑，并推导了Hadamard型形状导数边界表示，据此开发了形状梯度重建方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在随机偏微分方程（SPDE）框架下，同时恢复漂移源和扩散源的支撑是一个具有挑战性的几何反问题。以往研究通常只处理单一源的情况，缺乏同时反演两个不同通道源的数学理论与数值方法。

Method: 1) 建立部分边界通量测量唯一确定两个源支撑的定理；2) 证明带周界正则化目标泛函极小元的存在性；3) 对光滑界面推导Hadamard型形状导数的边界表示，揭示伴随状态控制漂移源界面灵敏度、鞅分量控制扩散源界面灵敏度的双通道随机结构；4) 基于该公式开发形状梯度重建方法。

Result: 数值实验表明所提出的形状梯度重建方法在完整和部分边界观测条件下均有效，且能够区分漂移源和扩散源两个不同的源通道。

Conclusion: 这是首次在SPDE框架下推导出同时恢复漂移源支撑与扩散源支撑的形状导数Hadamard型公式，为多源随机反问题的理论基础和数值算法提供了重要贡献。

Abstract: This paper addresses the geometric inverse problem of simultaneously recovering two unknown deterministic source supports in a stochastic parabolic equation, where one source appears in the drift term and the other in the diffusion term. We establish that partial boundary flux measurements alone uniquely determine both supports. Moreover, we prove the existence of minimizers for a perimeter-regularized objective functional. For smooth interfaces, we derive a Hadamard-type boundary representation of the shape derivative. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first such formula for the simultaneous recovery of a drift-source support and a diffusion-source support in an SPDE setting. The derivative exhibits a genuinely stochastic two-channel structure: the adjoint state governs the sensitivity of the drift-source interface, while the martingale component controls the sensitivity of the diffusion-source interface. Based on this formula, we develop a shape-gradient reconstruction method. Numerical experiments demonstrate its effectiveness and its capacity to distinguish between the two source channels under both full and partial boundary observations.

</details>


### [170] [Coordinate Optimality Reformulation for Mixed-Integer Convex Programs with Indicators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01385)
*Tong Xu,Salar Fattahi,Andrés Gómez,Simge Küçükyavuz*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出坐标最优性重构（CORe）框架，通过将逐坐标最优性条件融入标准的指示变量混合整数凸优化建模中，在保持全局最优性的同时显著提升分支定界算法的求解性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在混合整数凸优化问题中，二进制指示变量控制连续变量时，标准的big-M等指示变量建模方法往往导致分支定界算法性能不佳。作者希望利用问题中逐坐标最优性条件所暴露的结构信息来改进求解效率。

Method: 提出CORe框架，包含三个核心组成部分：(1) 逐坐标最优性条件；(2) 闭式刻画；(3) 析取（disjunctive）重构。通过将这些坐标级最优性信息整合到指示变量模型中来增强分支定界性能。

Result: 在二次规划和鲁棒单指标模型等多个问题族上的计算实验表明，CORe方法相比标准big-M建模能够显著提升求解器性能，尤其在稀疏和结构化问题中效果突出。

Conclusion: CORe框架通过融入逐坐标最优性信息为混合整数凸优化问题提供了一种有效的重构途径，在保持全局最优性的前提下显著改善分支定界求解效率，特别适用于稀疏和结构化问题场景。

Abstract: We consider mixed-integer convex optimization problems in which binary indicators control continuous variables. We introduce the \emph{Coordinate Optimality Reformulation} (CORe) framework, which augments standard indicator formulations by incorporating coordinate-wise optimality information. The resulting reformulations preserve global optimality while substantially improving branch-and-bound performance, particularly in sparse and structured settings where the coordinate-wise optimality conditions expose exploitable problem structure. We first develop the main components of CORe, including coordinate-wise optimality conditions, closed-form characterizations, and disjunctive reformulations. We then demonstrate the framework across multiple problem families, including quadratic problems and robust single-index models. Computational experiments show that CORe can substantially improve solver performance compared with standard big-$M$ formulations.

</details>


### [171] [Universal Triangle Covering Curve and Polygonal Chain: Escaping Forest and Fitting Worm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01393)
*Zhipeng Deng*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通用公式来解决曲线和多边形链的三角形覆盖与三角形拟合问题，将其建模为Bellman迷失森林问题和Moser蠕虫问题的特例，通过保持曲线静止、允许三角形平移和旋转来建立带支撑函数约束的泛函最小化公式，并证明了其等价性和收敛性，最后通过数值方法给出了不同角度的任意三角形覆盖曲线的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 覆盖问题和拟合问题在计算几何中具有重要应用，而现有的曲线覆盖与三角形拟合问题缺乏统一的通用公式。本文希望将这些看似不同的问题统一到一个理论框架下，并借助Bellman迷失森林问题和Moser蠕虫问题的理论工具来系统解决。

Method: 将曲线覆盖和拟合问题转化为Bellman迷失森林问题（逃出三角森林）和Moser蠕虫问题（被三角形覆盖）的特例；通过保持曲线固定、让三角形自由平移和旋转来建模；推导出带支撑函数约束的泛函最小化公式；证明公式的等价性和收敛性；采用数值方法求解并验证。

Result: 使用数值方法获得了用不同角度的任意三角形覆盖曲线的结果，并给出了若干推论和变体结果，包括闭曲线和闭多边形链的情况。

Conclusion: 本文成功建立了一个统一的泛函最小化框架来解决曲线/多边形链的三角形覆盖与拟合问题，不仅从理论上证明了公式的等价性和收敛性，还通过数值实验验证了方法的有效性，并为闭曲线和闭多边形链等变体问题提供了结论。

Abstract: In this paper, we present a general formulation to address the problems of covering curves and polygonal chains with triangle, and fitting these curves into triangle. These problems can be formulated as special cases of Bellman's lost-in-a-forest problem (escaping triangular forest) and Moser's worm problem (covered by triangle). We model and reformulate the problem by keeping the curve stationary while allowing the triangle to translate and rotate. Subsequently, we derive the functional minimization formulation with support function constraints to solve. We also prove the equivalence and convergence of the formulas. Finally, we employ numerical methods and present results for covering curves with arbitrary triangles of various angles. We also present some corollaries and variant results, including closed curves and closed polygonal chains.

</details>


### [172] [Generalized Quadratic Gradient: A New Direction in Optimization via the Fusion of Positive-Definite Curvature Matrices and Gradients into A Unified Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01552)
*John Chiang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出广义二次梯度（GQG）框架，将二次梯度原理推广到更广泛的牛顿型优化算法类别，证明其核心构造要求可泛化到任何满足局部二次模型驻点条件的正定曲率矩阵，而非局限于特定的Hessian近似。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的二次梯度方法（如QG、SQG、QQG）虽各有优势，但受限于特定的Hessian近似方式（常量Hessian、对角近似、BFGS等）。作者希望抽象出这些方法的共同结构，揭示二次梯度构造的本质上位要求，从而为开发更广泛的曲率感知优化算法提供统一理论基础。

Method: 通过抽象现有二次梯度方法的共同结构，GQG框架将二次梯度原理推广到任何满足局部二次模型驻点条件的正定曲率矩阵，并在BFGS之外探索多种正定Hessian代理（surrogate）来构造广义二次梯度。

Result: 证明了二次梯度构造的基本要求不限于特定的Hessian近似，可以泛化到更广泛的曲率矩阵类别，为超出BFGS的Hessian代理提供了构造广义二次梯度的基础。

Conclusion: GQG统一了现有的二次梯度方法，并拓展了曲率感知优化算法的设计空间，为开发新型牛顿型优化算法奠定了更广泛的理论基础。

Abstract: Quadratic Gradient (QG) is a Newton-type optimization framework that bridges first-order gradient descent and second-order optimization by incorporating curvature information into gradient updates. Simplified Quadratic Gradient (SQG) reduces the complexity of QG construction while preserving its optimization capability, whereas Quasi-Quadratic Gradient (QQG) extends the quadratic gradient principle to quasi-Newton methods such as BFGS.
  In this paper, we propose **Generalized Quadratic Gradient (GQG)**, a unified framework that extends the quadratic gradient principle to a broader class of Newton-type optimization algorithms. By abstracting the common structure of existing quadratic gradient methods, we show that the fundamental requirement of quadratic gradient construction is not limited to specific Hessian approximations, such as constant Hessian matrices, diagonal Hessian approximations, or BFGS-based Hessian surrogates. Instead, it can be generalized to any positive-definite curvature matrix satisfying the stationary condition of a local quadratic model.
  Based on this perspective, we investigate the construction of generalized quadratic gradients using various positive-definite Hessian surrogates beyond BFGS, providing a broader foundation for developing curvature-aware optimization algorithms.

</details>


### [173] [Convergence and Stability Analysis of a Generalized Proximal Point Algorithm and Its Inexact Version](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01584)
*Ba Khiet Le,Boris S. Mordukhovich,Michel A. Thera*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了自适应强单调性的概念，并建立了广义近端点算法（GPPA）在Hilbert空间中求解非单调包含问题近似解时的线性收敛性。同时研究了存在非衰减误差时的不精确广义近端点算法（IGPPA）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近端点算法通常依赖单调性或强单调性假设来保证收敛，但许多实际包含问题并不满足这些条件。作者希望通过引入更宽松的自适应强单调性概念，扩展GPPA的适用范围并保证其线性收敛速率。

Method: 引入自适应强单调性的新概念，在此基础上分析广义近端点算法（GPPA）的线性收敛性质；同时考察不精确广义近端点算法（IGPPA）在误差不衰减（nondiminishing errors）情况下的收敛行为。

Result: 在自适应强单调性条件下，GPPA对非单调包含问题的近似解实现了线性收敛；IGPPA在存在非衰减误差时仍保持有效收敛性。

Conclusion: 自适应强单调性是一个比传统强单调性更一般化的条件，能够有效支撑GPPA在非单调场景下的线性收敛分析，并扩展了IGPPA在误差不衰减情形下的理论保证。

Abstract: In this paper, we introduce the notion of adaptive strong monotonicity and establish a linear convergence of the recently proposed Generalized Proximal Point Algorithm (GPPA) for computing approximate solutions to nonmonotone inclusion problems in Hilbert spaces. We also investigate the Inexact Generalized Proximal Point Algorithm (IGPPA) in the presence of nondiminishing errors.

</details>


### [174] [Non-KKT Accumulation in Entropic Mirror Descent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01658)
*Kuangyu Ding,Kim-Chuan Toh*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文证明了有界镜像下降序列的极限点未必是KKT稳定点，通过构造C∞光滑目标函数和Shannon熵镜像下降在非负象限（n≥3）及概率单纯形（n≥4）上的反例，这些反例的聚点集是光滑边界圆，包含非空相对开弧段的非KKT点，是首个目标值非增的有界镜像下降序列不收敛到KKT点的反例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 镜像下降是优化中基本算法，一个长期悬而未决的基本问题是：在合适的步长下，有界镜像下降序列的每个聚点是否必须为KKT稳定点？之前的障碍在于Legendre梯度的边界爆炸效应——在边界极限处，逆熵度量在活动坐标上趋于零，可能抹去KKT系统中的对偶可行性。本文旨在回答这一基本问题。

Method: 作者构造了Shannon熵镜像下降在非负象限R_+^n（n≥3）和概率单纯形Δ_n（n≥4）上的C∞光滑目标函数，使得聚点集是一个光滑边界圆，其中包含一段非空相对开弧的非KKT点。步长满足α_k∝k^{-β}（β∈(1/2,1)），目标函数值非增，且目标函数是熵相对光滑的。

Result: 成功构造出反例：对于所有n≥3的非负象限和n≥4的概率单纯形，存在有界镜像下降序列，其聚点集中包含非KKT点。这些反例表明病理现象源于Bregman几何在边界处的退化，而非下降失败或步长选择不当。这是首个目标值非增的有界镜像下降序列不保证KKT聚点的反例。

Conclusion: 镜像下降在有界序列下不保证聚点为KKT点，问题的根源在于Bregman几何在边界处的退化性。这打破了长期以来的假设，对镜像下降的理论分析具有重要影响，提示需要在算法设计或理论假设上重新审视边界效应。

Abstract: For mirror descent generated by a Legendre kernel, perhaps one of the most basic question in optimization is this: must every accumulation point of a bounded mirror descent sequence be Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) stationary under proper stepsizes? We show that the answer is no. A longstanding obstacle to resolving this question is the boundary blow-up of the Legendre gradient: it keeps every mirror step in the interior, while at a boundary limit, the inverse entropy metric vanishes on active coordinates and can erase the dual-feasibility in the KKT system. We construct $C^\infty$ objectives and bounded sequences generated by the Shannon-entropic mirror descent on the nonnegative orthant $\R_+^n$, for every $n\geq 3$, and on the probability simplex $Δ_n$, for every $n\geq 4$, such that, in each case, the set of accumulation points is a smooth boundary circle containing a nonempty relatively open arc of non-KKT points. The steps satisfy $α_k\asymp k^{-β}$ with $β\in(1/2,1)$, the objective values are nonincreasing, and the objectives are entropy-relatively smooth. Hence the pathology stems from the degeneracy of the Bregman geometry at the boundary, rather than from failure of descent, or improper stepsizes. To the best of our knowledge, these provide the first counterexamples to KKT accumulation for bounded mirror descent sequences with nonincreasing objective values.

</details>


### [175] [A noncommunicative Kalman condition for null controllability of backward stochastic parabolic systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01836)
*Mohamed Fadili*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 研究了一类带常值确定性耦合矩阵和局部位移漂移控制的n维倒向随机热方程系统，建立了零可控性的充要代数条件：控制矩阵的列必须在两个耦合矩阵的联合非交换作用下生成状态空间。通过有限维随机Gramian的正性证明和小时间强制估计，结合Lebeau-Robbiano谱不等式和高频耗散，得到对偶前向系统的可观性，从而导出零可控性；条件不满足时存在非平凡不变不可观子空间，说明该条件也是必要的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 倒向随机偏微分方程（BSPDE）系统的可控性问题在随机控制和金融数学中具有重要意义。已有研究多关注标量情形或简单耦合结构，对于耦合同时作用于第一状态量和鞅积分项（即矩阵型耦合）的n维系统，其零可控性的精确代数刻画尚未建立。作者旨在给出一个简洁、可验证的充要条件。

Method: 将随机内部动力学与标量热半群分离处理。定义有限维随机Gramian，证明其正定性等价于联合字秩条件（columns of control matrix在耦合矩阵的非交换作用下生成状态空间），并建立多项式型小时间强制界。随后将Lebeau-Robbiano谱不等式与高频耗散相结合，导出对偶前向系统的可观性（从而零可控性）。必要性通过展示条件失败时存在非平凡不变不可观子空间来证明。

Result: 建立了刻画零可控性的充要代数条件：控制矩阵的列须在两个耦合矩阵的联合非交换作用下张成整个状态空间。有限维随机Gramian正定性与该条件等价，且满足多项式小时间强制估计。必要性与充分性均得到严格证明。

Conclusion: 该工作将倒向随机热方程系统的可控性归结为一个纯代数的联合字秩条件，兼具一般性和可验证性。所提出的"随机Gramian + 谱不等式 + 高频耗散"的分析框架有望推广到更一般的耦合结构和非局部漂移控制的系统。

Abstract: We study a system of $n$ backward stochastic heat equations with constant deterministic coupling matrices, scalar spatial diffusion, and a localized drift control. The coupling acts both on the first state and on the martingale integrand. We establish a necessary and sufficient algebraic condition for null controllability: the columns of the control matrix must generate the state space under the joint noncommutative action of the two coupling matrices. The proof separates the stochastic internal dynamics from the scalar heat semigroup. A finite-dimensional stochastic Gramian is shown to be positive exactly under the joint word-rank condition and to satisfy a polynomial small-time coercivity estimate. Combined with the Lebeau--Robbiano spectral inequality and high-frequency dissipation, this yields observability of the dual forward system and hence null controllability. The condition is also necessary, as its failure produces a nontrivial invariant unobservable subspace.

</details>


### [176] [Sparse Linear Surrogates for Interpretable Budget Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01858)
*Marc Goerigk,Michael Hartisch,Sebastian Merten*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文针对预算分配问题提出了新的线性替代模型，通过稀疏线性规则将实例映射到基于特征的解表示，并分别提出了基于混合整数规划的精确方法和启发式方法，通过计算实验验证了两种方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有优化方法往往缺乏内在可解释性，难以满足需要可解释性优化方法的需求。本文旨在为预算分配问题提供一种本质上可解释的优化方案。

Method: 提出稀疏线性替代模型，将实例映射为基于特征的解表示。采用两种计算方法：(1) 基于混合整数规划（MIP）的精确求解方法；(2) 启发式方法用于计算这些替代模型。

Result: 通过计算实验对比分析了精确方法和启发式方法各自的性能表现。

Conclusion: 本文为预算分配问题提供了可解释的线性替代求解途径，兼顾了精确性和实用性，为需要可解释性的优化场景提供了可行方案。

Abstract: To address the demand for inherently interpretable optimization methods, we introduce novel linear surrogates for budget allocation problems. These surrogates consist of sparse linear rules that map instances to feature-based representations of solutions. We present an exact approach based on mixed-integer programming as well as a heuristic for their computation. The performance of both approaches is analyzed through computational experiments.

</details>


### [177] [Safe screening rules for portfolio optimization with linear and cardinality constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01871)
*Nanari Wada,Shunnosuke Ikeda,Yuichi Takano,Jun-ya Gotoh*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出了针对基数约束投资组合优化问题的安全筛选规则，利用透视松弛和Fenchel对偶推导出资产级分数，在优化前安全固定二元资产选择变量，从而在不损失最优性的前提下大幅降低问题规模，并在S&P 500和Russell 2000数据集上验证了显著的计算加速效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基数约束限制了投资组合中持有的资产数量，对控制监控和交易成本至关重要，但该问题为NP-hard，随着候选资产数量增长，全局求解变得计算困难。安全筛选通过预先固定决策变量来缩小问题规模，同时保持最优性保证，是应对这一计算瓶颈的有效手段。

Method: 本文利用L2正则化项的透视松弛和Fenchel对偶理论，推导出结合线性约束拉格朗日乘子的资产特定分数；结合基于松弛的下界和可行解的上界，安全地将二元资产选择变量固定为0或1，实现问题规模的缩减。

Result: 在S&P 500和Russell 2000数据集上的实验表明，该方法在中度或强正则化以及较宽松的收益要求等具有挑战性的场景中，取得了显著的计算改进。

Conclusion: 安全筛选作为一种保持最优性的预处理技术，能在大规模基数约束投资组合优化中极大提升计算效率，验证了其有效性和实用价值。

Abstract: In portfolio optimization, a cardinality constraint, which limits the number of assets held, plays a key role in cutting down monitoring and transaction costs. However, the resulting problem is NP-hard and becomes computationally difficult to solve globally as the number of candidate assets grows. Safe screening addresses this difficulty by fixing decision variables before optimization without excluding any globally optimal solution, thereby reducing the problem size while preserving optimality guarantees. We propose safe screening rules for cardinality-constrained portfolio optimization with a convex quadratic objective function and linear constraints. Using a perspective relaxation of the L2-regularization term and Fenchel duality, we derive asset-specific scores that incorporate the Lagrange multipliers of the linear constraints. Combined with a relaxation-based lower bound and a feasible-solution upper bound, these scores safely fix binary asset-selection variables to zero or one. Experiments on S&P 500 and Russell 2000 datasets show substantial computational improvements on challenging cases, particularly under moderate or strong regularization and less stringent return requirements. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of safe screening as an optimality-preserving preprocessing technique that greatly boosts computational efficiency in large-scale cardinality-constrained portfolio optimization.

</details>


### [178] [A Continuous-Time Analysis of Smoothed Matrix-Polar Spectral Gradient Flows for Muon-Type Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01911)
*Jinlin Liu,Song Chen,Jiaxu Liu,Chao Xu*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究矩阵值优化中的光滑矩阵极谱梯度流。通过引入由光滑谱势生成的谱反馈律，克服了经典极因子映射在秩亏矩阵处丧失光滑性的问题，并证明了该反馈的正则性、单调性、有界性和耗散性。在此基础上提出光滑谱梯度流，证明其适定性和全局收敛性，并在非凸、凸和PL条件下给出收敛率，同时分析了动量增广系统的Lyapunov结构和收敛性，最后给出了谱梯度方向与标准Frobenius梯度方向的局部下降率比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 矩阵值优化中经典的极因子映射在秩亏矩阵处会失去光滑性，且当奇异值趋近于零时条件数变差，导致数值和分析上的困难。作者希望引入一种光滑化的机制来解决这一问题。

Method: 1) 引入由光滑谱势生成的谱反馈律，建立其正则性、单调性、有界性和耗散性；2) 基于该反馈律提出光滑谱梯度流并证明适定性和全局收敛性；3) 在非凸、凸和PL条件下推导收敛率；4) 分析动量增广系统的Lyapunov结构和收敛性；5) 通过Hessian二次模型比较谱梯度方向与Frobenius梯度方向的局部下降率，给出可验证的归一化下降率优势条件。

Result: 证明了光滑谱反馈律的正则性和耗散性，谱梯度流的适定性和全局收敛性，并在非凸、凸和PL设定下获得了收敛率结果。动量增广系统的Lyapunov结构得到分析。局部下降率比较表明谱方向的优势取决于与梯度矩阵的一阶对齐程度以及Hessian诱导的方向曲率。

Conclusion: 该工作为矩阵值优化提供了基于谱反馈的光滑梯度流框架，从理论上保证了收敛性，并揭示了谱梯度方向相比标准Frobenius梯度的局部优势条件和适用场景。

Abstract: This paper studies smoothed matrix-polar spectral gradient flows for unconstrained matrix-valued optimization.The canonical polar-factor map loses smoothness at rank-deficient matrices and becomes ill-conditioned as singular values approach zero, creating analytical difficulties.We therefore introduce a spectral feedback law generated by a smooth spectral potential and establish the regularity, monotonicity, boundedness, and dissipation properties of the feedback.Based on this feedback law, we propose a smoothed spectral gradient flow and prove well-posedness and global convergence of the flow.We derive convergence-rate results for the spectral gradient flow in nonconvex, convex, and Polyak--Lojasiewicz (PL) settings and analyze the Lyapunov structure and convergence of a momentum-augmented system under the same spectral feedback law. Furthermore, we provide a local descent-rate comparison between the smoothed spectral-gradient direction and the standard Frobenius-gradient direction using a general Hessian-based quadratic model. This analysis yields a verifiable normalized descent-rate advantage condition, showing that the local benefit of the spectral direction depends on both first-order alignment with the gradient matrix and the directional curvature induced by the Hessian.

</details>


### [179] [Exact Prescribed-Time Control Based on Simple Harmonic Motion: Stability Analysis and Nonsingular Sliding Mode Stabilization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01952)
*Yi Ding,Bin Zhou*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究精确预设时间控制的稳定性分析与非奇异滑模镇定问题，通过利用简谐振动的等时性建立了新颖的精确预设时间控制框架，并证明了在任意非零初始条件下收敛时间恰好等于预设时间，同时提出的滑模控制律在整个状态空间中非奇异且增益一致有界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确预设时间控制要求在预设时刻精确收敛，但现有方法在稳定性分析、奇异性和增益有界性方面存在挑战，需要建立更完善的理论框架。

Method: 本文利用简谐振动的等时性特性构建精确预设时间控制框架：首先提出一种新颖的李雅普诺夫分析方法用于精确预设时间控制，实现标量系统的精确预设时间镇定；然后将该框架扩展为新的滑模控制律，在存在外部扰动的情况下保证几乎全部初始条件下的精确预设时间收敛，且控制律在整个状态空间中非奇异、增益一致有界。

Result: 理论上证明了任意非零初始条件下收敛时间恰好等于预设时间；所提滑模控制律在存在外部扰动时仍能保证精确预设时间收敛，且避免了奇异问题并保持增益一致有界；仿真结果验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过简谐振动的等时性建立了一种新颖的精确预设时间控制框架，解决了稳定性分析、非奇异滑模镇定等问题，为精确预设时间控制提供了更完善的理论工具与设计方案。

Abstract: This paper investigates the problems of stability analysis and nonsingular sliding mode stabilization for exact prescribed-time control. By exploiting the isochronism of simple harmonic motion, this paper establishes a novel exact prescribed-time control framework. First, a novel Lyapunov analysis method for exact prescribed-time control is proposed, based on which the exact prescribed-time stabilization of scalar systems is achieved. It is theoretically established that for arbitrary non-zero initial conditions, the settling time is exactly equal to the prescribed time. Next, the framework is extended to a novel sliding mode control law. It guarantees exact prescribed-time convergence for almost all initial conditions even in the presence of external disturbances. Notably, the proposed control law is nonsingular across the entire state space and maintains uniformly bounded gains. Finally, simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

</details>


### [180] [Accelerating Evolutionary Strategy via Rao-Blackwellizing Realization of Uncertain Input](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02073)
*So Nakashima,Tetsuya J. Kobayashi*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了"输入不确定性下的优化"（OIU）问题，即目标函数的输入（而非目标函数本身）受不确定性影响。作者通过Rao-Blackwellization定理在理论上证明了利用已观测到的输入实现信息可以降低梯度估计的方差，并据此提出了表型加速进化策略（PAES），在连续优化和强化学习基准上展示了比传统进化策略更快的收敛速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的OIU求解方法大多只利用目标函数值而丢弃可观测的输入实现信息。作者想探究这些被丢弃的信息是否能够加速优化过程——这个问题在制造公差、物理系统控制噪声、MoE和RL等实际应用中都有重要意义。

Method: 作者首先通过Rao-Blackwellization在理论上证明，利用已实现的输入信息可以降低进化策略中梯度估计器的方差。基于这个Rao-Blackwell化梯度估计器，提出了表型加速进化策略（PAES），这是对传统进化策略（ES）在OIU场景下的改进算法。

Result: 数值实验表明，PAES从简单连续优化问题到强化学习基准任务中，均比传统进化策略收敛更快，验证了利用输入实现信息确实能加速优化过程。

Conclusion: 该研究从理论和实验两方面证明了在OIU问题中，可观测的输入实现信息不应被丢弃，它们可以通过Rao-Blackwellization显著提升进化策略的优化效率。这一发现为OIU领域提供了一种更有效的新方法，并拓展了进化策略在输入不确定性场景下的应用能力。

Abstract: We investigate Optimization under Input Uncertainty (OIU), in which the input to the objective function, rather than the objective function itself, is subject to uncertainty. OIU appears in manufacturing processes with production tolerance, control of physical systems with actuation noise, Mixture of Experts, and Reinforcement Learning (RL). Most of the existing approaches solve OIU by using the value of the objective function but discard the information of the realized input, even though the realized input is observable in various applications. The question here is whether the discarded information of the realized input is useful to accelerate the optimization process. We affirmatively answer this question for Evolutionary Strategy (ES) by theoretically showing that the information of the realized input can reduce the variance of the gradient estimator via Rao-Blackwellization. Using the Rao-Blackwellized gradient estimator, we propose Phenotype-Accelerated Evolutionary Strategy (PAES), which is a refinement of ES for OIU. Numerical experiments show that PAES converges faster than the usual ES from simple continuous optimization problems to RL benchmarks.

</details>


### [181] [A proximal gradient method with adaptive backtracking for weakly smooth multiobjective optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02201)
*Yuki Miyazaki,Masaru Ito,Shotaro Yagishita*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对弱光滑（Hölder连续梯度）多目标优化问题的近端梯度方法，采用自适应线搜索策略，无需预先知道弱光滑性相关参数。算法在非凸情形下的复杂度保证与现有工作兼容，并采用更严格的驻点度量；在凸情形下建立了优于非凸情形的新的复杂度结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多目标优化问题在实际中广泛存在，但现有近端梯度方法大多假设目标函数梯度是Lipschitz连续的（强光滑）。然而许多实际问题中的目标函数仅具有弱光滑性（即Hölder连续梯度），现有方法无法直接适用或需要预先知道光滑性参数，这限制了算法的实用性。

Method: 提出一种带自适应线搜索的近端梯度方法，通过线搜索自动确定合适的步长，使步长适应目标函数的弱光滑性，从而避免对弱光滑性参数的先验依赖，实现参数无关的算法设计。

Result: 在非凸情形下，算法的复杂度保证与现有相关工作兼容，并且采用了比现有方法更严格的coercer驻点度量；在凸情形下，建立了新的复杂度结果，该结果优于非凸情形下的复杂度。

Conclusion: 该算法是参数无关的，能够自适应处理弱光滑多目标优化问题，并在非凸和凸两种情形下均提供了可靠的复杂度保证，其中凸情形的复杂度结果具有显著改进。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose a proximal gradient method with adaptive linesearch for multiobjective optimization problems whose objective functions are weakly smooth, i.e., they have Hölder continuous gradients. The proposed method is parameter-free as we do not require prior knowledge of parameters related to the weak smoothness of the objective function; the proposed linesearch finds an appropriate step-size that adapts to the weak smoothness. The complexity guarantee analyzed in this paper for the non-convex case is compatible with related works and our algorithm accepts coercer stationarity measure compared to existing methods. We also establish a novel complexity result for the convex case which improves the one in non-convex case.

</details>


### [182] [Discrete-Time Adaptive Control in High Dimensions: Near Dimension-Free Performance via Mirror Descent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02256)
*Mohammad Boveiri,Peyman Mohajerin Esfahani*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究高维离散时间非线性系统的自适应控制问题，针对具有特殊结构（稀疏、低秩、分组稀疏等）的未知矩阵参数，提出一类基于mirror descent的非欧几里得自适应更新法则，实现了遗憾界对维度仅呈对数依赖，显著优于标准欧几里得方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代高容量模型在实时控制中的应用日益增多，但这些模型通常具有高维参数。在高维自适应控制中，标准的欧几里得更新方案（如递归最小二乘和梯度下降）的瞬态性能会随维度增加而恶化，即使真实参数具有低内在复杂度。因此，需要利用参数结构（稀疏、低秩等）的几何特性来设计更优的自适应控制算法。

Method: 提出一类新的镜像下降型（mirror-descent-type）自适应更新法则，配备非欧几里得Polyak型步长，充分利用参数结构（逐元素稀疏、分组稀疏、低秩、行随机或密度矩阵结构）所诱导的几何性质。同时建立渐近状态收敛性，并推导遗憾界。

Result: 证明了所提出的更新法则能够实现渐近状态收敛，遗憾界对环境维度最多呈对数依赖关系，而标准欧几里得方法的瞬态性能则随维度恶化。数值实验验证了所提方案的有效性。

Conclusion: 利用参数结构的几何特性设计非欧几里得自适应更新法则，是应对高维自适应控制挑战的有效途径，可在保持状态收敛的同时实现对维度友好的遗憾界。

Abstract: Motivated by the use of modern high-capacity models in real-time control problems, this paper studies the adaptive control of high-dimensional discrete-time nonlinear systems with an unknown matrix-valued parameter. We focus on regimes where the number of unknown parameter entries is large, but the parameter matrix possesses exploitable structure, such as entrywise sparsity, group sparsity, low rank, and row-stochastic or density-matrix structure. To quantify transient performance, we consider a regret criterion relative to a nominal controller with full knowledge of the true parameter. We show that standard Euclidean update schemes, including recursive least squares and gradient descent, are ill-suited to this setting: their transient performance deteriorates as the dimension increases, even when the true parameter has low intrinsic complexity. To address this limitation, we propose a novel class of mirror-descent-type adaptive laws equipped with a non-Euclidean Polyak-type step size that exploit the geometry induced by the parameter structure. For the proposed update laws, we establish asymptotic state convergence and derive regret bounds with at most logarithmic dependence on the ambient dimension. Numerical experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed schemes.

</details>


### [183] [Dynamic Traffic Allocation for Revenue Maximization on Creator Economy Platform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02293)
*Zhengli Wang,Franklin Lin Feng,Zhixi Wan*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究创作者经济平台面临的核心战略困境：如何将流量分配给成熟明星创作者以获取即时广告收入，还是扶持新兴创作者以积累粉丝基础、实现未来变现。作者构建了一个连续时间动态优化模型，刻画了平台在双收入流（广告和粉丝直接贡献）下对异构创作者的最优流量分配策略，并给出了解析解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 创作者经济平台存在核心的流量分配两难问题：流量给成熟创作者可立刻产生广告收入，但若忽视新兴创作者则平台生态缺乏可持续性。以往的研究缺乏一个动态、前瞻性的理论框架来系统刻画这一权衡，特别是考虑到创作者异质性、Bass扩散的WOM效应以及双收入流的复杂结构。

Method: 作者构建了连续时间动态优化模型，包含：（1）异构创作者的粉丝增长动力学（Bass扩散模型）；（2）平台的双收入流（广告+粉丝直接贡献）；（3）以最优流量分配为决策变量。通过解析推导刻画最优策略结构，并对照短视策略和公平性启发式策略进行理论比较，最后提出实用的次优启发式算法。

Result: 主要发现包括：（1）最优策略遵循"最有价值创作者优先"规则，由前瞻性激活集驱动；（2）在Bass扩散下呈现"条件反转"策略，即平台会暂时优先扶持落后创作者以利用口碑效应；（3）最优策略充当选择性守门人，设定严格的能力门槛，避免赢者通吃或盲目公平增长两个极端；（4）对成功进入者实施有纪律的增长管理，设定最优粉丝上限防止过度投资；（5）简单启发式策略可导致高达25%的收入损失，而提出的"粉丝增长调整"启发式接近最优性能。

Conclusion: 本文为创作者经济平台的流量分配提供了理论指导：最优策略既不是完全短视的赢者通吃，也不是公平至上的盲目扶持，而是在动态权衡中进行精细化的选择性管理。研究为平台实践提供了可操作的启发式算法，具有重要的管理启示。

Abstract: Creator economy platforms face a strategic dilemma: allocating traffic to established stars for immediate ad revenue versus nurturing emerging creators to build a follower base for future monetization. We develop a continuous-time dynamic optimization model to characterize the optimal traffic allocation policy for a platform managing heterogeneous creators with dual revenue streams (advertising and direct follower contributions). We characterize the optimal policy analytically, revealing a ``most-valuable-creator-first" rule driven by a forward-looking activation set. Under Bass diffusion dynamics, this policy exhibits a sophisticated ``conditional reversal" strategy, where the platform temporarily prioritizes lagging creators to capitalize on word-of-mouth effects. Regarding the ecosystem structure, we find the optimal policy acts as a selective gatekeeper. Unlike myopic policies that lead to a harsh ``winner-take-all" market, or naive fairness-driven heuristics that foster inefficient ``indiscriminate growth," the optimal policy imposes a strict capability threshold that screens which creators receive platform traffic. Furthermore, it enforces disciplined growth for successful entrants, capping their follower bases at an optimal ceiling to prevent over-investment. Finally, we demonstrate that simple heuristics can lead to significant revenue losses (up to 25\%) and propose a practical ``follower-growth adjusted" heuristic that achieves near-optimal performance by leveraging observed growth momentum.

</details>


### [184] [A Spectral Filtering Approach to Regret Analysis of Distributed Online Control for Linear Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02375)
*Ting-Jui Chang*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究了分布式在线控制问题，将集中式Online Spectral Control框架扩展到网络化LTI系统。每个智能体通过局部观测和邻居通信生成控制序列，与最优集中式线性策略竞争。基于谱参数化的遗憾最小化框架下，建立了次线性遗憾界O(√T poly(log T)/γ³)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线控制研究大多集中于集中式设置，而在实际大规模系统中，控制器需要以分布式方式部署，仅能依赖局部信息和邻居通信。如何将集中式在线控制方法的理论保证（如子线性遗憾界）推广到分布式网络场景是一个重要的开放问题。

Method: 每个智能体利用Hankel矩阵的前导特征向量对过去扰动做卷积得到谱控制器，控制器参数通过分布式在线梯度下降在局部代理代价函数上更新。问题被建模为基于谱参数化的遗憾最小化问题。

Result: 在标准假设下，建立了次线性遗憾界O(√T poly(log T)/γ³)，其中T为时间范围，γ为稳定性裕度。该界同时刻画了网络规模和连通性对性能的影响。

Conclusion: 本文成功将集中式Online Spectral Control框架推广到分布式设置，证明了分布式在线控制可以达到与集中式相当的次线性遗憾界，且能显式捕捉网络拓扑结构的影响。

Abstract: This paper studies the distributed online control problem over a network of linear time-invariant (LTI) systems in the presence of adversarial disturbances and time-varying convex costs. The network cost is characterized by the summation of local cost functions, where each local function is sequentially revealed only to the corresponding agent. The goal of each agent is to generate a control sequence, using only local observations and neighbor communication, that competes with the best {\it centralized} linear policy in hindsight. We extend the recently proposed Online Spectral Control framework from the centralized setting to the distributed setting. In particular, each agent applies a spectral controller obtained by convolving past disturbances with the leading eigenvectors of a Hankel matrix, while the controller parameters are updated through a distributed online gradient descent step over the local surrogate costs. We formulate this problem this problem as a {\it regret} minimization problem based on the spectral parameterization, and under standard assumptions, we establish a sublinear regret bound of $O(\frac{\sqrt{T}\text{poly}(\log T)}{γ^3})$, where $T$ is the time horizon and $γ$ denotes the stability margin. The resulting bound also captures the dependence on the network size and connectivity.

</details>


### [185] [Timescale Separation Through the Lens of Operator Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02443)
*Guido Carnevale,Nicola Bastianello,Luca Schenato,Giuseppe Notarstefano,Ruggero Carli*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文建立了确定性随机算子不动点迭代的时间尺度分离理论，将算子系统与互联动力系统分析联系起来，并给出了可检验的时间尺度参数界。通过反馈优化方案验证了该框架在确定性和随机场景下的收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间尺度分离是分析互联动力系统的强大工具，而算子理论为研究优化、学习和控制中迭代方法的收敛性提供了一般性框架。然而，这两个领域此前缺乏系统的联系，需要建立桥接两者的理论框架。

Method: 作者建立了一个算子理论框架，用于确定性及随机算子的不动点迭代的时间尺度分离分析。该框架包含辅助系统，这些系统在时间尺度参数趋于零的极限下从原始互联中产生，分别捕捉慢算子和快算子的动力学。关键创新在于给出了时间尺度参数的显式且易于检验的界，以标准算子常数表示。

Result: 提出了一个统一的算子理论框架，为时间尺度分离提供了显式可检验的边界条件，并成功将其应用于证明反馈优化方案在确定性和随机设定下的收敛性质。

Conclusion: 该工作成功弥合了时间尺度分离理论与算子理论之间的鸿沟，为分析和设计多时间尺度迭代优化与学习算法提供了新的理论工具，具有广泛的适用前景。

Abstract: Timescale separation is a powerful tool for analyzing interconnected dynamical systems. Meanwhile, operator theory provides a general framework for studying the convergence of iterative methods formulated as fixed-point iterations, including algorithms arising in optimization, learning, and control. In this paper, we bridge these two areas by establishing timescale separation results for fixed-point iterations induced by both deterministic and stochastic operators. As customary in timescale separation, our results involve auxiliary systems that arise from the original interconnection in the limit as the timescale parameter tends to zero and separately capture the dynamics induced by the slow and fast operators. The proposed operator-theoretic framework yields explicit and readily checkable bounds on this tunable parameter, expressed in terms of standard operator constants. To illustrate the applicability of our results, we employ them to prove the convergence properties of a feedback optimization scheme in both deterministic and stochastic settings.

</details>


### [186] [Hidden Star-Convexity in Policy Optimization for Gain-Scheduled LQR: Extended Version](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02493)
*Shiva Shakeri,Péter Baranyi,Mehran Mesbahi*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 本文研究增益调度线性二次调节（LQR）的策略优化问题，证明了在最小化器闭环协方差下评估代价梯度时，调度代价关于最小化器具有星凸性，该恒等式在整个可行集上成立且与参数化无关。收敛性由单一无量纲比率控制，满足阈值条件时梯度下降以显式速率线性收敛，且所有伪驻点必然不满足该条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 增益调度LQR问题中，对一族被控对象优化一组通过固定加权函数插值的增益调度时，代价函数可能出现虚假局部极小值。现有的收敛性证明要么是局部的，要么过度保守，缺乏对全局优化行为的精确刻画。

Method: 作者建立了一个精确恒等式：当代价梯度在最小化器闭环协方差处评估时，调度代价关于最小化器是星凸的。该恒等式对任意增益调度参数化在整个可行集上均成立。进一步通过单一无量纲比率刻画收敛性，阈值条件决定梯度下降是否在整体子水平区域上以显式速率线性收敛。

Result: 证明了满足阈值条件时梯度下降在完整子水平区域以显式速率线性收敛到最优解；每个虚假驻点必定不满足该条件。通过直接最大化该比率的实验表明阈值是可行域景观的活跃边界。扩展版本包含完整证明及额外数值研究。

Conclusion: 本文首次为增益调度LQR提供了全局性的收敛保证，通过星凸性和无量纲比率刻画了优化景观的精确边界，为理解和规避虚假局部极小值提供了理论工具。

Abstract: We study policy optimization for gain-scheduled linear quadratic regulation, where one schedule of gains, interpolated through fixed weighting functions, is optimized against a family of plants. The resulting cost can develop spurious local minima, and existing convergence certificates are either local or severely conservative. We establish an exact identity: when the gradient of the cost is evaluated with the minimizer's closed-loop covariances, the scheduled cost is star-convex about the minimizer. The identity holds on the entire feasible set, for any parametrization of the schedule. Convergence is governed by a single dimensionless ratio. Wherever the ratio satisfies a threshold condition, gradient descent converges linearly to the optimum on entire sublevel regions at an explicit rate; at every spurious stationary point the condition necessarily fails. Experiments that maximize the ratio directly show the threshold to be an active boundary of the landscape. This extended version contains the complete proofs and additional numerical studies omitted from the letter for space.

</details>


<div id='cs.CY'></div>

# cs.CY [[Back]](#toc)

### [187] [Optimising for Flourishing: Flourishing Metrics and Return on Flourishing as Success Criteria for Artificial Intelligence and Post-AGI Economic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00151)
*Keyun Ruan,Jonathan D. Teubner,John M. Bremen*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出以人类繁荣（human flourishing）作为AI系统评估的首要成功标准，构建了包含物理、情感、财务、关系、精神及星球福祉六维度的Flourishing Metrics框架，并提出Return on Flourishing（RoF）作为衡量AI干预对繁荣贡献的决策架构，以弥补现有AI评估过度聚焦能力、安全性和经济代理指标的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI评估框架（能力、安全、效率、生产力、财务回报等）虽然必要但不充分，无法确定日益强大的AI系统是改善还是损害人类与地球福祉。需要将人类繁荣确立为AI发展的首要成功标准，以应对通用人工智能（AGI）及其后经济体系带来的根本性挑战。

Method: 通过整合性概念综合（integrative conceptual synthesis），提出三大贡献：(1) Flourishing Metrics——覆盖物理、情感、金融、关系、精神、星球福祉六个维度的可扩展框架，结合验证过的主观测量与代表性的行为、组织、社区和环境指标；(2) Return on Flourishing (RoF)——扩展ROI概念，评估干预措施、政策及AI系统对繁荣的反事实贡献，考量资源、风险与机会成本；(3) 分配敏感（distribution-sensitive）保障机制，通过商业试点展示RoF如何指导AI赋能的工作再设计、机构评估、保障及部署后监测。

Result: 将繁荣正式化为动态系统变量，强调民主化定义、经验校准、独立验证以及防止特定维度或利益相关群体遭受不可接受的损失。RoF并非作为通用奖励函数，而是作为价值核算与决策架构，用于评估智能、自动化及经济转型是否带来持久的人类和行星进步。

Conclusion: 人类繁荣应作为AI评估与开发的首要准则，RoF提供了一套超越传统经济指标的决策框架，有助于在AI时代引导技术进步服务于人类和地球的长期福祉。

Abstract: Current evaluation frameworks for artificial intelligence focus mainly on capability, safety, and proxies such as adoption, engagement, efficiency, productivity, and financial return. These criteria are necessary but insufficient because they do not establish whether increasingly powerful systems improve or degrade human and planetary well-being. Through an integrative conceptual synthesis, we argue that human flourishing should serve as a primary success criterion for artificial intelligence, the global race to develop increasingly capable AI systems, and prospective post-AGI economic systems. We make three contributions. First, Flourishing Metrics provides an extensible framework spanning physical, emotional, financial, relational, spiritual, and planetary well-being, combining validated subjective measures with representative behavioural, organisational, community, and environmental indicators. Second, Return on Flourishing (RoF) extends return on investment by evaluating the counterfactual contribution of interventions, policies, and AI systems to flourishing relative to their resources, risks, and opportunity costs. Third, we develop distribution-sensitive safeguards and show how RoF could guide AI-enabled work redesign, institutional appraisal, assurance, and post-deployment monitoring through business pilots. We formalise flourishing as a dynamic system variable while emphasising the need for democratic specification, empirical calibration, independent validation, and protection against unacceptable losses within particular dimensions or stakeholder groups. RoF is proposed not as a universal reward function, but as a value-accounting and decision architecture for assessing whether intelligence, automation, and economic transformation generate durable human and planetary progress.

</details>


### [188] [A Protocol for Evaluating the Accessibility of AI-Generated Educational Materials: Prompt Configuration, WCAG-Derived Criteria, and Content Overload](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00749)
*Hector R. Amado-Salvatierra*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个评估AI生成教育材料可访问性的协议，对照WCAG标准评价五种内容类型和多款工具，比较三种提示配置条件。初步探索实验显示，WCAG显式配置可将合规分数从24.2%提升至96.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI工具越来越多地用于制作教育材料，但人们对这些内容是否符合可访问性要求知之甚少。已有证据表明生成式AI默认会复现不可访问的实践，需要显式配置才能改善合规性，但WCAG清单无法捕捉AI合成内容常见的视觉和信息过载问题。

Method: 提出一套评估协议，覆盖五种内容类型和多款工具，比较三种条件：无可访问性语言的通用提示、显式配置WCAG标准的单一提示、以及一次性加载的可复用可访问性配置文件。评估结合基于WCAG的评分量规和可访问性专家的启发式验证，弥补自动扫描器的不足。

Result: 初步探索实验显示，通用条件下的合规分数为24.2%，在WCAG显式配置条件下提升至96.7%（使用单一模型、每种条件每个类型一个产物、单人评分）；持久配置文件条件未被测试。

Conclusion: 主要贡献是方法论层面的：提供可复现的协议和开放的评估工具，并记录非配置AI内容对残障人群造成的障碍案例。该协议是社区可在完整基准规模上应用和扩展的可复用资源，同时旨在提高对生成式AI引入可访问性障碍的认识。

Abstract: Generative AI tools increasingly produce educational materials: documents, slides, images, audio, and video, yet little is known about whether this content meets accessibility requirements. This paper presents a protocol for evaluating the accessibility of AI-generated educational materials against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), across five content types and multiple tools. The protocol compares three conditions applied to the same tool: a generic instruction with no accessibility language; a single prompt explicitly configured with WCAG criteria; and a persistent, reusable accessibility profile loaded once rather than re-specified each time. Evaluation combines a WCAG rubric per content type with heuristic validation by accessibility experts, addressing a known limitation of automated scanners. Prior evidence shows generative AI tools reproduce inaccessible practices by default, and that explicit configuration measurably improves compliance. This paper extends that discussion to a dimension WCAG checklists miss: visual and informational overload common in AI-synthesized content. The main contribution is methodological: a reproducible protocol and open evaluation instrument, with cases documenting the barriers non-configured AI content creates for people with disabilities. A first exploratory application is also reported: a rubric-based compliance score rose from a pooled mean of 24.2% under the generic condition to 96.7% under the WCAG-configured condition, using one model, one artifact per condition and type, and single-evaluator scoring; the persistent-profile condition was not exercised. The protocol is a reusable resource for the community to apply and extend at full benchmark scale. Beyond the protocol, this work aims to raise awareness of accessibility obstacles generative AI can introduce, and encourage creators to consider accessibility when using these tools.

</details>


### [189] [CodeStylist: Supporting Early Undergraduate Programmers with Course-Aware Code Style Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00839)
*Ethan Dickey,Libra Vento,Peter Kurto,Andres Bejarano*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文介绍了CodeStylist，一个为早期本科生编程课程提供课程标准感知代码风格反馈的Web应用。专家评审（18名教学人员）显示其具有中等感知实用性和有限信任度（正确性平均60.7%，帮助度3.50/5，实用性3.33/5，预期学生学习2.61/5），但17/18的受访者预期学生至少每周使用该工具进行风格检查。反馈表明课程感知的风格反馈作为提交前修订辅助工具有前景，但未来版本应结合确定性规则检查与LLM生成解释、规则引用和更强的验证支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学生被期望遵循本地编程风格规范（命名、格式、注释、组织、可读性），但反馈往往延迟或不一致。通用linter或通用LLM提示无法支持课程特定标准，存在教学空白。

Method: 开发了CodeStylist Web应用，支持课程特定标准、多文件提交、文件和行级定位解释，旨在引导修订而非评分。进行形成性专家评审，18名教学人员使用自选代码工件探索原型，并完成关于响应质量、预期学生使用和重新设计优先级的调查。

Result: 调查显示中等效用但有限信任：感知正确性平均60.7%，响应帮助度3.50/5，实用性3.33/5，预期学生学习2.61/5。17/18的受访者预期学生主要将该工具用于风格检查，通常至少每周一次。开放反馈显示受访者重视CodeStylist使隐性课程标准更可见，但担心输出不可靠、过度依赖和延迟/成本问题。

Conclusion: 课程感知的风格反馈作为提交前修订辅助工具有前景，但未来版本应结合确定性规则检查与LLM生成解释、规则引用和更强的验证支持。

Abstract: This innovative practice full paper presents CodeStylist, a web application that provides course-standard-aware code style feedback for early undergraduate programming courses. CodeStylist addresses a common instructional gap: students are expected to follow local conventions for naming, formatting, comments, organization, and readability, but feedback on these expectations is often delayed or inconsistent. Unlike generic linters or general-purpose LLM prompts, CodeStylist supports course-specific standards, multi-file submissions, and file- and line-localized explanations intended to guide revision rather than grade correctness. We report a formative expert review with 18 instructional staff from one early undergraduate programming course. Participants explored the prototype using self-selected code artifacts and completed a survey about response quality, anticipated student use, and redesign priorities. Ratings indicated modest perceived utility but limited trust: perceived correctness averaged 60.7%, response helpfulness averaged 3.50/5, response usefulness averaged 3.33/5, and anticipated student learning averaged 2.61/5. Despite these concerns, 17/18 respondents expected students to use the tool primarily for style checking, often at least weekly.
  Open-ended feedback showed that respondents valued CodeStylist for making implicit course standards more visible, but were concerned about unreliable output, overreliance, and latency or cost. We interpret these findings as evidence that course-aware style feedback is promising as a pre-submission revision aid, but that future versions should combine deterministic rule checks with LLM-generated explanations, rule citations, and stronger verification support.

</details>


### [190] [BoilerSketch: A TA-Supervised, Diagram-First GenAI Practice for Structured Diagrams in CS1/Early CS2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00844)
*Ethan Dickey,Vivan Tiwari,Anvit Sinha,Andres Bejarano*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: BoilerSketch是一个由助教监督、以图表为先的GenAI实践工具，采用聊天+笔控白板双面板交互模式，通过约束模型生成结构化的Mermaid图表来为CS1和早期CS2课程提供视觉化概念解释，经21名教学人员评估，三分之二认为其对概念理解有一定帮助。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型早期计算机课程在实验室和办公时间面临支持瓶颈，许多学生问题最好用图表而非额外文本来回答，但大多数AI辅导工具仍以文本为主，且难以生成准确、教学上有用的视觉内容。

Method: 采用双面板交互模型（聊天+笔控白板）让学生进行草图绘制；通过提示策略约束模型生成结构化的可渲染Mermaid图表而非自由形式图像；系统范围限定为概念解释（禁止可执行代码和代码级调试）；采用人类参与工作流，助教作为监督者监控会话并在需要时干预。

Result: 对来自大型编程课程的21名教学人员进行45分钟专家评估，三分之二认为系统在概念理解和典型支持任务上至少中度有帮助/有用。员工认为常规图表解释价值最大，但指出图表深度和高级主题适用性有限。

Conclusion: 提出在早期计算机课程中采用受监督的、图表为先的GenAI支持的实践指导，强调范围与升级规则、提示作为政策护栏以及可靠的结构化图表渲染。

Abstract: This innovative practice full paper presents BoilerSketch, a TA-supervised, diagram-first GenAI practice and tablet interface for providing structured visual explanations in CS1 and early CS2 support settings. Large early computing courses routinely face a support bottleneck during labs and office hours because many student questions are best answered with a diagram rather than additional text, yet most AI tutoring tools remain text-forward and unreliable at producing accurate, pedagogically useful visuals.
  BoilerSketch addresses this gap through a dual-pane interaction model that combines chat with a pen-enabled whiteboard for student sketches and a prompting strategy that constrains the model to generate structured, renderable Mermaid diagrams rather than free-form images. To preserve academic integrity, the system is intentionally scoped to conceptual explanation: it forbids executable code and code-level debugging and uses a human-in-the-loop workflow in which teaching assistants remain accountable supervisors who can monitor sessions and intervene when responses require correction, deeper probing, or escalation to live help.
  We report a 45-minute expert evaluation with 21 instructional staff from a large programming course who used BoilerSketch on representative questions and completed a post-use survey. Two-thirds rated the system at least moderately helpful for conceptual understanding and at least moderately useful for typical support tasks. Staff saw the strongest value in routine diagram-based explanations and noted limits in diagram depth and applicability to more advanced topics. We conclude with practical guidance for adopting supervised, diagram-first GenAI support in early computing courses, emphasizing scope-and-escalation rules, prompt-as-policy guardrails, and reliable structured diagram rendering.

</details>


### [191] [Governing Mental-State Inference: Source-Neutral Regulatory Triggers and Tiered Obligations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00936)
*Shinnosuke Horiuchi*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文基于2025年联合国教科文组织《神经技术伦理建议书》作为非约束性指导，提出一个"来源中立"（source-neutral）的触发机制来规制技术中介的、与个人关联的心智状态归属。通过概念工程和功能法律比较，作者将诱发（elicitation）、归属（attribution）与使用（use）分离为累积性规制对象，并设计了七个有序问题与两个升级谓词，将允许的实践归入三个义务层级，最终提出一个分类工具而非经验验证的规制结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有法律分类存在漏洞：两种系统可以向同一机构决策者提供相同的个人关联归属，却因来源不同（神经信号 vs 文本/行为）落入不同法律类别。来源绑定（source-bound）规则允许规避；而泛化的"心智数据"类别又可能把可错的输出当作心智事实。因此需要一种来源中立的规制触发机制。

Method: 采用选择性批判综合、概念工程、功能法律比较和配对反事实案例的方法。将诱发、归属与使用分离为累积的规制对象；区分两种伤害路径与两个独立评估的义务序列；设计七个有序问题与两个升级谓词将实践分配到三个义务层级。

Result: 得出规制方案：推定禁止保留给实质性影响自主性的非自愿闭环干预，以及特定组合的隐蔽/胁迫性推断、核心属性、后果性决策和操控的组合。共同入口不会消除来源相关的加重因素——侵入性、具身性和闭环能力可增加义务或设定更高最低标准，而后果性的非神经推断也可达到相同的层级。

Conclusion: 最终方案是一个分类装置，而非经验验证的规制结果。该框架为神经技术伦理规制提供了超越来源绑定的新路径，既避免了"心智数据"泛化分类的风险，又保留了来源相关因素作为义务加重机制的作用。

Abstract: Two systems can supply the same person-linked attribution to the same institutional decision maker yet fall into different legal categories: one uses neural signals, the other text or behaviour. A source-bound rule therefore permits circumvention, while an all-purpose category of "mental data" risks treating fallible outputs as facts about the mind. This article reads the 2025 UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Neurotechnology as non-binding guidance and develops a source-neutral trigger for technologically mediated, person-linked mental-state attribution. Through selective critical synthesis, conceptual engineering, functional legal comparison, and matched counterfactual cases, it separates elicitation, attribution, and use as cumulative objects of regulation. The analysis also distinguishes two harm pathways from two independently assessed duty series. Seven ordered questions and two escalation predicates assign permitted practices to three duty tiers. Presumptive prohibition is reserved for materially autonomy-affecting non-consensual closed-loop intervention and for specified combinations of covert or coercive inference, core attributes, consequential decisions, and manipulation. Common entry does not erase source-related aggravators: invasiveness, embodiment, and closed-loop capacity can add duties or set a higher minimum, while consequential non-neural inference can reach the same tier. The resulting scheme is a classification device, not an empirically validated regulatory outcome.

</details>


### [192] [The Epistemic Politics of AI Anthropomorphism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00961)
*Donna M Bye,Levin Kuhlmann*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文批判AI拟人化(anthropomorphism)的主流学术框架。作者认为，学术界将用户与AI的拟人化互动视为"认知错误"的立场，并非基于合理的认识论权威，而是出于制度性优势（institutional advantage）。这种框架通过自我验证的证据循环（self-validating evidentiary loop）固化自身，并将成本不成比例地强加给神经多样性用户、处于危机中的人群及偏离制度规范的互动方式。论文质疑的不是拟人化解释本身是否正确，而是制定和维持这些解释的制度机构是否具备相应的正当性条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI拟人化研究普遍将其视为"用户误感知"问题，需要制度性纠正。持续或关系性使用AI的用户常被病理化、贬低为不够明智或缺乏辨别力。本文挑战这一主导框架，认为它从制度优势地位而非具有认识论正当性的立场运作，既未经充分论证，又对特定用户群体造成实际伤害，亟需重新审视。

Method: 本文采用批判性理论分析与认识论审查的方法。作者不直接介入"拟人化解释是否正确"的实证争论，而是：（1）解构主流拟人化框架的制度化运作方式；（2）揭示其自我验证的证据循环机制；（3）分析框架所施加的不对称成本分配；（4）提出公平框架应遵循的方法论承诺。

Result: 论文揭示了拟人化框架的三重问题：学术视角多样性被压缩为单一"用户错误"的出口立场；框架在未确立正当性依据的情况下强加于用户；框架所产生的不成比例伤害（尤其针对神经多样性用户及危机中人群）未被核算。此外，论文指出该框架通过自我验证循环自我再生产，使制度规范得以延续。

Conclusion: 论文主张，AI拟人化议题的核心问题不在于判断拟人化解释的真伪，而在于：决定这些解释的制度性和治理性机构是否已满足做出此类判定的条件；以及支撑这些判定的研究共同体是否履行了将翻译结果对用户负责的义务。作者据此勾勒了公平框架所需遵循的方法论承诺。

Abstract: AI anthropomorphism is typically treated as a problem of user misperception requiring institutional correction. Users who engage in sustained or relational interaction with AI are routinely pathologised or dismissed as naive, vulnerable to delusion or lacking in discernment. This paper argues that the dominant anthropomorphism frame operates from a position of institutional advantage rather than earned epistemic authority: collapsing the variety of academic perspectives into a single outbound position of user error, imposed without establishing the grounds required to justify it and without accounting for the harms it produces. The framing does not simply manage risk. It adjudicates the legitimacy of human experience in interaction with a phenomenon whose nature the field itself has not resolved. Reproducing itself through a self-validating evidentiary loop, the frame imposes costs that fall disproportionately on neurodivergent users, those in crisis and others whose modes of engagement diverge from institutional norms. The paper concludes by outlining the methodological commitments an equitable framing would need to honour. The argument does not engage the question of whether anthropomorphic interpretations are ultimately correct; it instead challenges whether the governing and institutional bodies determining these interpretations have met the conditions required to do so, and whether the research communities whose findings underpin them have held that translation to account.

</details>


### [193] [Copyright Is the Headline; Capability Is the Blind Spot: AI Technology in the Book-Publishing Trade Press, November 2025--August 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00964)
*Fred Zimmerman*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本快速证据综述分析了2025年11月1日至2026年8月1日间发表的89篇关于人工智能与图书出版的文章，涵盖八种语言。研究发现媒体对AI的态度并非单纯的敌意或沉默：30%为风险框架、42%为混合框架、28%为机会框架。中文报道更注重操作性和机会导向；专家评论的技术深度显著高于行业报道。然而，整个语料库仍集中于权利、许可、治理、读者信任、工作流采用和产品公告，仅有10篇文章提供持续的技术审视，且没有一篇以前沿实验室研究员或评估工程师的直接访谈为中心。核心缺口在于将模型架构和评估与出版决策相联系的报道。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者旨在系统评估大众媒体和专业评论对AI与图书出版交叉领域的报道质量，识别报道中的结构性缺失——特别是技术深度不足、缺乏实验室直接声音等问题——从而为出版行业和新闻界提供改进方向。

Method: 采用快速证据综述方法，对89篇文章进行有目的抽样（覆盖英语、中文、德语、法语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语和日语的出版报道、主流报纸书籍报道以及专业科技评论员文章），并对每篇按主题、立场、技术深度和主导声音进行编码分析。

Result: 报道立场呈三分格局：风险框架占30%、混合占42%、机会框架占28%。中文报道更操作化且机会导向；专家评论比贸易报道技术深度大得多。但语料仍聚焦于版权、许可、治理、读者信任、工作流采用和产品公告。仅10篇有持续技术审视，无一含实验室研究员或评估工程师的直接访谈。核心缺口在于模型架构/评估与出版决策的连接。

Conclusion: 作者建议设立常设AI报道版面、定期实验室访谈、声明台账、共享测试协议、读者小组和技术专栏作家，以填补报道空白。补充材料提供完整编码语料、声明台账、术语表和BibTeX数据库。

Abstract: This rapid evidence review examines 89 articles about artificial intelligence (AI) and book publishing published from November 1, 2025 through August 1, 2026.
