Furthermore, the BDD-constrained design integrates a guaranteed minimum decay rate and defines a novel numerical metric to quantify the conservatism inherent in the decentralized stability certificate. The proposed control design with BDD constraints and minimum decay rate implementation is validated through a case study of the IEEE 9-bus test system.

</details>


### [228] [Smoothing the Ramp, Not the Peak: Scheduling-Induced Power Dynamics of LLM Inference and Their Grid-Scale Consequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01250)
*Pan Li,Yize Chen,Xia Miao,Dai Wang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究了大规模语言模型（LLM）推理服务的电力负载动态特性，发现分块预填充（chunked prefill）调度——一种生产中默认部署的低延迟技术——可作为可控旋钮调节功率爬坡速率而不影响峰值功率。该效益随系统饱和度单调增长（轻载7.0%至重载34.6%的均值爬坡降低），在高"鲸鱼"长提示词负载下可达42.6%。通过无模型bootstrap的机会约束规划，该机制可转化为电网调节储备采购的量化收益，在95%-99.9%可靠性水平下实现20.3%-22.7%的快爬坡备用容量削减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理服务是快速增长的电力负载，但其功率动态特性尚未从电网规划角度得到刻画。随着数据中心负载快速增长，电网运营商面临功率快速爬坡带来的调节储备压力，亟需了解并利用可用的需求侧调控工具。

Method: 基于真实测量的GPU功率轨迹，分析分块预fill调度对功率爬坡速率的影响；沿着并发度和长提示词（鲸鱼请求）负载两个独立轴验证效益的单调增长性；将单GPU机制转化为电网调节储备采购问题，采用无模型bootstrap直接重采样真实功率轨迹，构建并求解机会约束规划问题。

Result: 分块预fill调度保持峰值功率基本不变，但显著降低平均爬坡速率；效益随系统饱和度单调增长（并发度维度：轻载7.0%到重载34.6%；鲸鱼负载维度：低发生率时统计平坦到高发生率时42.6%）；在95%-99.9%可靠性水平下，可实现20.3%-22.7%的快爬坡备用容量削减。

Conclusion: 分块预fill调度为电网运营商提供了一种零成本的需求整形工具，其效益在数据中心运行最热、电网压力最显著时最大。这一发现为LLM推理服务的电力负载管理提供了实用的、立即可用的手段。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference serving is a fast-growing electricity load whose power dynamics remain uncharacterized from a grid-planning perspective. Using real, measured GPU power traces, we show that chunked prefill scheduling, a latency-motivated technique already deployed by default in production LLM serving, is a controllable knob that regulates power ramp rate without touching peak power. Contrary to the intuitive hypothesis that splitting a long prompt's computation into smaller steps should flatten its power spike, peak power stays relatively the same while mean ramp rate falls substantially. Critically, this ramp-rate benefit is not a fixed property of the policy: it grows monotonically with system saturation, and we confirm this along two independent axes: concurrency (7.0% at light load to 34.6% at heavy load, mean-ramp reduction) and long-prompt ("whale") request load (from statistically flat at low whale incidence to 42.6% at high whale fraction/size). We translate this single-GPU mechanism into an operational grid quantity, regulation-reserve procurement, posed and solved as a chance-constrained problem using a model-free bootstrap directly resampling real measured power traces. At a representative operating point, this translates to an estimated 20.3-22.7% reduction in the fast-ramping reserve capacity a grid operator would need to provision, across reliability levels from 95% to 99.9%. Together, these results give grid operators a no-cost demand-shaping tool available today, whose benefit is largest precisely when data centers run hottest and grid stress is most salient.

</details>


### [229] [Improving a Hybrid Algorithm for APCS Hierarchical Architecture Design via Hyperparameter Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01296)
*Ruslan Zakirzyanov*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究了从现成工业组件构建自动化过程控制系统的组合优化问题，提出了一种混合方法，结合确定性构建算法和蚁群元启发式算法进行设备选择，并对元启发式算法的超参数进行优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业自动化过程控制系统具有层级多级树状架构，从具有预定特性的现成工业组件构建此类系统是一个多约束的复杂组合优化问题，需要有效的求解方法。

Method: 提出一种混合方法，将确定性构建算法与蚁群元启发式算法相结合，用于设备选择；同时针对依赖超参数的元启发式算法，提出超参数优化策略。

Result: 论文给出了通用问题形式化描述、定义了优化准则、描述了求解方法，并通过多个数值示例验证了所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过数值实验表明，该混合方法能够有效解决自动化过程控制系统树状结构的构建问题，超参数优化能进一步提升元启发式算法的性能。

Abstract: Automated process control systems, widely used in industry, have a hierarchical multi-level tree-based architecture and are built using specialized hardware and software. Constructing such a control system from off-the-shelf industrial components with predetermined characteristics is a complex combinatorial optimization problem with multiple constraints. A hybrid method for constructing a tree-based structure is considered, combining a deterministic construction algorithm and an ant colony metaheuristic for device selection. The effectiveness of the metaheuristic algorithm depends on its hyperparameters, which are proposed to be optimized. This paper presents a general problem formulation, defines optimization criteria, describes the solution method, and provides several numerical examples.

</details>


### [230] [A Luenberger Observer for P-Time Event Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01371)
*Dominik Tirpák,Davide Zorzenon,Jörg Raisch*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究P-Time事件图（P-TEGs）中转变触发时间的估计问题。P-TEGs是离散事件系统，通过包括令牌驻留时间的上界和下界约束来扩展定时事件图（TEGs）的建模能力。作者基于经典的Luenberger观测器设计了一个算法，利用P-TEGs上界约束带来的额外限制，在仅能观测部分转变的条件下获得更精确的触发时间估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: P-TEGs因其能够建模同步和延迟现象而被广泛使用，但现有的观测器设计主要针对TEGs，未充分利用P-TEGs中上界约束提供的额外信息，导致触发时间估计不够精确。

Method: 基于经典的Luenberger观测器框架，设计了一个考虑P-TEGs上界约束的估计算法。该算法利用上界约束所提供的信息来改进触发时间的估计精度，同时处理仅部分转变可观测的约束条件。

Result: 所提出的算法能够在P-TEGs中获得比传统方法更准确的转变触发时间估计。

Conclusion: 通过利用P-TEGs中上界约束带来的额外限制，可以显著提升在部分观测条件下转变触发时间的估计精度，为P-TEGs的监控和诊断提供更有效的工具。

Abstract: P-Time Event Graphs (P-TEGs) are discrete event systems able to model synchronization and delay phenomena. They extend the modeling power of Timed Event Graphs (TEGs) by including not only lower-bound, but also upper-bound constraints on the sojourn times of tokens in places. In this work, we consider the problem of estimating the firing time of transitions in P-TEGs, assuming that only a subset of transitions can be directly observed. Building on the (now classical) Luenberger observer for TEGs, we design an algorithm that takes into account the additional restrictions posed by the upper-bound constraints of P-TEGs to obtain a more accurate firing time estimation.

</details>


### [231] [Bidirectional Power Packet Transmission Using an Inductive Energy Buffer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01557)
*Yoshito Imanishi,Shiu Mochiyama*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种全可控的双向功率包传输方法，通过路由器间并联电感作为临时能量缓冲器，克服传统功率包路由器的两个物理层限制（传输方向不可控、每包能量可控性有限），并通过原型硬件实验验证了可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的共母线结构及其固有的母线稳压要求限制了电池供电自主系统的供电灵活性、可扩展性和即插即用能力。功率包化通过时分复用物理隔离的功率流消除共母线，但传统功率包路由器存在两个物理层限制：传输方向不可控以及每包能量可控性有限。

Method: 提出一种全可控的双向功率包传输方案，设计了一种带并联电感作为临时能量缓冲器的路由器间电路，使功率能够朝任意方向传输且完全控制传输能量；推导了路由器执行该操作的开关算法，并通过原型硬件进行实验验证。

Result: 通过使用原型硬件的实验验证，证明了所提出的双向功率包传输方案和开关算法的可行性。

Conclusion: 该方案解决了传统功率包路由器在传输方向和能量控制方面的局限性，为电池供电自主系统提供了更灵活、更可控的功率传输方式。

Abstract: The typical common-bus structure and its inherent bus stabilization requirement can become a bottleneck for flexibility in power supplies for battery-powered autonomous systems, limiting scalability and plug-and-play capability. Power packetization overcomes this by eliminating the common bus through time-division multiplexing of physically isolated power flows. However, conventional power packet routers face two physical-layer limitations: uncontrollable transmission direction and limited controllability of the amount of energy per packet. This paper proposes a fully controllable bidirectional power packet transmission to address these limitations. We introduce an inter-router circuit featuring a parallel inductor as a temporary energy buffer, enabling power transmission in any direction with full control over the transferred energy. We derive the switching algorithm for the routers to perform this operation and verify its feasibility through experiments using prototype hardware.

</details>


### [232] [On input-output persistency and the interconnection of positive nonlinear systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01699)
*Arthut Castello B. de Oliveira,Moh K. Wafi,Eduardo D. Sontag*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究正非线性SISO系统的反馈互联，提出两个互补性质：被控对象的持续输入/持续输出（PIPO）和控制器的持续输入/瞬态输出（PITO）。在闭环前向完备性和控制器输出满足单侧仿射增长的假设下，证明了PIPO和PITO联合蕴含控制信号的有界性。该结果是输入输出性质的，不需要子系统满足线性或单调性，但不保证控制器完整状态的有界性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 正系统反馈互联中的信号有界性分析通常依赖于线性或单调性等强假设，缺乏通用的输入输出层面的判定条件。本文旨在建立更一般的框架，无需线性或单调性假设即可分析正非线性系统反馈互联中控制信号的有界性。

Method: 提出了PIPO（被控对象）和PITO（控制器）两个互补性质；在闭环前向完备性和控制器输出单侧仿射增长界的假设下证明PIPO与PITO联合蕴含控制信号有界；为正单调被控对象提供了结构性PIPO条件（基于类K∞稳态特性）；对反余积分控制器建立了带显式增益的PITO；并在一个具有乘性控制器增长的非线性积分反馈基序上进行了验证。

Result: 证明了PIPO和PITO联合蕴含控制信号的有界性；给出了正单调被控对象的结构性PIPO条件；为反余积分控制器建立了显式增益的PITO；在非线性积分反馈基序上验证了框架的有效性。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种不依赖线性和单调性假设的输入输出层面的有界性分析方法，但局限性在于一般不能保证控制器完整状态的有界性，且要求闭环前向完备性等条件。

Abstract: In this paper we study feedback interconnections of positive nonlinear SISO systems and introduce two complementary properties: persistent-input/persistent-output (PIPO) for the plant and persistent-input/transient-output (PITO) for the controller. Assuming forward completeness of the closed loop and a one-sided affine growth bound on the controller output, we show that PIPO and PITO jointly imply boundedness of the control signal. The result is input-output in nature and does not require linearity or monotonicity of the interconnected subsystems, although it does not in general guarantee boundedness of the full controller state. We provide a structural PIPO condition for positive monotone plants with a class-\(\mathcal K_\infty\) steady-state characteristic, establish PITO for the antithetic integral controller with explicit gains, and illustrate the framework on a nonlinear integral-feedback motif with multiplicative controller growth.

</details>


### [233] [PHY-Layer Modeling and Throughput-Driven Adaptation for Batteryless V2X Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01928)
*Zhaoyu Liu,Ruikang Li,Liu Cao,YuKun Pan,Xiangkai Wang,Lyutianyang Zhang*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究了一种面向无电池设备的V2X被动叠加通信架构，在DSRC数据包中同时承载传统V2X数据和被动叠加载荷。文章建立了紧凑的PHY层模型，并提出基于多智能体强化学习（MARL）的自适应参数选择方法，实验表明该方法可实现稳定收敛并将平均吞吐量提升15%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无电池设备的被动叠加通信是下一代V2X网络的关键使能能力，但在不占用额外频谱的情况下实现可靠的被动载荷传输仍具挑战性，因为叠加信令必须嵌入到短且时变的车辆数据包中，同时保持传统主机传输的可解码性。

Method: 1) 提出一种基于DSRC的分组化无电池V2X叠加架构，在同一数据包中同时携带传统V2X数据和被动叠加载荷；2) 建立紧凑的PHY层模型，刻画衰减深度、嵌入比特率和传统调制编码方案（MCS）对主机链路和被动链路可靠性的耦合影响；3) 构建联合考虑传统分组错误率和被动解码错误率的和吞吐量最大化问题；4) 提出基于多智能体强化学习（MARL）的自适应参数选择方法。

Result: 仿真结果表明，所提出的MARL控制器实现了稳定收敛，并将平均吞吐量提升了15%，验证了吞吐量驱动的物理层自适应方案对无电池V2X叠加通信的有效性。

Conclusion: 本文证明通过MARL驱动的PHY层自适应参数选择，可以在不占用额外频谱的前提下实现可靠的分组化被动叠加V2X通信，为下一代V2X网络中无电池设备接入提供了一种有效方案。

Abstract: Passive overlay communication for batteryless devices is an important enabling capability for next-generation vehicle-to-everything (V2X) networks. However, enabling reliable passive payload delivery without occupying additional spectrum remains challenging, since overlay signaling must be embedded into short and time-varying vehicular packets while preserving the decodability of the legacy host transmission. This paper investigates a packetized batteryless V2X overlay architecture in which a dedicated short-range communications (DSRC)-based packet simultaneously carries conventional V2X data and a passive overlay payload. A compact PHY-layer model is developed to characterize the coupled effects of attenuation depth, embedded-bit rate, and legacy modulation and coding scheme (MCS) on host-link and passive-link reliability, as well as packet-level embedding feasibility. We then formulate a sum-throughput maximization problem that jointly accounts for the legacy packet error rate and passive decoding error rate. We further propose a multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL)-based adaptive parameter-selection method. Simulation results show that the proposed MARL controller achieves stable convergence and improves the average throughput by 15\%, demonstrating the effectiveness of throughput-driven PHY adaptation for batteryless V2X overlay communications.

</details>


### [234] [A Fair Comparison of Sliding-Mode and Immersion-and-Invariance Observers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02000)
*A. J. Munoz-Vazquez,J. D. Sanchez-Torres*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文对Cervantes-Pérez等人关于高增益注入不可行的论断进行了实验反驳。作者在相同平台和参数下重新仿真并硬件实现了Davila-Fridman-Poznyak超螺旋观测器和I&I观测器，发现：超螺旋方案在标称响应上不变且对观测器增益有50倍鲁棒性；I&I裕度在k_v≈170处发生反转；十倍缩短采样步长对I&I影响显著但对SM影响极小。硬件实验表明，按Levant-Moreno扰动界调参的signum超螺旋观测器在ISE、ITAE、ISC指标上全面优于I&I，且无 audible chattering。作者认为Cervantes-Pérez等人报告的抖振是其增益超出合理范围两个数量级的有意后果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反驳Cervantes-Pérez等人基于实验声称"高增益注入实际不可行"的结论。作者认为该论断以SM观测器为原型范例不妥，需要重新验证其真实性与普遍性。

Method: 在相同植物、轨迹和增益下，采用显式Euler积分（Δt=1ms和0.1ms）重新仿真，并在独立硬件上实现两种观测器（超螺旋SM观测器和I&I观测器），从极点位置、I&I裕度、采样步长敏感性及硬件实测指标（ISE/ITAE/ISC、抖振）等多维度进行对比。

Result: i) 控制器增益产生的极点位于-1.455和-1098.5（ζ=13.7），超螺旋方案能处理该标称响应且对自身观测器增益有50倍不变性；ii) I&I裕度随k_v单调变化并在k_v≈170（环路极点穿越-9.0 rad/s诱导观测器极点）时反转；iii) 采样步长缩小十倍使I&I指标变化3倍，而SM指标仅变化0.2%。硬件上，按扰动界调参的signum超螺旋观测器同时优于I&I的ISE、ITAE、ISC，且无audible chattering。

Conclusion: Cervantes-Pérez等人报告的抖振是其增益超调（超出合理调参处方两个数量级）的有意设计后果，而非高增益注入本身的固有缺陷。超螺旋SM观测器在合理调参下完全可行且表现优异，其"高增益不可行"的结论被实验证据否定。

Abstract: Cervantes-Pérez et al. (arXiv:2601.12545) claim, on experimental grounds, that high-gain injection is practically inadmissible, taking the SM observer of Davila, Fridman & Poznyak as a prototypical example. We re-simulate their plant, trajectory and gains with explicit Euler integration at Δt = 1 ms and 0.1 ms, and implement both observers on independent hardware. We got three findings: i) the controller gains k_p=1600, k_v=1100 place the tracking-error poles at the "pathological" locations -1.455 and -1098.5 (ζ= 13.7); the super-twisting scheme lands on the resulting nominal response and is invariant to its own observer gain over a fifty-fold range; ii) the I&I margin is monotone in k_v and reverses near k_v \approx 170, where the loop pole crosses the induced observer pole at -9.0 rad/s; iii) refining the sampling step tenfold moves every I&I figure by a factor of three, while the SM figures move by 0.2%. On hardware, a signum-based super-twisting observer tuned at the Levant-Moreno perturbation bound outperforms I&I on ISE, ITAE and ISC simultaneously, without audible chattering, on a $60 motor with a 0.043^\circ encoder at 500 Hz. The gains of Cervantes-Perez et al. exceed the same prescription by two orders of magnitude; the chattering the authors report is the designed consequence of that excess.

</details>


### [235] [A General Set-Based Framework for Cognitive State Estimation: Theory and Application to Conditionally Automated Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02308)
*Sibibalan Jeevanandam,Neera Jain*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于集合论（set-based）的框架来估计人机交互（HAI）中的人类认知状态，将过程和测量不确定性视为未知但有界，而非依赖概率分布假设。在SAE Level 3条件自动化驾驶场景中，该框架估计信任、感知风险和认知负荷三种认知状态，通过融合二值化依赖观察和间歇性量化自我报告产生集合值估计。基于20名参与者的驾驶模拟器实验表明，该估计器达到至少75%的一致性，且多步预测性能优于开环基线和粒子滤波器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HAI文献中占主导地位的概率方法需要大量结构化数据集或对噪声做分布假设，这些条件在真实人机交互场景中往往难以满足。作者旨在提出一种无需这些假设的替代框架，以实现在连续、非试验性交互中估计影响人类对自动化依赖的认知状态。

Method: 1) 采用混合动态建模框架识别个体特定的过程和测量模型；2) 通过强制可达集一致性（reachset conformance）系统地估计噪声边界；3) 识别影响每个个体对自动化依赖的认知状态子集；4) 融合二值化依赖观察和间歇性量化自我报告，产生认知状态的集合值估计。

Result: 在中等保真度驾驶模拟器中20名参与者的面对面实验中，集合值估计器在测试阶段对大多数参与者达到至少75%的一致性；在15、30、45、60时间步的所有预测时域上，多步前向依赖预测均优于开环基线和粒子滤波器，且性能差距在更长预测时域上更为显著。

Conclusion: 所提出的估计框架能够使自动化系统持续感知并响应驾驶员的状态，为人机交互中的认知状态估计提供了一种无需大规模数据和分布假设的替代方案。

Abstract: We present a set-based framework for estimating human cognitive states in human-automation interaction (HAI) contexts. Unlike probabilistic approaches dominant in the HAI literature, our framework treats process and measurement uncertainties as unknown but bounded, avoiding the need for large structured datasets or distributional assumptions on noise. We demonstrate the framework in the context of conditionally automated (SAE Level 3) driving, where we estimate three cognitive states (trust, perceived risk, and workload) that influence human reliance on the automation during a continuous, non-trial-based interaction. We leverage a hybrid dynamical modeling framework to identify individual-specific process and measurement models, systematically estimate noise bounds by enforcing reachset conformance, and identify the subset of cognitive states that influence each individual's reliance on the automation. Set-valued estimates of those states are then produced by fusing binary reliance observations and intermittent, quantized self-reports. The framework is evaluated through an in-person experiment in a medium-fidelity driving simulator with 20 participants. The set-valued estimator achieves at least 75% consistency for most participants during testing, and multi-step-ahead reliance predictions derived from the estimates outperform both an open-loop baseline and a particle filter across all choices of prediction horizons (15, 30, 45, 60 time steps), with the performance gap more evident at longer horizons. The proposed estimation framework can enable automation systems that are continuously aware of, and responsive to, the human driver's state.

</details>


### [236] [A Benchmarking Case Study for Local Flexibility Markets: Network, Scenarios, and Open Inputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02367)
*Savvas Panagi,Chrysovalantis Spanias,Petros Aristidou*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提供了一个与清算方法无关的完整输入数据集，基于修改后的CIGRE中压电网，包含基准负荷和压力负荷条件、合成灵活性报价、批发价格及变压器和电缆参数，并报告了基线AC运行点（电压、负载和老化），数据在Zenodo上开放发布，以促进灵活性市场清算方法的可复现基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前本地灵活性市场的输入数据（网络模型、需求场景、灵活性报价、资产热力学和经济参数）常在不同假设下定义，导致不同研究方法之间缺乏统一的基准，阻碍了可复现的比较和公平评估。

Method: 构建一个方法论无关的输入集：基于修改的CIGRE中压网络，规定基准负荷和压力负荷两种条件，生成合成灵活性报价、批发价格以及变压器和电缆参数，并提供两种日况下的基线AC运行点数据（电压、负载、老化）。

Result: 提供了完整的开放数据集，使不同灵活性请求和清算方法可以在相同输入条件下公平比较，相关数据已在Zenodo上公开发布。

Conclusion: 该输入集有助于消除外部输入假设差异带来的基准测试障碍，推动灵活性市场清算方法的标准化和可复现性研究。

Abstract: External inputs to local flexibility markets, network models, demand scenarios, flexibility offers, and asset thermal, economic parameters do not change the clearing methodology, yet they are routinely defined under heterogeneous assumptions, which hinders reproducible benchmarking. This paper provides a complete, methodology-agnostic input set built around a modified CIGRE MV network with prescribed base-load and stress-load conditions, synthetic flexibility offers, wholesale prices, and transformer and cable parameters. Baseline AC operating points (voltages, loadings, and aging) are reported for both days so that alternative flexibility-request and clearing methods can be applied to the same inputs and compared fairly. The associated data are released openly on Zenodo.

</details>


### [237] [Safe and robust tube-based path-following for robot navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02530)
*Arthur H. D. Nunes,Vinicius M. Gonçalves,Guilherme V. Raffo,Leonardo A. B. Torres,Luciano C. A. Pimenta*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向未知杂乱环境中机器人路径跟踪任务的鲁棒导航框架，通过避障确保反应式安全，利用管状控制策略保证目标路径的收敛性并缓解未知有界扰动的影响。框架整合了人工矢量场制导与反步控制的标称制导与控制方案、平滑距离函数、统一控制目标以及自适应控制组件，并通过屏障函数和Lyapunov稳定性理论提供了安全性和稳定性的形式化证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在未知杂乱环境中执行路径跟踪任务时面临两大挑战：一是需要同时满足避障安全性和路径收敛性；二是外部扰动会影响导航性能。现有的方法往往难以同时兼顾这些需求，因此需要一个统一的鲁棒导航框架来协调安全性、收敛性和鲁棒性。

Method: 该方法包含四个关键组成部分：(i) 基于人工矢量场引导和反步控制的标称综合制导与控制方案，用于路径跟踪；(ii) 平滑距离函数实现连续控制律，以确保无障碍避障；(iii) 统一控制目标在避障与路径跟踪之间取得平衡；(iv) 自适应控制组件增强对外部扰动的鲁棒性。此外，采用管状控制策略来缓解未知有界扰动的影响，并利用屏障函数和Lyapunov稳定性理论进行安全性和稳定性分析。

Result: 通过大量数值仿真验证了所提出框架的有效性，证明了该框架能够在未知杂乱环境中实现安全的路径跟踪，同时具备对扰动的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该工作为机器人路径跟踪提供了一种综合性的鲁棒导航框架，同时保证了反应式安全性、目标路径收敛性和扰动鲁棒性，并通过理论分析与仿真验证加以支撑。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose a new robust navigation framework for path following tasks in robots operating within unknown, cluttered environments. Our approach ensures reactive safety through obstacle avoidance and guaranteed convergence to a target path, while simultaneously mitigating the impact of unknown-but-bounded disturbances using a tube-based control strategy. The methodology integrates key aspects in the robot navigation: (i) a nominal Integrated Guidance and Control scheme for path-following employing Artificial Vector Fields guidance and Backstepping control; (ii) a smooth distance function that enables a continuous control law formulation for seamless obstacle avoidance; (iii) a unified control objective that balances collision avoidance with path-following; and (iv) an adaptive control component to provide robustness against external disturbances. We provide formal proofs of safety and stability using barrier functions and Lyapunov stability theory. The effectiveness of the proposed framework is validated through extensive numerical simulations.

</details>


### [238] [Performance-based Adaptation Termination for Preventing Parameter Drift in Adaptive Vibration Suppression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02570)
*Juan Augusto Paredes Salazar,Ankit Goel*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于均方根（RMS）的停止准则，用于自适应振动控制系统中防止参数漂移。该准则通过递归计算性能变量的指数加权移动RMS，在振动抑制效果持续达标后冻结参数更新，计算开销极小，并在悬臂梁振动抑制平台上通过数值仿真和闭环实验验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应振动控制系统中存在参数漂移问题，尤其在激励持久性减弱或测量扰动导致自适应问题病态时。柔性结构中，即使振动抑制已达标，自适应控制器仍可能持续更新参数，导致性能退化。

Method: 提出一种基于RMS的停止准则，递归计算性能变量的指数加权移动RMS，当振动衰减在指定时间间隔内持续满足要求时冻结自适应更新。该机制与回溯代价自适应控制（RCAC）集成，计算开销可忽略。

Result: 在悬臂梁非共置致动器配置的振动抑制平台上，通过数值仿真和闭环实验验证。未启用停止准则时参数漂移导致性能退化；启用后参数保持有界，振动衰减效果得以维持。

Conclusion: 简单的基于性能的监控机制可有效防止自适应振动控制中的参数漂移，保留自适应的瞬态优势，且计算开销极小。

Abstract: Parameter drift remains a practical limitation of adaptive vibration control systems, particularly when persistence of excitation diminishes after disturbance attenuation or when measurement disturbances render the adaptation problem ill-conditioned. This issue is especially relevant in flexible structures, where adaptive controllers may continue updating parameters even after satisfactory vibration suppression has been achieved. This paper proposes a computationally efficient root-mean-square (RMS)-based stopping criterion that mitigates parameter drift by freezing adaptation once satisfactory vibration attenuation has been sustained over a prescribed interval. The criterion is implemented by recursively computing an exponentially weighted moving RMS of the performance variable and requires negligible additional computational effort. The proposed mechanism is integrated with retrospective cost adaptive control (RCAC) and validated through both numerical simulations and closed-loop experiments on a cantilever-beam vibration-suppression platform with a noncollocated actuator configuration. Without the proposed stopping criterion, continued adaptation after disturbance rejection leads to gradual parameter drift and degradation of vibration suppression performance. When the RMS-based threshold is enabled, controller parameters remain bounded, and the achieved vibration attenuation is preserved. The results demonstrate that a simple performance-based monitoring mechanism can effectively prevent parameter drift in adaptive vibration control, retain the transient benefits of adaptation, and incur minimal computational overhead.

</details>


### [239] [Bridging Artificial Intelligence and Power Systems Education Using a Hands-On Executable Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02599)
*Junjie Yin,Buxin She,Xinyu Feng,Fangxing,Li*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向电力系统AI应用的开放、可执行模块库框架（EGAI），通过渐进式难度阶梯的Jupyter Notebook模块，降低AI在电力系统中的入门门槛。该框架基于社区调查（92%的受访者遇到至少一个运行AI模型的障碍，94%希望有电力专属的实操课程），包含从基础DNN到CNN潮流代理、深度强化学习储能控制和PINN摆动方程等模块，并通过IEEE在线课程和PES网络研讨会交付，吸引了590+现场参会者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有电力系统AI研究多聚焦于专门应用，对新手或跨学科学习者缺乏可复用材料；学习者日益依赖大语言模型而非自行构建模型。社区调查显示92%的从业者在运行AI模型前至少遇到一个障碍，94%希望有电力系统专属的实操课程，凸显了对工程化AI（EGAI）教学框架的迫切需求。

Method: 提出一个由开放、可执行模块构成的框架，模块按渐进式难度阶梯组织，将核心AI概念映射到代表性电力系统任务：(i)基础DNN模板用于函数逼近和负荷曲线拟合；(ii)域耦合CNN潮流替代模型（5节点系统）；(iii)前沿模块涵盖DNN辅助优化、用于电池储能控制的深度强化学习、以及用于摆动方程的物理信息神经网络。所有模块以Jupyter Notebook形式发布，支持本地或Google Colab运行，并通过IEEE在线课程和PES网络研讨会系列交付。

Result: 网络研讨会吸引了超过590名现场参与者，跻身IEEE PES网络研讨会前十；两周内仓库访问量超过344次，验证了基于调查的动机和社区对该资源的需求。

Conclusion: 本文证明了以工程规则为导向、渐进式模块化的AI教学框架能够有效满足电力系统社区的需求，为新手和跨学科学习者提供了可复用的实用资源，并获得了社区的积极反响。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly central to power and energy systems, supporting modeling, forecasting, optimization, and control. Yet most existing works emphasize specialized applications and offer little reusable material for newcomers or interdisciplinary learners, who increasingly rely on large language models rather than building their own. This gap points to a need for engineering-grounded AI (EGAI), in which AI workflows follow established engineering and power-system domain rules rather than acting as task-agnostic black boxes. Motivated by a community survey of researchers and practitioners, which shows 92% report at least one barrier before running an AI model and 94% want a power-specific hands-on course. This paper presents a framework consisting of open, executable module library that lowers the entry barrier for AI in power systems. The modules follow a progressive difficulty ladder that maps core AI concepts onto representative power-system tasks: (i) foundational deep neural network (DNN) templates for function approximation and load-curve fitting; (ii) a domain-coupled convolutional neural network (CNN) power-flow surrogate for a 5-bus system; and (iii) frontier modules on DNN-assisted optimization, deep reinforcement learning (DRL) for battery storage control, and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for the swing equation. All modules are released as Jupyter notebooks that run locally or on Google Colab and are delivered through an IEEE online course and IEEE Power & Energy Society (PES) webinar series. The webinar drew more than 590 live attendees, which is among the ten most-attended IEEE PES webinars, and over 344 repository visits within two weeks, reinforcing the survey-based motivation.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [240] [Uncertainty-Aware Simulation-Based Inference for Operations Research with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00019)
*Liang Guo,Lin Shaochong,Shen Zuo-Jun Max,Zhang Kun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需训练的、基于不确定性感知的推理框架，用于提升大语言模型在运筹学数学建模任务中的可靠性。该方法通过短视前瞻模拟评估中间候选步骤的下游预测不确定性，并利用重要性重采样动态选择更可能产生连贯数学公式的候选方案，在多个OR基准（NL4OPT、MAMO、IndustryOR）上优于标准和低温基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型用于运筹学（OR）任务时，正确性依赖于连贯的建模过程而非仅最终答案正确。标准自回归生成采用短视策略，无法预测部分公式能否有效扩展为全局一致的优化模型，导致局部合理步骤可能传播为灾难性的下游公式化或求解器代码错误。

Method: 提出一个不确定性感知、无需训练的推理框架。不更新模型参数，而是通过短视前瞻模拟（short lookahead simulations）评估中间候选步骤，量化下游预测不确定性或概率集中度，然后通过重要性重采样（importance resampling）动态选择更可能产生连贯数学公式的候选方案。

Result: 在多个OR基准测试（包括NL4OPT、MAMO和IndustryOR）上的实证评估表明，该框架在一致性地优于标准和低温解码基线，确立了高效且无需训练的可靠OR公式生成范式。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了无需参数更新的推理阶段干预可以有效提升LLM在OR数学建模任务中的可靠性，为可靠OR公式生成提供了一种高效、训练免费的范式。

Abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) for operations research (OR) tasks remains challenging because correctness depends on a coherent modeling process, not merely a correct final answer. Standard autoregressive generation operates on a myopic policy, which sometimes fails to anticipate whether a partial formulation can be validly extended into a globally consistent optimization model. Consequently, locally plausible steps may propagate into catastrophic downstream formulation or solver code errors. To address this, we propose an uncertainty-aware, training-free inference framework for OR mathematical modeling. Without updating model parameters, our method evaluates intermediate candidate steps using short lookahead simulations to quantify downstream predictive uncertainty or probability concentration. Candidates that demonstrate a higher likelihood of yielding coherent mathematical formulations are then dynamically selected via importance resampling. Empirical evaluations across multiple OR benchmarks (including NL4OPT, MAMO, and IndustryOR) demonstrate that our framework consistently outperforms both standard and low-temperature baselines, establishing an efficient, training-free paradigm for reliable OR formulation generation.

</details>


### [241] [Learning Compositional Meta-Routing for Agentic Workflows: An Executable Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00106)
*Natan Vidra,Alina Kapanova,Arun Kanhai,Spurthi Setty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个可执行的智能体路由基准测试和一个预算感知的元路由器，该路由器能够从原始任务文本中组合异构操作（直接回答、分解请求、检索证据、执行代码、委托专家、验证中间结果）。基准包含216个训练、72个开发、108个留出测试和108个锁定词汇转移挑战任务。学习策略在留出测试上达到100%成功率（对比静态工作流的93.5%），成本降低43%；但在词汇转移挑战集上降至75.9%，落后于静态路由的93.5%，表明词汇泛化是主要局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有路由工作大多孤立地选择模型端点、检索深度或工具，而智能体系统真正的挑战在于决定哪些推理和执行操作应该先于最终答案发生。需要一个可执行的基准和能够组合异构操作的路由方法。

Method: 提出了一个可执行基准测试和预算感知的元路由器。方法包括：1）构建覆盖数据分析、冻结语料库研究和文档处理的任务基准；2）独立的正则化逻辑回归头从词和字符特征预测操作概率；3）在开发数据上进行温度缩放；4）在路由成本和动作数量预算下进行贪心组合。

Result: 在留出测试上，学习策略达到100%成功率（对比静态和固定工作流的93.5%），成本比静态策略低43%；匹配的学习型一次性路由器仅达到56.5%。在未接触的挑战集上，学习成功率降至75.9%，落后于静态路由的93.5%，但成本仍低49%，超过一次性路由34.3个百分点。

Conclusion: 词法泛化（而非路由执行）是主要的性能限制因素。该工作建立了一个可复现的测试平台和有界的概念验证，不构成实时LLM性能的证据。

Abstract: Agentic systems must decide not only what answer to produce, but which reasoning and execution operations should precede it. A controller may answer directly, decompose a request, retrieve evidence, execute code, delegate to a specialist, or verify an intermediate result. Existing routing work largely selects model endpoints, retrieval depth, or tools in isolation. We introduce an executable benchmark and a budget-aware meta-router that composes heterogeneous operations from raw task text. The benchmark contains 216 training, 72 development, 108 held-out test, and 108 locked lexical-shift challenge tasks across data analysis, frozen-corpus research, and document processing. Outcomes are machine checked after operations execute. Independent regularized logistic heads predict operation probabilities from word and character features, are temperature-scaled on development data, and are greedily composed under route-cost and action-count budgets. On the held-out test, the learned policy achieves 100% success versus 93.5% for strong static and fixed workflows, with 43% lower cost than the static policy; a matched learned one-shot router reaches 56.5%. On the untouched challenge split, learned success falls to 75.9% and trails static routing at 93.5%, while remaining 49% cheaper and exceeding one-shot routing by 34.3 points. The gap identifies lexical generalization, rather than route execution, as the principal limitation. These results establish a reproducible testbed and a bounded proof of concept, not evidence of live-LLM performance.

</details>


### [242] [MetaRoute-Bench: Evaluating Meta-Decision Policies for Agentic Workflow Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00107)
*Natan Vidra,Alina Kapanova,Arun Kanhai,Spurthi Setty*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了MetaRoute-Bench，一个开放、可检查的框架，用于在共享执行模型下比较智能体系统的元决策策略（如直接回答、分解任务、调用工具、委派等）。基于180个合成任务、8种路由策略和43200条迹线，实验表明任务感知的组合策略在成功率上优于静态策略和直接回答策略，同时提供了可复现的评估方法和路由策略权衡分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体系统频繁面临元决策（直接回答、分解任务、调用工具、委派专家等），这些决策影响任务成功率、成本和延迟，但现有评估通常只关注整体任务准确率，元决策策略被嵌入编排框架中难以单独比较和审查。

Method: 构建MetaRoute-Bench开放框架，包含180个合成任务（覆盖数据分析、研究、文档处理三类）、8种路由策略和30对随机种子。采用离线种子执行模型生成43200条迹线，通过配对比较分析各策略的成功率、成本和延迟，并进行消融实验（限制组合操作、移除验证环节）。

Result: 任务感知组合策略成功率达79.4%，优于工作负载特定静态策略（76.7%）、一次性任务路由（67.4%）和直接回答（52.9%）。相比静态策略提升2.7个百分点（95% CI ±2.0），但成本和延迟分别增加4.7%和6.4%。消融表明限制组合为一个操作和移除验证是最大的性能损失来源。

Conclusion: 主要贡献是可复现的评估方法和对路由策略权衡的分析，而非生产环境有效性证据。作者发布任务生成、策略、迹线、测试和分析工件以支持实际系统验证。

Abstract: Agentic systems must repeatedly decide whether to answer directly, decompose a task, invoke a tool, execute code, delegate to a specialist, verify an intermediate result, or recover from failure. These meta-decisions affect not only task success but also operating cost and latency, yet they are often embedded inside an orchestration framework and evaluated only through aggregate task accuracy. We present MetaRoute-Bench, an open, inspectable framework for comparing meta-decision policies under a shared execution model. The initial benchmark contains 180 synthetic task profiles spanning data analysis, research, and document processing, eight routing policies, and 30 paired random seeds. Across 43,200 traces, a task-aware compositional policy achieves 79.4% success compared with 76.7% for a strong workload-specific static policy, 67.4% for one-shot task routing, and 52.9% for direct answering. Relative to the static policy, this is a 2.7 percentage-point improvement with paired 95% CI of plus or minus 2.0 points, at 4.7% higher mean cost and 6.4% higher latency. Ablations show the largest losses when route composition is restricted to one operation and when verification is removed. These results are generated by a seeded offline execution model rather than a live deployment; accordingly, the primary contribution is a reproducible evaluation method and an analysis of routing-policy tradeoffs, not evidence of production effectiveness. We release task generation, policies, traces, tests, and analysis artifacts to support live-system validation.

</details>


### [243] [Progressive$^2$: A Teacher-Student Progressive Co-Evolving Knowledge Distillation Method for Substantial Model Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00129)
*Tiancong Cheng,Ying Zhang,Zhiwen Yu,Yifang Yin,Bin Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为Progressive²的新型知识蒸馏方法，通过结合渐进增强的教师模型和渐进缩小的学生模型，解决教师与学生能力差距过大导致蒸馏性能下降的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识蒸馏（KD）在模型压缩中广泛应用，但当服务器端大模型（教师）与客户端小模型（学生）之间存在较大能力差距时，蒸馏性能会显著下降。

Method: Progressive²包含两个核心策略：(1) 教师侧：按"从粗略到精细"（raw-to-rich）的语义进展，逐步选择更多层参与蒸馏，建立系统学习课程；同时设计教师侧多特征融合适配器（基于Lipschitz连续性理论）提升训练稳定性。(2) 学生侧：不直接训练极小模型，而是逐步缩小网络规模，与教师形成迭代协同进化。

Result: Progressive²是一个灵活框架：教师的渐进策略可独立部署，在准确性与训练效率之间取得最优平衡；教师与学生的联合集成可进一步提升整体性能。

Conclusion: 通过渐进式策略有效缓解了教师与学生能力差距大时的蒸馏性能退化问题，为大规模模型压缩提供了新的方法论。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a widely utilized technique for transferring knowledge from a large model (the teacher) to a smaller model (the student). Owing to its flexibility and broad applicability, KD has been extensively applied in the compression of server-side models to meet the Quality of Service (QoS) requirements of client users. Despite significant advancements, the performance of distillation is substantially compromised when a large disparity exists between the capabilities of the server and the requirements of the client. To alleviate this problem, we propose a novel distillation approach, named Progressive$^2$, which operates through the combination of a progressively stronger teacher and a progressively smaller student. On the side of the teacher, rather than involving all layers simultaneously, we progressively select additional layers for distillation following a raw-to-rich semantic progression, establishing a systematic learning curriculum. Furthermore, we design a teacher-side multi-feature fusion adapter for the teacher to improve training stability, which is theoretically supported by the framework of Lipschitz continuity. On the side of the student, rather than directly training a tiny model, we gradually reduce the size of the network to facilitate an iterative co-evolution with the teacher. Progressive$^2$ serves as a flexible framework; the progressive strategy of the teacher can be deployed independently to achieve an optimal balance between accuracy and training efficiency, while the joint integration of the teacher and the student yields further improvements in overall performance.

</details>


### [244] [Rethinking Pretraining for Specialized Design Data: Evidence from the JONES-19 Cultural Design Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00135)
*Alexandros Haridis,Charles Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文基于设计档案图像数据集JONES-19（源自1857年《装饰语法》），评估CNN在ImageNet预训练与从零训练两种策略下的判别性能，发现局部采样的从零训练能有效弥补预训练优势，表明高质量小规模设计数据集可能比大规模通用预训练更具价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设计和建筑档案以图形格式编码专业知识，构成独特的ML挑战测试场景。作者希望验证在专业设计领域中，大规模通用预训练（ImageNet）是否真的必要，还是通过精心策划的小型高质量数据集即可获得同等甚至更优的表现。

Method: 使用JONES-19数据集（基于《装饰语法》的小型图像数据集），评估CNN在两种训练策略下的判别性能：(a) ImageNet预训练作为领域通用"视觉常识"；(b) 在JONES-19设计数据上从零训练，并结合重复局部采样（multi-crop）增强。

Result: 虽然领域通用的先验预训练改善了判别性能，但结合multi-crop局部采样的从零训练能够有效弥补这一差距。对于高度结构化的设计数据，局部设计驱动的表示足以支撑学习。

Conclusion: 在专业设计领域，精心策划的高质量小数据集（反映经验性与形式性设计原则）可能比大规模数据收集更有效，且更能揭示特定设计领域的本质特征，挑战了对大规模通用预训练的依赖。

Abstract: Design and architectural archives encode expert human knowledge in graphical formats, providing a critical testbed for design-inspired Machine Learning (ML) challenges absent with typical computer vision benchmarks. Building on JONES-19, a small-size image dataset based on The Grammar of Ornament (London, 1857), we evaluate the discriminative performance of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in two model training strategies: (a) ImageNet pretraining for domain-general "visual common sense," and (b) learning from scratch on the design data in JONES-19. We find that while domain-general priors improve discriminative performance, learning from scratch augmented with repeated local sampling (multi-crop) effectively recovers these gains. For highly structured design data, local design-driven representations provide sufficient foundation for learning, challenging a reliance on massive general-purpose pretraining. These findings suggest that in specialized design domains, careful curation of smaller high-quality datasets that capture empirical and formal design principles may prove more effective and informative on the nature of a particular design domain than prioritizing large-scale data collection.

</details>


### [245] [Leak It: A Probabilistic Approach to Training-Data Extraction from Black-Box Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00144)
*Victor Maricato*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于抽样的黑盒成员推理攻击（MIA）框架，从概率视角分析训练数据泄露。研究发现聚合ROC-AUC指标具有误导性：盲基线分类器在WikiMIA上可达AUC 0.97（掩盖了真实问题），而逐文档提取分析揭示真正的隐私风险——在Pythia-6.9B上16.6%的文档存在标识符泄露，且该风险随模型容量增长、在代码数据上更强，不受去重和采样参数影响。作者发布leakit审计工具，建议隐私审计应报告按域名分解的逐文档提取结果而非单一AUC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有成员推理攻击（MIA）评估通常使用聚合ROC-AUC指标，但这类评估存在混淆：无模型的盲基线仅凭表面文本就能区分成员与非成员。作者希望从概率视角重新审视基于抽样的训练数据泄露问题，揭示聚合指标掩盖的真实隐私风险。

Method: 将N个来自p(.|x)的抽样视为输出分布的估计，将泄露信号建模为该分布的泛函。通过扩展盲基线批评到抽样领域，在WikiMIA和IID Pile（MIMIR）上进行对比实验，并引入逐文档提取分析框架：检查文档标识符是否在抽样中精确复现且不在错配前缀控制中复现，从而归因于特定文档而非全局公共字符串。

Result: 1) WikiMIA上盲词袋分类器达AUC 0.97，抽样未增加信息增益；2) MIMIR上自浓缩和黄金延续恢复均未显著超越盲基线（增量AUC 95% CI含零）；3) Pythia-6.9B上83/500文档（16.6%）存在可归因的标识符泄露，且泄露率随模型容量从5.6%增长至16.6%；4) 代码数据的标识符泄露约是散文的3倍强；5) 温度、核采样、去重均无明显影响，16个token前缀即足够。

Conclusion: 聚合AUC指标掩盖了真实的逐文档泄露风险。隐私审计应转向报告按领域分解的逐文档提取结果，而非单一AUC。研究团队发布leakit黑盒提取审计工具，为语言模型隐私评估提供更精确的方法论。

Abstract: Membership inference (MIA) on language models is usually summarised by an aggregate ROC-AUC, but such evaluations are confounded: model-free blind baselines separate members from non-members from surface text alone. We study black-box, sampling-based training-data leakage through a probabilistic lens, treating N samples from p(.|x) as an estimate of the output distribution and casting leakage signals as functionals of it. We extend the blind-baseline critique into the sampling regime: on WikiMIA a blind bag-of-words classifier reaches AUC 0.97 (TPR 0.90 at 5% FPR) and sampling adds nothing, while on an IID Pile split (MIMIR) neither self-concentration nor gold-continuation recovery significantly beats a blind baseline (incremental AUC 95% CI includes zero). Aggregate metrics hide the real harm. The same sampling verbatim-extracts training data for a tail of documents no blind attack can reach. On Pythia-6.9B, 83 of 500 Pile documents bearing a real identifier (16.6%; 21.3% of those bearing an email address) have that exact identifier reproduced AND not reproduced under a mismatched-prefix control, so each leak is attributable to that document, not to a globally common string. This per-document disclosure is invisible to aggregate AUC and grows with capacity (5.6% to 16.6% from 410M to 6.9B). The risk is uneven: identifier leakage is ~3x stronger in code than prose, though prose stays clearly positive and also grows with capacity (4.0% to 12.1%), while recovery of arbitrary held-out continuations is confined to code (+0.44 member gap on GitHub vs at most +0.014 on prose). Temperature and nucleus sampling matter little, a 16-token prefix suffices, and we detect no reduction from corpus deduplication. Privacy audits should report per-document extraction, decomposed by domain, not a single AUC. We release leakit, a black-box extraction-audit tool.

</details>


### [246] [Response Magnitude as a Dominant Signal for Held-Out CRISPRi Perturbation Effect Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00152)
*Mehrdad Shoeibi,Niloofar Yousefi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究揭示了在CRISPRi扰动转录组效应预测任务中，简单基线超越深度模型的现象根源：目标变量（log Anderson-Darling距离）可由四个确定性标量函数高度预测。线性回归在四个标量上即可超越最强的x-only经典模型，而随机森林进一步大幅超越深度编码器。深度MLP编码器会坍缩到边际训练均值，标准补救措施无法弥合差距。在跨细胞类型和跨数据集零样本迁移中，幅度预测器表现出正向迁移，而表达预测器为负或无法解析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期研究表明简单基线常能匹敌或超越深度扰动预测模型，但这一现象的根源尚不清楚。理解深度模型在CRISPRi扰动预测中失效的具体原因，对于构建有效的扰动预测模型至关重要。

Method: 在Virtual Cell Challenge基准上采用严格的目标基因留出划分，识别驱动差距的低维信号：四个输入确定性标量函数。比较深度MLP编码器、线性回归、随机森林等模型，并通过两个预先指定的对照实验区分逐行对齐与维度增加的影响。另进行两个外部CRISPRi筛选的零样本迁移评估。

Result: 四个幅度标量的线性回归即超越最强x-only经典模型；随机森林在输入加四个标量上大幅超越深度编码器。幅度增益归因于逐行对齐而非维度增加。零样本迁移中幅度预测器正迁移，表达预测器负或无法解析。暴露幅度信号可改善深度编码器迁移，但仍不敌相同特征上的四标量线性回归。此外发现Anderson-Darling列度量的是转录组广度而非靶基因效应强度。

Conclusion: CRISPRi扰动幅度预测的核心信号是低维的确定性标量，深度模型在此任务上相对简单基线无优势。评估迁移时需注意Anderson-Darling端点度量的是转录组响应广度而非靶基因效应强度，这会影响结论的解读。

Abstract: Predicting the magnitude of a CRISPRi perturbation's transcriptomic effect on held-out target genes is an important open problem in single-cell biology. Recent work has documented that simple baselines often match or exceed deep perturbation predictors on related protocols. We study this phenomenon on the Virtual Cell Challenge (VCC) benchmark under a strict held-out target-gene split, identify the specific low-dimensional signal that drives the gap, and characterize how it transfers across cell types. The target is the log Anderson-Darling distance from non-targeting controls, which is strongly predictable from four deterministic scalar functions of the 2,000-dimensional input. A deep MLP encoder with direct access to the full input collapses toward the marginal training mean, and standard remedies do not close the gap. A linear regression on the four magnitude scalars alone exceeds the strongest x-only classical model, while a Random Forest on the input plus the four scalars substantially outperforms our deep proof-of-concept encoder. Two pre-specified controls attribute the magnitude gain to per-row alignment rather than added dimensionality. Under zero-shot transfer to two external CRISPRi screens evaluated against a target-gene endpoint rebuilt from single-cell data, magnitude-only predictors transfer positively whereas expression-only predictors are negative or unresolved. Exposing magnitude to the deep encoder improves transfer over its expression-only counterpart, yet the encoder does not outperform a four-scalar linear regression on the same features. We also find that the Anderson-Darling column distributed with these screens measures transcriptome-wide response breadth rather than target-gene effect strength, so evaluating transfer against it scores a different outcome.

</details>


### [247] [Inference-Time Policy Alignment for Fair Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00175)
*Umer Siddique,Peilang Li,Conor Wallace,Yongcan Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种推理时公平性对齐框架，通过乘法策略塑形调整预训练深度强化学习智能体的动作概率，无需更新基础策略参数即可优化基于福利的公平性目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的深度强化学习智能体通常针对标量奖励函数进行优化，一旦部署后策略僵化，难以适应新的性能标准（如利益相关者的公平性偏好）。现有实现公平性的方法通常假设偏好预先已知，且需要基于公平性度量对策略进行完全重新训练，成本高昂且不灵活。

Method: 将推理时公平性对齐形式化为策略塑形问题，提出乘法策略塑形框架：使用动作相关的福利分数调整动作概率，从而在不修改基础策略参数的情况下实现公平性对齐。该框架具有通用性，可与任意深度RL智能体兼容。

Result: 在多个领域的广泛实验中，推理时策略塑形显著改善了基于福利的公平性目标，同时保持了核心任务性能。

Conclusion: 推理时策略塑形是实现深度RL智能体公平性对齐的一种有效且高效的方法，无需重新训练即可适应新的公平性偏好。

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) agents achieve strong performance by optimizing scalar reward functions. However, once deployed, the policies of these RL agents are often rigid and costly to adapt to new performance criteria. For instance, an agent trained to maximize expected cumulative reward may not accommodate previously unknown stakeholder preferences. Existing approaches to achieve fairness, a type of preference, in RL typically assume that such preferences are known a priori and require complete retraining of the policy under a fairness-oriented metric. Inspired by inference-time alignment in large language models, we investigate the problem of steering a pretrained RL policy toward welfare-based fairness objectives at inference time without updating the base policy's parameters. We formalize inference-time fairness alignment as a policy shaping problem and propose a multiplicative policy shaping framework that adjusts action probabilities using action-dependent welfare scores, thus requiring no modification to the base policy. Our framework is general and compatible with any deep RL agent. Through extensive experiments across multiple domains, we demonstrate that inference-time policy shaping substantially improves welfare-based fairness objectives while preserving core task performance.

</details>


### [248] [AutoCause: A Python framework that automates expert decisions in environmental time-series causal discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00198)
*Marco Ruiz,Miguel Arana-Catania,David R. Ardila,Rodrigo Ventura*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AutoCause是一个开源Python工作流，通过记录因果发现中的每个决策、从扩展因果审计模块推导默认值，并允许领域知识覆盖，将环境时间序列因果发现中不一致的专家实践转化为可审计、可重复的分析流程。在145个数据集上的实验表明，多数方法支持的链接比单一方法更精确。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 环境时间序列因果发现需要专家在方法选择、条件独立性检验、滞后范围、样本量充分性、多重检验控制和证据解读等方面做出决策。这些决策在不同数据集上的应用不一致，导致生成的因果图无法比较、复现或审计，严重影响了研究的可信度和可重复性。

Method: AutoCause工作流包含三个核心组件：(1) 记录每个分析决策并推导默认值，同时允许领域专家覆盖；(2) 封装来自三个家族的四种成熟因果发现方法，并添加非因果参考模型作为对照；(3) 根据方法支持数量对链接进行分级（多数投票），以提升结果的可信度。在145个数据集（DGP-Atlas、TimeGraph和基于拓扑的CausalRivers参考）上进行了评估。

Result: 实验表明，不同的因果发现方法在参考图上恢复了互补的部分。在合成基准上，多数方法支持的链接比单一方法的链接更精确，但在河流拓扑参考上这一优势不成立。

Conclusion: AutoCause将不一致的专家实践转化为可审计、可重复的分析工作流；因果解释的最终责任仍由分析人员承担。工具已在GitHub上开源发布。

Abstract: Environmental time-series causal discovery requires expert decisions about method choice, conditional-independence tests, lag horizons, sample-size adequacy, multiple-testing control, and evidence interpretation. Applied inconsistently across datasets, these choices yield graphs that cannot be compared, reproduced, or audited. We present AutoCause, an open-source Python workflow that records each decision, derives defaults from an extended causal-audit module, and admits domain-informed overrides. The workflow wraps four established causal-discovery methods from three families, adds non-causal reference models, and grades links by method-count support. On 145 datasets from DGP-Atlas, TimeGraph, and a topology-derived CausalRivers reference, the methods recover complementary parts of the reference graphs. Majority-supported links are more precise than single-method links on the synthetic benchmarks but not against river topology. AutoCause converts inconsistent expert practice into an auditable, repeatable analysis; causal interpretation remains with the analyst. Available at https://github.com/marcoruizrueda/autocause.

</details>


### [249] [A Physics-Chemistry-Informed Neural Network (PCINN) for Real-Time Spatial-ALD Coverage Prediction and Reliable Kinetics Inversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00212)
*Ning Hu,Chang Liu,Yunlei Jiang,Yuan Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出物理化学信息神经网络（PCINN），一种用于空间原子层沉积（SALD）的混合代理模型，以实时速度（约7ms）达到CFD级精度（R²=0.998），比CFD快约5×10⁴倍，仅需30个训练样本即可跨越四个数量级的覆盖率范围。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SALD是工业ALD的关键技术，但高保真CFD仿真成本过高，无法用于操作窗口扫描；而解析模型无法捕捉气体帘幕等传输调制效应。需要一种既能快速预测表面覆盖率又保持精度的代理模型。

Method: PCINN架构结合了：1）小网络仅学习操作条件到近壁浓度闭合；2）已知表面动力学作为硬编码的可训练化学层，沿衬底轨迹积分；3）单一标量瓶颈设计使模型在稀疏数据下保持精度、可解释且可逆；4）完整的可辨识性分析（Fisher信息、剖面似然）。

Result: 查询约7ms（比CFD快5×10⁴倍），测试R²_log=0.998，留一法R²_raw=0.974，仅30个训练案例覆盖四个数量级。E_ads和k_des可稳健辨识，k_ads单温度下不可独立辨识。四温度下观察到斜率0.065 eV/decade的弱可辨识简并谷，对应k_B T_eff ln(10)。

Conclusion: 该研究验证了管道的自洽性和可辨识性边界，而非真实参数。斜率偏离可作为未建模位点异质性的可靠性诊断指标：单一Arrhenius失配下不变，只有出现第二个热激活过程时才偏移。

Abstract: Spatial atomic layer deposition (SALD) is a leading atmospheric-pressure, high-throughput route to industrial ALD, but design and control are limited by the cost of predicting surface coverage: high-fidelity CFD is far too slow for operating-window scans, while analytic models miss transport modulation such as the gas curtain. We present a physics-chemistry-informed neural network (PCINN), a hybrid surrogate with CFD-level accuracy at real-time speed: a query returns coverage in about 7 ms, roughly 5x10^4 times faster than a CFD solve, reaching a test R^2_log = 0.998 (leave-one-out R^2_raw = 0.974) from only 30 training cases spanning four orders of magnitude in coverage.
  The architecture is not a black box: a small network learns only the operating-condition to near-wall concentration closure, while the known surface kinetics is a hard-coded, trainable chemistry layer integrated along the substrate trajectory. This single-scalar bottleneck keeps it accurate under sparse data, interpretable and invertible.
  We add a full identifiability analysis (Fisher information, profile likelihood). The adsorption energy E_ads and desorption rate k_des are robustly identifiable; k_ads is not separately identifiable at a single temperature (only k_ads*c_wall is). Across four temperatures the prefactor nu and E_ads bind along a weakly identifiable degeneracy valley of slope 0.065 eV/decade, derived analytically as k_B T_eff ln(10) and turned into a reliability diagnostic: a seven-chemistry mismatch matrix shows it is invariant under any single-Arrhenius mismatch and shifts only when a second thermally activated process appears, so a slope departure flags unmodelled site heterogeneity.
  Data come from simulation with known ground truth inverted by the same kinetic form, so the study verifies pipeline self-consistency and the identifiability boundary, not real parameters.

</details>


### [250] [Verifier-Induced Support Reshaping in On-Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00220)
*Shaohang Wei,Zikun Su,Feifan Song,Wen Luo,Wei Li,Guangyue Peng,Houfeng Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示了在线强化学习（RLVR）在提升当前目标任务表现的同时，可能导致后续目标（如约束遵循）的成功轨迹变得过于稀少而无法被采样和强化，作者称之为"验证器诱导的支持重塑"（verifier-induced support reshaping）。通过跨两个模型家族、多基准实验，证明了这种效应主要集中在前几个响应token上，且端点改善无法保证未来的可训练性或联合能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线强化学习（RLVR）被广泛认为可以持续改进模型能力，但该工作发现RLVR在优化当前目标时可能无意中破坏对未来任务有用的行为分布，导致模型在后续目标上"失忆"或退步。这种支持重塑效应此前未被系统研究，因此亟需理解其机制和影响。

Method: 作者通过反复的验证器评分采样和双向训练（即分别用数学验证器和指令遵循验证器进行RLVR，再在对方验证器下训练）来研究该效应。使用两个模型家族，在数学推理和IFEval约束指令遵循上进行实验，并辅以token分布分析和受控开头干预实验来定位变化的来源。同时测试了参考策略约束、路由先验和在线蒸馏等缓解方法，以及MathIF和ReasonIF联合训练。

Result: 1) Math-RLVR提升平均指令遵循成功率但减少可采样的成功响应数量（如Qwen3-8B-Base上pass@1提升6.5个百分点但best@32下降9.8个百分点）；2) IF-RLVR将数学响应从逐步解答转向直接答案，降低所有采样预算下的best@k；3) 变化集中在响应的前几个token，RLVR主要对基础策略已有的开头进行重排序，且选定的开头因果影响数学可搜索性；4) 现有的缓解方法（参考策略约束、路由先验、在线蒸馏）只能部分保留跨任务支持；5) 联合训练方法MathIF和ReasonIF的边际收益只能部分转化为同时正确且符合约束的响应。

Conclusion: RLVR在优化当前目标时会导致"验证器诱导的支持重塑"，使后续任务的可行支持收缩。端点指标的改善并不意味着未来的可训练性或联合能力的保证。这提示在在线RL优化中需要更谨慎地设计训练流程，以保留跨任务的采样支持。

Abstract: We show that on-policy reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) can improve the current objective while making successful behaviors for later objectives too rare to sample and reinforce. We call this verifier-induced support reshaping and define effective rewardable support as successful trajectories reachable within a fixed rollout budget. Across two model families, we study this effect through repeated verifier-scored sampling and bidirectional training on mathematical reasoning and constrained instruction following, including sequential training with the opposite verifier. Math-RLVR raises average instruction-following success but reduces the number of prompts with any successful response under repeated sampling. On IFEval with Qwen3-8B-Base, pass@1 rises by 6.5 percentage points while best@32 falls by 9.8 percentage points, and the same divergence appears across both models and IF benchmarks. Conversely, IF-RLVR shifts math responses from step-by-step openings toward direct answers, lowers best@k across sampling budgets, and reduces reward variation for later Math-RLVR. Token-distribution analyses and controlled opening interventions show that these changes concentrate in the first few response tokens. RLVR mainly reranks openings already available in the base policy, and the selected opening causally affects math searchability. The tested reference-policy constraints, routing priors, and on-policy distillation preserve cross-task support only partially; MathIF and ReasonIF show that marginal gains translate only partly into responses that are both correct and constraint-following. Therefore, endpoint improvements do not guarantee future trainability or joint capability under on-policy optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/sylvain-wei/verifier-induced-support-reshaping

</details>


### [251] [Similarity-Aware Machine Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00246)
*Madhavan Citalamangalam Kumaran,Midhun Parakkal Unni,Vicky Kouni,Haripriya Harikumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种保留感知的定位方法用于机器遗忘，通过同时考虑参数对遗忘数据和保留数据的重要性来选取参数子集，减少对语义相似保留样本的附带损害。实验在CIFAR-10和ResNet18上的11种设置中验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于定位的机器遗忘方法仅根据遗忘集的重要性来选择参数，忽略了这些参数在保留数据集中的作用，导致对语义相似的保留样本造成附带损害。

Method: 提出一种保留感知的定位方法，同时考虑参数对遗忘数据和保留数据的重要性；并引入基于模型嵌入空间中余弦相似度构建的保留相似评估集，用于直接衡量附带损害。

Result: 在CIFAR-10数据集和ResNet18模型上的11种实验设置中，该方法一致地减少了附带损害，同时改善了标准机器遗忘指标。

Conclusion: 保留感知的定位方法对于相似性感知的机器遗忘是有效的，能够在保持遗忘效果的同时减少对保留数据的负面影响。

Abstract: Machine unlearning removes the influence of user-specified training examples from a trained model, avoiding the need to retrain it from scratch. Localization-based methods improve unlearning efficiency by identifying a subset of influential model parameters. However, existing approaches select parameters based solely on forget-set importance, neglecting their role in retained dataset and often causing collateral damage to semantically similar retained examples. We address this limitation with a retain-aware localization method that considers parameter importance to both forgotten and retained data. We also introduce a retain-similar evaluation set, constructed using cosine similarity in the model embedding space, to directly measure collateral damage. Across eleven experimental settings on CIFAR-10 dataset and ResNet18 model, our method consistently reduces collateral damage while improving standard unlearning metrics, demonstrating the effectiveness of retain-aware localization for similarity-aware machine unlearning.

</details>


### [252] [Agentic Bayesian Optimization through Surrogate-Augmented Autoresearch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00316)
*Paul Brunzema,Louis Tiao,Nhat Le,Kevin De Angeli,Yao Xuan,Djordje Gligorijevic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"智能体贝叶斯优化"范式，让LLM智能体作为BO循环中的核心决策者，同时保留贝叶斯后端提供的不确定性感知优化能力。通过Sara（LLM智能体）和lenz（可修改的BoTorch后端）实例化该思想，在合成和真实基准上保持SOTA BO的可靠性，超越LLM基线，并能利用自然语言先验和动态重配置优化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准BO依赖通用统计先验，难以编码丰富的领域先验（如自然语言、代码、文档中的信息），导致其效率受限。现有LLM-based BO方法要么将LLM固定在某角色（如代理或配置接口），要么赋予其过宽控制权而牺牲BO的系统性探索可靠性。需要一个既能利用LLM灵活先验知识、又能保持BO可靠性的框架。

Method: 提出智能体贝叶斯优化（agentic BO）范式：LLM智能体作为核心决策者，负责配置问题、查询后端、选择和提交评估，并可在运行过程中动态修订策略（收紧边界、切换采集函数、提出定向评估、甚至重新定义问题）；贝叶斯后端提供不确定性感知的优化底层。具体实现为Sara（surrogate-augmented autoresearch agent）搭配lenz（模块化的BoTorch后端，通过结构化接口被智能体检查和修改）。

Result: 在合成和真实基准上，Sara在无先验知识时保持SOTA BO的可靠性，超越LLM-based基线；利用自然语言先验时可进一步超越标准BO。在动态场景中，Sara能实时重构优化问题以适应需求变化，这是标准BO不具备的能力。

Conclusion: 智能体BO范式成功弥合了LLM灵活性和BO可靠性之间的鸿沟，展示了LLM智能体与贝叶斯后端协同在优化领域的潜力，尤其在动态、需要自然语言先验的实际场景中具有独特价值。

Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) has become the standard tool for sample-efficient optimization and owes its efficiency to uncertainty-aware search driven by generic statistical priors. Richer domain priors can improve BO in principle, but encoding them through tailored kernels or problem structure is difficult and rarely done in practice. LLMs can help sidestep this difficulty by making informal priors from natural language, code, and documentation directly available to the optimizer. However, existing LLM-based BO methods either insert the LLM into a fixed role (surrogate, acquisition proxy, or configuration interface) or hand it broad control, sacrificing the systematic exploration that makes BO reliable. We introduce agentic Bayesian optimization: a paradigm in which an LLM agent is the central decision maker in the BO loop while a Bayesian backend provides the uncertainty-aware optimization substrate. The agent configures the problem, queries the backend, selects and commits evaluations, and can revise the optimization strategy during the run by tightening bounds, switching acquisition functions, proposing targeted evaluations, or even reframing the problem following new instructions or observed evidence. We instantiate this idea in Sara, a surrogate-augmented autoresearch agent, and lenz, a modular BoTorch-based backend that the agent can inspect and modify through a structured interface. Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks, Sara preserves the reliability of state-of-the-art BO without prior knowledge, outperforms LLM-based baselines, and uses natural-language priors to improve beyond standard BO. We further demonstrate the practical value of agentic BO in dynamic settings, where Sara reconfigures the full optimization problem on the fly as requirements change, a capability not previously available in standard BO.

</details>


### [253] [Stabilized Best-of-$K$ Training for Neural Combinatorial Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00296)
*Melveena Jolly,Midhun Xavier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对Leader Reward方法进行了窄幅扩展测试：将其二元的领导/非领导区分替换为基于采样预算K的稳定排名信号。在POMO架构和TSP-100测试集上，K=8的稳定版本在三种配对训练种子上均降低了Best-of-8成本（7.7944 vs 7.8136），但这一观察仅限估计层且依赖特定解码器，作者明确不主张无偏估计、普适优越性或SOTA声明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Leader Reward通过强调重复推理产生的最佳轨迹来修改POMO训练。作者希望测试一种窄幅扩展：用基于采样预算K的稳定排名信号替代其二元领导者/非领导者区分，以探索更细粒度的奖励信号是否带来改进。

Method: 将Leader Reward的二元区分替换为稳定排名信号，该信号以采样预算K为索引。在固定的POMO架构、3,050轮训练计划和TSP-100测试集下进行对比实验，分别评估了100-start/8-augmentation贪心解码和独立采样协议下的表现。

Result: Leader Reward复现结果在100-start、8-augmentation贪心解码下为7.7662，与报道的7.766一致。在独立采样下，稳定K=8配方在三种配对训练种子中均降低了Best-of-8成本：7.7944对比7.8136。但三个种子低于六种子的测试下限，Leader Reward在采样K=1时表现更好，在其原始增强贪心协议下也仍略优。

Conclusion: 稳定排名信号的K=8变体在独立采样条件下对Best-of-8成本有改善，但该观察仅限估计层面且依赖特定解码器。作者明确不声称该方法具有无偏估计性质、普适优越性或达到SOTA水平，表明这只是一个初步探索性结果。

Abstract: Leader Reward modifies POMO training to emphasize the best trajectory produced by repeated inference. We test a narrow extension: replace its binary leader/non-leader distinction with a stabilized rank signal indexed by a sampling budget $K$. With the POMO architecture, 3,050-epoch schedule, and TSP-100 test set held fixed, the Leader Reward reimplementation obtains $7.7662$ under 100-start, 8-augmentation greedy decoding, matching the reported $7.766$ at its displayed precision. Under independent sampling, the stabilized $K=8$ recipe lowers realized Best-of-8 cost in all three paired training seeds: $7.7944$ versus $7.8136$. This observation is estimation-only and decoder-specific: three seeds are below the six-seed testing floor, Leader Reward is better at sampled $K=1$, and it remains slightly better under its original augmented-greedy protocol. We make no unbiased-estimator, universal superiority, or state-of-the-art claim.

</details>


### [254] [Learning the Pareto Frontier of Predictive Models under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00632)
*Yiming Dong,Jiwei Zhao,Yang Young Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Frontier Learning框架，将多个预训练/基础模型（包含白盒和黑盒访问模式）视为互补信息源，通过拼接内部表征和预测输出构建统一的目标域特征，再拟合轻量级正则化监督学习器。该框架在经验风险上保证不差于任何单一基线策略（零样本、微调、直接训练），并在模拟和两个真实分布偏移场景（DomainNet/VisDA视觉域适应、MIMIC-IV-Notes临床死亡率预测）中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代机器学习越来越依赖复用预训练/基础模型，但不同模型在性能和使用方式（白盒 vs 黑盒）上存在差异。在分布偏移下，没有任何单一策略（零样本应用、微调、直接训练目标域模型）是普遍最优的。因此需要一种能够综合利用多个候选模型的框架。

Method: Frontier Learning框架：1) 将白盒候选模型的内部表征与黑盒候选模型的预测输出进行拼接，构建统一的目标域特征；2) 在拼接特征上使用带标记的目标域数据拟合轻量级、正则化的监督学习器；3) 该假说类包含零样本复用、微调和直接训练作为特例，因此经验风险最小化在训练样本上保证不劣于任何个别基线。

Result: 在模拟实验（覆盖不同源-目标兼容度）和两个真实分布偏移场景（DomainNet/VisDA视觉域适应、MIMIC-IV-Notes临床死亡率预测）中，Frontier Learning匹配或超越了最强的单一复用策略，且在单一基线不可靠的偏移范围内取得了最大的增益。

Conclusion: Frontier Learning有效整合了多种预训练模型的互补信息，提供了一种理论上有保证、实践中稳健的模型复用策略，特别适用于分布偏移场景下单一基线不可靠的情况。

Abstract: Modern machine learning pipelines increasingly rely on reusing pretrained and foundation models across downstream tasks. These pretrained models can differ not only in performance but also in how they can be used: some only provide black-box predictions, while others may permit white-box access to internal representations that can be probed or fine-tuned. When deployed to the target domain in the presence of distribution shift, no single strategy, including zero-shot application, fine-tuning, or directly training a target-specific model, is uniformly the best.
  In this work, we propose Frontier Learning, a framework that treats a library of candidate models spanning different training histories and access regimes as complementary sources of information rather than mutually exclusive alternatives. Frontier Learning constructs a unified target-domain feature by concatenating internal representations from white-box candidates as well as prediction outputs from black-box candidates, then fits a lightweight, regularized supervised learner on this concatenated representation using labeled target data. Because the resulting hypothesis class contains predictors obtained by zero-shot reuse, fine-tuning, and direct training as special cases, empirical risk minimization over the frontier learner is guaranteed to be no worse, on the training sample, than any individual baseline.
  We evaluate the framework in simulations spanning varying degrees of source-target compatibility and in two real-world distribution-shift settings: visual domain adaptation on DomainNet/VisDA and clinical mortality prediction across intensive care unit domains using MIMIC-IV-Notes. Across all settings, Frontier Learning matches or outperforms the strongest individual reuse strategy, with the largest gains arising precisely when no single baseline is reliable across the range of shift considered.

</details>


### [255] [Abstention as an Action Can Kill Both the Reward Gradient and the KL Anchor: Collapse Law and Repair for Error-Penalized Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00301)
*Xujun Che,Yuchen Yuan,Weida Zhao,Chenyang Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了一个反直觉的结果：KL锚定的梯度学习者在面对误差惩罚式评分规则（答对+1，答错-λ，弃权0）时，可能走向"拒绝一切"的极端行为。尽管该规则理论上会引导理性智能体在正确概率超过Chow阈值时作答，但实际训练中，离散弃权动作导致的门饱和因子会同时扼杀奖励梯度和锚定恢复力，使模型漂移向全弃权状态（看似奖励上升实为覆盖崩溃）。优势估计器还会使有效惩罚变为1，把阈值从t*扭曲到1/2。作者提出结构性修复：训练一个必须输出的置信度报告（使用严格适当的评分加正确性奖励），仅在部署时通过阈值化该报告来决定是否弃权。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 误差惩罚式评分规则被认为是对抗幻觉的有效手段——理性智能体只在正确概率超过Chow阈值t*=λ/(1+λ)时才作答，否则弃权。然而作者发现，在实际的梯度学习（而非理性决策）场景中，这种规则可能导致灾难性的相反行为：模型学会拒绝一切问题。这一发现对LLM的安全部署和幻觉缓解具有重要实践意义，因为许多系统正是基于这种评分规则来设置置信度阈值和奖励。

Method: 作者通过理论分析证明KL锚定梯度学习者在离散弃权动作下的失败机制：（1）门饱和因子同时抑制奖励梯度和锚定恢复力，导致模型漂移到全弃权状态，训练奖励以1/t趋近于零（看起来像改进但覆盖崩溃）；（2）优势估计器在稀疏答案场景下通过组归一化将设计惩罚替换为有效惩罚1，把学习阈值从t*移到1/2。修复方案是结构性的：训练一个始终发射的置信度报告（严格适当评分+正确性奖励），部署时再通过阈值化该报告决定弃权——因为报告无门控饱和，奖励梯度和锚定可以共存，校准最优是吸引子。作者通过模拟和两个规模的LM实验验证。

Result: 模拟确认了所有理论预测。两个规模的LM实验证实机制真实存在：评分规则在10个优化步内就让模型对已能解答的问题沉默；消融实验隔离了原因；报告级训练同时提升了覆盖率、准确率和校准度。

Conclusion: 以"作答/弃权"为离散动作的误差惩罚评分规则在梯度学习中存在结构性缺陷，会导致覆盖全面崩溃。修复需要改变任务结构——将置信度报告作为必须输出的连续量而非可弃权的离散动作，使评分和锚定不再共享同一门控因子，从而保证校准最优的吸引性。

Abstract: Error-penalized scoring rules ($+1$ for a correct answer, $-λ$ for a wrong one, $0$ for abstaining) are increasingly prescribed against hallucination: a rational agent facing such a rule answers exactly when its correctness probability exceeds Chow's threshold $t^\ast=λ/(1+λ)$. We prove that a KL-anchored gradient learner can do the opposite. When abstention is a discrete action, the reward gradient and the anchor's restoring force are throttled by the same gate-saturation factor and die together: under explicit conditions (among them, blanket answering loses score in expectation and prompts share a bounded readout) the model drifts toward refusing everything, its mean training reward rising to zero like $1/t$ in training time $t$, so the curve reads as improvement while coverage collapses. The advantage estimator compounds the failure: in its sparse-answer regime, group normalization silently replaces every designed penalty with an effective penalty of one, moving the learned threshold from $t^\ast$ to $1/2$. The repair is structural: train a mandatory confidence report with a strictly proper score plus a correctness reward, and abstain only at deployment by thresholding the report. The always-emitted report has no gate to saturate, so no shared factor can kill its reward gradient and its anchor together, and its calibrated optimum is attracting. Simulations confirm every prediction, and experiments on language models at two scales confirm the mechanism live: the rule silences questions the models demonstrably still solve within ten optimizer steps, an ablation isolates the cause, and report-level training raises coverage, accuracy, and calibration together.

</details>


### [256] [Characterizing Bias in Post-Bandit Inference under Index Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01069)
*Lisu Wang,Yilun Chen,Jiaqi Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析了bandit算法（如UCB1及其推广）在自适应采样后对下游推断产生的样本均值偏差，给出了偏差和Z统计量的尖锐首阶表达式，并引入"有效探索率"这一关键量来解释偏差的算法来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Bandit算法广泛用于在线决策，但其自适应采样会导致后续基于bandit数据的样本均值产生系统性偏差。这种偏差降低了基于bandit数据做统计推断的可靠性，而现有分析未能给出对稳定索引算法（如UCB1）偏差的精确刻画。

Method: 针对稳定索引算法（包括UCB1及其推广），推导样本均值偏差和期望Z统计量的尖锐首阶表达式；引入"有效探索率"（effective exploration rate）这一依赖于索引函数的关键量；提出一种新颖的经验流体近似（empirical fluid approximation）来刻画算法的采样动态。

Result: 在UCB1下，有效探索率的阶为√logT，任何非唯一最优臂的标准化偏差以极慢的速率1/√logT衰减；索引函数的选择同时影响遗憾和偏差，揭示了遗憾-偏差权衡：更具探索性的算法降低偏差但增加遗憾。

Conclusion: 本文首次对稳定bandit索引算法的后验偏差提供了尖锐的理论刻画，揭示了偏差的算法机理（有效探索率），并建立了遗憾与偏差之间的权衡关系。所提出的经验流体近似方法本身也具有独立的理论价值。

Abstract: Bandit algorithms generate data for downstream inference, but adaptive sampling biases post-bandit sample means. We analyze this bias for stable index algorithms, including UCB1 and its generalizations, and derive sharp leading-order expressions for the sample-mean bias and expected $Z$-statistic. Our characterization reveals the algorithmic origin of bias through a key index-function-dependent quantity, which we term effective exploration rate. For example, under UCB1, the effective exploration rate is of order $\sqrt{\log T}$, and the standardized bias of any arm (that is not uniquely optimal) decays at the extremely slow rate $1/\sqrt{\log T}$. We also show how the choice of the index function affects both regret and bias, which reveals a regret-bias trade-off: more exploratory algorithm reduces bias but increases regret. Our sharp characterization for bias uses a novel empirical fluid approximation of the algorithm's sampling dynamics, which may be of independent interest.

</details>


### [257] [Neural operator learning for collision-aware trajectory planning of spacecraft swarms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00320)
*Sidhdharth D. Sikka,Suyi Gao,Zehui Lu,Rongjie Lai,Shaoshuai Mou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种置换等变神经算子，可在单次前向传播中为整个航天器编队生成碰撞感知轨迹，配合批量高斯-牛顿精化以满足轨道动力学约束。该算子无需最优轨迹标签训练，通过自监督物理目标与对抗威胁训练，可从10航天器零样本泛化至1000航天器规模，性能媲美逐代理最优控制求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主航天器编队在日益拥挤的轨道中需要规划燃料高效且无碰撞的机动，但经典轨迹优化方法因成对安全约束随编队规模平方增长而扩展性差，学习型规划器又难以跨编队规模或碎片密度泛化。

Method: 提出置换等变神经算子，将航天器、目标和碎片的分布映射为整个编队的碰撞感知轨迹（单次前向传播）；配以批量高斯-牛顿精化以强制执行精确轨道动力学。训练采用自监督物理目标（无需最优轨迹标签），并结合针对自身rollout生成的对抗威胁进行训练。

Result: 在10航天器上训练后，零样本泛化到1000航天器编队（面对11000+编目物体），匹配逐代理最优控制求解器的精度，能规避碎片无关基线无法规避的最坏情况威胁，并将编队内部近距离接近降低数倍。

Conclusion: 物理基础算子学习为拥挤轨道提供了快速、可扩展的最优控制替代方案。

Abstract: Autonomous spacecraft swarms must plan fuel-efficient, collision-free maneuvers in increasingly congested orbits, yet classical trajectory optimization scales poorly as pairwise safety constraints multiply with swarm size, and learning-based planners rarely transfer across swarm sizes or debris densities. Here we introduce a permutation-equivariant neural operator that maps distributions of spacecraft, targets and debris to collision-aware trajectories for an entire swarm in a single forward pass, paired with a batched Gauss-Newton finish that enforces exact orbital dynamics. The operator is trained without optimal-trajectory labels, combining self-supervised physics objectives with adversarial threats generated against its own rollouts. Trained on ten spacecraft, it generalizes zero-shot to swarms of 1,000 amid more than 11,000 catalogued objects, matching a per-agent optimal-control solver's accuracy, evading worst-case threats that a debris-blind baseline cannot, and reducing proximity within the swarm several-fold. Physics-grounded operator learning thus offers a fast, scalable alternative to optimal control for crowded orbits.

</details>


### [258] [Ensemble of Unsupervised Deep Learning for Clustering Imbalanced Tabular Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00346)
*Pulock Das,Yina Hou,Md. Kamrozzaman Bhuiyan,Manar D. Samad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了深度聚类方法在类别不平衡表格数据上的表现，提出两种集成策略（跨嵌入维度聚合和多算法多数投票），在16个二元不平衡数据集上验证了集成方法在ACC、NMI、ARI指标上优于单一聚类方法，表明深度聚类可作为不平衡场景下监督分类的强替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据不平衡是监督分类中的重大挑战，多数类偏差会导致假阴性和准确率高估。由于深度聚类无需类标签进行表征学习，理论上对类别不平衡具有免疫力，但其在不平衡表格数据上的表现尚未被系统研究。

Method: 1. 系统评估多种最先进的深度聚类方法在不同不平衡水平下的表现；2. 提出两种新颖的聚类集成方法：一种跨不同嵌入维度聚合深度聚类结果，另一种对表现最好的聚类算法进行多数投票。

Result: 在16个二元表格数据集（变体及人工诱导的不平衡水平）上的实验表明，不同深度聚类方法各有优势；平均而言，集成方法在ACC、NMI和ARI指标上均优于单一聚类方法，对数据不平衡具有更强的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 在不平衡数据场景下，深度聚类（尤其是集成方法）可以作为监督分类的强有力替代方案，无需类标签即可有效识别真实类别。

Abstract: Data imbalance poses a major challenge in supervised classification, where the majority-class bias contributes to false negatives and overestimates classification accuracy. Unsupervised deep clustering can be immune to class imbalance because representation learning for clustering is performed without class labels. Deep clustering has been proposed for images, languages, and graphs, while its application to tabular data has only emerged recently. This paper is among the first to examine the performance of state-of-the-art deep clustering methods under varying levels of data imbalance. We introduce two novel cluster ensemble approaches: one aggregates deep clustering assignments across different embedding dimensions, and the other applies majority voting to the best-performing clustering algorithms. Experiments on 16 binary tabular datasets with varying and artificially induced levels of imbalance reveal distinct strengths of different deep clustering methods. On average, our ensemble methods outperform individual clustering methods in ACC, NMI, and ARI scores, offering greater resilience to data imbalance when identifying ground-truth classes without supervision. Therefore, in an imbalanced data scenario, deep clustering can serve as a strong alternative to supervised classification.

</details>


### [259] [Stochastic Sequential Search in Very-High-Dimensional Feature Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01502)
*Petr Somol,Jiří Grim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种预算受限的采样步骤算子对，用固定数量的候选评估替代全量扫描，将任何顺序特征选择方法转化为随机对应物，定义随机顺序搜索（SSS）家族，并研究浮动搜索的随机对应物sSFFS。实验表明在高达10,105维的数据集上，sSFFS能以更少的计算达到或超越传统方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 顺序子集搜索（如前向选择与浮动回溯）是特征选择的质量基准，但每一步都需要扫描全部剩余候选特征，导致其无法应用于超高维问题。相比之下，仅有的单特征排序方法虽然可扩展，但对特征间交互作用建模很弱。因此需要一个既保留顺序搜索质量又具备高度可扩展性的方法。

Method: 提出预算受限采样步骤算子对：每步仅评估固定数量的候选，候选通过温度控制的softmax采样从依赖感知的逐特征统计量中抽取，统计量由搜索过程中每次准则评估在线学习，并加入均匀探索下限保证覆盖率。单步成本与维度无关，替换算子可将任何顺序方法转化为随机对应物。具体研究sSFFS（浮动搜索的随机版本）。

Result: 在500维madelon上，sSFFS以约1/4的评估次数保留至少97%的完整SFFS准则值，而均匀采样在此数据集上失效；在5,000维gisette上，sSFFS超越DAF和BIF排序的饱和准则水平；在10,105维reuters上，sSFFS在搜索目标和留出集准确率上均优于BIF和DAF，仅需约两分钟的单核评估。

Conclusion: sSFFS证明随机化顺序搜索能够在保持传统顺序搜索质量的同时，将可应用维度扩展到传统方法无法企及的范围，且带有验证过的独立实现。其结果表明在超高维场景下，搜索不再是最主要的约束，准则本身才是瓶颈。

Abstract: Sequential subset search -- forward selection with floating backtracking and its descendants -- remains the quality reference in feature selection, but every member of the family sweeps the full pool of remaining candidate features at each step, which excludes it from very-high-dimensional problems; there, only individual-feature ranking remains practical, and it models feature interplay weakly or not at all. We introduce a budgeted sampled step operator pair that replaces the full sweeps by a fixed number of candidate evaluations per step. Candidates are drawn by temperature-controlled softmax sampling from dependency-aware per-feature statistics learned online from every criterion evaluation the search performs, guarded by a uniform exploration floor; per-step cost becomes independent of dimensionality. Substituting the operators turns any sequential method into its stochastic counterpart, defining the Stochastic Sequential Search (SSS) family; we study the stochastic counterpart of floating search, sSFFS. On 500-dimensional madelon, sSFFS retains at least 97% of the full-SFFS criterion value at every subset size at about a quarter of its evaluations, while uniform sampling at the same budget collapses on madelon's synergistic features. On 5,000-dimensional gisette, far beyond full-SFFS reach, sSFFS exceeds the saturated criterion level of DAF and BIF ranking at matched budgets; holdout validation shows that at 500 training samples the binding constraint beyond the sequential frontier becomes the criterion, not the search. On 10,105-dimensional reuters, under a trustworthy multinomial filter criterion, sSFFS dominates BIF and DAF on the search objective and on holdout accuracy at every subset size, in about two minutes of single-core evaluation work. A verified standalone implementation accompanies the paper.

</details>


### [260] [Modeling Unknown Nonlocal PDE Systems via Flow Map Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00400)
*Zhongshu Xu,Ying Li,Yanzhi Zhang,Dongbin Xiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种流映射学习（FML）框架，直接从解数据中建模未知的非局部偏微分方程。该方法不学习或逼近底层非局部算子，而是在模态空间或节点空间中学习有限时间演化算子，并针对谱表示和网格表示分别开发了两种互补的公式。在一维和二维分数阶扩散及波动方程上的数值实验表明，该方法仅使用短观测窗口即可实现准确且稳定的长期预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非局部偏微分方程在许多应用中广泛出现，但由于非局部算子的存在，其建模和学习往往非常困难。传统的学习方法需要显式逼近或评估非局部算子，这增加了复杂性和计算负担。因此需要一个不依赖显式评估非局部算子的数据驱动框架来有效学习未知的非局部动力学。

Method: 提出流映射学习（FML）框架：1) 不学习或逼近底层非局部算子，而是直接学习有限时间演化算子；2) 在模态空间（谱表示）和节点空间（网格表示）两种互补的公式中实现；3) 仅使用短观测窗口的数据即可训练模型，实现长期稳定预测。

Result: 在一维和二维分数阶扩散方程及波动方程上的数值实验表明，该方法仅使用短观测窗口即可实现准确且稳定的长期时间预测，验证了FML框架在未知非局部动力学学习中的有效性。

Conclusion: 该框架为学习未知非局部动力学提供了一种有效的数据驱动方法，其核心优势在于完全避免了非局部算子的显式评估，从而简化了建模过程并提高了学习效率。

Abstract: Nonlocal partial differential equations arise in many applications but are often difficult to model and learn because of the presence of nonlocal operators. We present a flow-map learning (FML) framework for modeling unknown nonlocal PDEs directly from solution data. Rather than learning or approximating the underlying nonlocal operators, the proposed approach learns the finite-time evolution operator in either modal or nodal space. Two complementary formulations are developed for spectral and grid-based solution representations. Numerical experiments on one- and two-dimensional fractional diffusion and wave equations demonstrate accurate and stable long-time prediction using only short observation windows. The proposed approach provides an effective data-driven framework for learning unknown nonlocal dynamics without explicit evaluation of nonlocal operators.

</details>


### [261] [Aggregate-then-Calibrate for Human-centered Assessment with Theoretical Guarantees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02455)
*Zejun Xie,Xintong Li,Guang Wang,Desheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Aggregate-then-Calibrate (AtC)两阶段框架，结合人类判断与模型分数进行以人为中心的评估任务。第一阶段通过考虑标注者可靠性的排序聚合模型将异质比较判断聚合为共识排序；第二阶段通过保序投影将预测模型分数校准到该排序上，在保持序一致性的同时最大化保留模型定量信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有以人为中心的评估任务面临两难困境：仅用人类判断会受异构专业性和不一致评分标准影响，仅用模型生成分数则需从不完美代理或不完整特征中学习。需要一个能结合二者互补优势的方法。

Method: 提出AtC两阶段框架：(1) 第一阶段使用考虑标注者可靠性的排序聚合模型，将异质比较判断聚合为共识排序；(2) 第二阶段通过保序投影（isotonic projection）将任何预测模型的分数校准到共识排序上，强制序一致性同时尽可能保留模型的定量信息。

Result: 理论上证明：建模标注者异质性比同质性假设下共识估计更高效；保序校准即使在共识排序错误指定下也有风险界；AtC渐近优于仅模型评估。在半合成和真实数据集上，AtC在准确性和鲁棒性上持续优于仅人类或仅模型评估。

Conclusion: AtC将判断聚合与无模型校准联系起来，为真实标签昂贵、稀缺或不可验证的人为中心评估提供了一个有原则的解决方案。

Abstract: Human-centered assessment tasks, which are essential for systematic decision-making, rely heavily on human judgment and typically lack verifiable ground truth. Existing approaches face a dilemma: methods using only human judgments suffer from heterogeneous expertise and inconsistent rating scales, while methods using only model-generated scores must learn from imperfect proxies or incomplete features. We propose Aggregate-then-Calibrate (AtC), a two-stage framework that combines these complementary sources. Stage-1 aggregates heterogeneous comparative judgments into a consensus ranking using a rank-aggregation model that accounts for annotator reliability. Stage-2 calibrates any predictive model's scores by an isotonic projection onto the order, enforcing ordinal consistency while preserving as much of the model's quantitative information as possible. Theoretically, we show: (1) modeling annotator heterogeneity yields strictly more efficient consensus estimation than homogeneity; (2) isotonic calibration enjoys risk bounds even when the consensus ranking is misspecified; and (3) AtC asymptotically outperforms model-only assessment. Across semi-synthetic and real-world datasets, AtC consistently improves accuracy and robustness over human-only or model-only assessments. Our results bridge judgment aggregation with model-free calibration, providing a principled recipe for human-centered assessment when ground truth is costly, scarce, or unverifiable.

</details>


### [262] [DSETA: A Dual-Stage Continual Learning Framework for Travel Time Prediction in Dynamic Traffic Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00402)
*Yanming Lyu,Yue Cheng,Lingkun Li,Ruipeng Gao,Xinyue Liu,Hui Gao,Qiang Ni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DSETA是一个双阶段（日内/日间）增量更新ETA预测框架，通过日内实时数据适应短期交通波动、日间历史聚合数据捕捉长期分布漂移，并引入历史交通知识巩固模块防止灾难性遗忘。在滴滴三大城市在线A/B测试中分别实现MAE降低6.62%、0.73%和2.40%，已成功部署于生产环境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ETA预测方法难以适应大城市中日益动态的交通拥堵模式，要么无法应对不规则交通模式和突发拥堵，要么在面临新数据分布时无法区分长期趋势与短期波动，导致真实场景中模型性能下降。

Method: 提出DSETA双阶段增量学习框架：(1) 日内学习阶段，完全依赖实时数据，动态适应节假日或事故等引起的短期交通模式；(2) 日间学习阶段，利用短时间窗口内的聚合历史数据，捕获季节性趋势和交通网络演化等长期分布偏移；(3) 历史交通知识巩固模块，防止灾难性遗忘并保留常规模式知识。

Result: 在滴滴真实数据集上的离线与在线实验验证了有效性。北京、武汉、西安三城在线A/B测试分别实现MAE降低6.62%、0.73%和2.40%。框架已部署至滴滴生产环境，每日处理数亿级请求。

Conclusion: DSETA通过将连续学习划分为日内和日间两个阶段，有效解决了ETA预测中短期波动与长期漂移的适应问题，同时通过知识巩固模块缓解灾难性遗忘，在工业级大规模应用中展现了显著的性能提升。

Abstract: Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) prediction is a core component of intelligent transportation systems. As traffic congestion patterns become increasingly dynamic in large cities, maintaining high prediction accuracy poses a major challenge for ride-hailing platforms. Existing methods either fail to adapt to irregular traffic patterns and sudden congestion, or suffer from new distributions without disentangling long-term trends from short-term fluctuations, thereby degrading model performance in real-world scenarios. To address this challenge, we propose DSETA, an incrementally updated Dual-Stage ETA prediction framework. Specifically, the continual learning process is divided into \textit{inter-day} and \textit{intra-day} stages. We first design the \textit{intra-day} learning stage, which relies entirely on real-time data to enable dynamic adaptation to short-term traffic patterns caused by events like holidays or accidents.
