Driven by the observations that 1) online continual learning closely resembles how animals learn; 2) loss of plasticity---the progressive decline in a learning network's ability to learn---is another crucial challenge facing continual learning; and 3) incremental introduction of randomly initialized hidden units was recently shown to help preserve plasticity, in this paper, we study the plasticity of several foundational growing and elastic networks in online continual learning. Our experiments in supervised learning settings show that adaptive growing networks, which incrementally incorporate new, randomly initialized units to the network while keeping all existing connections adaptive, can maintain high prediction accuracy without losing plasticity despite the continuous increase in the dead hidden unit proportion. Furthermore, we demonstrate that adaptive elastic networks, which in addition to progressively adding new hidden units also prune estimated dead hidden units at the beginning of each new task, can achieve excellent accuracy without loss of plasticity while simultaneously maintaining a near-constant, compact size. Our results suggest that growing and elastic networks, which exhibit the ability to adapt its structure to the relevant learning objectives, can be a promising class of algorithms also for preserving high plasticity in online continual learning.

</details>


### [329] [Interpretable MEG Decoding of Perceived Speech: Cortical Sources and the Stimulus Features That Drive Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01481)
*Ilia Semenkov,Daria Kleeva,Ivan Dakhtin,Zarina Maksudova,Alex Ossadtchi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种从非侵入性脑磁图（MEG）记录中检索语音片段的方法。作者改进了原有的MEG-to-audio检索架构，用球谐函数替代平面传感器布局的空间注意力，将主体特异性表征从270个分支减少到25个，并为每个分支添加时间滤波器以匹配神经源。模型在MEG-MASC数据集上达到39.75±0.34%的Top-1准确率（1005个候选中），解码器参数减少约20倍。权重可映射到源空间，恢复了与语音感知网络一致的生成器，左侧分支携带右侧不明显的高频节律成分。MEG遮挡实验显示19个刺激特征中15个有贡献，其中静默、声音强度、元音和声学起始影响最大。随机词列表的结果表明无叙事结构的活动携带的可恢复信息较少。wav2vec目标可减少到约12个学习特征维度而不损失准确性，但强时间压缩会导致明显损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管已有的CLIP风格深度网络可以从非侵入性MEG记录中检索语音段，但其权重无法映射到电生理学量上，且不清楚哪些语音特性驱动了检索。作者希望构建一个既能实现高性能检索、又能将权重映射到源空间、并能揭示驱动检索的语音特征的模型。

Method: 在原有的高性能MEG-to-audio检索架构基础上进行两项关键改进：(1) 前端：用基于三维MEG头盔几何的球谐函数替代扁平传感器布局的空间注意力；将主体特异性表征从270个分支减少到25个，并为每个分支添加时间滤波器以匹配时空中的神经源；(2) 解码器：使用更浅的卷积解码器。训练前移除眼动和心电成分以减少刺激锁定捷径。

Result: 在MEG-MASC上达到39.75±0.34%的Top-1准确率（1005个候选），解码器参数减少约20倍。权重映射到源空间后恢复了与语音感知网络一致的生成器，左侧分支携带更高频节律成分。MEG遮挡实验显示15/19刺激特征有贡献（静默、声音强度、元音、声学起始影响最大）。随机词列表实验表明叙事结构的MEG活动携带更多可恢复信息。wav2vec目标可压缩到约12维而不损失准确性，但强时间压缩导致明显性能下降。

Conclusion: 通过源映射和输入干预相结合，该研究揭示了语音检索的驱动因素：模型依赖于多种语音特征（特别是静默、强度、元音和声学起始），需要叙事结构支撑的信息内容，左侧化的高频节律成分在检索中起重要作用。该工作为神经语言学中MEG-语音检索提供了可解释的架构。

Abstract: Short segments of perceived speech can be retrieved from non-invasive magnetoencephalographic (MEG) recordings by deep networks trained with a CLIP-style objective against wav2vec 2.0 audio embeddings. Yet their weights do not map onto electrophysiological quantities, and it remains unclear which speech properties drive retrieval.
  We build on a high-performing MEG-to-audio retrieval architecture but redesign both its front end and decoder. Its spatial attention operates on a flattened sensor layout; we replace it with spherical harmonics defined on the three-dimensional MEG helmet geometry. We reduce the subject-specific representation from 270 to 25 branches, add a temporal filter to each branch to match it to a neuronal source in space and time, and make the convolutional decoder shallower. Ocular and cardiac components are removed before training to reduce the risk of stimulus-locked shortcuts.
  On MEG-MASC, the model reaches 39.75 +/- 0.34% Top-1 accuracy among 1005 candidates across six trained solutions, with about 20 times fewer decoder parameters. Its weights map to source space, recovering generators consistent with the speech-perception network, while left-lateralized branches carry higher-frequency rhythmic components not evident on the right. Paired MEG occlusion shows that 15 of 19 stimulus features contribute, with the largest effects for silence, sound intensity, vowels, and acoustic onsets. Random word lists behave oppositely: substituting narrative MEG into them improves retrieval, indicating that activity without narrative structure carries less recoverable information than activity during coherent speech. The wav2vec target can be reduced to about twelve learned feature dimensions without loss of accuracy, whereas strong temporal compression causes a clear loss.
  Together, source mapping and input interventions reveal what drives retrieval.

</details>


### [330] [BiKAN: Restoring Collapsed Basis of Binary Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01490)
*Kazi Ahmed Asif Fuad,Lizhong Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出BiKAN，解决二值化KAN网络中多项式基因激活函数被限制为{-1,+1}时发生"空间正交性塌缩"的问题，通过引入Walsh字符（degree-2 parity）恢复成对坐标信息，在不增加计算开销的前提下显著提升二值KAN的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二值化KAN时，激活值被限制为{-1,+1}，导致所有偶数幂坍缩为常数、奇数幂坍缩为x，多项式基函数丧失表达能力（称为空间正交性塌缩），严重影响网络性能。

Method: 在每个二值KAN层中注入选定的degree-2 Walsh字符（parity特征）：固定循环通道生成成对奇偶性，通过学习的二值投影并使用XNOR-popcount运算进行混合，恢复显式的成对坐标信息，无需学习路由或基于乘法器的特征生成。

Result: CIFAR-10上移除parity使精度下降1.23个百分点（p=0.003）；等参数预算下parity优于传统加宽3.09个百分点；W1A1下在MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100分别达到99.48%、84.38%、55.81%；FPGA上卷积设计将DSP从164降至72、延迟从401降至54.8ms，密集设计实现零DSP推理仅损失0.03个点。

Conclusion: BiKAN通过Walsh奇偶校正有效修复了二值KAN的空间正交性塌缩问题，在保持硬件高效性的同时显著提升精度，且宽度越小增益越大、parity平面越多性能越好。

Abstract: Binarizing a polynomial Kolmogorov--Arnold Network (KAN) not only changes parameter precision, but also alters the function space available to each layer. When activations are restricted to ${-1,+1}$, all even powers reduce to $1$ and all odd powers reduce to $x$, causing the elementwise polynomial basis to collapse to constant and first-order responses. We refer to this structural failure as Spatial Orthogonality Collapse. Our proposed BiKAN addresses this critical issue by augmenting each binary KAN layer with selected degree-2 Walsh characters. Fixed circular channel rolls generate pairwise parities, and learned binary projections mix them using the same XNOR--popcount operations as the remaining W1A1 paths. This restores explicit pairwise coordinates without learned routing or multiplier-based feature generation. Experiments on CIFAR-10 confirms that removing parity reduces accuracy by $1.23$ points over five paired seeds ($p=0.003$), the gain increases as width decreases, and accuracy improves monotonically as more parity planes are added. At an equal $\sim$11.9M-parameter budget, parity outperforms conventional widening by $3.09$ points ($p<10^{-4}$). At W1A1, BiKAN reaches $99.48\%$, $84.38\%$, and $55.81\%$ on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100, respectively. Post-route Zynq-7020 FPGA results show that the repair remains hardware-efficient; the convolutional design cuts DSP usage from 164 to 72 and estimated compute-core latency from 401 to 54.8 ms, while the power-of-two-aware dense design achieves zero-DSP inference with a 0.03-point accuracy loss. The BiKAN implementation is available at https://github.com/OSU-STARLAB/BiKAN.

</details>


### [331] [Question Begets Question: Self-Evolving Curriculum for Reinforcement Fine-Tuning on Competition Mathematics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01522)
*Longtian Bao,Jianyou Wang,Yang Zhang,Youze Zheng,Ramamohan Paturi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Question-begets-Question (QbQ)框架与自进化课程训练方法，在仅使用问题与最终答案（无推理链）的强化学习训练下，突破训练数据稀缺导致的性能天花板，将Qwen2.5-Math-7B在AIME竞赛数学上的pass@1从5.6%提升至16.5%，且20轮训练后无饱和迹象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当语言模型尚未掌握某技能时，训练面临三大困难：训练数据稀缺、难以获得ground-truth推理轨迹、模型常出现额外的数据也无法突破的性能天花板。作者希望在受控条件下研究并解决这些问题。

Method: 提出QbQ（Question-begets-Question）可扩展数据生成方法，由教师模型将现有问题转化为探测相同底层技能的不同变体；训练仅通过强化学习，使用问题陈述与最终答案，不依赖教师推理轨迹。核心创新是自进化课程：每轮评估当前checkpoint，从模型能大部分答对的问题中生成QbQ变体进行训练，反复迭代。

Result: 静态训练（真实+合成数据增强、非课程QbQ）分别将pass@1限制在12.5%和14.5%；自进化课程在相同数据预算下突破天花板，将pass@1提升至16.5%，20轮后无饱和迹象。反直觉发现：模型从能大部分答对的问题变体训练中获益，且能泛化到训练中未见过的更难问题。

Conclusion: 性能天花板并非模型固有，而是由训练策略造成。自进化课程结合从可解决问题中生成变体的策略，能有效突破静态训练的数据天花板，为技能学习中数据稀缺和推理轨迹缺失问题提供了新思路。

Abstract: Teaching a language model a skill it has not mastered is obstructed by three recurring difficulties: training data is scarce, ground-truth reasoning traces are usually unavailable, and models often exhibit an apparent ceiling beyond which additional data yields no further improvement. We study these difficulties in a controlled setting, fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-7B on competition mathematics (AIME), a task on which it initially solves only 5.6\% of problems (pass@1). To address data scarcity, we introduce Question-begets-Question (QbQ), a scalable procedure in which a teacher transforms existing problems into diverse variants that probe the same underlying skills; to model the absence of oracle reasoning, we train exclusively via reinforcement learning on problem statements and final answers, never on teacher reasoning traces. Static training on such data, however, plateaus well short of the task: real-plus-synthetic augmentation and non-curriculum QbQ generated synthetic data training cap pass@1 at 12.5\% and 14.5\% respectively, despite large increases in data. Our central finding is that this ceiling is not intrinsic to the model. We propose a self-evolving curriculum that, each round, evaluates the current checkpoint, seeds QbQ from the problems it can mostly get right, and trains on the resulting variants; under an identical data budget, this breaks the ceiling and lifts pass@1 to 16.5\% with no sign of saturation after 20 rounds. Counterintuitively, we find that models improve when trained on variants of problems they can mostly get right, and that models trained this way go on to solve harder problems never seen during training.

</details>


### [332] [Gram-Space: Structure-Preserving Codebook Compression for Memory-Efficient Neuro-Symbolic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01528)
*Weilun Wang,Wantong Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Gram-Space，一个基于Gram-Schmidt正交化的压缩框架，用于减少向量符号架构（VSA）在神经符号AI推理中的高维码本内存瓶颈。实验表明该框架可将模型级GPU内存使用降低15.75倍，推理延迟提升3.62倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VSA在神经符号AI中被广泛用于推理，但其高维码本（codebook）会造成严重的内存瓶颈，限制了可扩展性和部署能力。需要一种有效的压缩方法来解决这一问题。

Method: Gram-Space框架利用Gram-Schmidt正交化将码本向量表示为紧凑的标准正交坐标系。该方法保持点积结构，从而在数学上等价地支持矩阵相似度计算、概率向量化和注意力分数计算等基于矩阵的VSA算子。作者提供了正确性分析证明在正交基表示下内积被保持。

Result: 在标准神经符号推理数据集上的实验表明，Gram-Space在多种先进的VSA模型上将GPU内存使用最多减少15.75倍，推理延迟提升最多3.62倍。分析结果还显示Gram-Space减少了码本相关阶段的分配开销，并提高了NeSy工作负载的硬件利用率。

Conclusion: Gram-Space是一种有效的VSA压缩框架，通过正交化在保持计算等价性的同时大幅降低内存占用和提升推理效率，为神经符号AI的可扩展部署提供了一种实用解决方案。

Abstract: Vector symbolic architectures (VSA) are widely used for reasoning in neuro-symbolic (NeSy) AI, yet high-dimensional codebooks often create severe memory bottlenecks that limit scalability and deployment. In this paper, we propose Gram-Space, a compression framework that applies Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization to represent codebook vectors in a compact orthonormal coordinate system. Gram-Space preserves the dot-product structure required by matrix-based VSA operators, which supports numerically equivalent execution of matrix similarity, probability vectorization, and attention score computations. We provide a correctness analysis showing that inner products are preserved under the orthonormal basis representation. Using modern GPU hardware, we benchmark the Gram-Space framework on standard neuro-symbolic reasoning datasets. Experimental evaluations across state-of-the-art VSA models show that Gram-Space reduces model-level GPU memory usage by up to 15.75x and improves inference latency by up to 3.62x. Profiling results further indicate that Gram-Space reduces allocation-heavy overhead in codebook-associated stages and improves hardware utilization for NeSy workloads.

</details>


### [333] [Rethinking Personalized Reward Modeling for LLMs under Preference Heterogeneity via Group-Debiased Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01556)
*Seongyoon Kim,Boryeong Cho,Jihwan Oh,Seokhyun Chung,Se-Young Yun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对联邦学习中奖励模型的对齐问题，发现一个反直觉现象：在偏好组平衡时，单个FedAvg模型经过少量本地微调后性能反而超过为每个ground-truth组单独训练的奖励模型。作者将此归因于共享初始化的"平坦性"——跨客户端平均能学习更丰富的共享表示并抵消冲突的偏好方向。然而组不平衡会破坏这一效应，使少数派客户端难以恢复。为此提出FedGD方法，在联邦训练中自动发现潜在偏好组，并通过组去偏客户端采样学习单个奖励模型，无需预先知道底层分组即可实现高效个性化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有联邦偏好对齐方法假设偏好异质性需要为不同客户端聚类分组并训练独立的奖励模型（每个组需要单独的初始化）。作者质疑这一假设的必要性，旨在探索是否可以用一个共享模型实现更好的个性化效果。

Method: 1) 理论分析：证明在平衡偏好组下，FedAvg的共享初始化具有平坦性，能学习区分响应的共享表示同时抵消冲突偏好方向，使模型靠近决策边界从而快速适应。2) 实证发现组不平衡会破坏该效应。3) 提出FedGD：在联邦训练过程中自动发现潜在偏好组，采用组去偏客户端采样策略，学习单个高度可适应的奖励模型。

Result: 在平衡偏好组条件下，FedAvg模型经过少量本地优化步骤后超越为每组单独训练的奖励模型；组不平衡会导致少数派客户端性能下降；提出的FedGD方法通过组去偏采样有效抵消组不平衡影响，保留初始化可适应性。

Conclusion: 论文挑战了联邦学习中"每组需要独立初始化"的传统假设，揭示了共享初始化平坦性在偏好个性化中的关键作用，并通过FedGD实现了无需预先分组知识的高效个性化。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly aligned to human preferences via reward modeling, but user preference data are sensitive and often cannot be centralized. Federated learning keeps such data local while learning a shared initial reward model, which is later personalized for each client through local fine-tuning. Because users often assign opposite labels to the same pair of responses, existing federated methods address preference heterogeneity by clustering similar clients and training one reward model per group, assuming that each group requires its own initialization. We show that this assumption is unnecessary. Under balanced preference groups, a single FedAvg model, despite starting at nearly random accuracy, surpasses reward models trained separately for each ground-truth group after only a few local optimization steps. We attribute this phenomenon to the flatness of the shared initialization: averaging across all clients learns richer shared representations that distinguish responses while canceling conflicting preference directions, leaving the model near a decision boundary that can be rapidly adapted. Group imbalance breaks this effect as the cancellation becomes asymmetric and leaves minority clients too far from the boundary to recover. Motivated by this observation, we propose FedGD (Federated Learning with Group Debiasing), which discovers latent preference groups during federated training and learns a single reward model using group-debiased client sampling. By counteracting the effect of group imbalance, FedGD learns an initialization that remains highly adaptable, enabling effective personalization without prior knowledge of the underlying groups.

</details>


### [334] [Meganeura: Portable GPU Training and Inference through Vulkan and Metal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01563)
*Dzmitry Malyshau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Meganeura是一个紧凑的原生编译器，可同时覆盖训练和推理两阶段，通过类型化静态图和自动微分等组件，在消费级GPU上通过Vulkan/Metal运行。在50个设备-工作负载-模式组合中48个通过验证，训练性能中位数与PyTorch差距1.8倍，部分推理工作负载接近或超越编译后的ROCm PyTorch，编译速度远快于torch.compile。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练和部署推理通常跨越不同的导出、转换和平台特定运行时边界，导致系统复杂且效率低下。作者希望探究是否可以用一个紧凑的原生编译器同时覆盖训练和部署两个阶段，在消费级GPU上实现统一的训练到部署流程。

Method: Meganeura包含类型化静态图、自动微分、优化器、检查点、内存规划和运行时，通过Vulkan和Metal图形API编译并执行专用程序。作者设计了严格的验证协议，将严格f32模式与加速快速路径分开，并独立控制前向和反向传播的验证门。实验涵盖5个匹配工作负载，在NVIDIA、AMD独显、AMD APU、Apple Silicon和Intel iGPU上对比PyTorch。

Result: 48/50个设备-工作负载-模式组合通过验证；严格f32下Meganeura在20个GPU参考的最小延迟单元中赢得12个，训练中位数差距1.8倍；AMD独显上4/5推理负载在1.10x内，3个训练负载更快；加速模式下最差训练差距4.6倍。编译时间0.1-2.4秒vs torch.compile的6-96秒，二进制仅13 MiB。性能瓶颈主要集中在卷积导数和注意力反向传播。

Conclusion: 消费级图形API（Vulkan/Metal）可以支撑一个紧凑的共享训练到部署栈，达到实用甚至部分场景下与厂商编译器竞争的性能。测量的性能差距源于内核覆盖、调度和算术策略，而非API本身的限制。Android XR案例研究验证了该栈在实际部署场景中的可行性。

Abstract: Training and deployed inference often cross export, conversion, and platform-specific runtime boundaries. Meganeura asks whether one compact native compiler can span both phases on consumer GPUs. Its typed static graph, automatic differentiation, optimizer, checkpoint, memory planner, and runtime lower specialized programs through Vulkan and Metal.
  We compare five matched workloads with PyTorch on NVIDIA and AMD discrete GPUs, an AMD APU, Apple silicon, and an Intel iGPU. The protocol separates strict f32 from validated fast paths and gates forward and backward independently. Forty-eight of 50 device-workload-mode cells pass both gates; the other two share one unresolved backward-reference disagreement on a newly supported APU. In strict f32, Meganeura wins 12 of 20 GPU-referenced minimal-latency cells and has a median valid training gap of 1.8x. On the discrete AMD GPU, four of five inference workloads are within 1.10x of compiled ROCm PyTorch and three training workloads are faster. Under accelerated contracts, the worst training gap is 4.6x.
  Compilation takes 0.1-2.4 seconds versus 6-96 seconds for torch.compile on supported GPU paths; the stripped binary is 13 MiB. Dispatch profiles localize the largest gaps to convolution derivatives and attention backward. A physical Android XR case study transfers a Meganeura-trained decoder into an Adreno/OpenXR application sharing the graphics queue. The results show that general consumer graphics APIs can support a compact shared train-to-deploy stack at useful, sometimes vendor-competitive performance. The measured gaps point to kernel coverage, scheduling, and arithmetic policy rather than an identified API limitation.

</details>


### [335] [Measuring in-context algorithmic reasoning in language models against an exact Bayes-optimal standard](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01575)
*Hector Zenil,Luan Ozelim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出F-ICL基准，基于图灵完备机器sF穷举所有1.5亿个程序并在Levin-Solomonoff先验下精确计算贝叶斯最优后验，用于测试大语言模型是否具备真正的算法推理。结果显示45/46个模型输出分布比按键参考更远离最优，其行为更像无循环的简单前缀统计混合，且更新非单调（6545次"解得→未解"转换），与贝叶斯理性相矛盾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准缺乏正确归纳推理的ground truth，难以区分大语言模型是真正的算法推理还是模式补全。需要一个具有精确最优解的基准来严格检验模型的归纳推理能力。

Method: 1) 使用图灵完备机器F并构造补对称版本sF消除输出极性偏差；2) 穷举枚举长度L≤13的所有15亿程序并闭式计算Levin-Solomonoff先验下的贝叶斯最优后验；3) 每个任务配对按位互补版本，用"原始-孪生差距"隔离模型的归纳偏差；4) 在105种服务配置、37个开源模型（0.8B-675B）及前沿系统上进行评估。

Result: 模型可答对高达92%的查询，但45/46个模型的分布比按键参考更远离最优；行为被仅基于可见证据的低阶前缀统计所界定，更接近无循环混合而非循环最优；更新非单调，出现6545次"解得→未解"转换；差距与准确率不相关（ρ=-0.19, p=0.21），不随规模或前沿代际缩小，指令微调和推理后训练反而加大差距。

Conclusion: 尽管模型在查询层面表现出高准确率，但其诱导分布本质上是无循环的简单算法混合，不具备真正的贝叶斯最优归纳推理能力；模型的行为模式与理性贝叶斯更新不一致，且能力差距不随规模扩展而缩小，表明当前LLM的"推理"更接近模式补全而非算法推理。

Abstract: Whether large language models perform genuine algorithmic reasoning or mere pattern completion is hard to test, because most benchmarks lack a ground truth for correct inductive inference. We introduce F-ICL, an in-context-learning benchmark that supplies one exactly. Using the Turing-complete machine F, complement-symmetrised into sF to remove output-polarity bias, we exhaustively enumerate all 1.5 billion programs of length $L\le13$ and compute the Bayes-optimal posterior in closed form under a bounded universal (Levin--Solomonoff) prior; models are scored by how closely their served distributions approach it at matched evidence. Each task is paired with its bitwise complement, on which the optimum scores identically, so an original-twin gap isolates the model's inductive bias. Across 105 serving configurations spanning 37 open models (0.8B--675B) and frontier systems from four laboratories, models answer up to 92\% of queries correctly, yet 45 of 46 models yield distributions farther from the optimum than a keystroke reference, and their behaviour is bracketed by low-order prefix statistics fitted only on visible evidence. That reference is itself an algorithmic mixture, induced by a print-only machine with no loops, so the panel's implied measure sits closer to a loop-free mixture than to the loop-bearing optimum, independently of the reference machine. Updating is also non-monotone, which no prior explains: a Bayes-rational solved set can only grow in this realisable, noiseless setting, yet added examples produce $6{,}545$ solved-to-unsolved transitions against $13{,}702$ gains. The gap is not predicted by accuracy (Spearman $ρ=-0.19$, $p=0.21$), does not close with scale or across frontier generations in the serving modes that expose distributions, and is widened by instruction and reasoning post-training. F-ICL is released as an open, reproducible benchmark and toolkit.

</details>


### [336] [HindSearch: Trajectory-Level Hindsight Critique for Search-Augmented Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01597)
*Haowei Liu,Jiamian Wang,Hsin-Tai Wu,Zhiqiang Tao,Yi Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HindSearch是一种用于GRPO的后见自我蒸馏方法：在每次rollout后，冻结的评判模型利用正确答案对失败轨迹撰写简短批评，并以此作为辅助的on-policy蒸馏信号来指导学生的搜索行为。在七个标准基准上，使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct达到39.4%的平均EM，优于之前的搜索RL基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的搜索增强LM智能体使用二进制精确匹配奖励进行训练，这种奖励丢弃了失败轨迹中包含的大部分关于失败原因的信息，导致训练信号稀疏且低效。

Method: 提出HindSearch：在GRPO框架中引入后见自我蒸馏。每次rollout后，冻结的评判模型（judge）利用标准答案对每条失败轨迹撰写简短批评，该批评作为辅助的on-policy蒸馏信号，指导学生的搜索动作。

Result: 在标准七基准套件上，HindSearch使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct达到39.4%的平均EM，优于先前搜索RL基线。消融实验显示，移除评判模型对标准答案的访问权会消除大部分性能提升，证明后见信息是改进的来源。

Conclusion: 后见知识（利用金标准答案生成的批评）是搜索增强LM智能体强化学习中的关键改进来源，通过自我蒸馏的方式可以有效利用失败轨迹中的丰富信息。

Abstract: Search-augmented LM agents are typically trained with a binary exact-match reward, which throws away most of what a failed trajectory tells us about why it failed. We introduce HindSearch, a hindsight self-distillation procedure for GRPO: after each rollout, a frozen judge writes a short critique of every failed trajectory using the gold answer, and the critique supplies an auxiliary on-policy distillation signal on the student's search actions. On the standard seven-benchmark suite with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, HindSearch reaches 39.4% average EM, outperforming prior search-RL baselines. Removing the judge's access to the gold answer erases most of the gain, isolating hindsight as the source of the improvement.

</details>


### [337] [Latent-Regime Bias Auditing for Volatility Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01599)
*Arthur Chagas,Pedro Bento,Yan Aquino,Arthur Buzelin,Wagner Meira,Cristiano Arbex Valle*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个模型无关的审计框架，用于评估波动率预测在不同潜在市场状态下是否可靠。通过学习市场状态窗口的时间序列表示、聚类为不同状态、并比较聚合误差与状态条件性偏差/尾部低估/经济损失，发现聚合精度高的模型仍可能在某些状态下严重失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的波动率预测评估只依赖RMSE、MAE等聚合指标，这些指标会掩盖条件性失效（即在某些市场状态下预测不可靠），而这正是风险管理最需要关注的。因此需要一种能在不同潜在市场状态下审计预测可靠性的方法。

Method: 提出模型无关的审计框架：1）学习市场状态窗口的时间序列表示；2）仅使用训练信息将状态聚类为不同市场体制；3）在样本外分配体制标签；4）对比聚合预测表现与状态条件性的偏差、尾部低估和低估敏感的经经济损损失。

Result: 在加密货币和ETF资产的日度波动率预测实验中，具有竞争性聚合精度的模型仍可能表现出显著的状态特定偏差和严重的尾部低估，表明聚合指标无法捕捉条件性失效。

Conclusion: 波动率预测评估不应只看平均误差，而应关注预测在哪些市场状态和何种方式下失效。该框架将预测评估从"哪个模型平均最准"转向"在哪些体制中看似准确的预测会条件性失效"。

Abstract: Volatility forecasts are commonly evaluated with aggregate accuracy metrics such as RMSE and MAE, but these metrics can hide conditional failures that matter for risk management. This paper proposes a model-agnostic audit framework for evaluating whether volatility forecasts remain reliable across latent market regimes. We learn time-series representations of market-state windows, cluster them into regimes using only training information, assign regimes out of sample, and compare aggregate forecast behavior with regime-conditional bias, tail-underprediction, and underprediction-sensitive economic losses. Applied to daily volatility forecasting across cryptocurrency and ETF assets, the audit shows that models with competitive aggregate accuracy can still exhibit substantial regime-specific bias and severe tail underprediction. The results suggest that volatility forecasting should be evaluated not only by average error, but also by where and how forecasts become unreliable. Our framework shifts forecast evaluation from asking which model is most accurate on average to identifying the market regimes in which apparently accurate forecasts fail conditionally. Reproducibility: https://github.com/arthurchagas1/Latent-Regime-Bias-Auditing-for-Volatility-Forecasting

</details>


### [338] [Online Algorithms via Minimax and Posterior Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01616)
*Thomas Kesselheim,Marco Molinaro,Kalen Patton,Sahil Singla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种统一的在线算法竞争比分析方法——后验匹配（posterior matching）原则。通过极小极大观点和Yao原则，将最坏情况竞争分析转化为在任意相关先验分布下的贝叶斯在线设计问题，并证明基于追踪后验过程X^(t)的单一原则可为多个经典在线分数问题（集合覆盖、负载均衡、匹配、资源分配等）提供最优或近最优保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线算法中的竞争比上界分析通常高度依赖具体问题，缺乏统一的方法论。研究者希望通过极小极大视角建立一套可复用的框架，将最坏情况分析转化为贝叶斯在线设计问题，从而为广泛的问题类别提供统一的分析工具。

Method: 1) 利用Yao原则将最坏情况竞争分析归约到任意相关先验分布下的贝叶斯在线设计。2) 定义后验过程X^(t)为事后最优分数解的期望。3) 提出后验匹配原则：在每个时刻选择尽可能贴近当前后验的可行在线行动。4) 将竞争保证归约为后验向量鞅的关键概率不等式。<br>

Result: 该原则为集合覆盖、负载均衡、匹配及更一般的资源分配问题（带范数/凹目标）恢复或改进了最先进的竞争比界。通过已知的舍入归约，还获得了加权分页、星度量MTS和滑雪租赁问题的随机整数保证。

Conclusion: 建立了从任意相关先验下的贝叶斯在线设计到信息论最坏情况竞争保证的可复用路线，为在线算法竞争分析提供了统一的新方法论。

Abstract: Competitive analysis is central to the study of online algorithms, but upper bounds are often highly problem-specific. We develop a more unifying methodology via the minimax viewpoint. Guided by Yao's principle, we reduce worst-case competitive analysis to Bayesian online design under an arbitrary correlated prior over arrival sequences. For such a prior, let $X^*$ be the hindsight-optimal fractional solution for the realized instance, and let $X^{(t)}=\mathbb E[X^*\mid \mathcal F_t]$ be its posterior process. Our guiding rule is posterior matching: at each time $t$, choose the feasible online action that tracks the current posterior $X^{(t)}$ as closely as the online constraints permit.
  We show that this single principle yields optimal or near-optimal guarantees for several classical online fractional problems, including set cover, load balancing, matching and more general resource-allocation problems, recovering or improving state-of-the-art bounds in these settings with norm/concave objectives. Via known rounding reductions, it also yields randomized integral guarantees for weighted paging, MTS on star metrics, and ski-rental. At a technical level, our analysis reduces competitive guarantees to key probabilistic inequalities for the vector martingales generated by the posterior of the offline optimum. The resulting framework gives a reusable route from Bayesian online design under arbitrary correlated priors to information-theoretic worst-case competitive guarantees.

</details>


### [339] [QWRF-Net: A Quantum-Wavelet Framework with Rectified Flow for Short-Term Precipitation Nowcasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01626)
*Zhuo Wang,Chaorong Li,Wenjie Luo,Chuanhu Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出QWRF-Net，一种基于量子-小波框架（结合整流流）的短期降水临近预报方法。核心思路是将潜在特征显式分解为小波子带，在分解后的潜在空间中进行差异化的量子启发式调制，再通过基于整流流的非自回归解码器生成未来序列。在KNMI雷达和SEVIR基准上验证了其在中等至高降水阈值、极端事件子集以及强降水核和精细尺度结构保持方面的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 短期降水临近预报对水文气象早期预警至关重要，但雷达降水场包含强耦合的多尺度结构，且预报质量在较长的提前时段会退化，难以在整个预警相关时间范围内保持强降水核及其空间组织。

Method: 1) 将潜在特征显式分解为小波子带（实现尺度解缠）；2) 在分解后的潜在空间中进行差异化的量子启发式调制（针对不同子带差异化处理）；3) 通过基于整流流的非自回归解码器生成未来序列（保证多步生成的稳定性）。

Result: 在KNMI雷达和SEVIR基准的统一评估协议下，QWRF-Net取得了较好的整体性能，在中高降水阈值、极端事件子集以及强降水核和精细结构保持方面有一致的增益。消融实验表明小波尺度解缠、差异化子带调制和流式生成提供了互补的收益。

Conclusion: 联合增强多尺度降水表征和稳定多步生成是面向预警的短期降水临近预报的有前景方向；所提出的改进可为下游水文和预警相关应用提供更有用的降水基础。

Abstract: Short-term precipitation nowcasting is important for hydrometeorological early warning, especially when intense convective rainfall may trigger urban flooding, flash floods, and other high-impact hazards. A key challenge in warning-oriented nowcasting is that radar precipitation fields contain strongly coupled multi-scale structures, while forecast quality often degrades at later lead times, making it difficult to preserve intense precipitation cores and their spatial organization over the full warning-relevant horizon. To address this problem, we propose QWRF-Net, a quantum-wavelet framework with rectified flow for short-term precipitation nowcasting. The core idea is to improve the conditional representation of precipitation by explicitly decomposing latent features into wavelet sub-bands and then performing differentiated quantum-inspired modulation in the decomposed latent space, before generating future sequences through a rectified-flow-based non-autoregressive decoder. Experiments on the KNMI radar and SEVIR benchmarks under a unified evaluation protocol show that QWRF-Net achieves favorable overall performance, with relatively consistent gains at medium-to-high precipitation thresholds, on an extreme-event subset, and in preserving intense precipitation cores and fine-scale structures. Ablation results further indicate that wavelet-based scale disentanglement, differentiated sub-band modulation, and flow-based generation provide complementary benefits within the proposed framework. Overall, these results suggest that jointly enhancing multi-scale precipitation representation and stable multi-step generation is a promising direction for warning-oriented short-term precipitation nowcasting. The observed improvements may also provide a more useful precipitation basis for downstream hydrological and warning-related applications.

</details>


### [340] [GraphIR: Architecture-Level Search States for LLM-Guided Neural Architecture Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01633)
*Zhen Liu,Wanqi Zhou,Shuanghao Bai,Yuhan Liu,Jinjun Wang,Jingwen Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GraphIR，一种架构感知的中间表示，弥补了大型语言模型（LLM）引导神经架构搜索（NAS）时，可执行代码与变异所需架构状态之间的表示鸿沟。GraphIR通过三个互补视图（计算骨架、变异表面、有效性包络）组织候选架构，并在NAS-Dependency基准和多个下游基准上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM可以直接在可执行神经网络程序上进行NAS，但代码级灵活性无法提供有效的架构状态用于变异操作——LLM必须从实现细节中推断张量依赖关系、可编辑组件和兼容性约束，导致表示不匹配问题。

Method: GraphIR是一种架构感知的中间表示，通过三个互补视图补充可执行程序：(1) 计算骨架——描述张量流；(2) 变异表面——暴露可编辑模块和操作；(3) 有效性包络——捕获接口契约、传播的形状和下游依赖关系。此外，作者构建了NAS-Dependency基准（120个问题，覆盖六个依赖推理维度）来评估方法。

Result: 在NAS-Dependency诊断中，GraphIR在识别精确生产者出现、追踪依赖传播以及诊断接口和失败风险方面特别有效。在包括CLRS在内的六个下游基准中，GraphIR实现了最佳的整体搜索性能，同时保持可比的模型大小和有利的端到端NAS效率（集成到OpenEvolve中）。

Conclusion: 结果表明，面向变异的架构状态为可执行神经程序与LLM引导的架构演化之间提供了有效接口，有效解决了代码级NAS中的表示不匹配问题。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) enable neural architecture search (NAS) directly over executable neural network programs. However, code-level flexibility does not provide the architecture state needed for effective mutation: LLMs must infer tensor dependencies, editable components, and compatibility constraints from implementation details. To address this representation mismatch, we propose GraphIR, an architecture-aware intermediate representation that supplements executable programs with a mutation-aligned candidate state. GraphIR organizes each candidate through three complementary views: a computation skeleton describing tensor flow, a mutation surface exposing editable modules and operations, and a validity envelope capturing interface contracts, propagated shapes, and downstream dependencies. To evaluate our method, we construct NAS-Dependency, a 120-question benchmark covering six complementary dependency-reasoning dimensions. The diagnostic shows that GraphIR is particularly effective at identifying exact producer occurrences, tracing dependency propagation, and diagnosing interface and failure risks. Across six downstream benchmarks including CLRS, GraphIR achieves the best overall search performance while maintaining comparable model size and favorable end-to-end NAS efficiency when integrated into OpenEvolve. These results show that a mutation-oriented architecture state provides an effective interface between executable neural programs and LLM-guided architecture evolution.

</details>


### [341] [Evaluating Forecasting Techniques for Hardware Errors on a Large-scale HPC System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01648)
*Kaiyuan Liao,Xiwei Xuan,Tanwi Mallick,Kevin Brown,Christopher D. Carothers,Kwan-Liu Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究利用Theta超级计算机七年的生产日志，系统评估了经典统计模型和深度学习模型在HPC硬件错误时序预测中的有效性。研究发现预测效果高度依赖于错误序列的时间结构：规则且结构稳定的错误可被LSTM和Transformer等模型准确预测，而稀疏和突发型错误难以预测。该研究并非提出部署方案，而是为HPC硬件错误预测提供了实证经验和改进方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HPC系统中的硬件错误日志虽能提供早期异常信号，但利用现代预测方法有效预测这些错误仍存在挑战。作者希望探索时间序列预测方法在HPC硬件错误动态分析中的适用边界，回答"何时预测有效、何时无效"这一关键问题。

Method: 使用Theta超级计算机七年的生产日志数据，对比评估经典统计模型与深度学习模型（包括LSTM和Transformer架构）在硬件错误时间序列预测中的表现，并引入时间特征来提升预测效果。

Result: 预测有效性高度依赖错误序列的时间结构：规则出现且结构稳定的错误可以被准确建模，尤其LSTM和Transformer结合时间特征表现优异；而稀疏且突发的错误则难以预测。

Conclusion: 本文不追求提供可直接部署的故障预测框架，而是提供实证指导，说明在什么条件下时序预测对HPC硬件错误有效，并指出提升预测精度的潜在研究方向。

Abstract: Hardware error logs in high-performance computing (HPC) systems provide early signals of abnormal behavior, yet there remain challenges in effectively forecasting these errors using modern predictive methods. This work investigates the boundaries of applying time series forecasting to HPC hardware error dynamics. We use seven years of production logs from the Theta supercomputer to evaluate the predictive efficacy of classical statistical and deep learning models. Our results show that forecasting effectiveness depends strongly on the temporal structure of the error series: regularly occurring and structurally stable errors can be modeled accurately, particularly by LSTM and Transformer architectures with temporal features, while sparse and burst-dominated errors remain difficult to predict. Rather than proposing a deployment-ready failure prediction framework, this study provides empirical guidance on when forecasting is effective and highlights potential directions for improving forecasting accuracy in HPC hardware error analysis.

</details>


### [342] [Sharp Root Anti-Concentration via Projective Incidence and Ordered Root Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01670)
*Zijun Wang,Yuchen Miao,Yifan Hu,Huanmin Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文解决了Balcan、Pegden和Sharma提出的关于分段Lipschitz函数在线优化的一维局部根反集中问题。对于齐次特征曲线，证明了最坏情况区间命中常数等于A乘以截面平均射影入射速度，消除了之前的√N损失；对于首一d次多项式，证明了区间命中常数有限的充要条件，并给出了两个图学习应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在在线优化分段Lipschitz函数的背景下，需要理解函数在区间上的"反集中"性质（即根不会过于集中在某一区间），这对于刻画遗憾界至关重要。Balcan等人此前提出了一维局部根反集中问题，但存在√N因子损失，本文旨在给出锐利的、维度无关的刻画。

Method: 本文结合了多种技术：(1) 利用截面平均射影入射速度描述区间命中常数；(2) 建立了条件与联合系数空间面积公式；(3) 引入两图证书（two-chart certificate）来处理依赖和奇异系数分布；(4) 利用射影入射定理和有序根刚体平移来分析多项式核模型。

Result: 对于齐次特征曲线，区间命中常数等于A乘以截面平均射影入射速度，且对立方体支撑系数等价（至多相差普适常数）于射影Lipschitz常数，获得锐利的维度无关刻画。对于首一d次多项式，证明区间命中常数有限的充要条件是有序实根分布具有有界密度，且因子d的比较是锐利的。两个应用分别实现~O((An²De^{BD}/ℓ+1)√T)和~O((qn²κ+1)√T)期望遗憾。

Conclusion: 本文给出了分段Lipschitz函数在线优化中根反集中问题的完整、锐利的刻画，消除了之前的√N损失，提供了可验证的判据，并通过两个图学习应用完成了向遗憾界的完整推导链，即使在系数分布奇异的场景下也能获得次线性遗憾。

Abstract: This paper answers the one-dimensional local root anti-concentration questions posed by Balcan, Pegden, and Sharma in the context of online optimization of piecewise-Lipschitz functions. For a homogeneous feature curve and coefficients whose density relative to the uniform law on a symmetric convex body $K$ is bounded by $A$, we show that the worst-case interval-hitting constant equals $A$ times a section-averaged projective incidence speed. For cube-supported coefficients, this speed is equivalent, up to universal constants, to the projective Lipschitz constant. This yields a sharp, dimension-free characterization and removes the previous $\sqrt N$ loss. For monic degree-$d$ polynomials under arbitrary coefficient laws, we prove that the interval-hitting constant is finite if and only if the ordered real-root laws have bounded densities, with a factor-$d$ comparison that is sharp. Conditional and joint coefficient-space area formulas, together with a two-chart certificate, make this criterion verifiable for dependent and singular coefficient laws. We also give two graph-learning applications that complete the transition-to-regret chain. A cost-sensitive Gaussian-RBF harmonic classifier uses the projective incidence theorem and achieves expected regret $\widetilde O((An^2D e^{BD}/\ell+1)\sqrt T)$. A common-offset polynomial-kernel model uses rigid translation of the ordered roots and achieves $\widetilde O((qn^2κ+1)\sqrt T)$ regret, even when the induced coefficient law is singular in the ambient coefficient space.

</details>


### [343] [Progressive Agent Skill Generation via Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01678)
*Junhao Shen,Zhanqiu Zhang,Yiwen Guo,Hong Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Skill-α是一种基于强化学习的智能体技能生成方法，通过将技能构建分解为可单独评估的顺序编辑过程，并引入回滚奖励（rollback reward）来评估每个编辑对下游任务执行的影响，从而从异构数据源生成高质量技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能生成方法依赖启发式规则或流水线式整合，需要针对不同证据源专门设计，缺乏统一性。学习式方法虽有统一建模优势，但技能缺乏基于相关性或正确性的自然监督信号，其价值只能通过下游任务表现来体现，这给训练带来了挑战。

Method: 1) 将技能生成建模为顺序编辑过程，将技能构建分解为可单独评估的编辑步骤；2) 引入新颖的回滚奖励机制，通过在锚定查询（anchored query）上比较原始技能和编辑后技能的下游执行结果来评估每个编辑的价值。

Result: 在文档到技能和经验到技能两种设置下均优于启发式或流水线方法。以GPT-4o为主worker时，在CL-Bench上比最强基线平均提高3.3个百分点，在tau2-bench上提高6.7个百分点。消融实验验证了回滚奖励和渐进式生成的重要性。

Conclusion: Skill-α通过强化学习实现了统一的、跨异构来源的技能生成框架，回滚奖励和渐进式生成是提升技能质量的关键组件，为学习式技能生成提供了有效的新范式。

Abstract: Existing skill generation methods largely rely on heuristics or pipeline-style consolidation, which must be specially designed for different evidence sources. In contrast, learning-based approaches offer a more unified way to model skill generation across heterogeneous sources. However, learning-based skill generation remains challenging because skills lack a natural supervision signal based on relevance or correctness; their value can largely be determined only by whether they improve the behavior of the agent on downstream tasks. To address this challenge, we propose Skill-$α$, a reinforcement learning method for progressively generating high-quality agent skills. Specifically, we formulate skill generation as a sequential editing process that decomposes skill construction into individually evaluable edits, and introduce a novel rollback reward that evaluates each edit by comparing downstream execution under the original and edited skills on an anchored query. Extensive experiments show that Skill-$α$ generates more effective skills than methods based on heuristics or pipelines in both document-to-skill and experience-to-skill settings. Under the main GPT-4o worker, Skill-$α$ improves average downstream success rates over the strongest skill-generation baseline by 3.3 points on CL-Bench and 6.7 points on tau2-bench. Further ablations validate the importance of rollback reward and progressive generation.

</details>


### [344] [Beckmann Transport Models: From Autonomous Flows to One-Step Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01692)
*Lee Cheuk-Kit,Florentin Coeurdoux,Peter Potaptchik,Yilun Du,Michael Samuel Albergo,Eric Vanden-Eijnden*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于自治流（时间无关速度场）的流匹配方法，能够精确地在两个分布之间映射，前提是目标分布为奇异分布（支持在低维数据流形上）。该方法还表明该流对应的一步生成映射是某个简单守恒方程的唯一解，可直接从样本中学习。这一框架统一了诸如泊松流生成模型和均衡匹配等方法，并在ImageNet 256x256上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流匹配方法通常依赖时间依赖的速度场，而作者希望探索自治流（时间无关速度场）是否也能实现分布间的精确映射，并为此类映射提供统一的动力学解释和学习框架，同时纠正现有方法中的不一致性。

Method: 作者提出了自治流匹配实例化方法，核心思想是利用时间无关的速度场在奇异分布（低维数据流形）上精确映射两个分布。同时证明了一步生成映射是某个守恒方程的唯一解，并可直接从样本中学习该映射。该框架为Beckmann运输问题中的通量约束赋予了动力学意义，并统一了泊松流生成模型和均衡匹配等方法（后者使用二次流匹配回归损失）。

Result: 在ImageNet 256x256数据集上验证了自治流和一步映射方法的有效性，展示了该理论框架的实际生成性能。

Conclusion: 自治流为分布映射提供了一种新颖的统一理论框架，能够纠正现有方法的理论不一致性，并展现出在高质量图像生成上的实际能力。

Abstract: We propose an instantiation of flow matching that relies on a time-independent velocity field (an \emph{autonomous flow}) to exactly map between two distributions, so long as the target is singular, i.e.\ supported on a lower-dimensional data manifold. We also show that the one-step generative map associated with this flow is the unique solution of a simple conservation equation, which can be used to learn the map directly from samples. These autonomous flows and maps give a dynamical meaning to the flux constraint of Beckmann's transportation problem. Their construction provides a unifying framework that recovers, for instance, the closed-form Poisson-flow generative model and equilibrium matching with a quadratic flow-matching regression loss. We illustrate how this theory corrects inconsistencies in existing methods and demonstrate the effectiveness of the autonomous flow and the one-step map on ImageNet 256x256.

</details>


### [345] [Beyond On-Policy Exploration: Integrating External Policy Rollouts for Reinforcement Learning in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01717)
*Wonseok Lee,Jimyeong Kim,Jungmin Ko,Wonjong Rhee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ERILS方法，通过将更强外部策略产生的高奖励rollout与目标dLLM的on-policy rollout相结合，并引入长度控制和来源分离的奖励处理机制，以解决on-policy训练在正奖励稀缺时的进步缓慢问题。在Sudoku、Countdown和MATH500上的实验表明ERILS显著提升了多采样性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）的强化学习方法通常依赖目标模型自身产生的on-policy rollouts，但当高奖励rollout稀缺时，on-policy训练获得的正面奖励很少，学习进步有限。为此，作者探索引入由更强外部策略生成的更高奖励rollout来辅助训练，以缓解这一问题。

Method: 提出ERILS（External Rollout Integration with Length Control and Source-Specific Processing），包含两个关键设计：(1) 长度控制——对外部rollout的长度进行约束，解决on-policy与外部rollout长度差异的问题；(2) 来源特定奖励处理——将on-policy和外部rollout的奖励分开处理，避免联合处理时产生的不稳定性。

Result: 在Sudoku、Countdown和MATH500上以零样本评估，ERILS在三个任务上均提升了多采样性能，其中Sudoku提升最大：best-of-4完成准确率达98.4%，而最强基线仅为40.3%。同时，ERILS在Sudoku上于128、256、512 token生成长度下均保持约90%的确定性单次完成准确率。组件分析表明，长度控制的外部rollout更有效，且来源特定奖励处理避免了联合奖励处理导致的训练崩溃。

Conclusion: 实验结果证明，在将外部rollout整合进dLLM强化学习时，rollout构建和奖励处理是两个重要的设计维度。ERILS通过长度控制和来源特定奖励处理有效提升了训练效果，为dLLM强化学习提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Recent reinforcement learning methods for diffusion large language models (dLLMs) commonly rely on on-policy rollouts generated by the target dLLM itself. When successful on-policy rollouts are scarce, however, on-policy training may receive little positive reward and make only limited progress. To mitigate this problem, we explore incorporating higher-reward rollouts generated by a stronger external policy alongside on-policy rollouts from the target dLLM. However, directly incorporating these external rollouts introduces two practical challenges: differences in rollout length and instability when jointly processing rewards from on-policy and external rollouts. To address these challenges, we propose External Rollout Integration with Length Control and Source-Specific Processing (ERILS), which controls external-rollout length and processes the rewards of on-policy and external rollouts separately. Experiments on Sudoku, Countdown, and MATH500 under zero-shot evaluation show that ERILS improves multi-sample performance across all three tasks, with the largest gains on Sudoku. On Sudoku, ERILS achieves 98.4% best-of-4 completion accuracy, compared with 40.3% for the strongest baseline. ERILS also maintains approximately 90% deterministic single-completion accuracy on Sudoku across generation lengths of 128, 256, and 512 tokens. Our component analysis further shows that length-controlled external rollouts are more effective than uncontrolled external rollouts, and that source-specific reward processing avoids the training collapse observed with joint reward processing. These results show that rollout construction and reward processing are important design dimensions when integrating external rollouts into dLLM reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [346] [LLM-Guided Retrieval for Prediction of Molecular Perturbation Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01734)
*Betty Xiong,Jan-Christian Huetter,Gabriele Scalia,Tommaso Biancalani,Sepideh Maleki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LLM-Guided Retrieval (LGR)方法，利用大语言模型对药物进行检索排序，然后聚合少量生物相关化合物的已知响应来预测未测量药物在细胞系中的转录组响应，在Tahoe-100M单细胞扰动图谱上验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测小分子扰动对转录组响应是药物发现的核心问题，但穷举测量所有药物-细胞组合不可行。现有方法（如ChemCPA）依赖复杂的预测模型，但检索质量可能比预测器复杂度更重要。作者希望探索一种更简洁的检索-聚合范式，并利用LLM作为生物先验知识源。

Method: 将分子扰动预测建模为"检索-聚合"任务：1) 使用LLM对候选邻居药物进行排序（限于目标细胞系中已有测量数据的药物）；2) 选定少量相关化合物后，使用固定的均值聚合器（mean aggregator）将它们观察到的表达变化（expression deltas）组合起来形成预测。在Tahoe-100M单细胞扰动图谱上评估了三种场景：未见药物、未见细胞系、开放世界。

Result: LGR在三种评估场景下均优于药物均值、ChemCPA和基于化学结构的kNN基线。最强增益出现在未见细胞系泛化场景，取得了更高的相关性和更低的误差。在方向（符号）准确性方面，LGR在所有设置下都改善了对基因调控方向的预测，表明即使基于幅度的指标相似时，也能更好地恢复生物学上有意义的扰动效应。

Conclusion: 检索质量而非预测器复杂度是零样本分子扰动预测的关键驱动因素。LLM在作为受约束的检索模块时可以提供有用的生物学先验，为药物响应预测提供了更高效、可解释的新范式。

Abstract: Predicting transcriptomic responses to small-molecule perturbations across cell lines is central to drug discovery, but exhaustive profiling of drug-cell combinations is infeasible. We frame molecular perturbation prediction as retrieve-and-aggregate: approximate an unmeasured drug's response in a cell line by aggregating measured responses of a small set of biologically related compounds. We propose LLM-Guided Retrieval (LGR), where a large language model (LLM) ranks candidate neighbor drugs (restricted to those profiled in the target cell line); after which a fixed mean aggregator combines their observed expression deltas to form the prediction. We evaluate on the Tahoe-100M single-cell perturbation atlas under unseen-drug, unseen-cell-line, and open-world regimes. LGR consistently improves over drug mean, ChemCPA, and chemistry-based kNN baselines, with the strongest gains for unseen cell-line generalization, where it achieves higher correlation and lower error than mean baselines. Across settings, LGR improves directional (sign) accuracy of gene regulation, indicating better recovery of biologically meaningful perturbation effects even when magnitude-based metrics are similar. These results suggest that retrieval quality, rather than predictor complexity, is a key driver of zero-shot molecular perturbation prediction, and that LLMs can provide a useful biological prior when used as constrained retrieval modules.

</details>


### [347] [Disagree to Accelerate: Closing the Loop on Diffusion Feature Forecasts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01740)
*Yanchao Li,Jiaqing Xie,Ben Gao,Wanhao Liu,Yanbo Wang,T. Y. Tsui,Jinfei Liu,Yuqiang Li,Tianfan Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RACER，一种无需训练的闭环控制器，通过利用特征预测之间的分歧信号作为实时可靠性指标，自适应地缩小不可靠预测并动态刷新特征，从而加速扩散模型采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有免训练特征预测方法主要聚焦于设计更强的预测器，但忽略了预测误差在不同去噪步骤间差异巨大，且开环缓存无条件信任每个跳跃步骤的预测。当加速变得激进时，这种固定信任机制导致质量下降。核心问题是不仅要知道如何更好地预测，还要知道何时以及多大程度信任预测。

Method: RACER提出两个关键见解：(1) 从缓存本身可以观测预测可靠性——两个预测在特征轨迹平滑处一致、在预测困难处分歧，分歧可作为一个零额外代价的实时信号；(2) 基于该信号，RACER作为闭环控制器执行两种响应：持续将不确定的预测向最后计算的特征收缩（shrinkage），并在风险最高的步骤刷新特征，同时通过跳过后续计划步骤来补偿额外计算。作者还推导了收缩的确定性误差界。

Result: 在相同去噪评估次数下，RACER在SD3.5-Large、FLUX.1-dev、Wan2.1-14B和HunyuanVideo上优于最强开环基线，评测基准涵盖DrawBench、VBench和COCO。在SD3.5上还实现了同等质量下更快的采样速度。RACER对多种预测设计具有泛化能力，例如在Taylor基线上恢复了大量质量损失。

Conclusion: 可靠的扩散加速不仅取决于预测器的强度，也取决于预测结果的使用策略。通过无监督的、零额外代价的可靠性信号实现闭环保真控制，RACER展示了在激进加速下保持质量的可行性，为扩散采样加速提供了新思路。

Abstract: Training-free feature forecasting accelerates diffusion sampling by predicting features at skipped denoising steps. Recent work has mainly focused on designing stronger forecasters. Yet forecast error varies sharply across steps, and open-loop caches trust the forecast in full at every skipped step. This fixed trust is what breaks as acceleration turns aggressive. The missing question is not only how to forecast better, but when and how much to trust a forecast. We show that reliability can be observed from the cache itself. Two forecasts agree where the feature trajectory is smooth, and they diverge where prediction turns hard. Their disagreement is a cheap runtime signal, and it costs no extra denoiser evaluation. Based on this signal, we introduce RACER, a training-free closed-loop controller with two responses. It continuously shrinks uncertain forecasts toward the last computed feature. At the riskiest steps, RACER refreshes the feature and repays the added evaluation by skipping a later scheduled one. We derive a deterministic error bound for the shrinkage and empirically evaluate its validity and tightness across acceleration regimes. At the same number of denoiser evaluations, RACER improves the strongest open-loop baseline across SD3.5-Large, FLUX.1-dev, Wan2.1-14B, and HunyuanVideo on DrawBench, VBench, and COCO. On SD3.5, we further show that RACER samples faster at equal quality. RACER generalizes across forecasting designs as well. For example, it recovers much of the quality lost on a Taylor base. These results show that reliable diffusion acceleration also depends on how forecasts are used. Code is available at https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/RACER

</details>


### [348] [Toward Plasticity-Preserving KL Regularization for Capability Retention in LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01743)
*Li Wang,Xiaodong Lu,Xiaohan Wang,Jiajun Chai,Wei Lin,Tianhao Peng,Guojun Yin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出正确性条件KL正则化（CoKL），将传统全策略KL正则化的约束范围从完整输出分布收窄到正确性条件分布，从而在保留基座模型已有能力的同时最小化对新任务学习的干扰。CoKL在前向KL散度下实现了对正确响应相对概率分配的精细正则化，并在理论上证明其优于全策略前向/反向KL正则化（后者在参考策略不完美时会导致严格的最优正确性差距）。实验验证了CoKL在目标任务提升与既有能力保留之间取得更优平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM后训练中，强化学习优化新目标可能导致基座模型已有能力退化。传统全策略KL正则化约束整个响应分布，过度限制探索空间和目标任务学习，需要更精确的约束机制以在保留既有能力与学习新任务之间取得平衡。

Method: CoKL将正则化约束从完整输出分布收窄为正确性条件响应分布。具体地，在总体层面将正确响应的总概率与其正确性条件分布解耦，仅正则化参考模型支持的正确响应之间的相对概率分配，而不直接锚定错误输出或总正确性质量。实例化采用前向KL散度，并推导出实用的有限组训练目标。

Result: 理论分析表明，当参考策略不完美时，全策略前向和反向KL正则化都会产生严格的最优正确性差距，而CoKL避免了这一局限。在受控多解环境和多模型规模的持续后训练设置中，CoKL在目标任务提升与既有能力保留之间取得了比现有正则化方法更好的平衡。

Conclusion: CoKL通过条件化正则化设计，提供了一种更精细的能力保留机制，在理论上避免了全策略KL正则化的固有局限，并在实验中验证了其有效性，为RL-based LLM后训练中的灾害性遗忘问题提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a central paradigm for large language model (LLM) post-training, but optimization toward new objectives can degrade capabilities already present in the base model. KL regularization is widely used to mitigate such forgetting by constraining policy drift toward a reference model. However, standard full-policy KL regularization constrains the entire response distribution and may unnecessarily restrict exploration and target-task learning. This raises a natural question: can a more precise constraint preserve existing capabilities while minimizing interference with learning new tasks? To this end, we propose \underline{Co}rrectness-Conditioned \underline{KL} Regularization (CoKL), a conditional regularization framework that narrows the preservation constraint from the full output distribution to correctness-conditioned response distributions. We instantiate CoKL with forward KL divergence and derive a practical finite-group training objective for RL-based LLM post-training. At the population level, CoKL decouples the total probability assigned to correct responses from their correctness-conditioned distribution, thereby regularizing the relative probability allocation among reference-supported correct responses without directly anchoring incorrect outputs or total correctness mass. We further show that full-policy forward and reverse KL regularization induce a strict optimal correctness gap when the reference policy is imperfect, whereas CoKL avoids this limitation. Experiments in controlled multi-solution environments and continual post-training settings across multiple model scales demonstrate that CoKL achieves a more favorable balance between target-task improvement and prior-capability retention than existing regularization methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lumina04/CoKL.

</details>


### [349] [Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Radio Resource Management under Coupled Finite-Horizon Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01745)
*Yeonseo Jeong,Wonhyeok Ko,Sungweon Hong,Songnam Hong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HeLyMARL，一种基于Lyapunov的异构多智能体强化学习框架，通过在虚拟队列中内化能量和切换预算约束，将受约束的有限时域问题转化为无约束的MARL问题，从而在密集无线网络中联合优化用户关联、调度、基站激活和切换控制，实现吞吐量与公平性的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在密集无线网络中，联合管理用户关联、调度、基站激活和切换控制需要同时满足有限时域的能量与切换预算约束，这带来了基站侧能量管理与用户侧切换调控之间的根本矛盾。现有MARL方法面临两大困难：有限时域预算约束无法在每个时隙直接评估，且非线性比例公平效用缺乏原则性的逐时隙分解方法。

Method: HeLyMARL采用Lyapunov嵌入的异构MARL框架，通过漂移加惩罚（drift-plus-penalty）分解和虚拟队列技术，将能量和切换约束压力直接内化到统一的逐时隙奖励中，把受约束的有限时域问题转化为无约束的MARL问题。

Result: 仿真表明HeLyMARL是唯一能在整个时域内同时维持吞吐量-公平性平衡和连续服务的算法，优于传统MARL、基于Lyapunov的方法以及受约束的MARL基线，且不会过早耗尽预算。相比拉格朗日方法，HeLyMARL的虚拟队列能在每个部分时域内限制累计预算消耗，提供了超越贪婪Lyapunov控制的节奏保证。

Conclusion: HeLyMARL通过虚拟队列机制解决了有限时域约束在MARL中的评估难题，实现了密集无线网络中吞吐量、公平性与服务连续性三者兼顾的最优性能，展示了Lyapunov方法嵌入MARL的有效性。

Abstract: Maximizing throughput under proportional fairness in dense wireless networks requires jointly managing user association, scheduling, base station (BS) activation, and handover control under hard finite-horizon energy and handover budgets, which induces a fundamental tension between BS-side energy management and user-side handover regulation. While multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is a natural framework for such distributed sequential control, its application here faces two difficulties: finite-horizon budget constraints cannot be evaluated at each time slot, and the nonlinear proportional fairness utility admits no principled per-slot decomposition. We propose HeLyMARL, a Lyapunov-embedded heterogeneous MARL framework that resolves both via drift-plus-penalty decomposition with virtual queues. The energy and handover constraint pressures are internalized directly into a unified per-slot reward, converting the constrained finite-horizon problem into an unconstrained MARL problem. Comparison against two Lagrangian-based alternatives reveals a timescale separation: Lagrangian relaxation regulates constraints only across training episodes, whereas the virtual queues of HeLyMARL bound cumulative budget consumption at every partial horizon within an episode, a pacing guarantee beyond the reach of greedy Lyapunov-based control. Simulations show that HeLyMARL is the only method that sustains the throughput-fairness balance together with uninterrupted service throughout the horizon, outperforming conventional MARL, Lyapunov-based, and constrained MARL benchmarks without premature budget exhaustion.

</details>


### [350] [Multi-Source Dynamic Graph Learning for Compound-Flood Forecasting in Managed Coastal Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01775)
*Liangjun You,Min Wu,Orlando Woods,Dongsheng Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种锚定式洪水预报框架，通过状态和超前时间依赖的有界残差修正，融合跨站点水文气象与运行管理信号，在保持局部时序预报稳定性的同时，改善持续高水位平台的预测可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复合洪水事件受多站点水文条件和水利调度共同影响，现有模型虽全局误差低，但可能掩盖长时间高水位平台期的预报不准问题；单站点记录无法完整表征高水位动态，而盲目融合跨站点信号又会破坏局部时序预测的稳定性。

Method: 提出锚定式预报框架：以局部时序预报为稳定锚点，引入状态依赖和超前时间依赖的有界残差修正；通过多源体制表征（水文气象与运行观测）自适应地校准站点间关系与修正尺度，实现有选择性的跨站点调整。

Result: 实验表明，选择性集成多站点动态条件能改善持续高水位平台的预测可靠性，同时保持常规水文条件下的高精度。

Conclusion: 该框架可有效支撑洪水预警和水管理决策支持，解决了跨站点信息融合与局部预测稳定性之间的平衡问题，并以事件尺度高水位过程的时间对齐作为超越全局误差统计的评估手段。

Abstract: Compound flooding in managed coastal systems is influenced by hydrological conditions and water-management activity observed across multiple monitoring stations. Current forecasting models can capture temporal dependencies with low average errors, but global error metrics may conceal poor reproduction of prolonged high-water plateaus that are relevant to flood early warning. Because hydrometeorological and operational signals are distributed across heterogeneous gages, single-site records do not fully represent high-water dynamics. Nevertheless, unconstrained fusion of cross-site signals can degrade the stability of local temporal forecasts. This work proposes an anchored forecasting framework that incorporates cross-site information through state- and lead-dependent bounded residual corrections. A multi-source regime representation constructed from hydrometeorological and operational observations adaptively calibrates inter-site relationships and correction scales, enabling targeted cross-site adjustment while preserving the local temporal forecast as a stable anchor. Beyond conventional global error statistics, we evaluate event-scale high-water characteristics through the temporal alignment of forecasted and observed high-water processes. Experiments demonstrate that selectively integrating multi-station dynamic conditions improves the prediction reliability of sustained high-water plateaus while maintaining high accuracy during routine hydrological conditions, supporting flood early warning and water-management decision support.

</details>


### [351] [ReFP-AD: Rectified Flow Preconditioning for Energy-Based Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01793)
*Camile Lendering,Erkut Akdag,Joaquín Figueira,Egor Bondarev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReFP-AD提出了一种基于几何重参数化的统一异常检测方法，通过最优传输耦合的整流流（Rectified Flow）将高维DINOv2嵌入映射到良态（well-conditioned）的潜在空间，实现稳定的持续对比散度训练和预条件随机梯度Langevin动力学（SGLD）采样，最终利用学习的能量景观中的梯度范数进行异常评分，在MVTec-AD和VisA数据集上取得了显著优于现有统一EBM基线的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一异常检测需要建模高度异质的正常数据且无法访问异常样本。虽然DINOv2等基础模型提供了丰富的token表示，但在这些高维token空间中直接进行显式密度估计（如EBM）面临不稳定问题——各向异性（anisotropy）和强跨维度相关性导致有限步MCMC采样退化，作者识别出这一不稳定性本质上是几何问题。

Method: ReFP-AD的核心是学习一个几何重参数化映射，通过最优传输（OT）耦合的整流流将高维嵌入映射到良态的潜在空间。这种预条件化使全维度token空间中的持续对比散度（persistent contrastive divergence）配合预条件SGLD能够稳定训练。异常分数通过学习的能量景观中的梯度范数推导。

Result: 在MVTec-AD上实现98.6%图像AUROC和97.9%像素AUROC，在VisA上实现97.3%图像AUROC和99.0%像素AUROC，相比之前的统一EBM基线在图像AUROC上最高提升+10.8%。消融实验证明几何重参数化对有限步MCMC和高维token空间中的精确异常定位至关重要。

Conclusion: ReFP-AD验证了几何预条件化是解决高维token空间中EBM训练不稳定的关键，通过OT耦合整流流实现了稳定而有效的统一异常检测，代码已开源。

Abstract: Unified anomaly detection requires modeling highly heterogeneous normal data without access to anomalous samples. While foundation models like DINOv2 provide rich token representations, leveraging these spaces for explicit density estimation remains challenging. Energy-Based Models (EBMs) offer a principled formulation, but their training in high-dimensional token spaces is unstable due to anisotropy and strong cross-dimensional correlations, which degrades finite-step Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling. We identify this instability as fundamentally geometric and introduce ReFP-AD (Rectified Flow Preconditioning for Anomaly Detection), which learns a geometric reparameterization that maps high-dimensional embeddings into a well-conditioned latent space via an optimal transport (OT)-coupled rectified flow. This preconditioning enables stable persistent contrastive divergence with preconditioned Stochastic Gradient Langevin Dynamics (SGLD) in full-dimensional token spaces. Anomaly scores are then derived from the learned energy landscape using gradient norms. Under a strict unified protocol on the MVTec-AD and VisA datasets, ReFP-AD achieves 98.6%/97.9% Image/Pixel AUROC on MVTec-AD and 97.3%/99.0% on VisA, outperforming prior unified EBM baselines by up to +10.8% in Image AUROC. Ablation experiments demonstrate that geometric reparameterization is critical for finite-step MCMC and accurate anomaly localization in high-dimensional token spaces. Code is available at https://github.com/CLendering/ReFP-AD

</details>


### [352] [LEAP: Lean Environment-Feedback via Adaptive Pruning for Code RL in GPU Kernel Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01804)
*Tankun Li,Zhi Chen,Yaohua Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LEAP是一个面向低层系统编程（如CUDA内核生成）的可扩展多轮强化学习框架，通过Difficulty-Conditioned Pruning动态门控机制剪枝简单和灾难性任务，并采用Rank-Based Reward在GRPO rollout组内通过成对锦标赛结果派生无尺度相对优势，在提升首轮熟练度和多轮调试鲁棒性的同时加速收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的无评论家RL框架（如GRPO）在代码生成领域表现出色，但直接应用到低层系统编程（如CUDA内核生成）时面临严峻挑战：二元通过/失败奖励导致严重信号稀疏性，多轮环境反馈循环存在编译延迟高和跨轨迹奖励稀释的问题，亟需一种能高效利用计算资源的自适应框架。

Method: LEAP包含两个核心组件：(1) Difficulty-Conditioned Pruning (DCP)——一个动态门控机制，自适应地将简单任务和过度灾难性任务从多轮扩展中剪枝，将高成本的编译和硬件探索资源集中在高价值复杂任务上；(2) Rank-Based Reward——通过GRPO rollout组内成对锦标赛结果派生无尺度相对优势，在简单提示上内在惩罚token低效，同时在困难分布上最大化学习梯度，无需手动超参数工程。

Result: 实证评估显示LEAP在首轮熟练度和多轮调试鲁棒性上均表现优越，同时比未剪枝的多轮基线收敛更快，为低层代码RL建立了实用的范式。

Conclusion: LEAP验证了自适应任务剪枝和基于排名的奖励设计能够有效解决低层硬件加速器对齐中RL训练的信号稀疏和计算瓶颈问题，为低层系统编程的RL应用提供了可扩展的实用方案。

Abstract: Post-training large language models (LLMs) via reinforcement learning (RL) has significantly advanced code generation capabilities. To bypass the heavy memory footprint of critic networks, current state-of-the-art frameworks leverage critic-free paradigms like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) tied to rule-based verification sandboxes. However, applying these frameworks to low-level systems programming, such as CUDA kernel generation-presents severe challenges: binary pass/fail rewards introduce severe signal sparsity, while multi-turn environmental feedback loops suffer from prohibitive compilation latencies and reward dilution across trajectories. In this work, we introduce LEAP (Lean Environment-Feedback via Adaptive Pruning), a scalable and computationally efficient multi-turn RL framework optimized for low-level hardware accelerator alignment. LEAP features Difficulty-Conditioned Pruning (DCP), a dynamic gating mechanism that adaptively cuts off simple and overly catastrophic tasks from multi-turn expansion, focusing resource-heavy compilation and hardware exploration exclusively on high-value, complex tasks. To fully operationalize these paths without manual hyperparameter engineering, we propose a Rank-Based Reward formulation. By deriving scale-free relative advantages from pairwise tournament outcomes within the GRPO rollout group, our method inherently penalizes token inefficiency on simple prompts while maximizing learning gradients on challenging distributions. Empirical evaluations show that LEAP achieves superior first-turn proficiency and robust multi-turn debugging resilience while converging faster than unpruned multi-turn baselines, establishing a practical paradigm for low-level code RL.

</details>


### [353] [tFUSOperator: Operator Learning for Transcranial Focused Ultrasound Digital Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01839)
*Minjee Seo,Haris Ghafoor,Minju Seol,Seonaeng Cho,Kyungho Yoon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出tFUSOperator，一种基于坐标感知神经算子（coordinate-aware neural operator）的经颅聚焦超声（tFUS）颅内声场预测方法。它将tFUS仿真建模为算子学习问题，将自由场压力、颅骨解剖和治疗参数映射到共享物理坐标系中的颅内场，在已见和未见颅骨上分别达到约90%和72%的Dice分数，较数值仿真快约5.6×10⁴倍，且可从MR或CT输入获得相近性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: tFUS治疗需要准确估计被颅骨畸变干扰的颅内声场。数值求解器精度高但计算昂贵，难以用于需反复重估声场的数字孪生场景；现有深度学习代理方法虽快，但采用固定网格的体素到体素回归，缺乏声能传播机制的表征。因此需要一种既能建模声传播物理规律又计算高效的预测方法。

Method: 将tFUS仿真建模为算子学习问题，提出tFUSOperator——一种坐标感知的神经算子，在共享物理坐标框架内，将自由场压力、颅骨解剖结构和治疗参数映射为颅内声场。该方法利用算子学习天然的空间传播机制，结合坐标感知实现物理约束。

Result: 在已见颅骨上声聚焦定位Dice约达90%，未见颅骨上约72%；从MR输入与CT输入性能接近；运行速度比数值仿真快5.6×10⁴倍。

Conclusion: tFUSOperator提供了一条快速、无辐射的路径，可实现个体化tFUS治疗的安全实用的数字孪生系统，代码已开源。

Abstract: Transcranial focused ultrasound (tFUS) requires accurate estimation of the intracranial acoustic field, which is distorted by skull-induced aberrations. Numerical solvers are accurate but computationally expensive for digital twins, where the field must be re-estimated repeatedly as treatment conditions change. Existing deep-learning surrogates are fast but typically use voxel-to-voxel regression on a fixed grid, with no mechanism reflecting how acoustic energy propagates through the skull. We instead cast tFUS simulation as an operator learning problem and propose tFUSOperator, a coordinate-aware neural operator that maps the free-field pressure, skull anatomy, and treatment parameters to the intracranial field within a shared physical coordinate frame. To our knowledge, this is the first operator-based formulation of tFUS field prediction. On both seen and unseen skulls, the model localizes the acoustic focus accurately-reaching about 90% and 72% Dice, respectively-and it performs nearly as well from magnetic resonance (MR) as from computed tomography (CT) input while running $5.6 \times 10^4$ times faster than numerical simulation. These results suggest a fast, radiation-free route to safe and practical digital twins for patient-specific tFUS treatment. The code is available at: https://github.com/CMME-Lab/tFUSOperator.git.

</details>


### [354] [WorldDynCache: Risk-Controlled Latent Dynamics Approximation for Diffusion World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01845)
*Leyang Chen,Junyi Wu,Shaoqiu Zhang,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了WorldDynCache，一种风险可控的潜在动力学近似框架，用于加速扩散世界模型的推理。通过轻量级潜在转变风险估计器和条件/相位感知的提升潜在代理，在HunyuanVoyager-13B和Aether-5B上分别实现4.92倍和2.15倍加速，同时保持最优的生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散世界模型能生成高质量的未来帧，但重复的Transformer评估导致推理速度极慢。现有缓存方法虽能重用中间特征或选择性更新token，但可能遗漏两类问题：(1)近似引起的潜在转变缺陷在跳步过程中累积；(2)相位或条件变化导致潜在演化方向的改变。这些方法缺乏对近似误差长期影响的准确评估。

Method: WorldDynCache包含两个核心组件：(1)轻量级潜在转变风险估计器——跟踪近似缺陷的累积未来影响，并通过在精确锚点处观察到的反事实缺陷来校准预测；(2)条件与相位感知的提升潜在替代模型——在不增加额外Transformer评估的情况下近似潜在演化过程。

Result: 在HunyuanVoyager-13B和Aether-5B上分别实现4.92倍和2.15倍推理加速，并在WorldScore、PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS等指标上达到所有对比缓存方法中最优的生成质量。

Conclusion: WorldDynCache通过风险可控的潜在动力学近似，在显著加速扩散世界模型推理的同时保持甚至提升生成质量，验证了考虑近似误差累积影响和条件/相位感知的必要性。

Abstract: Diffusion world models generate high-quality futures, but re- peated transformer evaluations make inference prohibitively slow. Existing caches reuse intermediate features, selectively update tokens, or reuse and extrapolate denoising outputs ac- cording to local drift or short native-space histories. These criteria can miss both approximation-induced latent transition defects that accumulate across skipped steps and phase- or condition-dependent changes in the direction of latent evo- lution. We propose WorldDynCache, a risk-controlled latent dynamics approximation framework with two core compo- nents. First, a lightweight latent-transition risk estimator tracks the accumulated future impact of approximation defects and calibrates its predictions against counterfactual defects ob- served at exact anchors. Second, a condition- and phase- aware lifted latent surrogate approximates latent evolution without extra transformer evaluations. On HunyuanVoyager- 13B and Aether-5B, WorldDynCache achieves 4.92 times and 2.15 times speedups, respectively, while attaining the best gen- eration quality among the compared caching methods across WorldScore, PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS.

</details>


### [355] [Beyond Magnitude and Shape: A Direction-Aware Loss for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01857)
*Seunghan Lee,Jaehoon Lee,Jun Seo,Junhyeok Kang,Sangjun Han,Sungdong Yoo,Minjae Kim,Tae Yoon Lim,Dongwan Kang,Hwanil Choi,Soonyoung Lee,Wonbin Ahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CosDir，一种方向感知的损失函数，通过余弦相似度对齐预测与目标的差分向量，解决MSE训练模型在小幅变动方向预测上的失败问题。CosDir是即插即用的轻量损失项，并扩展出CosDir-UW自适应学习方向与幅值损失的混合权重，在超过10万次实验中显著提升方向准确率同时保持幅值精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 变化方向（上升或下降）在风险管理、金融预测等决策驱动应用中往往与精确数值同等重要。然而现有预测损失函数（如MSE）仅优化点幅值或形状频率结构，没有显式针对变化方向进行优化，导致MSE训练的预测器在小幅变动的方向预测上表现不佳。

Method: 提出CosDir损失，通过余弦相似度对齐预测差分向量与目标差分向量，具有尺度不变性，能对小幅变动保持方向梯度，弥补MSE的盲区。CosDir是即插即用的附加项，无需修改网络架构。进一步提出CosDir-UW，在训练过程中自适应学习方向项与幅值项的混合权重，无需超参数调优即可匹配逐数据集调优的性能。

Result: 进行了超过10万次实验，证明该方法在保持幅值精度的同时持续且显著地提升方向准确率，并且优于多种基线损失函数。

Conclusion: CosDir为预测任务中方向感知优化提供了一个简单、有效且通用的解决方案，填补了现有损失函数在变化方向优化上的空白，并在大幅实验中验证了其鲁棒性与优越性。

Abstract: The direction of change --- whether a series will move up or down --- is often as important as its exact value in decisiondriven applications such as risk management and financial forecasting. However, most forecasting losses optimize either point magnitude or shape and frequency structure, and none explicitly targets the direction of change. In this paper, we find that MSE-trained forecasters fail on the direction of small moves. To address this, we propose CosDir, a simple yet effective direction-aware loss that aligns the difference vectors of the prediction and the target via cosine similarity. Being scale-invariant, CosDir keeps a directional gradient on small moves, re-injecting learning signal exactly where MSE neglects it. CosDir is a lightweight, plug-in term that attaches to any backbone without architectural modification. Since the best ratio for mixing the directional and magnitude terms differs across datasets, we further propose CosDir-UW, an extension that makes this ratio adaptive by learning it during training, matching a per-dataset tuned weight with no hyperparameter. We conduct over 100K experiments, demonstrating that our method consistently and significantly improves directional accuracy while preserving magnitude accuracy, and that it outperforms various loss functions. Code is available at: https://github.com/seunghan96/cosdir.

</details>


### [356] [LAB-Tab: LLM-Augmented Bayesian Network Adaptation for Few-Shot Tabular Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01879)
*Zijian Shen,Taijie Chen,Bin Zhou,Ziyang Jiang,Jintao Ke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LAB-Tab框架，利用LLM增强贝叶斯网络适应，解决源感知少样本表格数据生成问题。通过LLM提出目标域可能存在的边，再用PPO策略校准边的操作（保留、削弱、增强、翻转、停用），在六个分布偏移场景中取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少样本表格数据生成中，仅提供少量目标记录和丰富源域数据。现有方法要么直接拟合稀疏目标统计导致过拟合，要么复用源域生成器导致保留目标域不再成立的依赖关系，缺乏有效的源感知适应方法。

Method: LAB-Tab三步流程：（1）从源数据拟合贝叶斯网络；（2）利用LLM提出源图缺失但目标域可能存在的边，将语义和弱统计证据转化为显式结构假设；（3）用PPO策略对增强BN中的边进行校准，包括保留、削弱、增强、翻转、停用等操作，奖励函数结合分布对齐、下游效用和目标相关依赖的保留，最终从适应后的BN采样生成目标域表格。

Result: 在基于三个美国人口普查（ACS）预测任务构建的六个源-目标分布偏移场景中，LAB-Tab在10%目标数据预算下取得最佳性能，在六个单独场景中领先四个，相对最强基线将宏观Overall分数降低33.8%，同时获得最佳宏观JSD、WAPE和UtilityGap指标，并保持有竞争力的特征-标签保留度。

Conclusion: LAB-Tab成功结合LLM的结构假设能力与强化学习的边校准能力，有效解决了源感知少样本表格生成中的分布偏移问题，在多个评估维度上优于现有基线方法。

Abstract: Tabular data generation supports analysis and decision-making when target-domain data are scarce, yet collecting complete target samples is often costly. A practical but underexplored setting provides only a few target records together with richer source data from a related domain. Existing few-shot tabular generators often either fit sparse target statistics directly, which can overfit incidental patterns, or reuse source-domain generators, which may preserve dependencies that no longer hold in the target domain. To address this problem, we propose LAB-Tab, an LLM-augmented Bayesian network (BN) adaptation framework for source-aware few-shot tabular generation. LAB-Tab first fits a BN from source data and then uses an LLM to propose plausible target-domain BN edges that are absent from the source BN graph. This step converts semantic and weak statistical evidence into explicit structural hypotheses, thereby expanding the editable edge space beyond the source-fitted graph. Because the proposed edges may be noisy and interact with existing dependencies, a PPO policy calibrates edges in the augmented BN through edge-level actions, including keep, weaken, strengthen, flip, and deactivate. The PPO policy is trained with a reward that combines distributional alignment, downstream utility, and preservation of target-relevant dependencies. The adapted BN is then sampled to synthesize target-domain tables. Across six source--target distribution-shift scenarios built from three US Census (ACS) prediction tasks, LAB-Tab achieves the best performance at the 10% target-data budget, leads four of the six individual scenarios, and reduces the macro Overall score by 33.8% relative to the strongest baseline. It also obtains the best macro JSD, WAPE, and UtilityGap while maintaining competitive feature--label preservation.

</details>


### [357] [CARE: A Cascaded Framework for Efficient and Reliable Time Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01885)
*Zemin Chao,Qianhui Xu,Jianhe Cen,Guangzhi Ge,Xiao Chen,Hoangzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CARE，一个模型无关的级联推理框架，用于加速时间序列异常检测。通过轻量级预过滤器（LPM）快速过滤高置信度的正常样本，仅将不确定样本路由到高容量复杂检测模型（CDM），实现2.7倍到4.8倍的推理加速，同时保持竞争力的检测质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型在时间序列异常检测中性能优异，但其复杂架构带来巨大的推理开销。现有方法对所有数据点采用统一的推理策略，然而异常本质上是非常稀缺的，绝大多数时间序列数据是可预测的正常模式，这种"一刀切"的方式效率低下。

Method: CARE框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 轻量级预过滤器LPM，使用Residual MLP AutoEncoder和Normality-Conditioned Gating机制快速过滤高置信度正常样本；(2) 结构注意力模块（Structure Attention），显式捕获通道级别的异常贡献；(3) 通过置信度引导的选择性路由目标函数优化门控网络，学习可靠的决策以减少不必要的CDM调用。

Result: 在八个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，CARE能有效分离高置信度正常样本。相比最准确的SOTA方法，该框架实现了2.7倍至4.8倍的推理加速，同时保持竞争力的检测质量。

Conclusion: CARE通过级联推理框架充分利用了"异常稀缺"这一时间序列数据的固有特性，用轻量模型处理绝大多数正常样本，仅在必要时调用复杂模型，在不显著牺牲检测质量的前提下大幅提升推理效率。

Abstract: While deep learning models have achieved state-of-the-art performance in time series anomaly detection, their complex architectures incur substantial inference overhead. Existing methods typically apply a uniform inference strategy across all data points, which is inefficient given that anomalies are inherently scarce and the vast majority of temporal data consists of predictable normal patterns. To mitigate this bottleneck, we propose CARE, a model-agnostic cascaded inference framework that integrates a Lightweight Pre-filter Model (LPM) with an existing high-capacity Complex Detection Model (CDM). The LPM rapidly filters high-confidence normal samples using a Residual MLP AutoEncoder and a Normality-Conditioned Gating mechanism. Crucially, we introduce a Structure Attention module to explicitly capture channel-wise anomaly contributions, and optimize the gating network via a confidence-guided selective routing objective that learns reliable routing decisions to reduce unnecessary CDM invocations. Extensive experiments across eight real-world benchmarks demonstrate that CARE effectively isolates high-confidence normal samples. By routing only uncertain samples to the CDM, our framework achieves $2.7\times$ to $4.8\times$ inference speedup compared to the most accurate SOTA approaches, while still maintaining competitive detection quality.

</details>


### [358] [Understanding and Correcting Low-Frequency Bias in EEG Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01898)
*Junjie Yu,Zihan Deng,Jianyu Zhang,Junrong Mu,Jiahui An,Wenxiao Ma,Ziling Lu,Yue Wang,Yan Zhu,Kexin Lou,Quanying Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现EEG基础模型的预训练存在持续的低频偏置问题，即增加数据规模或模型容量无法一致提升下游性能。作者将这一偏置归因于EEG的1/f^α频谱结构与神经网络偏好学习低频成分的交互作用，以及掩码自编码器中ℓ₂重建损失对高功率低频成分的过度加权。为此提出FAME框架，在预定义的EEG频带内重建时频活动并均衡各频带损失，在41个下游任务中达到24个SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EEG基础模型预训练面临一个关键矛盾：扩大数据规模和模型容量并不能稳定提升下游任务性能。作者通过分析发现，这一问题源于模型学习到的表征存在持续的低频偏置，该偏置在不同数据规模、模型容量和预训练目标下均稳定存在，严重制约了EEG基础模型的泛化能力。

Method: 作者首先系统分析了EEG基础模型中低频偏置的存在与成因，将其归结为EEG的1/f^α频谱结构与神经网络低频偏好学习的交互，以及掩码自编码器中ℓ₂损失对高功率低频成分的不成比例加权。基于此，提出FAME（频率平衡掩码自编码框架）：将EEG输入转换到时频域，在预定义EEG频带内分别独立标准化重建目标，并对所有频带损失赋予相等权重，从而实现对EEG频谱的均衡监督。

Result: 在OmniEEG-Bench的41个下游任务上进行评估，FAME学习到了更具频谱平衡性的表征，并在其中24个任务上取得了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，均衡的频谱监督对于学习可迁移的EEG表征至关重要，FAME框架有效解决了EEG基础模型中的低频偏置问题，为EEG自监督预训练提供了新的设计思路。

Abstract: Increasing EEG pretraining data scale or model capacity does not consistently improve downstream performance. We identify a persistent low-frequency bias in representations learned by diverse EEG foundation models, which remains across dataset scales, model capacities, and pretraining objectives. Our analysis links this bias to the interaction between EEG's $1/f^α$-like spectral structure and neural networks' tendency to preferentially learn low-frequency components. In masked autoencoders, the $\ell_2$ reconstruction objective further amplifies this imbalance: under comparable relative reconstruction errors, high-power low-frequency components contribute disproportionately to the loss. To address this issue, we introduce FAME, a frequency-balanced masked autoencoding framework that reconstructs time--frequency activity in predefined EEG bands from masked EEG inputs. FAME independently standardizes the reconstruction targets within each band and assigns equal weight to all band-specific losses, thereby balancing supervision across the EEG spectrum. Evaluated on 41 downstream tasks in OmniEEG-Bench, FAME learns more spectrally balanced representations and achieves state-of-the-art performance on 24 of them. These results underscore the importance of balanced spectral supervision for learning transferable EEG representations.

</details>


### [359] [Finite-Time Analysis of Discounted Exponential-Utility Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01917)
*Ankur Naskar,Vivek T A,Aditya Kumar,Gugan Thoppe,Prashanth L. A*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对折扣指数效用（风险敏感）强化学习中的两个模型无关不动点算法，在异步马尔可夫采样下建立了$\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$的有限时间收敛速率，并采用无需调参的步长选择方案。这是该领域首个有限时间保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 风险敏感的序贯决策需要折扣指数效用准则，但其非线性结构使强化学习变得复杂。先前工作提出了Bellman兼容的代理函数和两个模型无关不动点算法，但主要收敛结果仅是渐近的。为了实际应用，需要对这些算法提供有限时间收敛保证。

Method: 对于单时间尺度算法：利用算子的有界性、单调性和齐次性，解决更新方程与底层幂律算子压缩几何不对齐的问题，获得相对误差动态的局部伪压缩性质；结合Moreau包络Lyapunov函数和Polyak-Ruppert平均，在参数自由步长下得到收敛速率。对于双时间尺度算法：主要控制快时间尺度上的跟踪误差。

Result: 在异步马尔可夫采样下，两个算法均获得$\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$的有限时间收敛速率，且步长参数无需手动调节（参数自由）。这是折扣指数效用强化学习首个模型无关的有限时间保证。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了风险敏感强化学习算法在有限时间分析上的空白，通过巧妙的算子性质分析和Lyapunov方法克服了非线性结构的挑战，为后续研究提供了理论基础和分析工具。

Abstract: Discounted exponential utility provides a principled criterion for risk-sensitive sequential decision-making, but its nonlinear structure complicates reinforcement learning. A recent work \citep{thoppe2026reinforcement} addressed this difficulty by introducing a Bellman-compatible surrogate and two model-free fixed-point algorithms for optimizing it over stationary policies. However, their main convergence results are asymptotic. In this work, we establish finite-time rates of $\tilde{O} (1/\sqrt{n})$ for the aforementioned two algorithms under asynchronous Markovian sampling, where $n$ is the iteration index and $\tilde{O}$ hides logarithmic expressions. Importantly, we employ parameter-free choices for the stepsize parameter to derive these rate results. For the algorithmically simpler one-timescale method, the main challenge is that its update equation is not directly aligned with the contraction geometry of its underlying power-law operator. We overcome this mismatch by exploiting the boundedness, monotonicity, and homogeneity of the operator to obtain a local pseudo-contraction property for the relative-error dynamics. We then use a Moreau-envelope-based Lyapunov function and Polyak--Ruppert averaging to obtain the stated convergence rate with parameter-free stepsizes. For the two-timescale method, the main challenge is to control a tracking error on the faster timescale. These results provide the first finite-time guarantees for model-free discounted exponential-utility reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [360] [HarnessCompass: Guiding Automatic Harness Evolution toward Generalizable and Effective Agent Harnesses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01918)
*Luan Zhang,Ruochen Zhou,Dandan Song,Zhengyu Chen,Yuhang Tian,Jun Yang,Huipeng Ma,Chenhao Li,Guangyuan Feng,Xudong Li,Yizhou Jin,Yan Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HarnessCompass，一种自动harness进化框架，通过约束进化、主动反馈和组件独立优化，在SWE-bench Verified上将GPT-5.4的Pass@1从54%提升至66%，仅需5次进化迭代，且泛化能力显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动harness进化方法存在三个关键问题：过度拟合进化任务、仅依赖轨迹派生信号、联合优化harness组件导致组件间干扰。这些局限性阻碍了harness的泛化能力和进化效率。

Method: HarnessCompass通过三个核心机制解决上述问题：(1) 约束进化——对进化施加全局约束，限制修改为任务无关的harness变更，确保泛化性；(2) 主动反馈——在轨迹派生证据基础上，补充agent关于harness使用的第一人称主动反馈，提供更丰富的进化信号；(3) 组件独立优化——将不同harness组件的优化解耦后再整合为统一harness，减少跨组件干扰同时保留组件协同效应。

Result: 在SWE-bench Verified上使用GPT-5.4，HarnessCompass仅用5次进化迭代即将Pass@1从54%提升至66%，在有效性和进化效率上均优于AHE。进化的harness能有效迁移到held-out任务和其他模型，展现远强于先前自动harness进化方法的泛化能力。

Conclusion: HarnessCompass证明了约束进化、主动反馈和组件独立优化这三大设计原则能显著提升自动harness进化的效果、效率与泛化性，为LLM agent harness的自动化设计提供了更优的范式。

Abstract: Harness design plays a critical role in agent performance by shaping how large language models (LLMs) perceive, reason over, and act within executable environments. Recent work has proposed automatic harness evolution, which iteratively improves the harness from agent--environment interactions. However, existing methods often overfit to the evolution tasks, rely exclusively on trajectory-derived signals, and optimize harness components jointly, causing interference across components. We propose HarnessCompass, a novel automatic harness evolution framework built around constrained evolution, proactive feedback, and component-wise optimization. HarnessCompass first enforces global constraints on evolution, restricting modifications to task-agnostic harness changes that generalize beyond the evolution tasks. It then augments trajectory-derived evidence with proactive first-person feedback from the agent about harness usage, yielding richer signals for evolution. Finally, it decouples the optimization of different harness components before consolidating them into a unified harness, reducing cross-component interference while preserving component synergy. On SWE-bench Verified with GPT-5.4, HarnessCompass improves Pass@1 from 54\% to 66\% in only 5 evolution iterations, outperforming AHE in both effectiveness and evolution efficiency.
