We investigate whether distribution-aware planning is possible without these constraints. Using a quadratic action-value parameterization, we first reduce the Bellman backup to an expectation over the state-value function alone; the key idea is then a compatibility principle between the predictive transition distribution and the value function class, under which this expectation is analytic in the distribution's moments. We instantiate this principle with a Gaussian transition model paired with a radial-basis value function, yielding a closed-form backup that propagates both predictive mean and covariance. Empirically, our approach reduces target variance and yields well-calibrated predictive uncertainty under stochastic observations in continuous control, providing a principled framework for planning with learned distribution models.

</details>


### [394] [Uncertainty Is Not Enough: Value-of-Information Routing for Mixtures of LoRA Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02528)
*Tom Saliencro,Rohan Desai,Priya Nair,Maya Lindqvist,Daniel Whitmore*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出VI-MoLE，将MoE-LoRA的路由问题形式化为"认证价值信息分配"（certified value-of-information allocation）。该方法学习每个专家前缀后的反事实风险，在校准数据上生成同时上界证书（simultaneous upper-risk certificates），并基于边际风险降低/成本比来贪心分配全局适配器预算。终端证书决定是回答还是弃权，从而区分了当前歧义、可恢复风险和残余风险，优于传统的不确定性门控方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动态MoE-LoRA路由器在不确定时激活更多专家，但这一规则隐含假设"不确定性=需要更多计算"。然而，不确定的样本可能包含互补的专家证据，也可能在所有专家都给出相同但不明确的答案后仍然保持歧义。因此需要一种更精细的方法来区分可恢复风险与残余风险，避免浪费计算资源。

Method: 1) 将路由建模为认证价值信息分配问题；2) 学习每个专家前缀后的反事实风险（counterfactual risk）；3) 在保留的校准数据上将这些预测转换为同时上界证书（simultaneous upper-risk certificates）；4) 将全局适配器预算分配到具有最大认证边际风险降低/单位成本的token-层动作上；5) 使用终端证书决定回答或弃权。

Result: 证明了对证书同时有效性、在递减认证增益下的最优贪心分配，以及值估计误差下的分配遗憾上界。评估协议涵盖了匹配计算量下的准确性、证书覆盖率、风险-覆盖率、分布偏移和尾部延迟，并与固定和动态MoE-LoRA路由器进行了对比。

Conclusion: VI-MoLE通过价值信息的认证分配替代了简单的不确定性门控，能够从理论上保证风险证书的有效性和预算分配的近最优性，在区分歧义类型的同时提升参数高效路由的整体性能。

Abstract: Mixtures of low-rank adaptation experts increase parameter-efficient capacity by routing each input through a subset of adapters. Recent dynamic routers activate more experts when the router or prediction is uncertain. This rule silently equates uncertainty with useful additional computation: an uncertain example may contain complementary, unqueried expert evidence, but it may instead remain ambiguous after every expert agrees. We formulate routing as certified value-of-information allocation. VI-MoLE learns the counterfactual risk remaining after each expert prefix, converts these predictions into simultaneous upper-risk certificates on held-out calibration data, and spends a global adapter budget on the token--layer action with the largest certified marginal risk reduction per unit cost. A terminal certificate then decides whether to answer or abstain. Unlike an uncertainty gate, this procedure distinguishes present ambiguity from recoverable and residual risk. We prove simultaneous certificate validity, optimal greedy allocation under diminishing certified gains, and allocation regret under value-estimation error. The evaluation protocol tests matched-compute accuracy, certificate coverage, risk--coverage, distribution shift, and tail latency against fixed and dynamic MoE-LoRA routers.

</details>


### [395] [Benchmarking Sheaf Neural Networks for Inductive Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02558)
*Stefano Fiorini,Edoardo Coppola,Pietro Liò*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地对Sheaf神经网络（SNNs）在归纳式（inductive）设置下进行基准测试，通过1,890个受控实验评估了扩散机制、限制映射参数化、stalk维度及GNN架构组件等完整设计空间，发现限制映射是主导设计选择、架构组件比sheaf本身更重要，且SNNs在归纳设置下表现不及最强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管SNNs具有坚实的理论基础和有前景的传导式（transductive）结果，但以往研究几乎只在传导式节点分类上进行评估，其在归纳式协议下的行为完全未知。这一空白使得研究者无法判断SNNs是否具有跨图泛化能力，也无法指导实际应用中的设计选择。

Method: 对sheaf设计空间进行系统基准测试：评估三种扩散机制（neural sheaf diffusion、sheaf attention、sheaf attention with GATv2）、三种限制映射参数化、三种stalk维度以及六种现代GNN架构组件。使用消息传递重构来避免组装繁重的sheaf Laplacian，使完整设计空间可在跨图批处理下训练。在14个归纳式数据集上运行1,890个受控实验。

Result: 实验揭示了多个关键发现：（1）限制映射是主导设计选择，且通用映射更优；（2）更大stalk维度增加容量但不提升长距离推理能力；（3）架构组件对性能变异的影响大于整个sheaf特定设计空间本身；（4）在匹配协议下SNNs可迁移到归纳设置，但未达到最强基线，差距因数据集而异；（5）单个sheaf配置可跨数据集泛化，调优重点应放在架构配方而非sheaf算子。

Conclusion: SNNs在归纳设置下的表现并未超越最强基线，但设计空间的研究揭示了实用洞见：限制映射的选择比sheaf架构的其他部分更关键，且由于单一sheaf配置可跨数据集复用，实际工程中应更多关注周边GNN架构组件的调优。

Abstract: Sheaf Neural Networks (SNNs) generalize message passing by replacing scalar edge weights of standard Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) with learnable, edge-dependent restriction maps between node stalks. Despite their strong theoretical foundations and promising transductive results, SNNs have been evaluated almost exclusively on transductive node classification, leaving their behaviour under inductive protocols unknown. We address this gap through the first systematic benchmark of the sheaf design space, evaluating three diffusion mechanisms (neural sheaf diffusion, sheaf attention, and sheaf attention with Graph Attention Network v2), three restriction-map parameterizations, three stalk dimensions, and six modern GNN architectural components, within a message-passing reformulation that never assembles the heavy sheaf Laplacian, making the full design space trainable under cross-graph batching. Across $1{,}890$ controlled experiments on 14 inductive datasets, multiple insights emerge: restriction maps are the dominant design choice and general maps are preferable, larger stalks add capacity but not long-range reach, architectural components explain more performance variation than the entire sheaf-specific design space itself. Under a matched protocol, SNNs transfer to inductive settings but do not reach the strongest baselines, with gaps being dataset-dependent. Practically, a single sheaf configuration can generalize across datasets, so effort is better spent tuning the surrounding architectural recipe than the sheaf operator itself.

</details>


### [396] [Structured Memory for Edge Language Models: Persistent Context and Corpus Retrieval via O(1) SSM State Injection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02560)
*Anusha Madan Gopal,Aras Pirbadian,Kristofor D. Carlson,M Anthony Lewis,Jonathan Tapson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PRECOG，利用状态空间模型（SSM）的固定大小、位置无关的循环隐藏状态特性，将检索增强生成（RAG）的prefill成本从O(L_context)压缩到O(1)。通过离线预编码文档为SSM隐藏状态，查询时直接注入最佳匹配状态，避免上下文重新摄入。同时提出SMC（结构化记忆整合）机制，实现分层持久记忆、认知域聚类和O(1)会话初始化。在TENNs-LLM（1.2B参数的SSM模型，192KB隐藏状态）上验证，将prefill延迟从约27秒降至6毫秒以下（约4500倍加速）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG面临两大成本：prefill成本与检索上下文长度成正比，以及Transformer架构下KV缓存随生成token线性增长。虽然SSM天然解决了第二个问题，但prefill成本依然存在。作者希望利用SSM独特的隐藏状态特性——固定大小、位置无关且是已读内容的完整摘要——来彻底消除第一个成本，使大规模检索在边缘设备上达到交互式速度。

Method: 提出PRECOG（Pre-Computed Context Injection）机制：1) 离线将文档语料库预编码为SSM隐藏状态；2) 查询时直接将最匹配的隐藏状态注入模型，跳过上下文重新摄入。同时提出SMC（Structured Memory Consolidation）：构建分层持久记忆系统，包含认知域聚类、可调节保真度-存储权衡旋钮和O(1)会话初始化，将短期情景状态整合为长期语义记忆，并在查询时与检索到的语料库状态融合。整个系统在TENNs-LLM（1.2B参数门控SSM语言模型，192KB隐藏状态）上实现。

Result: PRECOG在回答质量上与传统的上下文内RAG相当，但将prefill延迟从约27秒降至6毫秒以下，实现约4500倍加速。这一跨越将系统从不可用状态提升到交互式可用水平。作者强调该机制在Transformer KV缓存架构中是不可能的，因为KV缓存与位置纠缠且随上下文长度线性增长。

Conclusion: PRECOG证明了SSM为RAG提供了一种全新的可能性：通过隐藏状态的操作代替上下文重新摄入，可实现数量级的性能提升。这不仅是一个性能优化方案，更揭示了SSM架构在检索增强系统中的独特优势——固定大小、位置无关的隐藏状态使预计算和状态注入成为可能，而这是Transformer架构在原理上无法实现的。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) imposes a prefill cost proportional to retrieved context length, and -- with Transformer backbones -- a KV-cache that grows with each generated token. State-Space Models (SSMs) avoid the second cost by construction; we eliminate the first, collapsing prefill from $O(L_{context})$ to $O(1)$ per query. We introduce PRECOG (Pre-Computed Context Injection), a retrieval mechanism that exploits a property unique to SSMs: the fixed-size, position-agnostic recurrent hidden state is a complete summary of everything the model has read. PRECOG pre-encodes document corpora offline as SSM hidden states and injects the best-matching state directly at query time, bypassing in-context re-ingestion entirely. The same state-injection mechanism enables SMC (Structured Memory Consolidation): a hierarchical persistent memory with cognitive-domain clustering, an adjustable fidelity-vs-storage dial, and $O(1)$ session initialization, which consolidates short-term episodic states into long-term semantic memory and fuses both with retrieved corpus states at query time. We demonstrate the system on TENNs-LLM, a 1.2B-parameter gated-SSM language model with a 192 KB hidden state. PRECOG matches in-context RAG answer quality, reducing prefill latency from $\sim$27 s to $<$6 ms on edge hardware -- a $\sim$4500$\times$ speedup that crosses the threshold from unusable to interactive. The mechanism is architecturally impossible for Transformer KV-caches, which are position-entangled and grow linearly with context length.

</details>


### [397] [Smooth Reparameterizations of Functions on Simplicial Product Spaces: Applications to Probabilistic Tensor Decomposition and Functional Data Registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02576)
*Shashwat Kumar,Arafat Rahman,Anuj Srivastava,P. -A. Absil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了定义在单纯形乘积空间上的优化问题，提出用光滑、逐元素严格凸的重新参数化替代乘积单纯形，将约束优化转化为流形上的无约束优化。作者证明平滑流形上的二阶KKT点可映射为乘积单纯形上的弱二阶KKT点，并基于此提出黎曼梯度下降（RGD）算法，在张量分解和曲线配准任务中优于投影梯度下降（PGD）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多实际优化问题定义在单纯形乘积空间上，例如低秩离散多元概率分布的张量分解、以及SRVF表示下的函数数据配准。这类约束优化问题求解困难，而将约束空间转换为更光滑的流形结构可能带来理论保证和计算优势。

Method: 作者将乘积单纯形替换为光滑的、逐元素严格凸的重新参数化，从而将原约束优化问题转化为流形上的无约束优化问题。他们建立了光滑流形上的二阶KKT点与乘积单纯形上弱二阶KKT点之间的映射关系，并设计了基于该重新参数化的黎曼梯度下降算法。

Result: 所提出的RGD算法在性能上优于投影梯度下降（PGD），并且在曲线配准任务中能够更忠实地保留原始函数的形状特征。

Conclusion: 通过光滑严格凸重新参数化，可以将单纯形乘积空间的约束优化问题转化为流形上的无约束问题，同时保持最优性条件的对应关系，从而获得更高效、更可靠的优化算法。

Abstract: We consider optimization problems defined on product spaces of simplices. Examples of this class of problems include learning low-rank discrete multivariate probability distributions via simplex constrained tensor decomposition and performing functional data registration under the Square Root Velocity Function (SRVF) representation. In this work, we demonstrate the feasibility of replacing the product simplex with a smooth, elementwise strictly convex reparameterization, resulting in an unconstrained optimization problem on a manifold. We show that performing such a reparameterization results in the second order Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) points on the smooth manifold being mapped to the weak second order KKT points on the product simplex. This leads to a Riemannian Gradient Descent (RGD) algorithm for solving the reparameterized problem, which outperforms Projected Gradient Descent (PGD), and provides a more faithful representation of the original function shapes while performing curve registration.

</details>


### [398] [GradCuit: Credit-Assigned Gradient Flow Enables Robust and Interpretable Test-Time Latent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02585)
*Zhaoxin Yu,Qi Shen,Hengli Li,Zhaowei Zhang,Song-Chun Zhu,Chi Zhang,Zilong Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GradCuit通过在Transformer层间插入可优化的连续隐状态，使整个生成序列的奖励加权梯度直接分配到隐状态上，从而在测试时优化内部推理过程，实现了比思维链提示和现有隐推理方法更高的准确率与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于优化的隐式推理方法通过解码token间接连接隐状态与推理轨迹，导致序列级信用分配不直接，难以理解隐状态更新如何影响后续推理。

Method: 在选定的Transformer层中，于提示的隐藏表示与生成续写之间插入可优化的潜在状态。利用因果自注意力机制，使每个续写token的对数概率都能通过剩余Transformer块对每个前置隐状态产生可微路径，从而将来自整个续写的奖励加权梯度直接分配至隐状态。

Result: 在5个指令微调骨干模型、3个推理基准和2种答案格式上，平均准确率64.5%，超越思维链提示6.6个百分点，超越最强对比方法2.4个百分点。在7种学习率设置下始终优于LatentSeek，准确率标准差从1.53降至0.82，随机游走变体仍具竞争力。

Conclusion: GradCuit开辟了稳健且可解释的测试时扩展新维度，使LLM能够通过直接优化内部推理来适应任务，而非仅仅重新生成、采样或重排序输出。层分析表明早至中层Transformer是最有效的优化空间。

Abstract: Optimization-based latent reasoning improves large language model outputs by optimizing instance-specific continuous states at test time while keeping model parameters frozen. Existing methods, however, typically connect these states to the reasoning trajectory through decoded tokens, making sequence-level credit assignment indirect and obscuring how latent updates shape subsequent reasoning. We introduce GradCuit (gradient through circuit), which inserts optimizable latent states at a selected Transformer layer between the hidden representations of the prompt and the generated continuation. Causal self-attention provides every continuation-token log-probability with a differentiable path to every preceding latent state through the remaining Transformer blocks, enabling reward-weighted gradients from the entire continuation to be assigned directly to the latents. Across five instruction-tuned backbones, three reasoning benchmarks, and two answer formats, GradCuit achieves an average accuracy of 64.5%, outperforming chain-of-thought prompting by 6.6 percentage points and the strongest competing method by 2.4 points. GradCuit also demonstrates greater robustness: across seven learning-rate settings, it consistently outperforms LatentSeek while reducing the standard deviation of accuracy from 1.53 to 0.82, and even its random-walk variant remains competitive with LatentSeek. For interpretability, token-level gradient attribution reveals that latent influence concentrates on reasoning-connector tokens, while layer analysis identifies early-to-middle Transformer layers as the most effective optimization space. By directly optimizing internal reasoning from outcome feedback, GradCuit opens a new axis of robust and interpretable test-time scaling, where LLMs adapt how they reason rather than merely regenerate, sample, or rerank outputs.

</details>


### [399] [onepot-Bench 0: towards lab-aware in silico chemistry benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02595)
*Brandon Wang,Andrei S. Tyrin,Daniil A. Boiko*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文介绍了onepot-Bench 0，一个专有的基准测试套件，用于评估语言模型在湿实验相关的合成化学能力，包含三个互补的评估：ChemAbacus（化学信息学素养）、SynthRefusal（安全与拒绝行为）、SynthBench（反应结果预测和催化剂选择）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型在实验室科学中的应用越来越重要，但现有评估很少测量物理实验室中可靠决策所需的能力，且常依赖可能已出现在模型训练语料中的公开数据，难以精确衡量模型真实的科学能力。

Method: 构建包含三个互补评估的专有基准套件onepot-Bench 0：ChemAbacus评估无工具化学信息学素养和数值推理；SynthRefusal表征各种良性、受控和设计药物靶点的安全与拒绝行为；SynthBench使用实验室内部生成的私有实验数据评估反应结果预测和催化剂选择。

Result: 该基准套件通过三个互补的评估维度，综合探测了实验室可靠表现所需的基本能力、可靠性和深层知识。

Conclusion: onepot-Bench 0利用专有数据弥补了现有评估的不足，为精确衡量语言模型在湿实验室执行相关的合成化学能力提供了更全面的评估框架。

Abstract: Language models are playing an increasingly important role in laboratory science, performing tasks such as experiment planning, execution, and post-hoc analysis. However, precisely measuring their abilities is difficult, as scientific capabilities require a mixture of both problem-solving skills and domain-specific intuition. Existing evaluations rarely measure the capabilities required to make reliable decisions in a physical laboratory and often rely on public data that may have appeared in model training corpora.
  We introduce onepot-Bench 0, a proprietary benchmark suite for evaluating language models on synthetic chemistry capabilities relevant to wet-lab execution. onepot-Bench 0 comprises three complementary evaluations: ChemAbacus measures tool-free cheminformatics literacy and numerical reasoning; SynthRefusal characterizes safety and refusal behavior across a variety of benign, controlled, and designer-drug targets; and SynthBench evaluates reaction-outcome prediction and catalyst selection using private experimental data generated in our laboratory. Together, these evaluations probe basic competency, reliability, and deeper knowledge, all skills which are required for reliable performance in the lab.

</details>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [400] [Revisiting Classic Thought Experiments to Measure Consciousness for Artificial Intelligence Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00001)
*Peter David Fagan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过"守恒一致编码"(CCE)框架重新审视莱布尼茨磨坊、图灵测试和塞尔中文屋等经典思想实验，提出了任务表现(W_causal,T)与操作意识(κ_T)的分离：一个未压缩查找系统与一个紧凑生成系统可以取得相近的行为表现，但在κ_T上截然不同，从而将外在行为与支撑该行为的内部组织区分开来，为AI安全分析提供新的视角。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典的心智哲学与AI思想实验（莱布尼茨磨坊、图灵测试、塞尔中文屋）长期争论机器"理解"与"意识"的本质，但缺乏一个形式化框架来区分外在行为表现与内在结构效率。作者希望用一个严格的符号化设定来重新框定这些争论。

Method: 引入CCE（Conservation-Congruent Encoding）框架，建立玩具符号系统：用W_causal,T度量任务表现（因果成功），用κ_T度量操作意识（内部结构支持的效率）。对比两类系统：未压缩查找系统（依赖不断扩张的未重用映射存储）与紧凑生成系统（重用紧凑的内部结构）。

Result: 在理论上，两类系统可以达成同等的任务表现（相同W_causal,T），但在操作意识κ_T上存在显著分歧：查找系统κ_T低（内部结构不断扩张且不重用），生成系统κ_T高（内部结构紧凑且被高效复用）。这证明行为等价并不蕴含内部组织等价。

Conclusion: 通过将外在行为表现与支撑行为的内部组织分离，CCE框架为理解与意识之争提供了新的形式化视角，并说明这一区分对未来AI安全分析具有重要动机价值——即仅靠行为评估可能掩盖系统内部结构的本质差异。

Abstract: This research note revisits Leibniz's mill, Turing's imitation game, and Searle's Chinese Room through the Conservation-Congruent Encoding (CCE) framework. It formalises a toy symbolic setting in which successful behaviour is measured by task performance ($W_{causal,T}$), while the efficiency with which preserved internal structure supports that behaviour is measured by operational consciousness ($κ_T$). Within this setup, an uncompressed lookup system and a compact generative system can in principle achieve comparable behavioural success, yet diverge sharply in $κ_T$: the former relies on an expanding standing store of unreused mappings, whereas the latter reuses compact internal structure. The note therefore reframes classic disputes about understanding by separating outward performance from the organisation that sustains it, and motivates why this distinction may matter for later AI-safety analysis.

</details>


### [401] [AutoFOAM: The Self-Refining Autonomous OpenFOAM Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00003)
*Arun Govind Neelan,A Seshaditya*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoFOAM是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的自演化智能体，能够根据自然语言指令自动创建、评估、运行和演化OpenFOAM仿真，通过预训练+微调以及7阶段演化循环，显著降低了CFD仿真的使用门槛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 使用OpenFOAM等开源CFD求解器需要大量的专业知识和技能，且配置文件设置耗时。为降低这一负担，作者提出AutoFOAM，使用户仅通过自然语言指令即可完成CFD仿真。

Method: 基于Qwen-coder 2.5-14B预训练模型，在252个文本提示上微调，覆盖7个OpenFOAM求解器、13个参数化网格模板和y-plus数值策略。核心是7阶段的演化循环，并采用三种防退化机制：RAG增强重试上下文、字典级外科补丁、提示多样性改写。

Result: AutoFOAM加速了快速原型设计，降低了CFD工作流的使用门槛，使非专业用户也能进行高级流体仿真。

Conclusion: 通过将生成式AI与严格流体仿真相结合，AutoFOAM实现了CFD工作流的民主化，在自动化和易用性方面迈出了重要一步。

Abstract: Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) plays an important role in modern engineering, but using open-source solvers such as OpenFOAM requires considerable knowledge and skills, as well as time-consuming configuration file setup. To reduce this burden, we propose AutoFOAM - a self-evolving large language model (LLM) agent that creates, evaluates, runs, and evolves its own OpenFOAM simulations based solely on natural-language instructions. Our model is pre-trained on the Qwen-coder 2.5-14B, which is then fine-tuned on 252 text prompts targeting 7 OpenFOAM solvers, 13 parametrized mesh templates, and a y plus-aware numerical policy. The crucial element of the algorithm is a sophisticated evolution loop composed of 7 stages. To prevent model degeneration under repeated self-training, the agent employs three complementary anti-collapse streams: RAG-augmented retry context, surgical dictionary-level patching, and prompt-diversity paraphrasing. By bridging generative artificial intelligence with rigorous fluid simulations, AutoFOAM accelerates rapid prototyping and democratizes advanced CFD workflows.

</details>


### [402] [The Scaling Paradox in Human-AI Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00818)
*Anyan Qi,Mengxin Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过分析模型研究了AI规模扩展（scaling）在人类-AI协作系统中的表现，发现AI规模带来的性能提升能否转化为联合系统性能提升，取决于人类对AI能力的感知准确性。人类高估AI能力会导致"规模悖论"，即更大的AI规模反而降低系统性能并放大利润损失；人类低估AI能力则使性能提升速度显著变慢。企业可通过成本内化和感知对齐等运营策略来管理这些偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然规模定律（scaling laws）表明AI系统规模增大时性能会可预测地提升，但在现实应用中AI通常与人类协作而非独立运行。因此需要探究AI规模扩展带来的收益能否在人类-AI联合系统中持续存在，以及人类对AI能力的感知如何影响这一关系。

Method: 开发了一个分析模型（analytical model），研究AI规模扩展的实证收益何时能转化为人类-AI联合系统性能的提升。模型考虑了人类对AI能力的感知偏差（高估或低估），以及企业层面的运营政策（如成本内化、感知对齐）对这些影响的管理效果。

Result: 研究发现：1）当人类准确感知AI能力时，AI规模扩展能正向提升联合系统性能；2）当人类高估AI能力时，出现"规模悖论"——AI规模越大，系统整体性能反而下降，且企业利润损失放大；3）当人类低估AI能力时，性能虽随规模提升但速度显著放缓；4）运营政策（成本内化、感知对齐）的有效性取决于AI部署的经济性和人类误感知的方向。

Conclusion: 组织可能从管理人类-AI交互界面中获益更多，而非简单投资于更大更昂贵的AI系统。AI规模扩展不仅是技术问题，更是行为与运营问题，不应假定更大的AI系统会自动带来更好的运营结果。AI规模能否创造价值最终取决于增强的AI能力如何塑造人类信念和协作努力。

Abstract: The discovery of scaling laws has highlighted the extraordinary potential of AI systems with a striking empirical pattern: as AI systems scale, their capabilities tend to improve predictably. Yet, in real-world applications, AI rarely operates in isolation; instead, it often works alongside humans, raising the question of whether these gains persist in human-AI collaboration. In this work, we develop an analytical model to examine when the empirical scaling benefits of AI translate into improved human-AI joint system performance. We demonstrate that the performance of a human-AI system can scale positively as the AI scales up-provided that humans have an accurate perception of the AI's capabilities. Human misperception, however, can fundamentally alter this relationship: i) when humans over-perceive the AI's capabilities, a scaling paradox may arise, in which greater AI scale reduces overall system performance and amplifies firm-level profit losses, and (ii) when humans under-perceive the AI's capabilities, performance still improves with scale but at a substantially slower rate. We further show that firms can actively manage these distortions through operational policies such as cost internalization and perception alignment, whose effectiveness depends on the economics of AI deployment and the direction of human misperception. These findings suggest that organizations may benefit more from managing the human-AI interface than from simply investing in larger, more expensive AI systems. More broadly, our results suggest that AI scaling should be viewed not only as a technological challenge, but also as a behavioral and operational one, and caution against the view that larger AI systems will automatically lead to better operational outcomes. Whether AI scaling creates value ultimately depends on how increased AI capabilities shape human beliefs and collaborative efforts.

</details>


### [403] [Enhancing LLMs with Context-Specific Knowledge for Mitigating Misinformation in SMEs: A RAG-based Modeling and Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00006)
*Md. Samiul Islam,Iqbal H. Sarker,Chadni Islam,Ahmad Mohsin,Ahmed Ibrahim,Helge Janicke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对中小企业在使用大语言模型时面临的幻觉和错误信息问题，提出了VectorRAG和GraphRAG两种检索增强生成方法，并在LLaMA、Mistral和Qwen等多个主流LLM上进行了评估，结果表明RAG增强方法能显著提升响应质量，减少幻觉，支持更可靠的决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在中小企业中被广泛用于问答和决策支持，但其生成的幻觉内容会传播错误信息，降低用户对系统可靠性和可信度的信心，亟需一种能够缓解该问题的方法。

Method: 提出VectorRAG和GraphRAG两种检索增强生成（RAG）建模方法，通过将外部知识源纳入建模过程来缓解幻觉和错误信息风险，并在多个SOTA LLM（LLaMA、Mistral、Qwen）上评估其性能。

Result: 实验结果显示，RAG增强的LLM在有用响应生成、减少幻觉风险、上下文相关性和人类可解释性方面均有显著提升，验证了该方法在中小企业环境中的有效性。

Conclusion: RAG增强方法能够显著改善LLM在中小企业环境中的响应质量，减少幻觉和错误信息，从而支持更可靠、可信和上下文感知的决策过程。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs), a part of artificial intelligence (AI), are increasingly being adopted by Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) to enhance question-answering capabilities and support business decision-making processes. However, hallucinations in LLM-generated outputs can serve as a source of misinformation, reducing user confidence in their reliability and trustworthiness within SMEs. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising approach to address this challenge by incorporating external knowledge sources into the modeling process. In this paper, we present VectorRAG and GraphRAG modeling approaches to mitigate hallucinations and misinformation risks and evaluate their effectiveness in SME environments. Our experimental evaluation is conducted on multiple state-of-the-art LLMs, including LLaMA, Mistral, and Qwen, to assess performance in terms of useful response generation, risk of hallucination, contextual relevance, as well as human-interpretation. The results demonstrate that RAG-enhanced LLMs can significantly improve response quality by reducing hallucinations and misinformation, thereby supporting more reliable, trustworthy, and context-aware decision-making in SME environments.

</details>


### [404] [Energy Efficiency of Locally Deployed LLMs: A Preliminary Quantitative GPU Power Benchmark on Consumer Hardware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00008)
*Philipp M. Zähl,Anika Hennig*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对消费者级GPU（RTX 4060Ti 16GB）上运行的9个开源LLM（1B-7B参数）进行了可复现的硬件级能耗基准测试，使用Ollama推理引擎并通过nvidia-smi以2Hz采样GPU功耗，评估了均/峰值功耗、每提示能耗、每token能耗和吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 本地部署LLM因隐私和本地推理需求日益流行，但消费者硬件上的能耗成本缺乏深入研究，现有基准大多只关注准确性而忽略了能效指标。

Method: 在单块RTX 4060Ti 16GB GPU上，通过Ollama推理引擎运行9个开源LLM（1B-7B参数），使用nvidia-smi以2Hz频率采样GPU功耗，在固定提示集上评估均值/峰值功耗、每提示总能耗（J/prompt）、每输出token能耗（J/token）和吞吐量（tok/s）。

Result: 模型架构和量化策略（而非仅参数数量）是影响能效的关键因素。gemma3:1b和llama3.2:1b获得最低能耗成本（0.56 J/token和0.65 J/token）和最高吞吐量（>170 tok/s）；7B-Mistral每token能耗是最节能模型的4.4倍；qwen3.5:2b因扩展内部推理导致每提示能耗异常偏高。

Conclusion: 能效评估需区分token生成模式，不能仅依赖参数数量判断能耗表现；该基准为消费者硬件上的LLM能源成本提供了可复现的量化参考。

Abstract: The local deployment of large language models (LLMs) is gaining traction due to privacy concerns and the desire for on-premise inference. However, the energy costs on consumer hardware remain poorly characterized, as most benchmarks focus solely on accuracy. This paper presents a reproducible, hardware-level energy benchmark of nine open-source LLMs (1B to 7B parameters) executed on a single consumer GPU (RTX 4060Ti 16GB). Using the Ollama inference engine, GPU power draw was sampled at 2Hz via nvidia-smi across a fixed prompt set. We evaluate mean/peak power, total energy per prompt (J/prompt), energy per output token (J/token), and throughput (tok/s). Our findings suggest that factors beyond raw parameter count, including model architecture and quantization strategy, drive energy efficiency. Specifically, gemma3:1b and llama3.2:1b achieve the lowest energy cost (0.56 J/token and 0.65 J/token) and the highest throughput (>170 tok/s). In contrast, the 7B-Mistral model consumes up to 4.4x more energy per token than the most efficient model. Notably, qwen3.5:2b exhibits anomalously high per-prompt energy due to extended internal reasoning, highlighting the need to distinguish between token generation modes in efficiency metrics.

</details>


### [405] [A New Theory of Value for Post-AGI Economics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01432)
*Keyun Ruan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"繁荣价值理论"(FVT)，作为后AGI时代的经济学基础。FVT将价值定义为系统、机构、资产或干预对个人和社区在社交与行星约束下实现繁荣的持久能力的反事实、分配敏感贡献，并区分了价值创造与价值攫取，将价格、利润、生产率等保留为部分信号而非最终衡量标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用人工智能(AGI)可能削弱支撑传统经济价值理论的稀缺性——劳动、专业知识、信息和生产能力。如果认知工作可以广泛自动化，市场价格、劳动投入、显示性偏好、利润和总产出可能与人类和社会福祉严重脱节，因此需要一套新的经济价值理论框架。

Method: 该论文综合人工智能经济学、福利与能力理论、自动化、数字估值和生态经济学，提出FVT框架。其核心方法包括：将价值定义为多维度的繁荣贡献；将价值创造与价值攫取区分开；将稀缺驱动转向治理下的丰裕、交易转向转型、零和竞争转向正和无限博弈；并提出基于繁荣指标和投资繁荣回报(RoF)的分层架构，涵盖企业、政府、工作转型、AI治理和国家核算。

Result: 论文建立了FVT理论框架，提出后AGI时代核心经济问题不再是最大化产出，而是如何将丰富的智能转化为持久且公平分配的人类、社会和行星繁荣。该框架保留了传统经济指标作为部分信号，但不再将其作为最终进步衡量标准。

Conclusion: 后AGI经济学的核心挑战在于发展新的价值理论，将经济系统从追求产出最大化转向追求可持续的、分配公平的繁荣。FVT为这一转变提供了理论基础和操作架构。

Abstract: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) may weaken scarcities in labour, expertise, information, and productive capability that underpin established theories of economic value. If cognitive work becomes widely automatable, market price, labour input, revealed preference, profit, and gross output may diverge sharply from human and societal benefit. This paper develops Flourishing Value Theory (FVT) as a foundation for post-AGI economics. FVT defines value as the counterfactual, distribution-sensitive contribution of a system, institution, asset, or intervention to the durable capabilities of persons and communities to flourish within social and planetary constraints. It treats societal value as multidimensional, agency-preserving, regenerative, and non-compensatory at critical thresholds. Drawing on the economics of AI, welfare and capability theory, automation, digital valuation, and ecological economics, the paper distinguishes value creation from value capture and retains price, profit, productivity, and GDP as partial signals rather than final measures of progress. It develops the shifts from scarcity to governed abundance, transaction to transformation, and zero-sum rivalry to positive-sum and infinite-game dynamics, with collective expansion of consciousness as an agency-preserving form of regenerative value. Building on Flourishing Metrics and Return on Flourishing (RoF), it proposes a layered architecture for firms, governments, work transitions, AI governance, and national accounting. The central post-AGI economic problem is not how to maximise output, but how to convert abundant intelligence into durable, fairly distributed human, societal, and planetary flourishing.

</details>


### [406] [CoT-Core: Accelerating LLM Evaluation via CoT-Aware Coreset Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00014)
*Qihua Pan,Zhenheng Tang,Peijie Dong,Xiang Liu,Huacan Wang,Bo Li,Xiaowen Chu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CoT-Core是一个无需训练的核⼼问题选择框架，通过让LLM展开零样本思维链(CoT)推理轨迹并将路径投影到潜在空间，按内在逻辑等价性而非表面文本相似性对问题聚类，从而在保持高保真分数估计的同时大幅降低评估成本。在GSM8K、MMLU、MMLU-Pro和GPQA上的实验验证了其有效性，并揭示了其效果受任务复杂度门槛制约。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM评估在持续开发过程中计算开销巨大。现有核⼼集选择方法存在两个主要缺陷：(1) 基于项目反应理论(IRT)的方法需要大量历史日志，存在严重的"冷启动"瓶颈；(2) 其他方法存在表层词汇偏差，无法捕捉任务底层的推理流形。因此需要一种既能避免冷启动、又能基于深层逻辑等价性进行问题选择的评估框架。

Method: CoT-Core框架的核心思路是：1) 利用零样本思维链(CoT)提示LLM展开推理过程；2) 将推理轨迹投影到潜在空间；3) 在潜在空间中根据内在逻辑等价性而非表面文本相似性对问题聚类，从而选择具有代表性的核心问题子集进行高效评估。

Result: 在GSM8K、MMLU、MMLU-Pro和GPQA四个基准上的大量实验表明，CoT-Core在显著降低评估成本的同时保持了高保真的分数估计，并且明确了推理感知剪枝的边界条件——其有效性本质上受任务复杂度的门槛所调节。

Conclusion: CoT-Core为LLM高效评估提供了一种无需历史日志、不受表层词汇偏差影响的训练-free方案，通过推理感知的问题选择实现成本与保真度的平衡。同时，研究发现任务复杂度是决定此类推理感知剪枝方法有效性的关键调节因素。

Abstract: Evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) incurs prohibitive computational overhead during continuous development processes. While coreset selection accelerates evaluation, existing methods either suffer from a severe ``cold start'' bottleneck requiring massive historical logs (e.g., Item Response Theory) or exhibit a surface lexical bias that misses the underlying reasoning manifold of tasks. We propose CoT-Core, a novel training-free core question selection framework. Recognizing that lexically disparate questions can share equivalent underlying logic, CoT-Core prompts LLMs to unroll zero-shot Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning trajectories. Projecting these paths into a latent space effectively clusters questions by intrinsic logical equivalence rather than superficial text similarity. Extensive experiments on GSM8K, MMLU, MMLU-Pro, and GPQA demonstrate that CoT-Core drastically reduces evaluation costs while maintaining high-fidelity score estimation, and delineate the boundary conditions of reasoning-aware pruning, revealing that its efficacy is intrinsically gated by task complexity.

</details>


### [407] [Optimization and Constraint Modeling using LLMs with a Retrieval Augmented Generation Process](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00015)
*Prateek Roy,Akash Singirikonda*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文评估了基于检索增强生成（RAG）的流水线能否改善LLM在优化建模任务上的表现。通过使用Text2Zinc种子描述和LLM生成的专业角色，合成了500个优化问题并存储在Chroma向量数据库中，检索语义相似问题作为上下文指导LangChain LLM代理。在Qwen 3 30B Instruct模型上，准确率从40%提升到72%（NL4OPT）、40%到56%（MAMO Easy）、32%到56%（MAMO Complex），表明合成数据+检索增强是微调的有效替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 优化建模和约束建模需要深厚的领域专业知识和建模形式语言能力，但现有的大语言模型在生成优化公式时经常产生结构不一致或不完整的结果，特别是在组合优化场景中。作者希望探索一种无需昂贵模型重训练的实用路径来提升LLM的优化建模能力。

Method: 作者构建了一个RAG流水线：(1) 从Text2Zinc数据集获取种子描述，结合LLM生成的专业角色，合成500个优化问题，以JSON格式规范表述并关联经过验证的Python求解器脚本；(2) 将这些问题编码到Chroma向量数据库；(3) 对每个推理问题，检索语义相似的问题作为上下文指导；(4) 使用LangChain LLM代理在Qwen 3 30B Instruct模型上进行推理。

Result: 在三个基准测试集上，准确率显著提升：NL4OPT从40%提升到72%，MAMO Easy从40%提升到56%，MAMO Complex从32%提升到56%。使用经过语义验证的合成示例同时提升了解决方案的准确性和结构质量。

Conclusion: 合成的领域特定语料库结合检索增强是微调的有效替代方案，为在实际决策支持场景中部署基于LLM的优化工具提供了实用途径，无需昂贵的模型重训练。

Abstract: Both optimization modeling and constraint modeling are non-trivial problems requiring deep domain expertise and proficiency in modeling formalism languages. Despite their importance across logistics, healthcare, and supply chain management, current large language models regularly produce structurally inconsistent or incomplete optimization formulations, particularly in combinatorial settings. This paper evaluates whether a Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline built on a curated synthetic dataset can meaningfully improve LLM optimization modeling performance. A total of 500 optimization problems were synthesized using seed descriptions from the Text2Zinc dataset and professional personas created using an LLM, specified in JSON and associated with validated Python solver scripts. These problems were encoded in a Chroma vector database. For each inference problem, semantically similar problems were retrieved and used as contextual guidance for a LangChain LLM agent. Three benchmark testbeds were used to evaluate the proposed pipeline under the Qwen 3 30B Instruct model. Accuracy rose from 40% to 72% on NL4OPT, 40% to 56% on MAMO Easy, and 32% to 56% on MAMO Complex. The use of semantically validated synthetic examples greatly improves both solution accuracy and structure. The combination of synthetic dataset generation with retrieval augmentation provides an effective alternative to fine-tuning, suggesting that domain-specific synthetic corpora paired with retrieval augmentation can serve as a practical pathway for deploying LLM-based optimization tools in real-world decision-support contexts without costly model retraining.

</details>


### [408] [Memory Reward Inflation in Self-Improving LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00017)
*Mohammad Asadolahi,Amir Amini,Samira Talebi,Amirfarhad Farhadi,Azadeh Zamanifar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究无权重更新的记忆型自改进LLM智能体（外部记忆存储+评分+检索）中，因用LLM评估替代真实标签而产生的"Echo Gap"失败模式：过度自信的错误被放大复用。作者形式化提出误差独立性假设（EIA），证明其是修正分数膨胀的必要条件，并给出闭环可恢复收益公式；同时提出无需答案的去膨胀算法LUCID，在BIRD text-to-SQL基准上实现了端到端一致性提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 记忆型自改进智能体在部署时无法获得真实标签，只能依赖LLM自身的评分作为代理奖励。当LLM过高评价错误经历时，智能体会优先复用自己最自信的错误，且该误差随记忆累积而非抵消，导致性能退化。作者希望揭示这一系统性失败模式并建立其理论框架，同时开发可用的改进算法。

Method: 1. 形式化"Echo Gap"为记忆型自改进智能体中自评分偏差的系统性放大现象；2. 提出误差独立性假设（EIA），证明分数修正需要验证信号的误差与记忆偏差去相关性，且可恢复收益为这两个量的闭式函数；3. 证明膨胀不仅在按分数排序检索时发生，在纯相似度检索（部署实际使用场景）下同样累积；4. 设计LUCID去膨胀算法，无需真实答案即可校正分数。

Result: LUCID在BIRD text-to-SQL基准上将执行准确率提升至56.9%，显著超过Memento风格自评智能体（54.0%，+2.9点平均增益）和无记忆同架构智能体（52.4%）。

Conclusion: 作者证明了自评分记忆型智能体中存在系统性分数膨胀问题（Echo Gap），EIA是修正该问题的必要条件而非充分描述；LUCID算法能在无答案场景下有效去膨胀并带来一致的端到端收益，为可扩展的记忆型自改进智能体提供了理论基础和实用方案。

Abstract: Self-improving LLM agents increasingly learn from experience without updating any weights. Each episode is stored in an external memory, scored, and retrieved for similar future tasks to shape later behavior. Viewed through a reward lens, the stored score is a proxy reward for an implicit, non-parametric policy. Each retrieved episode then becomes a policy-improvement step whose reliability hinges on how that score is produced. In deployment, ground-truth labels are unavailable, so the stored reward is at best an LLM assessment. This substitution creates a failure mode, the *Echo Gap*, across the memory-based self-improving agents and model families studied. Incorrect episodes receive inflated rewards; thus, the agent preferentially reuses the very mistakes it has most confident in. Because the error compounds through memory rather than averaging out and the confirming judge's errors remain correlated with the original self-grading bias, so it cannot identify which memories are overvalued. The missing property is formalized as the *Error-Independence Assumption* (EIA), which we prove is a *necessary* condition for correcting the inflation, not merely a description of a good verifier: a usable signal must track truth *and* decorrelate its error from the memory bias, and the recoverable payoff is a closed-form function of exactly those two quantities. We further show the inflation compounds not only when retrieval ranks by the stored score but also under plain similarity retrieval which is the regime the deployed agent uses. Finally, the answer-free de-inflation algorithm LUCID delivers a consistent end-to-end gain on the BIRD text-to-SQL benchmark. It raises execution accuracy to $56.9\%$, above both a Memento-style self-graded agent ($54.0\%$, a $+2.9$-point mean gain across seeds) and a memory-less agent of identical architecture ($52.4\%$).

</details>


### [409] [Request-Level Energy Attribution for Batched LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00026)
*Qi Luo,Kunlin Li,Ziwen Wang,Dongsheng Wang,Yun Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: JouleShare是一个用于批量LLM服务中请求级能耗归因的框架，它通过离线基准测试建立精确的Shapley能量地面真值，并用轻量级校准模型JCalib在服务时预测能量份额。实验表明token按比例归因与真实Shapley值偏差较大（归一化L1约0.44），而JCalib可将误差降至0.116-0.177，显著提高公平性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 批量LLM服务提高了吞吐量但使能耗计费复杂化。GPU功耗遥测是聚合级的，而可持续性报告、费用分摊和工作负载分析需要请求级能耗。现有基准只报告模型/阶段/token级能耗，缺乏测量到的请求级地面真值，无法评估实践中使用的计费规则与公平分配之间的偏差。

Method: JouleShare包含两个组件：(1) 离线基准测试框架，通过vLLM重放请求子集、整合GPU功耗遥测并计算每个请求的精确Shapley能量；(2) 轻量级校准模型JCalib，从廉价请求特征学习预测Shapley份额用于服务时。此外还使用采样Shapley扩展到更大组规模。

Result: 在16个模型/工作负载运行中，token按比例归因与精确Shapley平均偏差0.440（静态批处理）和0.458（连续批处理），该差距在三种数据中心GPU上均复现。JCalib将误差降至0.116（静态）和0.177（连续），甚至优于在线不可用的独立测量基线，同时保持精确的批量能量效率。

Conclusion: token归因不能作为批量执行下边际能量的可靠代理；通过测量的Shapley地面真值可以校准低成本的请求特征，实现更公平的能耗归因。

Abstract: Batched LLM serving improves throughput but complicates energy accounting. GPU power telemetry is aggregate, whereas sustainability reporting, chargeback, and workload analysis often require request-level energy charges. Existing inference-energy benchmarks report model-, phase-, or token-level energy, and recent carbon-accounting work motivates Shapley fairness conceptually. Neither provides measured request-level ground truth, so how far the accounting rules used in practice deviate from a fair allocation has remained unknown. We present JouleShare, an attribution framework with two components. An offline harness establishes this ground truth by replaying request subsets under vLLM with a reproducible protocol, integrating GPU power telemetry, and computing exact Shapley energy for each request. A lightweight calibration model, JCalib, then learns to predict Shapley shares from cheap request features for use at serving time. Across 16 model/workload runs, token-proportional attribution differs from exact Shapley by 0.440 normalized L1 on average under static batching and by 0.458 under continuous batching, a gap that reproduces across three data-center GPUs. JCalib reduces this error to 0.116 under static batching and 0.177 under continuous batching, below even a standalone-measurement baseline that is unavailable online, while preserving exact batch-energy efficiency. Sampled Shapley extends the measured reference to larger group sizes, where the gap persists and a single offline calibration remains the most accurate deployable rule. The results show that token attribution is not a reliable proxy for marginal energy under batched execution, and that measured Shapley ground truth can calibrate low-cost request features toward fairer attribution.

</details>


### [410] [Motif-Mamba: network motif improved mamba for long-range sequence modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00027)
*Chonghe Hao,Yue Sun,Jian Zhang,Yansong Wang,Wangzi Yao,Yunjie Yao,Tielin Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Motif-Mamba是一种结构化状态空间模型，通过在Mamba架构中引入基于三节点网络模体（motif）约束的低秩循环通路，增强状态维度间的交互通信，同时保持线性时间循环结构，在长序列外推、语言建模和脑机接口解码任务上均优于Mamba基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Mamba虽然通过选择性状态空间递归实现了线性时间的长序列建模，但其主导的（predominantly）对角状态转移矩阵限制了状态维度之间的显式交互（explicit interactions），导致模型难以充分捕捉跨维度的复杂动态关系。作者希望在不牺牲线性时间复杂度的前提下，增强状态维度间的通信能力。

Method: Motif-Mamba在Mamba的基础上增加了一个模体约束的低秩循环通路：首先将隐藏状态投影到一个紧凑的动态子空间，然后施加由三节点网络模体启发的导向交互（motif-guided interactions），最后将动态结果映射回原始状态空间。这一设计在保留Mamba线性时间递归结构的同时，增强了跨维度信息交换。

Result: 在长序列外推、语言建模基准测试以及脑机接口解码三个任务上的实验表明，Motif-Mamba相对于Mamba主干模型均取得了一致的性能提升（consistent improvements）。

Conclusion: 模体导向的低秩动态为长范围序列建模提供了一种有效的结构先验（structural prior），证明了在状态空间模型中引入网络模体动力学可以有效改善跨维度交互，且无需牺牲线性时间的计算效率。

Abstract: Efficient long-sequence modeling remains a central challenge for large language models, as self-attention scales quadratically with sequence length. Mamba offers a linear-time alternative through selective state space recurrence, but its predominantly diagonal state transitions restrict explicit interactions among state dimensions. We propose Motif-Mamba, a structured state space model that augments Mamba with a motif-constrained low-rank recurrent pathway. Inspired by the dynamics of three-node network motifs, the proposed pathway projects hidden states into a compact dynamical subspace, imposes motif-guided interactions, and maps the resulting dynamics back to the original state space. This design enhances cross-dimensional communication while preserving the linear-time recurrent structure of Mamba. Experiments on long-sequence extrapolation, language modeling benchmarks, and brain--computer interface decoding show consistent improvements over Mamba backbones, suggesting that motif-guided low-rank dynamics provide an effective structural prior for long-range sequence modeling.

</details>


### [411] [Nova: An End-to-End MLIR Compiler for Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00029)
*Adwaid Suresh,Aparna A,Harshini V M,Jona Delcy C A,Killi Uma Maheswara Rao,Ram Charan Golla,Surendra Vendra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Nova是一个自动化的端到端JIT编译器，通过捕获eager execution并将前向/反向传播统一为单一值语义方言，实现激进的全图优化。它利用Analytic Configurator基于算术强度确定性推导最优执行调度（无需搜索），并通过结构哈希运行时直接从计算结构合成细粒度内核。在RTX 3060上，Nova在TF32矩阵乘法上匹配或略超cuBLAS和XLA；模型层面比PyTorch吞吐量高10.6%，比XLA高4.4%，内存占用减少29%，能在12GB GPU上训练PyTorch无法处理的1.44亿参数模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型性能受限于高级数学运算到底层硬件映射的效率。高层张量框架（如PyTorch）的eager执行模型缺乏全图可见性和对硬件/内存的细粒度控制，无法原生最大化物理硬件利用率。因此需要一种自动化编译器来弥合高层抽象与底层硬件之间的差距。

Method: 1) 捕获eager执行并将前向和反向传播统一为单一值语义方言，实现全图级优化；2) 利用Analytic Configurator基于算术强度确定性推导最优执行调度，将搜索时间降至零；3) 采用结构哈希运行时，直接从计算结构合成细粒度内核（直至寄存器级别的调优）；4) 跨操作边界融合操作、优化复杂内存层次结构。

Result: 在RTX 3060上：TF32矩阵乘法在多数形状下匹配或略超cuBLAS和XLA（相对误差<5e-4）；4200万参数模型上吞吐量比PyTorch高10.6%、比XLA高4.4%；内存占用比PyTorch减少29%，成功在12GB GPU上以17,900 tokens/s训练1.44亿参数模型（PyTorch在此遭遇OOM）。

Conclusion: Nova证明通过消除搜索式优化并采用确定性的解析配置策略，可以实现对硬件映射的绝对控制，在不损失数值精度的情况下同时提升吞吐量和降低内存占用，使消费级GPU能够训练更大规模的模型。

Abstract: The performance of deep learning models at scale relies heavily on how effectively high-level mathematical operations are mapped to underlying physical hardware. While high-level tensor frameworks provide flexible abstractions for model design, their eager execution models inherently lack the whole-graph visibility and granular control over hardware and memory required to maximize physical hardware utilization natively. To bridge this gap, we designed Nova, an automated end-to-end JIT compiler whose defining purpose is to achieve absolute control over this hardware mapping: fusing operations across operation boundaries, optimizing complex memory hierarchies, and tuning execution down to the register level. By capturing eager executions and unifying forward and backward passes into a single value-semantic dialect, Nova unlocks aggressive whole-graph optimizations. It then utilizes an Analytic Configurator to deterministically derive optimal execution schedules based on arithmetic intensity, dropping search time to zero. Backed by a structural hashing runtime, Nova synthesizes fine-grained kernels directly from the computation's structure. In our evaluations on an RTX 3060, Nova matches or modestly exceeds cuBLAS and XLA on TF32 matmuls on most shapes, maintaining a stringent < 5e-4 relative error. At the model level, Nova achieves up to 10.6% greater throughput than PyTorch and 4.4% greater than XLA on a 42-million parameter model, without compromising on numerical fidelity. Crucially, by reducing the memory footprint by up to 29% relative to PyTorch, Nova successfully trains a 144-million parameter model at 17,900 tokens/s where PyTorch encounters Out-Of-Memory (OOM) failures on the same 12 GB consumer GPU.

</details>


### [412] [SIRIN: A Unified Toolkit for Detecting Contextual Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented and Memory-Grounded LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00033)
*Julia Belikova,Rauf Parchiev,Mikhail Filimonov,Konstantin Polev,Andrey Savchenko,Maksim Makarenko*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SIRIN是一个统一的工具包和交互式Web界面，用于检测检索增强、智能体及记忆增强LLM系统中的上下文幻觉（即流畅但缺乏证据支持的响应）。它整合了三种检测器范式（表征探测、不确定性估计和评审式验证），并支持生成前查询可回答性判断，提供响应级和跨度级检查，支持白盒和黑盒设置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着RAG、智能体和记忆增强系统的广泛应用，上下文幻觉问题日益严重，但现有工具通常各自为政，仅支持单一检测方法或单一范式，缺乏统一的接口、配置系统和评估流程。此外，生成前的查询可回答性判断也未被整合到检测流程中。

Method: SIRIN将三种检测器范式（表征探测、不确定性估计、评审式验证）统一到一个界面和配置系统中，同时整合生成前查询可回答性判断；提供响应级和跨度级检查，支持白盒和黑盒设置；通过Web UI支持用户提交的上下文-查询-答案三元组的实时分析，包括幻觉评分、无依据跨度高亮及检测器并排对比；采用轻量级插件设计便于添加新检测器。

Result: SIRIN在幻觉检测、查询可回答性判断以及作为长期记忆系统中的忠实度门控（faithfulness gate）等任务上得到了验证。源代码已公开。

Conclusion: SIRIN提供了一个统一、可扩展且可视化的上下文幻觉检测解决方案，弥补了现有工具在范式整合和可用性方面的不足，为RAG、智能体和记忆系统提供了实用的评估基础设施。

Abstract: SIRIN (Semantic Inconsistency Recognition and Inspection Nexus) is a unified toolkit and interactive web UI for detecting contextual hallucinations (fluent, plausible responses unsupported by the provided evidence) in retrieval-augmented, agentic, and memory-grounded LLM systems. SIRIN unifies three detector paradigms (representation probing, uncertainty estimation, and judge-style verification) and the complementary task of pre-generation query answerability under one interface, configuration system, and evaluation pipeline, supporting response- and span-level inspection in both white-box and black-box settings. The web UI enables live analysis of user-supplied context-query-answer triples through hallucination scores, unsupported-span highlighting, and side-by-side detector comparison, with a lightweight plug-in design for adding new detectors. We demonstrate SIRIN on hallucination detection, query answerability, and as a faithfulness gate within long-term memory systems.
  The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/sb-ai-lab/SIRIN.

</details>


### [413] [Linguistic Context Recodes Visual Representations in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00035)
*Brian Song,Michael A. Lepori,Ellie Pavlick*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了视觉-语言模型（VLMs）中语言诱导的视觉表征重编码现象：一是存在抽象的目标相关参考表征（可通过对比转向向量提取并因果影响预测），二是语言提示会导致后期层对目标相关属性的选择性放大（属性调制），并通过因果干预证明该调制中介了模型响应分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究大多将VLM中的视觉表征视为静态信息仓库，由语言表征来操纵使用。然而，VLM在面对目标导向的语言任务时，视觉表征是否会被语言主动重编码仍然缺乏系统性的刻画，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 1) 识别语言提示下的抽象参考表征，提取对比（contrastive）转向向量（steering vectors），并验证其对模型预测的因果作用；2) 通过跨目标、跨任务上下文、以及从合成图到自然图像的泛化实验证明参考表征的抽象性；3) 在后期层中检测语言诱导的属性调制现象，记录目标相关属性在视觉表征中的选择性放大；4) 进行因果干预实验以证明属性调制介导了VLM的响应分布。

Result: 1) 参考表征是抽象的，可泛化到不同物体、任务上下文，甚至从合成图像泛化到自然图像；2) 后期层会选择性放大目标相关属性（属性调制）；3) 因果干预证明属性调制介导了模型的响应分布，表明视觉令牌并非静态信息库。

Conclusion: 本文支持VLM中跨模态处理的动态观点：视觉表征在语言查询下会被主动调制重编码，而非作为静态信息仓库被操作。这为理解VLM的视觉-语言交互机制提供了新视角。

Abstract: Goal-directed visual processing is a hallmark of human visual intelligence, resulting in representations that support downstream tasks such as categorization or search. Though vision-language models (VLMs) are often faced with these same tasks, their ability to recode visual representations when presented with goal-directed language remains poorly characterized. Indeed, prior work largely treats visual representations in VLMs as static repositories of visual information that are manipulated by language representations. In the present work, we provide evidence for two concrete instances of language-induced recoding of visual representations. First, we identify an abstract reference representation that denotes which objects are goal-relevant under a natural language prompt. We extract contrastive steering vectors corresponding to this reference representation and demonstrate that they are causally implicated in model predictions. These reference representations are abstract in that they generalize to different objects, different task contexts, and even from synthetic to naturalistic images. Second, we demonstrate language-induced attribute modulation: later layers selectively amplify goal-relevant attributes in visual representations of objects. We demonstrate this phenomenon across a range of different prompts. Finally, we provide a causal intervention that demonstrates that attribute modulation mediates a VLM's response distribution. Together, our results support a more dynamic account of cross-modality processing in VLMs -- rather than vision tokens serving as static repositories of information, they are modulated to support queries articulated in language.

</details>


### [414] [RAG-TESTER: Automated End-to-End Testing of Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00054)
*Ange Maiztegi,Jon Ayerdi,Miren Illarramendi,Aitor Arrieta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出RagTester，一种面向RAG系统的自动化端到端测试方法。该方法自动生成检索文档、测试输入和预期输出，并使用LLM作为评判者评估回答质量。在72,000次测试执行中，RagTester检测到21,633个失败，比基线方法多6.6%，在24个配置中优于基线20个。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG系统的可靠性依赖于生成模型、嵌入模型、检索机制和提示词构建策略之间的复杂交互，但目前缺乏系统化的端到端测试方法来评估这些组件之间的协同效果。

Method: RagTester包含四个步骤：(1)生成检索文档、测试输入和预期输出；(2)执行测试；(3)使用LLM作为评判者评估回答。测试生成策略针对复杂段落、不支持查询和文档覆盖率标准进行设计。

Result: 使用8个LLM和6个嵌入模型组成24个兼容配置进行评估，与基线测试输入生成器对比。在72,000次测试执行中检测到21,633个失败（比基线多6.6%），在20/24个配置中表现优于基线。检测到的失败包括检索不准确、不支持的回答、检索上下文使用不完整以及复杂段落理解困难。

Conclusion: 基于覆盖率的测试生成能有效暴露检索与生成组件交互引起的失败，支持在部署前评估RAG配置。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enables Large Language Models (LLMs) to use external and domain-specific knowledge, but its reliability depends on the interaction between the generative model, embedding model, retrieval mechanism, and prompt construction strategy. We present RagTester, an automated end-to-end testing approach for RAG systems. RagTester generates retrieval documents, test inputs, and expected outputs; executes the tests; and evaluates the resulting answers using an LLM as a judge. Its test-generation strategy targets complex passages, unsupported queries, and document-coverage criteria. We evaluate RagTester using eight LLMs and six embedding models, yielding 24 compatible configurations, and compare it with a baseline test-input generator. Across 72,000 test executions, RagTester detected 21,633 failures, 6.6% more than the baseline, and outperformed it in 20 of the 24 configurations. The detected failures include inaccurate retrieval, unsupported answers, incomplete use of retrieved context, and difficulties interpreting complex passages. These results show that coverage-oriented test generation can effectively expose failures caused by the interaction between retrieval and generation components and support the assessment of RAG configurations before deployment.

</details>


### [415] [H+ Embedding: Harmonizing Global and Token-Level Retrieval with Context-Dependent Phrases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00065)
*Shusen Zhang,Junyi Hu,Ye Feng,Ziteng Wang,Zhaoyuan Pan,Guosheng Dong,Xiaojun Yuan,Jiangshou Hong,Xiangzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出H+ Embedding，一种统一的多粒度检索器，通过预测可变长度短语分区并执行加权MaxSim交互，在全局向量压缩和token级交互之间提供了中间质量-成本的检索方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在术语密集的检索场景（尤其是医学领域）中，多词实体、缩写、数字约束和组合概念需要被保留。但现有方法处于两个极端：单向量检索器过度压缩局部相关信号，而token级晚期交互保留每个子词导致索引、存储和评分成本过高。因此作者提出疑问：上下文相关的短语能否作为全局向量和token之间的有用检索单元？

Method: 提出H+ Embedding统一多粒度检索器，包含三个关键设计：(1) 预测可变长度短语分区；(2) 将未覆盖的token保留为单例；(3) 应用重要性引导的单元选择与加权MaxSim交互机制。

Result: 在16个科学、医学和双语任务上，短语检索分支比全局检索分支提高了6.91个宏nDCG@10。同时，该方法在使用比Token少13.7%的文档向量的情况下几乎与Token性能相当，并在中等向量预算下优于内容无关的分组规则。

Conclusion: 上下文相关的短语交互为实际检索系统提供了介于全局压缩与token级交互之间的中间质量-成本平衡点，是一种有效的折中方案。

Abstract: Terminology-intensive retrieval, especially in medical settings, depends on preserving multi-word entities, abbreviations, numerical constraints, and compositional concepts. However, existing representations lie at two extremes: single-vector retrievers often over-compress local relevance signals, while token-level late interaction retains every tokenizer subword at substantial indexing, storage, and scoring cost. This mismatch raises a natural question: can context-dependent phrases provide a useful retrieval unit between global vectors and tokens? We introduce H+ Embedding, a unified multi-granularity retriever that predicts variable-length phrase partitions, preserves uncovered tokens as singletons, and applies importance-guided unit selection with weighted MaxSim interaction. Across 16 scientific, medical, and bilingual tasks, its phrase retrieval branch exceeds the global retrieval branch by 6.91 macro nDCG@10. It also nearly matches Token while using 13.7% fewer document vectors and outperforms content-independent grouping rules under moderate vector budgets. Context-dependent phrase interaction therefore provides an intermediate quality-cost point between global compression and token-level interaction for practical retrieval systems.

</details>


### [416] [Evolutionary Curriculum Learning Improves Biological Sequence Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00697)
*Richard Zhu,Kento Nishi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出进化课程学习（ECL）策略，通过按进化距离从近到远逐步向VAE模型暴露序列，提升蛋白质变异效应预测和RNA序列生成的下游任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准生物VAE训练将序列视为可交换的，忽略了同源序列的进化结构。作者希望利用进化距离这一先验信息来组织训练课程，从而提升模型性能。

Method: ECL通过从锚点序列出发，按幂律扩展调度逐步增加训练序列的进化距离，渐进式暴露更具挑战性的多样序列。

Result: 在EVE（p53和PTEN）及RfamGen上，ECL提升了性能。p53 AUROC从0.981升至0.989；PTEN达到1.000（基线不稳定，均值0.905）；RNA三个家族bit scores均提升，12/15运行超越种子匹配基线。

Conclusion: 渐进式扩展进化距离优于固定邻域和均匀随机采样，进化距离可作为生物序列建模中训练课程排序的有效归纳偏置。

Abstract: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) trained on multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) have emerged as powerful generative models for biological sequences, with applications ranging from disease variant prediction to functional RNA design. However, standard biological VAE training treats all sequences as exchangeable, ignoring the rich evolutionary structure that organizes homologous sequences from evolutionarily close to highly divergent. We propose Evolutionary Curriculum Learning (ECL), a training strategy that exploits this structure by progressively exposing the model to sequences of increasing evolutionary distance from sampled anchors, following a power-law expansion schedule. Applied to two architecturally distinct VAE models and two biological domains--protein variant effect prediction with EVE and RNA family sequence generation with RfamGen--ECL improves downstream task performance across five random seeds per configuration. Mean ClinVar classification AUROC rises from 0.981 to 0.989 for p53; for PTEN, ECL attains 1.000 in every seed whereas the baseline is unstable (mean 0.905, falling as low as 0.54). For RNA, ECL raises mean covariance-model bit scores on all three families tested and exceeds its seed-matched baseline in 12 of 15 training runs, though with only three families the effect cannot be established as significant at the family level. Ablation experiments show that progressively expanding the sampled sequences by evolutionary distance outperforms fixed-size neighborhood sampling in addition to uniform random sampling. Evolutionary distance is therefore a useful inductive bias for ordering the training curriculum in biological sequence modeling.

</details>


### [417] [Agentic Coding in the Wild: Characterizing GitHub Copilot Traces at Production Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00101)
*Banruo Liu,Haoran Qiu,Íñigo Goiri,Rodrigo Fonseca,Ricardo Bianchini,Esha Choukse*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次对生产规模的AI编码代理（GitHub Copilot）工作负载进行了特征化分析，使用2026年6月的采样数据（320万用户、1300万会话、7.61亿次LLM调用、95万亿token）。研究发现代理编码会话具有稀疏的用户回合、高KV缓存命中率（回合内90%，跨回合降至55%）、长尾分布的token消耗和工具调用等特征，并设计了能捕捉86-90%总空闲时间的轻量级空闲时间预测器，为代理原生的LLM服务基础设施提供了实证基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码代理（如GitHub Copilot、Claude Code、Codex）将多步LLM推理与工具执行交织在一起，形成与传统聊天机器人截然不同的工作负载。然而，现有LLM服务系统大多基于聊天工作负载设计，缺乏对代理工作负载的生产规模理解，因此需要实测数据来揭示其独特属性并指导系统设计。

Method: 从2026年6月的GitHub Copilot生产环境中采样大规模追踪数据（320万用户、1300万会话、7.61亿LLM调用、95万亿token），对代理编码会话的结构（用户回合与代理循环）、KV缓存命中率（回合内/跨回合/事件失效）、工作负载多样性（token消耗、时间跨度、工具调用）以及用户空闲模式进行系统性统计与特征分析，并设计轻量级空闲时间预测器。

Result: 发现代理编码会话具有稀疏用户回合，每个回合展开为几乎总是伴随工具执行的自主代理循环；回合内KV缓存命中率平均90%，跨回合降至55%，在模型切换或上下文压缩等事件后急剧失效；工作流和用户行为呈现多样且长尾的token消耗、时间跨度和工具调用特征；代理周转时间短但用户回合边界处有数分钟的空闲期，轻量级空闲时间预测器可捕获86-90%的总空闲时间。

Conclusion: 代理编码工作负载的独特属性（高但易碎的KV缓存、回合边界长空闲期、长尾多样性）挑战了当前LLM服务系统的核心假设，论文为代理原生（agent-native）的基础设施设计提供了实证基础，特别是通过空闲时间预测实现的资源编排优化。

Abstract: AI coding agents like GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and Codex interleave multi-step LLM inference with tool execution, creating a workload different from chatbots. We present the first production-scale characterization of this workload using sampled GitHub Copilot traces from June 2026, comprising 3.2M users, 13M sessions, 761M LLM calls, and 95T tokens.
  Our analysis reveals distinctive workload properties with important systems implications. For example, agentic coding sessions consist of sparse user-initiated turns, each unfolding into an autonomous agent loop of LLM calls almost always coupled with tool execution. This structure yields KV cache hit rates averaging 90% within a turn, but falling to 55\% across turn boundaries and drastically invalidated after events like model switches or context compaction. Diverse workflows and user behaviors are observed with variable and long-tailed token consumption, time span, and tool calls. We highlight the difference between quick agentic turnaround times and the minutes-long user idle periods at turn boundaries, and design a lightweight idle-time predictor that captures 86-90\% of total idle time, enabling proactive decisions for efficient resource orchestration. These findings challenge assumptions underlying current LLM-serving systems and provide an empirical foundation for agent-native infrastructure.

</details>


### [418] [Humans Are More Diverse: Frontier LLMs Show Extreme Policies in Idealised AI Development Races](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01193)
*Phu Hoa Pham,Duy Minh Dao Sy,Trung Kiet Huynh,Phu Quy Nguyen Lam,Chi Nguyen Tran,Minh Trung Le,Phong Hao Le,Dinh Nam Nguyen,Thien Ky Nguyen Dong,Elias Fernandez Domingos,Le Hong Trang,The Anh Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究AI开发竞赛中多智能体的安全困境博弈，通过严格的审计门控验证后，考察了2-5个玩家的LLM代理在战略安全行为上的表现，发现强规则记忆可能伴随弱状态追踪和期望收益计算，且不同模型间的行为模式差异很大，因此强调多智能体AI竞赛模拟需要有效性检查和轨迹级分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI开发竞赛构成多智能体安全困境，但此前研究通常假设代理理解游戏就直接解释其行为。作者认为有效动作并不能证明代理真正理解游戏，因此需要在行为解释之前进行严格的审计验证。

Method: 首先验证游戏引擎，然后测试规则回忆、状态追踪、收益计算以及在不同等价任务描述下的稳定性，再将LLM动作序列与进化博弈论基准和已发表的人类数据进行比较，并探索不同模型、风险条件、人设和2-5人竞赛中的差异。

Result: 审计显示强规则回忆可以与弱状态追踪和期望收益计算共存；提供验证过的算术和改变响应表示会改变后续动作。七个模型端点中，聚合率掩盖了动作序列、对对手反应和竞赛位置反应方面的巨大差异。三到五人竞赛中的模式也是模型特定的。

Conclusion: 多智能体AI竞赛模拟在输出被描述为战略性、类人或安全感知之前，需要进行有效性检查和轨迹级分析。研究结果是探索性的，仅适用于所测试的模型、提示和解码设置。

Abstract: An AI development race creates a multi-agent safety dilemma. Each company can develop slowly and safely, or move faster while taking a risk that may remove its final reward. We use this repeated game to study strategic safety behaviour among large language model (LLM) agents in races with two to five players. However, a valid action does not show that an agent understands the game. We therefore place an audit gate before behavioural interpretation. We first verify the game engine, then test rule recall, state tracking, payoff calculation, and stability under different but equivalent task descriptions. We then compare LLM action sequences with an evolutionary game-theory benchmark and published human data, and explore differences across models, risk conditions, personas, and two- to five-player races. The audit shows that strong rule recall can coexist with weak state tracking and expected-payoff calculation. Providing verified arithmetic and changing the response representation can also change later actions, even when the game rules stay fixed. Across seven tested model endpoints, aggregate rates hide large differences in action sequences, responses to opponents, and responses to race position. Patterns across the tested three- to five-player races are also model-specific rather than a single effect of adding competitors. These results show why multi-agent AI-race simulations need validity checks and trajectory-level analysis before their outputs are described as strategic, human-like, or safety-aware. Our findings are exploratory and apply only to the tested models, prompts, and decoding settings.

</details>


### [419] [Can LLM Agents Price Competitively? A Dynamic Multi-Attribute Auction Benchmark for Agentic Commerce](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00102)
*Shimaa Ahmed,Yiwei Cai,Mohsen Minaei,Rahul Rachuri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Bazaar——一个动态密封投标基准，用于测试LLM驱动的智能体在多属性拍卖中的定价能力。通过对11个前沿LLM进行系统评估，发现客户获取能力与盈利能力排名不一致，且需求冲击下学习速度与信念更新速度呈负相关。即使最强智能体也只达到事后最优利润的三分之一，说明LLM在智能体商业中仍有很大提升空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体商业正从概念走向实际部署，支付网络、零售商和AI平台已开始让智能体代表商家和消费者进行交易。然而，LLM能否在客户偏好隐藏、竞争对手实时调整、需求可能突变的真实市场中胜任定价，尚未被系统测试。现有研究缺乏一个能在动态条件下精确评估LLM定价能力的基准。

Method: 作者引入Bazaar，一个动态密封投标基准，专门用于多属性拍卖场景。该基准具有真实的动态特性（客户偏好隐藏、竞争实时调整、需求突变），但底层基于闭式客户效用函数，因此可以精确评估智能体的表现。作者对来自四个提供商的11个前沿LLM进行了系统测试。

Result: 客户获取领先的智能体（如Gemini 3.1 Pro）往往不是利润领先者（如Opus 4.6）。在需求冲击下排名再次变化：冲击前学习最快的智能体在冲击后信念修正最慢，而Gemini 3.1 Pro尽管利润不领先，但恢复最快。然而，即使最强的智能体也只能获得事后最优利润的三分之一以下。

Conclusion: 当前LLM在智能体商业方面取得了一定进展，但仍有显著提升空间。不同指标（客户获取vs利润）和不同市场条件（稳定vs需求冲击）下的排名不一致性表明，LLM定价能力具有高度情境依赖性，需要针对性改进。

Abstract: Agentic commerce is moving from concept to deployed infrastructure: payment networks, retailers, and AI platforms are setting the stage for agents to transact on behalf of merchants and consumers. Yet whether the LLMs behind these agents can price competently in real markets, where customer preferences are hidden, competitors adapt in real time, and demand can shift without warning, has not been systematically tested. We introduce Bazaar, a dynamic sealed-bid benchmark for multi-attribute auction under these conditions. Despite its dynamics, the benchmark is grounded in closed-form customer utilities, enabling exact evaluation. Across 11 frontier LLMs from four providers, the leading agents on customer acquisition (e.g. Gemini 3.1 Pro) are often not the leading agents on profit (e.g. Opus 4.6). The ranking shifts again under demand shocks: agents that learned fastest pre-shock are typically the slowest to revise their beliefs afterwards, while Gemini 3.1 Pro recovers fastest despite not leading on profit. However, even the strongest agent captures less than a third of hindsight-optimal profit, suggesting current LLMs are progressing in agentic commerce but leave substantial headroom.

</details>


### [420] [Shared Organizational Memory for Enterprise Coding Agents: System Design and Deployment Snapshot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00122)
*Harsh Rao Dhanyamraju,Leonidas Raghav*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个企业级编码智能体的共享组织记忆系统，该系统将经验捕获作为编码工作流中的平台级功能，自动收集任务相关的开发者经验（需贡献者批准），并将其整理为可复用的问答记忆，同时进行安全与隐私风险过滤，供未来智能体检索使用。该系统已在生产环境中部署，当前正在评估其对检索和编码任务的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业编码智能体依赖工具和检索，但企业知识（内部DSL、专有平台、本地惯例、近期修复、隐性工作流）往往不在公共训练数据或正式文档中。现有知识接口虽能暴露存储资源，但依赖智能体主动识别并显式记录有价值的经验，导致经验捕获与编码工作流脱节，开发经验被反复"重新发现"，造成效率损失。

Method: 该系统设计了一个完整的生命周期：1) 捕获环节——在编码工作流中自动收集与任务相关的经验，需贡献者批准；2) 策展环节——将原始经验整理为可复用的问答（Q&A）记忆格式；3) 安全门控——过滤明显的安全与隐私风险；4) 检索环节——供未来编码智能体检索使用。该部署是持续进行中的生产系统。

Result: 该系统的生产部署正在进行中，论文提供了部署生命周期和运营快照的描述。目前对检索和编码任务的实际影响仍处于评估阶段，尚未给出最终效果数据。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种将知识捕获内嵌于编码工作流而非依赖智能体主动记录的组织记忆框架，解决了企业隐性知识反复发现的问题。系统的安全与隐私门控以及"捕获-策展-检索"的闭环设计是其核心贡献，但效果验证仍在进行中。

Abstract: Enterprise coding agents rely on tools and retrieval, yet enterprise knowledge often remains outside public training data and formal documentation: internal DSLs, proprietary platforms, local conventions, recent fixes, and tacit workflows. Existing knowledge interfaces expose stored resources but still depend on agents recognizing and explicitly recording lessons worth reusing, disconnecting capture from the coding workflow and leaving development experience repeatedly rediscovered. We report an ongoing production deployment of a shared organizational memory system that makes capture a platform-level part of coding work: it collects task-adjacent experience with contributor approval, curates it into reusable question-answer memories, gates obvious security and privacy risks, and retrieves memories for future agents. This short paper describes the deployed lifecycle and an operational snapshot. Effects on retrieval and coding tasks remain under evaluation.

</details>


### [421] [A Contractualist Argumentation Framework for Moral Decision-Making](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01937)
*Luis Marcos-Vidal,Giulio Antonio Abbo,Tony Belpaeme*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于Scanlon契约主义的道德决策形式化框架，使用ASPIC+结构化论证框架并结合基于价值的过滤机制，构建了"契约主义论证框架"（Contractualist Argumentation Framework），使智能体在共享环境中的道德决策能够通过论证语义进行形式化推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主智能体在共享环境中做出的决策会影响多个利益可能冲突的个体，需要一种正式框架来支持道德决策，而现有方法缺乏对"原则上无人能合理拒绝"这一契约主义核心思想的系统形式化支撑。

Method: 采用Scanlon契约主义伦理理论作为道德判断基础，使用ASPIC+结构化论证框架进行操作化，并扩展基于价值的过滤机制来建模每个智能体的价值观如何决定哪些理由在道德上是相关的；由此构建契约主义论证框架，通过论证语义对智能体的理由进行形式化表示、比较和评估。

Result: 通过一个家庭场景的工作示例展示了该框架的应用，并讨论了其与现有基于价值论证方法的区别与联系。

Conclusion: 该框架为自主智能体的道德决策提供了基于契约主义的形式化推理基础，能够处理多个智能体间利益冲突的场景，并与已有价值论证方法形成互补。

Abstract: Autonomous agents operating in shared environments must make decisions that affect multiple individuals with potentially conflicting interests. We propose a formal framework for moral decision-making grounded in Scanlon's contractualism, an ethical theory that evaluates the permissibility of actions in terms of principles that no one could reasonably reject. To operationalise contractualist reasoning, we use ASPIC+, a structured argumentation framework, extended with value-based filtering to model how each agent's values determine which reasons are morally relevant in the first place. The result is a Contractualist Argumentation Framework in which agents' reasons are formally represented, compared, and evaluated through argumentation semantics. We illustrate the approach through a worked example in a domestic setting and discuss its relation to existing value-based argumentation approaches.

</details>


### [422] [AgentStream: How Well Do Self-Evolving LLM Agents Perform Under Streaming Tasks?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00155)
*Dong Yan,Jian Liang,Dapeng Hu,Ran He,Nicholas Jing Yuan,Qi Zhang,Tieniu Tan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出AgentStream框架，用于在真实流式任务场景下评估自进化大语言模型智能体，涵盖Isolated、Sequential和Interleaved三种流式场景，并在三个前沿基础模型上组合评估五种自进化方法。研究发现自进化可靠性随流式场景变化、其收益受模型能力门控且与模型强度呈非单调关系，没有任何单一方法在所有模型和场景中占优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自进化智能体的研究主要采用独立评估方式，无法反映智能体在真实流式环境中面对多样复杂任务流时的行为。作者认为这一差距导致自进化智能体在现实流式场景中的表现仍不为人知，因此需要新的评估框架来弥合这一空白。

Method: 构建AgentStream统一评估框架，将智能体基准组织为可配置的任务流，并在测试时实例化三种流式场景（Isolated、Sequential、Interleaved），逐步变化任务流的范围和领域组成。在此基础上，组合评估五种代表性自进化方法和三个前沿基础模型，解耦模型能力、方法架构和流式场景对自进化的联合影响。

Result: 发现自进化的可靠性在不同流式场景下存在显著差异；自进化的收益受模型能力门控，且与模型强度呈非单调关系；没有单一方法能在所有模型和场景中占据主导地位。

Conclusion: 自进化智能体应在真实任务流而非孤立的单任务设置下进行评估，并为跨模型和流式场景选择自进化方法提供了具体指导。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can self-evolve by continually improving from their own accumulated experience. However, existing studies predominantly adopt independent evaluation. Consequently, the behavior of self-evolving agents in realistic streaming settings, where agents adapt to diverse and complex task streams, remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we introduce AgentStream, a unified framework that evaluates self-evolving agents spanning diverse evolution components by organizing agentic benchmarks into a configurable task stream and instantiating the \texttt{Isolated}, \texttt{Sequential}, and \texttt{Interleaved} streaming scenarios at test time, which progressively vary the scope and domain composition of the stream. Over these scenarios, we combinatorially evaluate five representative self-evolving methods across three frontier foundation models, disentangling how model capability, method architecture, and streaming scenario jointly shape self-evolution. Our results show that self-evolution reliability varies across streaming scenarios, the benefit of self-evolution is gated by model capability and non-monotonic in model strength, and no single method dominates across models and scenarios. These findings offer concrete guidance for selecting self-evolving methods across models and streaming scenarios. Overall, we advocate that self-evolving agents should be evaluated under realistic task streams rather than isolated single-task settings.

</details>


### [423] [EduZone: A Framework for Evaluating LLM Safety for K-12 Students and Teachers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02024)
*Junyeong Park,Jieun Han,Haneul Yoo,So-Yeon Ahn,Jinsung Yoon,Alice Oh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了EduZone，一个面向K-12教育场景的LLM安全评估框架。该框架系统性地结合学生/教师使用场景、细粒度课程概念以及6大风险类别（含28个子类别），生成上下文相关的对抗性交互，并在单轮请求、静态多轮对话和动态多轮对话三种设置下评估了十个LLM在四个安全等级上的表现。结果表明模型对教育特定风险和动态多轮交互更为脆弱，现有安全护栏无法充分应对这些风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在K-12教育中的使用日益广泛，但现有的安全评估很少针对学生与教师与LLM交互中出现的有害或不适当内容进行考察，缺乏面向教育场景的系统性安全评估框架。

Method: EduZone框架通过三个维度的系统组合来生成上下文相关的对抗性交互：(1)学生和教师面向的LLM使用场景；(2)细粒度的课程概念；(3)涵盖传统和教育特定危害的6个风险类别及28个子类别。交互构建在三种设置下完成：单轮请求、静态多轮对话、动态多轮对话。评估使用四个安全等级：拒绝、安全协助、带安全指导的风险协助、完全风险协助，并对十个LLM进行评测。

Result: 实验发现模型对教育特定风险和动态多轮交互场景表现出更大的脆弱性，而现有安全护栏未能充分应对这些风险，暴露出当前LLM在教育场景中的安全短板。

Conclusion: EduZone提供了一个自动化、可扩展的评估框架，推动LLM在K-12教育中的安全发展，支持更安全LLM的开发和部署。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used across diverse tasks in K-12 education, yet existing safety evaluations rarely examine how harmful or inappropriate content appears in interactions between LLMs and students or teachers. To address this, we present EduZone, an evaluation framework for LLM safety across diverse educational scenarios. Our framework systematically combines (1) student- and teacher-facing LLM usage contexts, (2) fine-grained curriculum concepts, and (3) 6 risk categories and 28 subcategories spanning both conventional and education-specific harms to generate contextually grounded adversarial interactions. We construct these interactions in three settings: single-turn requests, static multi-turn conversations, and dynamic multi-turn conversations. Using these interactions, we evaluate ten LLMs using four safety levels: refusal, safe assistance, risky assistance with safety guidance, and fully risky assistance. Our results reveal greater vulnerability to education-specific risks and dynamic multi-turn interactions, while existing safety guardrails fail to adequately address these risks. EduZone advances LLM safety in education by providing an automated, scalable evaluation framework that supports the development and deployment of safer LLMs in K-12 education.

</details>


### [424] [TRACE-TS: Attribution-Grounded and Traceable Sensor-Language Reasoning for Human Activity Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00200)
*Sparsh Rastogi,Tanmay Kumar,Baiyu Chen,Jatin Bedi,Zechen Li,Flora D. Salim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TRACE-TS是一个用于可穿戴时间序列数据的结构化、信号可溯源推理框架。它利用专家分类器的归因机制识别关键时空传感器区域，构建带有显式证据来源的DAG推理轨迹，并通过门控交叉注意力训练紧凑语言模型生成这些轨迹。在推理时，模型同时输出活动预测和推理轨迹，无需归因计算或教师指导。在七个可穿戴基准上取得最优平均准确率和F1（84.43%/81.24%），比最佳LLM基线F1高17.96%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可穿戴传感器数据分析方法大多将信号简化为活动标签，虽然近期基于语言模型的方法能生成自然语言解释，但推理过程与底层信号之间缺乏强关联，导致生成的解释虽流畅却难以验证。

Method: 1) 利用专家分类器的归因机制识别显著的时空传感器区域；2) 基于这些区域构建带显式证据来源的DAG推理轨迹；3) 通过门控交叉注意力训练紧凑语言模型生成推理轨迹；4) 推理时联合输出活动预测与推理轨迹；5) 提出SNM（Semantic Node Match）指标，用LLM作为评判器，从观测、推理、综合三个层面诊断推理保真度。

Result: 在七个可穿戴基准上，TRACE-TS取得所有评估方法中最优的平均准确率和F1（84.43%/81.24%），比最佳LLM基线在F1上提升17.96%。

Conclusion: 通过将信号归因与语言模型推理轨迹结合，TRACE-TS实现了可验证、结构化的传感器数据推理，同时引入SNM指标弥补了标准NLG指标在定位幻觉观测和断裂证据链方面的不足。

Abstract: Wearable sensors capture fine-grained motion patterns that support rich behavioral understanding, yet most existing methods reduce these signals to activity labels. Recent LM-based approaches generate natural-language explanations for sensor data, but their reasoning is weakly grounded in the underlying signal, leading to fluent yet unverifiable explanations. We introduce TRACE-TS (Traceable Reasoning with Attribution-Grounded Evidence), a framework for structured and signal-grounded reasoning over wearable time series. TRACE-TS uses attribution from an expert classifier to identify salient spatio-temporal sensor regions, uses them to construct DAG reasoning traces with explicit evidence provenance, and trains a compact language model to generate these traces through gated cross-attention over sensor memory tokens. At inference, the adapted model jointly outputs the activity prediction and its reasoning trace, without requiring attribution computation or teacher guidance. We introduce Semantic Node Match(SNM), an LLM-as-judge metric that diagnoses reasoning fidelity at the observation, inference, and synthesis levels, localizing hallucinated observations and broken evidence chains missed by standard NLG metrics. Across seven wearable benchmarks, TRACE-TS achieves the best average accuracy and F1 among all evaluated methods (84.43%/81.24%), and outperforms the best LLM-based baseline by 17.96% in F1. Our code is available at https://github.com/SparshRastogi/TRACE-TS.

</details>


### [425] [MonitrLLM: A Community-Centered Evaluation Infrastructure for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02409)
*Victor Ojewale,Ro Encarnación,Suresh Venkatasubramanian,Danaé Metaxa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MonitrLLM，一个开源基础设施，用于将完整对话记录与用户报告的任务意图和结果评估相连接，作为LLM评估的主要信号。通过26名大学生为期两周的试点研究（206份评估报告），发现用户满意度（4.19/5）虽高但任务失败率达23.1%，且多轮对话失败率是单轮的2.5倍，表明现有评估方法的重大盲区。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM评估存在三方面断裂：基准测试评估受控任务但缺乏自然使用场景，大规模对话语料捕捉自然使用但缺少用户反馈，界面内反馈机制记录满意度但没有任务目标信息。三者均未将交互轨迹与用户定义的结果联系起来，形成了关键评估空白。

Method: 作者构建MonitrLLM开源基础设施，将完整对话转录、用户报告的任务意图和结果评估三者整合为同等重要的评估信号。通过26名大学生两周试点，收集206份包含完整对话转录的评估报告，分析满意率与任务失败率之间的差异、多轮与单轮对话的失败率差异。

Result: 研究发现尽管用户报告平均满意度高达4.19/5，但目标任务失败率达23.1%；多轮对话的失败率是单轮对话的2.5倍，提示扩展交互可能反映任务困难而非用户参与度。

Conclusion: 将直接用户反馈与观察数据结合可提供更稳健的LLM评估，现有以满意度为核心的评估可能显著高估模型性能。作者呼吁建立支持此类评估的基础设施，以社区为中心进行更真实的模型能力评测。

Abstract: Benchmark suites assess model capability on controlled tasks; large-scale conversation corpora capture naturalistic use without user feedback; and in-interface feedback mechanisms record satisfaction without task purpose. Together, they leave a critical gap in LLM evaluation: no existing infrastructure routinely links interaction trajectories to user-defined outcomes. We introduce MonitrLLM, open-source infrastructure for community-centered LLM evaluations that links full conversation transcripts to user-reported task intent and outcome assessments, treating all three as primary evaluative signals rather than optional metadata.
  To demonstrate the value of this approach, we conducted a two-week feasibility pilot with 26 college students using ChatGPT, collecting 206 evaluation reports with full conversation transcripts. The findings from our pilot demonstrate the value of connecting conversation trajectories with user-reported outcomes. For instance, despite reporting high average satisfaction (4.19/5) with their LLM interactions, participants also experience a substantial 23.1% failure rate on their goal tasks. We also find that multi-turn conversations are reported as failing at 2.5 times the rate of single-turn exchanges, a pattern that reframes extended interaction as a signal of difficulty rather than engagement. We conclude by discussing the value of incorporating direct user feedback with observational data for robust LLM evaluations, and the possibilities for infrastructure that enables this goal.

</details>


### [426] [Personalizing Large Language Model Agents with Small Policy Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00215)
*Dian Jin,Zhi Zhang,Huichao Li,Yihe Pan,Rundong Huang,Doudou Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出FABLE（因子化自适应Bandit层），一种轻量级策略层，用于在冻结的黑盒LLM代理外部实现个性化执行决策，通过在线学习用户特定的执行策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代理虽然能检索记忆、调用工具、询问澄清问题等，但将这些执行决策适配到个体用户仍然困难。微调独立LLM成本高昂或对专有系统不可行，而提示和记忆主要向代理暴露用户信息，而非从反馈中适配执行决策。

Method: FABLE将个性化形式化为在线学习逐用户执行策略问题，仅从已执行动作的标量反馈中学习。它通过三个关键设计：1）因子化记忆、信息获取和响应决策，使反馈更新相关选择；2）在探索前通过外部指定的可行集过滤动作；3）使用贝叶斯上下文汤普森采样学习用户特定残差偏好（相对于固定默认与成本评分）。

Result: 在线性残差奖励模型下，校准变体对最佳可行动作具有期望遗憾界。论文还刻画了持续可行性约束下不可识别的偏好，并提供随时有效的虚假晋升控制。在个性化推理、受控反馈和可执行工具使用评估中，FABLE在多项偏好敏感行为上优于仅规则控制，同时保持端到端任务性能的竞争力。

Conclusion: FABLE提供了一种轻量级、无需微调黑盒LLM代理的个性化方案，通过Bandit在线学习实现逐用户偏好适配，兼具理论保证和实证有效性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can retrieve memory, call tools, ask clarifying questions, and vary response style, yet adapting these execution decisions to an individual user remains difficult. Fine-tuning a separate LLM is costly or impossible for proprietary systems, while prompts and memory primarily expose user information to the agent rather than adapt its execution decisions from feedback. We formulate personalization of a frozen agent as online learning of a per-user execution policy from scalar feedback observed only for the executed action. We propose FABLE (Factorized Adaptive Bandit Layer for Execution), a lightweight policy layer outside a potentially black-box host agent. FABLE factorizes memory, information-acquisition, and response decisions so feedback updates related choices; filters actions through an externally specified feasible set before exploration; and learns user-specific residual preferences relative to a fixed default-and-cost score via Bayesian contextual Thompson sampling. Under a linear residual-reward model, a calibrated variant inherits an expected-regret bound against the best feasible action. We also characterize preferences unidentifiable under persistent feasibility constraints and provide anytime-valid false-promotion control. Across personalized-reasoning, controlled-feedback, and executable tool-use evaluations, FABLE improves several preference-sensitive behaviors relative to rule-only control while remaining competitive on end-to-end task performance.

</details>


### [427] [More Debate, Same Evidence: Structural Limits of Homogeneous Multi-Agent Groundedness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.00243)
*Yuelyu Ji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体LLM法官小组在事实核查/幻觉检测任务中的效果，发现与单智能体相比，三智能体小组在6个基准上准确率差异从+8.5到-4.4个百分点，仅2个数据集有显著提升，1个显著下降，3个无统计显著性，效果并不如预期般稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM法官越来越多地被组织成多智能体小组，假设通过交换批评意见可以提升判断质量。本文旨在检验这一假设在"事实核查"（groundedness verification）任务中是否成立，因为该任务有明确的客观答案，便于严格评估。

Method: 在6个公开的事实核查和幻觉检测基准上，评估一个同质的（homogeneous）三智能体小组，对比固定的单智能体参考系统，测量系统级准确率的差异。

Result: 小组相对单智能体的准确率差异范围从+8.5到-4.4个百分点。2个数据集有可靠提升，1个有可靠下降，3个在统计上不显著。且由于参考系统和小组使用不同模型变体，这些差异反映的是完整系统间差异，而非纯粹的辩论效应。

Conclusion: 多智能体小组的辩论并不总是提升判断质量，其效果因数据集而异，甚至可能降低准确率。未来的研究需要更严格地隔离辩论本身的因果效应。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) judges are increasingly organized as multi-agent panels under the assumption that exchanging critiques improves judgment quality. We test this assumption for \emph{groundedness verification}, where a judge must determine whether a claim is supported by the supplied evidence. We evaluate a homogeneous three-agent panel on six public fact-verification and hallucination-detection benchmarks. Relative to a fixed single-agent reference, the panel's system-level accuracy difference ranges from $+8.5$ to $-4.4$ percentage points: two datasets show reliable gains, one shows a reliable loss, and three are statistically inconclusive. Because the reference and panel use different model variants, these differences characterize the complete systems rather than isolate a causal debate effect.

</details>


### [428] [Magnet: Detecting Cross-Session AI Misuse Through Capability Accumulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02518)
*Natalie Isak,Matthew Dressman*

Main category: cs.AI
